area.m: 联想：阿瑞阿（area）→一大片地方→地区；领域
area.e: Rural areas often lack good public transport.
area.z: 农村地区往往缺乏良好的公共交通。

issue.m: is(出)+sue(走，同exit)→流出来的东西→发布；引出的问题
issue.e: Climate change is a major global issue.
issue.z: 气候变化是一个重大的全球问题。

community.m: com(共同)+mun(义务/分担)+ity(名词)→共同承担者→社区
community.e: The library serves the whole local community.
community.z: 这座图书馆服务于整个当地社区。

create.m: creat(生长，创造)+e→使生出来→创造
create.e: The project will create hundreds of new jobs.
create.z: 该项目将创造数百个新工作岗位。

research.m: re(反复)+search(寻找)→反复寻找→研究
research.e: Recent research shows that sleep improves memory.
research.z: 最近的研究表明睡眠能提升记忆力。

policy.m: polic(城邦，同police/politics)+y→治理城邦之道→政策
policy.e: The government introduced a new housing policy.
policy.z: 政府出台了一项新的住房政策。

process.m: pro(向前)+cess(走)→向前走的过程→过程；处理
process.e: Learning a language is a slow process.
process.z: 学习一门语言是一个缓慢的过程。

major.m: maj(大，同majesty)+or(比较级)→更大的→主要的
major.e: Traffic is a major problem in big cities.
major.z: 交通是大城市的一个主要问题。

require.m: re(再)+quire(寻求)→一再寻求→需要；要求
require.e: Most jobs require good communication skills.
require.z: 大多数工作都需要良好的沟通能力。

role.m: 联想：原指演员台词卷轴(roll)→所演的角色→作用
role.e: Parents play a key role in education.
role.z: 父母在教育中起着关键作用。

federal.m: feder(联盟，同confederation)+al(形容词)→联盟的→联邦的
federal.e: Federal funding for schools increased last year.
federal.z: 去年联邦对学校的拨款增加了。

couple.m: coupl(连接)+e→连在一起的两个→一对；夫妇
couple.e: A young couple moved in next door.
couple.z: 一对年轻夫妇搬到了隔壁。

site.m: sit(放置，位置)+e→所处之地→地点
site.e: The site was chosen for the new hospital.
site.z: 这块地点被选来建新医院。

project.m: pro(向前)+ject(扔)→向前抛出的设想→项目；预计
project.e: Sales are projected to rise next year.
project.z: 预计明年销售额会上升。

image.m: imag(模仿，像)+e→相像之物→形象；图像
image.e: The scandal damaged the company's image.
image.z: 这一丑闻损害了公司形象。

data.m: dat(给，同date)+a(复数)→给出的事实→数据
data.e: We collected data from over 500 students.
data.z: 我们收集了500多名学生的数据。

technology.m: techno(技艺)+logy(学问)→技艺之学→技术
technology.e: Technology has changed the way we work.
technology.z: 技术改变了我们的工作方式。

source.m: sour(升起，同surge)+ce→水涌出之处→源头；来源
source.e: The river is the main source of drinking water.
source.z: 这条河是饮用水的主要来源。

culture.m: cult(耕种)+ure(名词)→耕耘心灵→文化
culture.e: Food is an important part of any culture.
culture.z: 食物是任何文化的重要组成部分。

energy.m: en(在内)+erg(工作，同ergonomics)+y→内在做功能力→能量
energy.e: Solar energy is becoming cheaper every year.
energy.z: 太阳能每年都在变得更便宜。

period.m: peri(周围)+od(路)→绕一圈的路程→一段时期
period.e: The museum covers the Victorian period.
period.z: 这家博物馆涵盖维多利亚时期。

available.m: a(去)+vail(价值，有用)+able(能…的)→能用上的→可获得的
available.e: Free parking is available near the station.
available.z: 车站附近有免费停车位。

administration.m: ad(向)+minister(仆人，服务)+ation(名词)→为人服务→管理；行政
administration.z: 她在医院行政部门工作。

economy.e: Tourism is vital to the local economy.
economy.z: 旅游业对当地经济至关重要。

medical.m: medic(治疗)+al(形容词)→治疗的→医学的

involve.e: The job involves a lot of travel.
involve.z: 这份工作需要经常出差。

seek.m: 联想：seek与search同义，"四颗"眼睛到处找→寻求
seek.z: 许多毕业生到国外求职。

goal.m: 联想：足球"球门"→要射进的地方→目标
goal.e: Her goal is to study at Oxford.
goal.z: 她的目标是去牛津读书。

author.m: auct(增加，创造，同augment)+or(人)→创造者→作者
author.e: The author wrote three novels about war.
author.z: 这位作者写了三部关于战争的小说。

focus.m: 联想：拉丁语focus原指"炉膛"，家中的中心→焦点
focus.e: Students should focus on their weak areas.
focus.z: 学生应该专注于自己的薄弱环节。

series.m: ser(连接，串)+ies→串在一起的→系列
series.e: The BBC made a series about wildlife.
series.z: BBC制作了一部关于野生动物的系列片。

significant.m: sign(记号)+ific(使…)+ant(形容词)→做了记号的→重要的
significant.e: There was a significant rise in prices.

similar.e: The two cities have similar climates.

factor.m: fact(做)+or(物)→起作用的东西→因素
factor.e: Cost is a key factor in choosing a university.
factor.z: 费用是选择大学的关键因素。

decade.m: dec(十)+ade(名词，组)→十个一组→十年
decade.e: The city has grown rapidly over the past decade.
decade.z: 过去十年这座城市发展迅速。

despite.m: de(向下)+spite(看，同spect)→往下看，蔑视→不顾；尽管
despite.e: Despite the rain, the match went ahead.
despite.z: 尽管下雨，比赛照常进行。

approach.e: We need a new approach to teaching maths.
approach.z: 我们需要一种新的数学教学方法。

fund.e: The charity raises funds for local schools.
fund.z: 这家慈善机构为当地学校筹集资金。

occur.z: 大多数事故发生在家里。

media.m: medi(中间)+a(复数)→中间传递者→媒体
media.e: Social media shapes young people's opinions.
media.z: 社交媒体塑造着年轻人的观点。

individual.m: in(不)+divid(分开)+ual(形容词)→不可再分的→个人
individual.e: Each individual has the right to vote.

resource.m: re(再)+source(源泉)→可一再涌出的源泉→资源
resource.e: Water is a precious natural resource.
resource.z: 水是一种宝贵的自然资源。

identify.m: ident(相同，同identity)+ify(使)→确认是同一个→识别
identify.e: Scientists identified the cause of the disease.
identify.z: 科学家们确认了这种疾病的病因。

indicate.e: The results indicate a clear trend.
indicate.z: 结果表明了一个明显的趋势。

region.m: reg(统治，同regal)+ion(名词)→统治的范围→地区
region.e: The region is famous for its wine.
region.z: 这个地区以葡萄酒闻名。

physical.m: physic(自然，同physics)+al(形容词)→自然界/身体的
physical.z: 经常锻炼身体可以减轻压力。

benefit.m: bene(好)+fit(做，同fact)→做好事→好处；受益
benefit.z: 锻炼对健康有很多好处。

section.m: sect(切)+ion(名词)→切下的一块→部分
section.e: Read the first section of the report.
section.z: 请阅读报告的第一部分。

authority.m: author(创造者)+ity(名词)→创始者的权力→权威；当局
authority.e: Local authorities are responsible for rubbish collection.
authority.z: 地方当局负责垃圾收集。

design.m: de(加强)+sign(记号)→标出记号→设计
design.e: The building has a modern design.
design.z: 这座建筑采用现代设计。

strategy.m: strat(军队)+egy(带领)→领兵之术→策略
strategy.e: The company needs a new marketing strategy.
strategy.z: 公司需要新的营销策略。

environment.m: en(使…在)+viron(环绕)+ment(名词)→周围环绕的→环境

remove.e: Please remove your shoes before entering.

network.m: net(网)+work(工作，制品)→编织物→网络
network.e: The city has an excellent rail network.
network.z: 这座城市有出色的铁路网络。

legal.e: Driving at sixteen is legal in some countries.
legal.z: 在一些国家十六岁开车是合法的。

final.e: The final exam is in June.

establish.m: e(加强)+stabl(站稳，同stable)+ish(动词)→使稳固→建立

expert.m: ex(出)+pert(尝试，同experience)→试过很多的人→专家
expert.e: Experts warn about rising sea levels.
expert.z: 专家警告海平面正在上升。

theory.m: theor(观看，思考，同theatre)+y→观察思考所得→理论
theory.e: Darwin developed the theory of evolution.

impact.m: im(向内)+pact(压紧)→撞进去→冲击；影响
impact.e: Tourism has a huge impact on the island.
impact.z: 旅游业对该岛影响巨大。

respond.m: re(回)+spond(承诺，同sponsor)→回应承诺→回应
respond.e: The council responded quickly to complaints.
respond.z: 市议会迅速回应了投诉。

maintain.e: It is hard to maintain a healthy diet.

reveal.m: re(反)+veal(面纱，同veil)→揭开面纱→揭示
reveal.z: 调查揭示了令人惊讶的结果。

structure.m: struct(建造)+ure(名词)→建造的方式→结构
structure.e: The structure of the essay is very clear.
structure.z: 这篇文章结构非常清晰。

affect.z: 噪音会影响孩子的注意力。

style.m: 联想：原指古人写字的尖笔(stylus)→笔法→风格
style.e: I like the style of her paintings.

adult.m: ad(向)+ult(生长，同adolescent)→已长大的→成年人
adult.e: Adults need about eight hours of sleep.
adult.z: 成年人大约需要八小时睡眠。

range.m: 联想：rang(排，同rank)+e→排成一列伸展开→范围
range.e: The shop sells a wide range of books.
range.z: 这家店出售种类繁多的书籍。

specific.m: speci(种类，看)+fic(做)→特定种类的→具体的

challenge.m: 联想：原义"诽谤、指控"，向人叫阵→挑战
challenge.e: Climate change is a global challenge.
challenge.z: 气候变化是一个全球性挑战。

method.m: meta(沿着)+hod(道路)→遵循的路子→方法
method.z: 这种教学方法效果很好。

generation.m: gener(产生)+ation(名词)→生出的一代→一代人
generation.e: The younger generation uses smartphones constantly.
generation.z: 年轻一代经常使用智能手机。

item.m: 联想：拉丁语item意为"同样，还有"，清单逐条列举→项目；物品
item.e: Each item on the menu costs ten pounds.

task.m: tax(税)变体→分派的劳役→任务
task.e: Cleaning is a boring but necessary task.
task.z: 打扫卫生是一项无聊但必要的任务。

partner.m: part(部分)+ner(人)→分享一部分的人→伙伴

positive.m: posit(放置)+ive(形容词)→明确放下的→肯定的；积极的
positive.e: Exercise has a positive effect on mood.
positive.z: 锻炼对情绪有积极影响。

civil.e: Civil rights are protected by law.

debate.m: de(加强)+bate(打，同battle)→激烈交锋→辩论
debate.e: There is a debate about school uniforms.
debate.z: 关于校服存在一场争论。

assume.m: as(向)+sume(拿取，同consume)→拿来当作→假定；承担
assume.e: Don't assume everyone agrees with you.
assume.z: 不要假定每个人都同意你。

professional.m: profess(公开声明)+ion+al(形容词)→公开宣称从事某业的→专业的

option.e: Online courses are a popular option for adults.
option.z: 网课是成年人的热门选择。

access.e: Everyone should have access to clean water.
access.z: 每个人都应能获得干净的水。

publish.m: publ(公众，同public)+ish(动词)→公之于众→出版
publish.e: The study was published in a medical journal.
publish.z: 这项研究发表在一本医学期刊上。

release.m: re(回)+lease(放松，同relax)→放开→释放；发布
release.e: The company will release a new phone soon.
release.z: 公司很快将发布一款新手机。

credit.m: cred(相信，同credible)+it→被相信→信用；功劳
credit.e: She deserves credit for her hard work.
credit.z: 她的辛勤工作值得称赞。

version.m: vers(转)+ion(名词)→转换后的样子→版本
version.e: The film is a modern version of Hamlet.
version.z: 这部电影是《哈姆雷特》的现代版本。

income.e: Many families live on a low income.
income.z: 许多家庭靠微薄收入生活。

achieve.m: a(向)+chieve(头，顶端，同chief)→到达顶端→实现
achieve.e: She achieved her dream of becoming a doctor.
achieve.z: 她实现了成为医生的梦想。

attitude.m: 联想：apt(适合，同aptitude)变体+itude→身体姿态→态度
attitude.e: A positive attitude helps you learn faster.
attitude.z: 积极的态度帮助你学得更快。

concept.m: con(一起)+cept(拿)→把想法抓在一起→概念
concept.e: The concept of time differs across cultures.

conduct.m: con(一起)+duct(引导)→带领→进行；实施
conduct.e: Researchers conducted a survey of 1,000 people.
conduct.z: 研究人员对1000人进行了调查。

nuclear.e: Some countries are closing their nuclear power stations.
nuclear.z: 一些国家正在关闭核电站。

conflict.m: con(一起)+flict(打击)→互相打击→冲突
conflict.e: The conflict lasted for ten years.

feature.m: feat(做，同fact)+ure(名词)→做成的样子→特征
feature.e: The phone's best feature is its camera.
feature.z: 这款手机最大的特点是摄像头。

define.m: de(加强)+fin(界限)+e→划定界限→定义
define.e: It is difficult to define happiness.

element.m: 联想：拉丁elementum"基本成分"，"爱了门的"基础→要素
element.e: Trust is an essential element of friendship.
element.z: 信任是友谊的基本要素。

status.z: 医生享有很高的社会地位。

normal.m: norm(规范，木匠角尺)+al(形容词)→合规范的→正常的
normal.e: It is normal to feel nervous before exams.

survey.m: sur(在上)+vey(看，同view)→从上往下看→调查
survey.e: A recent survey asked students about stress.
survey.z: 最近一项调查询问学生关于压力的情况。

tradition.m: tra(=trans，跨越)+dit(给)+ion→代代传下去→传统
tradition.e: Giving gifts is a Christmas tradition.

potential.m: pot(能力，同potent)+ent+ial(形容词)→有能力的→潜在的
potential.e: The town has great potential for tourism.
potential.z: 这个小镇有很大的旅游潜力。

contract.m: con(一起)+tract(拉)→拉到一起→合同；收缩
contract.e: Metal contracts when it gets cold.

previous.m: pre(先)+vi(路，同via)+ous(形容词)→先走过路的→以前的
previous.e: She had no previous experience in teaching.

target.m: 联想：源自古法语targe"小圆盾"→射击用的盾形靶→目标
target.e: The government set a target for reducing emissions.

text.m: text(编织，同textile)→编织成的文字→文本
text.e: Read the text carefully and answer the questions.
text.z: 仔细阅读文本并回答问题。

vehicle.m: veh(运载)+icle(小东西)→运载工具→车辆
vehicle.e: Electric vehicles are becoming more common.

emerge.m: e(出)+merge(沉入)→从水里冒出→出现
emerge.e: New problems emerged during the project.
emerge.z: 项目期间出现了新问题。

contribute.m: con(一起)+tribut(给予)+e→共同给出→贡献

promote.m: pro(向前)+mote(移动，同motion)→推向前→促进
promote.z: 这项活动推广健康饮食。

technique.e: He learned new painting techniques in Paris.
technique.z: 他在巴黎学到了新的绘画技巧。

principle.m: prin(第一，同prime)+cip(拿)+le→首先拿住的→原则
principle.e: Honesty is a basic principle of business.
principle.z: 诚信是商业的基本原则。

survive.e: Few animals survive in the desert.
survive.z: 很少有动物能在沙漠中存活。

aspect.e: Money is only one aspect of a job.
aspect.z: 钱只是工作的一个方面。

annual.e: The festival is an annual event.
annual.z: 这个节日是一年一度的活动。

comment.m: com(加强)+ment(心智，同mental)→用心思考说出→评论
comment.e: He made a comment about the weather.

demonstrate.m: de(加强)+monstr(显示，同monster)+ate→清楚显示→证明
demonstrate.e: The study demonstrates the value of reading.
demonstrate.z: 这项研究证明了阅读的价值。

document.m: doc(教导，同doctor)+ument(名词)→用来教导的凭证→文件
document.e: Please sign the document at the bottom.

commit.m: com(加强)+mit(送，同transmit)→交付出去→承诺；犯罪
commit.e: Young people who commit crimes need support.
commit.z: 犯罪的年轻人需要帮助。

deny.m: de(加强)+ny(否定，同negative)→完全说不→否认

perspective.e: Travel gives you a new perspective on life.
perspective.z: 旅行让你对生活有新的视角。

intelligence.m: intel(=inter，之间)+lig(选择，读)+ence→在其中辨别→智力
intelligence.e: Intelligence is not only about exam scores.

grade.m: grad(步，级，同graduate)+e→一级一级→等级；成绩
grade.e: She got a good grade in maths.

context.m: con(一起)+text(编织)→织在一起的上下文→语境
context.e: Guess the word's meaning from context.

aware.m: a(加强)+ware(小心，同beware)→留心的→意识到的
aware.e: People are more aware of health risks today.
aware.z: 如今人们更加意识到健康风险。

function.m: funct(执行)+ion(名词)→执行的作用→功能
function.e: The main function of the heart is pumping blood.
function.z: 心脏的主要功能是泵血。

category.m: 联想：希腊语kategoria"指控，断言"→对事物的断定归类→类别
category.e: The books are sorted into categories.

academic.m: 联想：源自柏拉图讲学的Academy学园→学术的
academic.e: Academic writing requires a formal style.
academic.z: 学术写作需要正式的文体。

contact.m: con(一起)+tact(接触，同tactile)→相互接触→联系
contact.z: 请通过电子邮件联系我们。

participate.e: All students are encouraged to participate.

tape.m: 联想：谐音"胎布"，一条长布带→胶带；磁带
tape.e: Fix the poster with some tape.

appropriate.m: ap(向)+propri(自己的，同property)+ate→变为己用的→合适的
appropriate.e: Jeans are not appropriate for a job interview.
appropriate.z: 穿牛仔裤去面试不合适。

democracy.m: demo(人民)+cracy(统治)→人民统治→民主
democracy.e: Free elections are central to democracy.
democracy.z: 自由选举是民主的核心。

primary.m: prim(第一)+ary(形容词)→第一位的→主要的；初级的
primary.e: Her primary concern is her children's safety.
primary.z: 她最关心的是孩子的安全。

domestic.m: dom(家，同dome)+estic(形容词)→家里的→国内的
domestic.e: Domestic flights are cheaper than international ones.
domestic.z: 国内航班比国际航班便宜。

expand.m: ex(向外)+pand(展开)→向外展开→扩大
expand.e: The company plans to expand into Asia.

corporate.m: corpor(身体，团体)+ate(形容词)→团体的→公司的
corporate.e: He left corporate life to become a teacher.
corporate.z: 他离开公司生活当了老师。

mental.m: ment(心智)+al(形容词)→心智的→精神的

obtain.e: You must obtain a visa before travelling.
obtain.z: 出行前你必须获得签证。

complex.m: com(一起)+plex(编织，折叠)→编在一起→复杂的
complex.e: The human brain is extremely complex.

predict.e: Experts predict that prices will rise.

aid.m: 联想：与help同义，"爱的"援助→帮助
aid.e: The country received foreign aid after the flood.
aid.z: 洪灾后该国接受了外国援助。

code.m: 联想：源自拉丁codex"法典"→规则汇编→准则；代码
code.e: The school has a strict dress code.
code.z: 学校有严格的着装规定。

acknowledge.m: ac(加强)+knowledge(知道)→公开表示知道→承认

theme.m: 联想：希腊语thema"放下的东西"→摆出的话题→主题
theme.e: Love is the main theme of the novel.

prime.z: 安全是我们的首要关注点。

conclude.m: con(加强)+clude(关闭，同close)→结束→得出结论
conclude.e: The report concludes that more funding is needed.
conclude.z: 报告得出结论，需要更多资金。

shift.m: 联想：发音像"失(去)服"→换衣服→转变；轮班
shift.e: There has been a shift towards online shopping.

revenue.m: re(回)+ven(来)+ue→回来的钱→收入；税收
revenue.e: Tourism brings in huge revenue for the city.
revenue.z: 旅游业为这座城市带来大量收入。

locate.m: loc(地方，同local)+ate(动词)→确定地方→位于；找到
locate.e: The hotel is located near the beach.
locate.z: 这家酒店位于海滩附近。

obvious.m: ob(在前)+vi(路)+ous(形容词)→就在路前面→明显的
obvious.z: 现在答案似乎很明显了。

trend.m: 联想：原义"转弯"，形近turn→转向的方向→趋势
trend.e: There is a growing trend of working from home.
trend.z: 居家办公的趋势日益增强。

notion.m: not(知道，同note)+ion(名词)→所知→概念；看法
notion.e: I reject the notion that money brings happiness.
notion.z: 我不认同金钱带来幸福的看法。

unique.m: uni(一)+que(形容词)→唯一的→独特的
unique.z: 每个人的指纹都是独一无二的。

internal.e: The company is facing internal problems.

ethnic.m: ethn(民族，希腊语ethnos)+ic(形容词)→民族的
ethnic.z: 伦敦有许多民族风味餐馆。

link.m: 联想：铁"链"(link)的一环→连接→联系
link.e: There is a link between diet and health.
link.z: 饮食和健康之间存在联系。

stress.m: 联想：源自distress(苦恼)的缩略→压力；强调
stress.e: Exams cause a lot of stress for students.
stress.z: 考试给学生带来很大压力。

select.e: Ten students were selected for the team.

appreciate.m: ap(向)+preci(价值，同precious)+ate→给出价值→欣赏；感激

file.m: fil(线，同filament)+e→用线串起的文书→文件
file.e: Save the file before closing the program.
file.z: 关闭程序前请保存文件。

outcome.e: The outcome of the election surprised everyone.
outcome.z: 选举结果令所有人吃惊。

ensure.e: Please ensure all windows are closed.
ensure.z: 请确保所有窗户都已关闭。

component.m: com(一起)+pon(放)+ent→放到一起的部分→组成部分
component.e: Exercise is a key component of a healthy life.
component.z: 锻炼是健康生活的重要组成部分。

contrast.e: In contrast, rural areas are quieter.
contrast.z: 相比之下，农村地区更安静。

capacity.m: cap(拿，容纳，同capture)+acity(名词)→能装的量→容量；能力
capacity.e: The stadium has a capacity of 60,000.

estate.m: 联想：与state同源，"所处的状态"→财产状况→地产
estate.e: He works for a real estate company.
estate.z: 他在一家房地产公司工作。

circumstance.m: circum(周围)+st(站)+ance→站在周围的东西→情况
circumstance.e: Under no circumstances should you cheat.
circumstance.z: 无论如何你都不应作弊。

pursue.e: She wants to pursue a career in law.

estimate.m: 联想：与esteem(尊重，估价)同源→估价→估计
estimate.e: Experts estimate the cost at two million pounds.
estimate.z: 专家估计费用为两百万英镑。

investigate.m: in(进入)+vestig(足迹)+ate→循足迹追查→调查
investigate.z: 警方正在调查这起事故。

gender.m: gen(种类，出生)+der→生来的类别→性别
gender.e: Pay should not depend on gender.

fee.e: The course fee includes all materials.
fee.z: 课程费用包括所有材料。

eliminate.m: e(出)+limin(门槛，同limit)+ate→赶出门槛→消除
eliminate.e: We must eliminate waste in the system.
eliminate.z: 我们必须消除系统中的浪费。

regime.m: reg(统治)+ime→统治方式→政权；制度
regime.e: The new regime introduced strict laws.
regime.z: 新政权颁布了严格的法律。

confirm.e: Please confirm your booking by email.
confirm.z: 请通过电子邮件确认预订。

rely.m: re(加强)+ly(捆绑，同ligament)→紧紧绑在→依赖
rely.e: Many people rely on public transport.

topic.m: top(地方，希腊语topos)+ic→讨论之处→话题
topic.e: Climate is a hot topic in IELTS essays.
topic.z: 气候是雅思作文的热门话题。

bond.m: bond(捆绑，同band/bind)→绑在一起→纽带；债券
bond.e: There is a strong bond between the sisters.

grant.m: 联想：与guarantee同源，"担保给予"→授予；拨款
grant.e: The university received a research grant.
grant.z: 这所大学获得了一笔研究拨款。

volume.e: The volume of traffic has doubled.

cite.m: cit(唤起，召唤)+e→召唤出来→引用
cite.e: Always cite your sources in essays.
cite.z: 写论文时一定要注明出处。

welfare.e: The state provides welfare for the unemployed.
welfare.z: 国家为失业者提供福利。

overall.e: Overall, the project was a success.
overall.z: 总体而言，这个项目是成功的。

initial.m: init(开始，进入)+ial(形容词)→开头的→最初的
initial.e: Our initial plan was too expensive.
initial.z: 我们最初的计划太贵了。

contemporary.m: con(共同)+tempor(时间)+ary→同一时代的→当代的
contemporary.z: 这家画廊展出当代艺术。

sector.m: sect(切)+or→切出的一块→部门；行业
sector.e: The service sector employs most workers.
sector.z: 服务业雇用了大部分工人。

faculty.m: fac(做，同facile)+ulty(名词)→做事的能力→才能；院系
faculty.e: She joined the Faculty of Law last year.

liberal.e: He holds liberal views on education.
liberal.z: 他在教育方面持开明观点。

decline.m: de(向下)+cline(倾斜)→向下倾→下降；谢绝

invest.m: in(进入)+vest(衣服，同vest)→给穿上衣→投入资金→投资
invest.e: The government should invest in education.

expose.e: Children are exposed to many advertisements.
expose.z: 孩子们接触到大量广告。

reject.e: The council rejected the building plan.
reject.z: 市议会否决了这项建筑计划。

assess.m: as(在旁)+sess(坐)→坐在旁边评判→评估
assess.e: Teachers assess students' progress every term.
assess.z: 教师每学期评估学生的进步。

acquire.m: ac(加强)+quire(寻求)→寻求到手→获得

technical.e: The flight was delayed by a technical problem.

plus.e: The ticket costs ten pounds plus tax.

alternative.m: alter(另一个)+n+ative(形容词)→二者择另一→替代的
alternative.e: Cycling is a healthy alternative to driving.
alternative.z: 骑自行车是开车的健康替代方式。

curriculum.m: curr(跑，同current)+iculum→跑道→学习的进程→课程
curriculum.e: Music should be part of the school curriculum.
curriculum.z: 音乐应成为学校课程的一部分。

priority.m: prior(在先的)+ity(名词)→排在前面→优先事项
priority.z: 安全是我们的头等大事。

recover.m: 源自拉丁recuperare：re(回)+取→把失去的取回→恢复
recover.e: It took him months to recover from the illness.
recover.z: 他花了几个月才从病中康复。

schedule.m: 联想：源自拉丁schedula"小纸条"→写在纸条上的安排→日程

brief.m: 联想：与abbreviate(缩写)同源，表"短"→简短的
brief.e: He gave a brief speech at the wedding.
brief.z: 他在婚礼上作了简短致辞。

visual.e: Visual aids make lectures easier to follow.
visual.z: 视觉辅助工具让讲座更容易理解。

perceive.m: per(完全)+ceive(拿，取)→完全领会→察觉；认为
perceive.e: Many people perceive cities as unsafe.
perceive.z: 许多人认为城市不安全。

layer.e: The ozone layer protects us from the sun.
layer.z: 臭氧层保护我们免受阳光伤害。

abandon.m: a(向)+bandon(控制，权力)→交出控制权→放弃
abandon.e: They abandoned the plan due to costs.
abandon.z: 他们因成本问题放弃了该计划。

transform.m: trans(转变)+form(形状)→改变形状→转变

tension.e: There is tension between the two countries.

consist.m: con(一起)+sist(站)→站在一起→由…组成
consist.e: The team consists of five members.
consist.z: 这个团队由五名成员组成。

enable.e: The internet enables people to work remotely.
enable.z: 互联网使人们能远程工作。

error.e: There is an error in your calculation.

atmosphere.m: atmo(蒸气)+sphere(球体)→包裹地球的气→大气层；氛围
atmosphere.e: Carbon dioxide traps heat in the atmosphere.
atmosphere.z: 二氧化碳将热量困在大气中。

cycle.e: Recycling is part of the product life cycle.
cycle.z: 回收是产品生命周期的一部分。

resolve.e: The two sides resolved their dispute.

phase.m: 联想：希腊语phasis"显现"，月相一阶段一阶段显现→阶段
phase.e: The project is now in its final phase.
phase.z: 项目现在处于最后阶段。

philosophy.e: The company's philosophy is customer first.
philosophy.z: 公司的理念是客户至上。

quote.m: 联想：原义"标注章节编号"→注明出处→引用
quote.e: He quoted a famous line from Shakespeare.
quote.z: 他引用了莎士比亚的一句名言。

foundation.e: Reading is the foundation of all learning.
foundation.z: 阅读是一切学习的基础。

implement.m: im(进入)+ple(填满，同complete)+ment→填满实现→实施
implement.e: The school will implement the new rules in May.
implement.z: 学校将在五月实施新规定。

intense.m: in(加强)+tense(伸展，拉紧)→绷得很紧→激烈的

adjust.e: It takes time to adjust to a new culture.

visible.m: vis(看)+ible(能…的)→看得见的→可见的
visible.e: The mountain is visible from the city.

dominate.m: domin(主人，统治)+ate(动词)→做主→主导
dominate.e: A few companies dominate the market.
dominate.z: 少数几家公司主导着市场。

transfer.m: trans(转移)+fer(带，同ferry)→带到别处→转移

attach.m: at(向)+tach(钉，同tack)→钉上去→附加；重视
attach.e: Please attach a photo to your application.
attach.z: 请在申请表上附一张照片。

prospect.m: pro(向前)+spect(看)→向前看到的→前景
prospect.e: The job prospects for engineers are good.
prospect.z: 工程师的就业前景很好。

fundamental.m: fund(底)+ament+al(形容词)→底部的→根本的
fundamental.e: Education is a fundamental human right.

enhance.m: en(使)+hance(高，源自拉丁altus)→使变高→提高
enhance.e: Good lighting can enhance a room.
enhance.z: 良好的照明能为房间增色。

impose.m: im(在上)+pose(放)→放在上面→强加；征收
impose.e: The government imposed a tax on sugar.

evaluate.e: We need to evaluate the results carefully.
evaluate.z: 我们需要仔细评估结果。

symbol.m: sym(一起)+bol(扔)→扔在一起比对的信物→象征
symbol.e: The dove is a symbol of peace.

emphasis.m: em(在内)+phas(显示)+is→突出显示→强调
emphasis.e: The course places emphasis on speaking.

illustrate.e: The graph illustrates changes in population.
illustrate.z: 这张图说明了人口的变化。

monitor.m: mon(提醒，同admonish)+itor(人/物)→提醒者→监测
monitor.e: Doctors monitor the patient's heart rate.

concentrate.m: con(共同)+centr(中心)+ate→聚集到中心→集中
concentrate.e: I can't concentrate with loud music.
concentrate.z: 音乐太吵我无法集中注意力。

vary.e: Prices vary from shop to shop.

commission.m: com(加强)+miss(送)+ion→交付出去的任务→委托；委员会
commission.e: The government set up a commission to study crime.
commission.z: 政府成立了一个委员会研究犯罪问题。

constant.m: con(始终)+st(站)+ant→一直站着不变→持续的
constant.e: The city suffers from constant traffic noise.
constant.z: 这座城市饱受持续的交通噪音之苦。

capable.m: cap(拿，容纳)+able(能…的)→能拿得住的→有能力的
capable.e: She is capable of running the business alone.
capable.z: 她有能力独自经营这家企业。

crucial.m: cruc(十字，同cross)+ial→处在十字路口的→至关重要的
crucial.e: Sleep is crucial for good health.

objective.m: ob(对着)+ject(扔)+ive→扔在面前的东西→目标；客观的

dimension.m: di(=dis，分开)+mens(测量)+ion→量出的尺寸→维度
dimension.e: The problem has a social dimension.

peer.m: 联想：与par(同等)同源→同等的人→同龄人
peer.e: Teenagers are strongly influenced by their peers.
peer.z: 青少年深受同龄人影响。

accompany.e: Children must be accompanied by an adult.

publication.m: publ(公众)+ic+ation(名词)→公之于众之物→出版物
publication.e: The magazine is a monthly publication.

phenomenon.m: phen(显现，同phase)+omenon→显现出来的东西→现象
phenomenon.e: Global warming is a worldwide phenomenon.
phenomenon.z: 全球变暖是一种全球现象。

assist.e: Volunteers assist elderly people with shopping.

secure.m: se(离开)+cure(担心，同curious的cura)→没有担忧→安全的
secure.e: She finally secured a job in London.
secure.z: 她终于在伦敦找到了一份工作。

apparent.m: ap(向)+par(出现，同appear)+ent→出现在眼前→明显的
apparent.e: It became apparent that he was lying.

channel.m: 联想：与canal(运河)同源→水道→渠道；频道
channel.e: Email is the main channel of communication.
channel.z: 电子邮件是主要的沟通渠道。

restore.e: The old castle has been restored.

assure.e: I assure you the food is fresh.
assure.z: 我向你保证食物是新鲜的。

criteria.m: crit(判断，同critic)+eria(复数)→判断的依据→标准

via.e: We flew to Sydney via Singapore.
via.z: 我们经新加坡飞往悉尼。

nevertheless.m: never(决不)+the+less(更少)→并不因此减少→然而
nevertheless.e: It was raining; nevertheless, we went out.
nevertheless.z: 天在下雨，但我们还是出去了。

incorporate.m: in(进入)+corpor(身体)+ate→纳入体内→纳入
incorporate.z: 这个设计融入了太阳能板。

ultimate.m: ultim(最远，同ultra)+ate→最远端的→最终的
ultimate.e: Our ultimate goal is zero waste.
ultimate.z: 我们的最终目标是零浪费。

minor.m: min(小，同mini)+or(比较级)→较小的→次要的

assign.m: as(向)+sign(记号)→标出给某人→分配
assign.e: The teacher assigned us an essay.
assign.z: 老师给我们布置了一篇论文。

classic.m: class(等级)+ic→一流等级的→经典的
classic.e: Pride and Prejudice is a classic novel.
classic.z: 《傲慢与偏见》是一部经典小说。

chemical.m: chem(化学，源自alchemy)+ical(形容词)→化学的
chemical.e: Farmers use chemicals to protect crops.
chemical.z: 农民使用化学品保护庄稼。

label.m: 联想：古法语"布条"→贴在物品上的布条→标签
label.e: Always read the label before buying food.
label.z: 买食品前一定要看标签。

index.m: in(向)+dex(指示，同indicate)→指向→索引；指数
index.e: The price index rose by two percent.

advocate.m: ad(向)+voc(声音，喊)+ate→为之呼喊→提倡

draft.m: 联想：与draw(拉，画)同源→画出的初稿→草稿
draft.e: I wrote the first draft of my essay.

drama.m: 联想：希腊语drama"行动，表演"→戏剧

roughly.m: rough(粗糙的)+ly(副词)→粗略地→大约
roughly.e: Roughly half the students live on campus.
roughly.z: 大约一半学生住在校内。

react.e: How did your parents react to the news?
react.z: 你父母对这个消息有什么反应？

communicate.z: 青少年主要通过应用程序交流。

mechanism.m: mechan(机器，同machine)+ism→机器的运作→机制
mechanism.e: The body has a natural defence mechanism.
mechanism.z: 人体有天然的防御机制。

proceed.m: pro(向前)+ceed(走)→向前走→继续进行

occupy.e: Offices occupy most of the building.
occupy.z: 办公室占据了大楼的大部分。

retain.e: The town has retained its old charm.
retain.z: 小镇保留了古老的魅力。

incentive.m: in(进入)+cent(唱，同chant)+ive→唱起来鼓劲→激励
incentive.e: Tax cuts give businesses an incentive to invest.

accurate.m: ac(加强)+cur(关心，同cure)+ate→用心做的→准确的
accurate.e: Weather forecasts are more accurate today.
accurate.z: 如今天气预报更准确了。

whereas.m: where(在那里)+as(正如)→而在那边→然而；而
whereas.e: Cats are independent, whereas dogs need attention.
whereas.z: 猫很独立，而狗需要关注。

elite.e: Only the elite could afford higher education.
elite.z: 只有精英才负担得起高等教育。

chart.m: 联想：与card(卡片)同源→画在纸片上→图表
chart.e: The chart shows sales over five years.
chart.z: 这张图表显示了五年来的销售情况。

interpret.m: inter(在…之间)+pret(价格，交易)→在两方间说合→解释
interpret.e: It is hard to interpret these figures.

detect.m: de(去掉)+tect(遮盖)→揭开遮盖→发现
detect.e: The test can detect cancer early.
detect.z: 这项检测能及早发现癌症。

guarantee.m: 联想：与warrant(担保)同源，"瓜软题"也能保过→保证
guarantee.e: The product comes with a two-year guarantee.

journal.m: journ(日，同法语jour)+al→每日记录→日志；期刊
journal.e: She published her findings in a scientific journal.
journal.z: 她在一本科学期刊上发表了研究成果。

mode.e: Trains are a green mode of transport.
mode.z: 火车是一种绿色交通方式。

imply.m: im(进入)+ply(折叠)→折在里面→暗示

finance.e: She works in finance in London.
finance.z: 她在伦敦从事金融工作。

diverse.m: di(分开)+vers(转)+e→转向不同方向→多样的
diverse.e: London is a culturally diverse city.
diverse.z: 伦敦是一座文化多元的城市。

relevant.m: re(加强)+lev(举起，同lever)+ant→举起相助的→相关的
relevant.e: Your answer is not relevant to the question.

conservation.z: 野生动物保护需要更多资金。

justify.m: just(正当)+ify(使)→使正当→证明…合理
justify.z: 任何理由都不能为暴力开脱。

considerable.m: consider(考虑)+able→值得考虑的→相当大的
considerable.e: The plan costs a considerable amount of money.
considerable.z: 这个计划花费相当多的钱。

prior.m: pri(前，同prime)+or(比较级)→更前的→先前的

constitute.m: con(一起)+stitut(站，建立)+e→一起立起来→构成
constitute.e: Women constitute half of the workforce.

alter.m: alter(另一个，同alternative)→变成另一个→改变
alter.z: 天气改变了我们的计划。

convert.e: The old factory was converted into flats.

comprehensive.m: com(全部)+prehens(抓住)+ive→全部抓住→全面的
comprehensive.e: The report gives a comprehensive overview.

stable.m: sta(站)+ble(能…的)→站得住的→稳定的
stable.e: The patient is now in a stable condition.

emission.e: Cars are a major source of carbon emissions.
emission.z: 汽车是碳排放的主要来源。

radical.z: 这个体制需要彻底改革。

adapt.m: ad(向)+apt(适合)→使适合→适应；改编

distribute.e: Volunteers distributed food to the homeless.
distribute.z: 志愿者向无家可归者分发食物。

instance.m: in(在上)+st(站)+ance→站在眼前的事→例子
instance.e: For instance, many students work part-time.

framework.e: The law provides a framework for protection.
framework.z: 这项法律提供了保护框架。

chapter.m: 联想：源自拉丁capitulum"小头"，与capital同源→书的小标题→章节
chapter.e: Read chapter three before the seminar.

carbon.e: Trees absorb carbon from the air.

consume.m: con(加强)+sume(拿，取)→全拿掉→消耗；消费
consume.e: Americans consume a lot of sugar.

scheme.m: 联想：希腊语skhema"形状，计划"，同schema→方案
scheme.e: The government launched a recycling scheme.
scheme.z: 政府推出了一项回收计划。

trace.m: tract(拉)变体→拉出的痕迹→痕迹；追溯
trace.e: The custom can be traced back to Roman times.
trace.z: 这一习俗可追溯到罗马时代。

uniform.m: uni(一)+form(形状)→统一形式→统一的；制服

scholarship.m: scholar(学者)+ship(名词)→学者身份→奖学金；学术
scholarship.e: He won a scholarship to study in Australia.
scholarship.z: 他获得了去澳大利亚留学的奖学金。

derive.e: Many English words derive from Latin.
derive.z: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语。

privacy.m: priv(个人，单独，同private)+acy(名词)→个人的状态→隐私
privacy.e: Social media can threaten our privacy.
privacy.z: 社交媒体可能威胁我们的隐私。

proportion.e: A large proportion of students work part-time.
proportion.z: 很大比例的学生做兼职。

guideline.m: guide(指引)+line(线)→指引线→指导方针
guideline.e: Follow the safety guidelines at all times.

ratio.m: rat(计算，同rate)+io→计算出的比→比率
ratio.e: The ratio of teachers to students is one to twenty.

controversial.m: contro(=contra，相反)+vers(转)+ial→转向对立面→有争议的
controversial.e: Nuclear power remains a controversial issue.
controversial.z: 核电仍是一个有争议的问题。

sufficient.m: suf(在下)+fic(做)+ient→在下面做足→充足的
sufficient.e: There is not sufficient evidence to prove it.
sufficient.z: 没有足够的证据证明这一点。

modest.m: mod(尺度)+est→有分寸的→适度的；谦虚的
modest.e: Prices rose by a modest two percent.

scope.e: This topic is beyond the scope of the essay.
scope.z: 这个话题超出了本文的范围。

principal.m: prin(第一)+cip(拿)+al→占第一位的→主要的
principal.e: The principal cause of the fire was faulty wiring.
principal.z: 火灾的主要原因是电线故障。

sequence.m: sequ(跟随，同consequence)+ence→一个跟一个→顺序
sequence.e: Put the pictures in the correct sequence.
sequence.z: 把图片按正确顺序排好。

register.e: You must register for the course online.
register.z: 你必须在网上注册这门课。

heritage.m: herit(继承，同inherit)+age(名词)→继承之物→遗产
heritage.e: The old town is part of our cultural heritage.
heritage.z: 老城是我们文化遗产的一部分。

submit.m: sub(在下)+mit(送)→从下面递上去→提交

anticipate.e: We anticipate a rise in visitor numbers.
anticipate.z: 我们预计游客数量会增加。

furthermore.e: Furthermore, the plan will save money.
furthermore.z: 此外，这个计划还能省钱。

distinct.m: di(分开)+stinct(刺，标记)→刺上记号分开→明显不同的
distinct.e: The two words have distinct meanings.
distinct.z: 这两个词有不同的含义。

subsequent.m: sub(在下，随后)+sequ(跟随)+ent→随后跟着的→随后的
subsequent.z: 随后的研究证实了这些结果。

exceed.e: Demand exceeds supply in the housing market.

widespread.m: wide(宽)+spread(展开)→广为散布的→广泛的
widespread.e: The use of smartphones is widespread.
widespread.z: 智能手机的使用很普遍。

adequate.m: ad(向)+equ(相等)+ate→达到相等的→足够的
adequate.z: 许多学校缺乏足够的资金。

exhibit.e: The gallery exhibits works by local artists.
exhibit.z: 画廊展出当地艺术家的作品。

reinforce.e: The bridge was reinforced with steel.

formula.m: form(形式)+ula(小)→小的固定形式→公式
formula.e: There is no simple formula for success.

attribute.e: He attributes his success to hard work.

highlight.e: The report highlights the need for reform.
highlight.z: 报告强调了改革的必要。

hypothesis.m: hypo(在下)+thesis(放置，论点)→放在下面的假定→假设
hypothesis.z: 这个实验检验了该假设。

compound.m: com(一起)+pound(放，同component)→放在一起→复合的
compound.e: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.

integrate.e: Immigrants need time to integrate into society.
integrate.z: 移民需要时间融入社会。

export.e: China exports goods all over the world.
export.z: 中国向世界各地出口商品。

evident.m: e(出)+vid(看)+ent→看得出来的→明显的
evident.e: It is evident that the plan has failed.
evident.z: 很明显这个计划失败了。

logic.m: log(言语，理性，同logo)+ic→说理之学→逻辑
logic.e: I can't follow the logic of his argument.
logic.z: 我理解不了他论证的逻辑。

unemployment.m: un(不)+employ(雇用)+ment(名词)→没被雇用→失业
unemployment.e: Youth unemployment is a serious problem.
unemployment.z: 青年失业是一个严重问题。

reverse.e: It is hard to reverse climate change.

initiate.e: The council initiated a tree-planting project.
initiate.z: 市议会发起了一项植树项目。

lecture.e: The professor gave a lecture on economics.
lecture.z: 教授做了一场经济学讲座。

restrict.z: 一些国家限制互联网访问。

enforce.e: Police must enforce the speed limit.
enforce.z: 警察必须执行限速规定。

inevitable.m: in(不)+e(出)+vit(避免)+able→无法避开的→不可避免的
inevitable.e: Change is inevitable in any organisation.
inevitable.z: 任何组织中变化都是不可避免的。

motive.e: Money is not his only motive.

consult.m: 联想：con(一起)+sult(源自consulere"商议")→一起商议→咨询
consult.e: You should consult a doctor first.

infrastructure.m: infra(在下)+structure(结构)→下层结构→基础设施
infrastructure.e: The city needs better transport infrastructure.
infrastructure.z: 这座城市需要更好的交通基础设施。

random.m: 联想："乱的母"(random)→乱来的→随机的

domain.m: dom(主人，统治，同dominate)+ain→主人的领地→领域

minimum.e: The minimum wage rose this year.

hence.m: 联想：古英语"从这里"(hence=from here)→由此→因此
hence.e: The road is closed, hence the delay.

ideology.m: ideo(观念，同idea)+logy(学说)→观念学说→意识形态
ideology.z: 政治意识形态影响经济政策。

virtual.m: virtu(力量，同virtue)+al→有实效的(非实体)→虚拟的
virtual.e: Students can take a virtual tour of the campus.
virtual.z: 学生可以虚拟参观校园。

modify.m: mod(尺度，方式)+ify(使)→使合尺度→修改
modify.e: The plan was modified after feedback.
modify.z: 计划根据反馈作了修改。

accommodate.m: ac(向)+com(一起)+mod(尺度)+ate→使合适→容纳；适应
accommodate.z: 这家酒店可容纳200位客人。

injure.m: in(不)+jur(法律，正当)+e→不正当对待→伤害
injure.e: Two people were injured in the accident.

currency.m: curr(跑，流通)+ency(名词)→流通之物→货币
currency.e: The euro is the currency of many countries.
currency.z: 欧元是许多国家的货币。

pension.m: pens(支付，称量，同expense)+ion→定期支付→养老金
pension.e: Many elderly people live on a pension.
pension.z: 许多老人靠养老金生活。

identical.m: ident(相同)+ical(形容词)→完全相同的
identical.z: 这对双胞胎长得一模一样。

precise.m: pre(在前)+cis(切，同scissors)+e→预先切准→精确的
precise.z: 我们需要精确的测量数据。

sum.m: 联想：拉丁summa"最高处"，古人从下往上加→总数
sum.e: A large sum of money was donated.

thereby.e: He saved money, thereby reducing his debt.
thereby.z: 他存了钱，从而减少了债务。

sharply.m: sharp(锐利的，急剧的)+ly(副词)→急剧地
sharply.e: House prices rose sharply last year.

bias.m: 联想：原指"斜线"，看问题歪斜→偏见
bias.e: The report shows a clear bias against women.
bias.z: 这份报告显示出明显的对女性的偏见。

entity.m: ent(存在，同essence)+ity(名词)→存在物→实体
entity.e: The company is a separate legal entity.
entity.z: 该公司是一个独立的法律实体。

isolate.e: Patients with the virus were isolated.
isolate.z: 感染该病毒的患者被隔离。

dynamic.e: Hong Kong is a dynamic city.
dynamic.z: 香港是一座充满活力的城市。

prohibit.m: pro(在前)+hibit(拿，持有)→挡在前面→禁止
prohibit.e: Smoking is prohibited in public places.

abstract.m: abs(离开)+tract(拉)→抽离出来→抽象的

cooperate.m: co(共同)+oper(工作，同operate)+ate→一起工作→合作
cooperate.e: The two countries agreed to cooperate.

undertake.m: under(在下)+take(承担)→接手下来→承担
undertake.e: She undertook a study of local schools.
undertake.z: 她承担了一项当地学校的研究。

output.e: Factory output fell by ten percent.

toxic.m: 联想：希腊语toxikon"涂在箭上的毒"→有毒的
toxic.z: 一些塑料会释放有毒化学物质。

rocket.m: 联想：火箭(rocket)直冲上天→猛增
rocket.e: Fuel prices have rocketed this year.

input.e: The project needs input from local residents.
input.z: 这个项目需要当地居民的参与。

equip.m: 联想：源自古法语"装备船只"→装备
equip.e: The lab is equipped with modern computers.
equip.z: 实验室配备了现代计算机。

neutral.m: neutr(两者都不，拉丁neuter)+al→不偏向任何一方→中立的
neutral.e: Switzerland stayed neutral during the war.
neutral.z: 瑞士在战争期间保持中立。

flexible.m: flex(弯曲)+ible(能…的)→能弯曲的→灵活的
flexible.z: 许多员工想要弹性工作时间。

ministry.m: minister(仆人，服务)+y→为国服务的机构→（政府）部
ministry.e: The Ministry of Education announced new rules.

instruct.m: in(进入)+struct(建造)→在脑中建造→指导
instruct.e: The teacher instructed us to read quietly.

manipulate.z: 广告商操纵我们的情感。

practitioner.m: practi(实践，同practice)+tion+er(人)→实践的人→从业者
practitioner.e: A medical practitioner checked the patient.
practitioner.z: 一位执业医生给病人做了检查。

subsidy.m: sub(在下)+sid(坐)+y→坐在下面托底→补贴
subsidy.e: Farmers receive subsidies from the government.

insert.m: in(进入)+sert(放，连接，同series)→放进去→插入
insert.e: Insert your card into the machine.

equivalent.m: equi(相等)+val(价值)+ent→价值相等的→相等的
equivalent.e: One mile is equivalent to 1.6 kilometres.

interact.m: inter(相互)+act(行动)→相互作用→互动
interact.e: Children learn by interacting with others.
interact.z: 孩子们通过与他人互动来学习。

legislature.m: legis(法律)+lat(提出，带来)+ure→制定法律的机构→立法机关
legislature.e: The legislature passed a new tax law.
legislature.z: 立法机关通过了一项新税法。

exploit.m: ex(出)+ploit(折叠，同ply)→展开利用→开发；剥削
exploit.z: 一些公司剥削廉价劳动力。

consent.m: con(共同)+sent(感觉，同sense)→感觉一致→同意
consent.e: Patients must give consent before surgery.
consent.z: 手术前病人必须表示同意。

comprise.m: com(一起)+prise(拿，抓)→抓在一起→包含
comprise.z: 这个班由三十名学生组成。

ecological.m: eco(家，生态)+log(学)+ical→生态学的→生态的
ecological.z: 塑料造成严重的生态破坏。

unprecedented.m: un(没有)+pre(先)+ced(走)+ent+ed→没有先例的→史无前例的
unprecedented.z: 这座城市经历了前所未有的发展。

behalf.m: be(在)+half(一边)→站在某人一边→代表
behalf.e: I am writing on behalf of my company.

cease.e: The factory ceased production last year.

rational.e: We need a rational discussion about immigration.
rational.z: 我们需要理性地讨论移民问题。

dip.m: 联想：dip"蘸一下"，往下一沉→小幅下降
dip.z: 三月份销售额略有下降。

sole.e: He was the sole survivor of the crash.
sole.z: 他是空难中唯一的幸存者。

commodity.m: com(加强)+mod(尺度，合适)+ity→合用之物→商品

transport.m: trans(穿过)+port(运)→运过去→交通；运输
transport.e: Public transport is cheap in this city.
transport.z: 这座城市的公共交通很便宜。

interval.m: inter(在…之间)+val(墙，同wall)→两墙之间→间隔
interval.z: 公交车每隔十分钟一班。

bulk.m: 联想：发音像"包裹"，鼓鼓一大包→大量；大部分
bulk.e: The bulk of the work is done online.
bulk.z: 大部分工作在网上完成。

voluntary.m: vol(意愿，同volunteer)+untary→出于意愿的→自愿的
voluntary.e: Attendance at the event is voluntary.
voluntary.z: 参加这次活动是自愿的。

valid.m: val(强，有价值)+id→有效力的→有效的
valid.e: Your passport must be valid for six months.
valid.z: 你的护照必须有六个月有效期。

tourism.e: Tourism is the island's main industry.
tourism.z: 旅游业是该岛的主要产业。

globe.e: Students come from all over the globe.

undergraduate.m: under(低于)+graduate(毕业生)→尚未毕业的→本科生
undergraduate.e: She is an undergraduate at Cambridge.
undergraduate.z: 她是剑桥大学的本科生。

surveillance.m: sur(在上)+veill(看，警戒)+ance→从上监视→监控
surveillance.e: Surveillance cameras are everywhere in the city.
surveillance.z: 城市里到处都是监控摄像头。

explicit.e: The instructions were clear and explicit.

coordinate.m: co(共同)+ordin(顺序，同order)+ate→排入同一秩序→协调
coordinate.e: She coordinates volunteers at the hospital.
coordinate.z: 她负责协调医院的志愿者。

transit.m: trans(穿过)+it(走)→走过去→运输；中转
transit.e: The goods were damaged in transit.

specify.m: speci(种类，具体)+fy(使)→使具体→具体说明

seminar.m: 联想：semin(种子，同semen)+ar→播种思想的苗圃→研讨会
seminar.e: We have a history seminar every Tuesday.
seminar.z: 我们每周二有一节历史研讨课。

sustainable.m: sus(在下)+tain(握)+able→托得住的→可持续的
sustainable.e: We need more sustainable sources of energy.
sustainable.z: 我们需要更多可持续能源。

summary.m: sum(总和)+mary(名词)→总起来说的→总结
summary.e: Write a short summary of the article.
summary.z: 写一篇这篇文章的简短摘要。

overseas.m: over(越过)+seas(海)→越过大海→海外的
overseas.e: More students choose to study overseas.
overseas.z: 越来越多学生选择出国留学。

extract.e: Oil is extracted from the seabed.

compensate.m: com(一起)+pens(称量，支付)+ate→同等称量→补偿
compensate.e: The airline compensated passengers for the delay.
compensate.z: 航空公司就延误向乘客作出赔偿。

clarify.e: Could you clarify what you mean?
clarify.z: 你能澄清一下你的意思吗？

accumulate.e: Dust accumulates quickly in old houses.
accumulate.z: 老房子里灰尘积得很快。

intervene.m: inter(在…之间)+ven(来)+e→来到中间→干预
intervene.e: The government should intervene in the housing market.
intervene.z: 政府应该干预住房市场。

literacy.m: liter(文字，同literature)+acy(名词)→识字状态→读写能力
literacy.e: Literacy rates have risen across Africa.
literacy.z: 非洲各地的识字率已经提高。

greenhouse.m: green(绿色)+house(房子)→养绿植的房子→温室
greenhouse.z: 温室气体导致全球变暖。

parliament.m: parl(说话，同法语parler)+iament→议事之处→议会
parliament.e: Parliament will vote on the bill next week.
parliament.z: 议会将于下周就该法案投票。

addiction.m: ad(向)+dict(说)+ion→宣判归属于→沉溺→上瘾
addiction.e: Smartphone addiction is common among teenagers.
addiction.z: 手机成瘾在青少年中很常见。

paradigm.m: para(在旁)+digm(显示)→摆在旁边示范的→范式
paradigm.e: The discovery led to a paradigm shift in science.
paradigm.z: 这一发现引发了科学范式的转变。

hierarchy.m: hier(神圣)+archy(统治)→神职等级统治→等级制度
hierarchy.e: The army has a strict hierarchy.
hierarchy.z: 军队有严格的等级制度。

pesticide.m: pest(害虫)+i+cide(杀，同suicide)→杀害虫的→杀虫剂
pesticide.e: Organic farms do not use chemical pesticides.
pesticide.z: 有机农场不使用化学农药。

notably.e: Some countries, notably Japan, have ageing populations.
notably.z: 一些国家，尤其是日本，人口老龄化。

reside.m: re(后，留)+side(坐，同sit)→坐下不走→居住
reside.e: Most of the population resides in cities.
reside.z: 大部分人口居住在城市。

empirical.m: em(在内)+pir(尝试，同experience)+ical→亲身尝试的→实证的
empirical.e: There is little empirical evidence for this claim.
empirical.z: 这一说法几乎没有实证依据。

attain.z: 很少有学生取得最高分。

hazardous.e: Smoking is hazardous to your health.

parameter.m: para(在旁)+meter(测量)→旁边辅助的度量→参数
parameter.e: The study set clear parameters for the survey.
parameter.z: 这项研究为调查设定了明确的范围。

correspond.m: cor(共同)+respond(回应)→相互回应→符合；通信
correspond.e: The results correspond with earlier findings.
correspond.z: 结果与先前的发现一致。

successor.m: suc(在下，随后)+cess(走)+or(人)→随后跟来的人→继任者
successor.e: The manager chose her successor carefully.
successor.z: 经理谨慎地选定了她的继任者。

contrary.e: Contrary to popular belief, bats are not blind.
contrary.z: 与普遍看法相反，蝙蝠并不瞎。

precede.e: A short talk preceded the dinner.
precede.z: 晚宴前有一个简短的讲话。

substitute.m: sub(在下，替代)+stitut(站，放)+e→放在下面顶替→代替
substitute.e: You can substitute honey for sugar.

presume.m: pre(预先)+sume(拿)→预先拿来当真→假定
presume.e: I presume you have read the report.
presume.z: 我想你已经看过这份报告了。

ignorance.e: Many problems are caused by ignorance.
ignorance.z: 许多问题是由无知造成的。

wetland.e: Wetlands provide homes for many birds.
wetland.z: 湿地为许多鸟类提供栖息地。

recycle.m: re(再)+cycle(循环)→再循环→回收利用
recycle.e: We recycle paper, glass and plastic.
recycle.z: 我们回收纸张、玻璃和塑料。

tuition.m: tuit(看护，同tutor)+ion→照看教导→教学；学费

revise.m: re(再)+vis(看)+e→再看一遍→修改；复习
revise.e: I need to revise for my exams.

parallel.m: para(在旁)+llel(彼此，希腊allelon)→彼此并排→平行的
parallel.e: The road runs parallel to the river.

incidence.m: in(在上)+cid(落下)+ence(名词)→落到身上的事→发生率
incidence.e: The incidence of diabetes has risen sharply in recent decades.
incidence.z: 近几十年来糖尿病的发病率急剧上升。

rebound.e: House prices rebounded quickly after the recession.
rebound.z: 经济衰退后房价迅速反弹。

paragraph.m: para(旁边)+graph(写)→写在旁边的分段记号→段落
paragraph.e: Each paragraph should focus on one main idea.
paragraph.z: 每个段落应集中于一个中心思想。

analogy.m: ana(按照)+log(比例,道理)+y(名词)→按比例对照→类比
analogy.e: The teacher used an analogy to explain electricity.
analogy.z: 老师用一个类比来解释电。

erosion.m: e(出,掉)+ros(咬,啃)+ion(名词)→被啃掉→侵蚀
erosion.e: Trees help prevent soil erosion on hillsides.
erosion.z: 树木有助于防止山坡水土流失。

thesis.m: 源自希腊语 thesis(放置)→放出来的观点→论点；论文
thesis.e: She is writing her thesis on urban poverty.
thesis.z: 她正在写关于城市贫困的论文。

ozone.m: 源自希腊语 ozein(发出气味)→有特殊气味的气体→臭氧
ozone.e: The ozone layer protects us from harmful radiation.
ozone.z: 臭氧层保护我们免受有害辐射。

intake.m: in(进)+take(拿)→拿进来的量→摄入量
intake.e: Doctors advise reducing your daily sugar intake.
intake.z: 医生建议减少每日糖摄入量。

marginal.m: margin(边缘)+al(形容词)→在边缘的→微小的；边缘的
marginal.e: The new policy had only a marginal effect on unemployment.
marginal.z: 新政策对失业率只有微小影响。

kindergarten.m: 德语 Kinder(孩子)+Garten(花园)→孩子的花园→幼儿园
kindergarten.e: My daughter started kindergarten this September.
kindergarten.z: 我女儿今年九月上幼儿园了。

compost.m: com(一起)+post(放)→放在一起堆起来→堆肥
compost.e: Many households turn kitchen waste into compost.
compost.z: 许多家庭把厨余垃圾变成堆肥。

offset.m: off(离开)+set(放置)→放到另一边去抵→抵消
offset.e: Planting trees can offset some carbon emissions.
offset.z: 植树可以抵消部分碳排放。

exaggerate.m: ex(出,加强)+agger(堆)+ate(动词)→堆得过高→夸大
exaggerate.e: The media often exaggerate the risks of flying.
exaggerate.z: 媒体常常夸大乘飞机的风险。

differentiate.m: different(不同的)+iate(动词)→使不同→区分
differentiate.e: Children learn to differentiate colours at an early age.
differentiate.z: 孩子很小就学会区分颜色。

underestimate.m: under(低于)+estimate(估计)→估计低了→低估
underestimate.e: Never underestimate the value of a good education.
underestimate.z: 永远不要低估良好教育的价值。

clause.m: 源自拉丁语 claudere(关闭)→封闭的一小段→条款；从句
clause.e: The contract contains a clause on early termination.
clause.z: 合同里有一条关于提前终止的条款。

prestigious.m: prestige(声望)+ious(形容词)→有声望的→有名望的
prestigious.e: She won a place at a prestigious university.

migrate.e: Many birds migrate south for the winter.
migrate.z: 许多鸟类向南迁徙过冬。

orient.m: ori(升起)+ent→太阳升起的方向(东方)→定向；使适应
orient.e: New students need time to orient themselves on campus.
orient.z: 新生需要时间熟悉校园。

coincide.m: co(共同)+in(在上)+cide(落下)→一起落下→同时发生；一致
coincide.e: The festival coincides with the school holidays.
coincide.z: 这个节日正好赶上学校放假。

flawed.e: The study was flawed because the sample was too small.
flawed.z: 这项研究有缺陷，因为样本太小。

implicit.m: im(向内)+plic(折叠)+it→折在里面的→含蓄的；隐含的
implicit.e: There was an implicit criticism in his remarks.
implicit.z: 他的话里含有隐晦的批评。

referendum.m: re(回)+fer(带)+endum(须…的事)→须带回给民众决定的事→全民公投
referendum.e: The country held a referendum on independence.
referendum.z: 该国就独立问题举行了全民公投。

complement.m: com(加强)+ple(填满)+ment(名词)→填满补全→补充；补足物
complement.e: Exercise is a good complement to a healthy diet.
complement.z: 锻炼是健康饮食的良好补充。

allocate.m: al(去)+loc(地方)+ate(动词)→分配到各处→分配
allocate.e: The government allocated more money to education.
allocate.z: 政府向教育拨了更多资金。

definite.m: de(加强)+fin(界限)+ite(形容词)→界限分明的→明确的
definite.e: We need a definite answer by Friday.
definite.z: 我们需要在周五前得到明确答复。

discriminate.m: dis(分开)+crimin(区分,判断)+ate(动词)→分开对待→歧视；区分
discriminate.e: It is illegal to discriminate against job applicants by age.
discriminate.z: 因年龄歧视求职者是违法的。

displace.m: dis(离开)+place(位置)→使离开原位→取代；使流离失所
displace.e: The floods displaced thousands of families.
displace.z: 洪水使数千个家庭流离失所。

gradual.m: grad(步,级)+ual(形容词)→一步一步的→逐渐的
gradual.e: There has been a gradual rise in temperatures.

contradict.m: contra(相反)+dict(说)→说反话→反驳；与…矛盾
contradict.z: 这些结果与早期研究相矛盾。

landfill.m: land(土地)+fill(填)→用垃圾填地→垃圾填埋场
landfill.e: Most plastic waste ends up in landfill.
landfill.z: 大多数塑料垃圾最终进了填埋场。

dispose.m: dis(分开)+pos(放)+e→分开放置处理→处理；丢弃(of)

conform.m: con(共同)+form(形状)→和大家同一形状→遵从；符合
conform.e: Teenagers often feel pressure to conform.
conform.z: 青少年常常感到从众的压力。

inequality.e: Income inequality has widened in many countries.
inequality.z: 许多国家的收入不平等加剧了。

coherent.m: co(共同)+her(粘)+ent(形容词)→粘在一起的→连贯的
coherent.e: Your essay needs a clear and coherent argument.
coherent.z: 你的文章需要清晰连贯的论证。

ambiguous.m: ambi(两边)+gu(驱动,走)+ous(形容词)→两边都能走的→模棱两可的
ambiguous.e: The question was ambiguous, so students answered differently.
ambiguous.z: 这道题有歧义，所以学生答案各不相同。

confer.m: con(共同)+fer(带)→带到一起商量→商议；授予
confer.e: The university conferred an honorary degree on her.

obesity.e: Childhood obesity is a growing public health problem.
obesity.z: 儿童肥胖是日益严重的公共卫生问题。

terminate.m: termin(界限,终点)+ate(动词)→到终点→终止
terminate.e: The company terminated his contract early.
terminate.z: 公司提前终止了他的合同。

sewage.m: sewer(下水道)+age(名词)→下水道里的东西→污水
sewage.e: Untreated sewage was pumped into the river.
sewage.z: 未经处理的污水被排入河中。

eventual.m: event(结果,发生)+ual(形容词)→最终发生的→最终的
eventual.e: The eventual cost was twice the original estimate.
eventual.z: 最终费用是最初估算的两倍。

renewable.m: re(再)+new(新)+able(能…的)→能再更新的→可再生的
renewable.e: Solar power is a clean, renewable energy source.
renewable.z: 太阳能是清洁的可再生能源。

pollutant.e: Cars release pollutants into the air.
pollutant.z: 汽车向空气排放污染物。

amend.m: a(去除)+mend(缺陷)→去掉缺陷→修改(法律等)
amend.e: Parliament voted to amend the law.
amend.z: 议会投票修改了这项法律。

inhibit.m: in(向内)+hibit(拿住)→拿住不让出→抑制
inhibit.e: Stress can inhibit your ability to learn.
inhibit.z: 压力会抑制你的学习能力。

arbitrary.m: arbitr(仲裁人)+ary(形容词)→凭仲裁人个人意志→任意的；武断的
arbitrary.z: 这个决定似乎完全是武断的。

runoff.e: Farm runoff can pollute nearby rivers.
runoff.z: 农田径流会污染附近河流。

underlie.m: under(在下)+lie(躺)→躺在下面→构成…的基础
underlie.z: 贫困是许多社会问题的根源。

implicate.m: im(向内)+plic(折叠)+ate(动词)→卷进去→牵连
implicate.e: The report implicated several senior officials.
implicate.z: 报告牵连了几名高级官员。

constrain.m: con(加强)+strain(拉紧)→拉紧不放→限制；约束
constrain.e: Lack of funding constrains our research.
constrain.z: 资金不足限制了我们的研究。

degradation.m: de(向下)+grad(级)+ation(名词)→降级→退化；恶化
degradation.z: 环境退化威胁着许多物种。

offshore.m: off(离开)+shore(岸)→离岸的→近海的；境外的
offshore.e: The company is building an offshore wind farm.
offshore.z: 该公司正在建一个海上风电场。

biodiversity.m: bio(生命)+diversity(多样性)→生物多样性
biodiversity.z: 热带雨林生物多样性丰富。

convene.m: con(共同)+ven(来)+e→一起来→召集；集会
convene.e: The committee will convene next month.
convene.z: 委员会将于下月召开会议。

compute.m: com(一起)+put(计算,思考)+e→合起来算→计算
compute.e: The software can compute results in seconds.
compute.z: 这个软件能在几秒内算出结果。

glacier.e: The glacier has shrunk by half since 1950.
glacier.z: 自1950年以来这条冰川缩小了一半。

simulate.e: Pilots train in machines that simulate real flights.
simulate.z: 飞行员在模拟真实飞行的设备中训练。

dropout.m: drop(掉)+out(出)→掉出去的人→辍学者
dropout.e: The school has a high dropout rate.

institute.m: in(在内)+stitut(站立,设立)+e→设立起来的→机构；设立
institute.e: She works at a research institute in London.
institute.z: 她在伦敦一家研究所工作。

equate.e: Many people equate success with wealth.
equate.z: 许多人把成功等同于财富。

humidity.e: High humidity makes the heat feel worse.
humidity.z: 高湿度让炎热感觉更难受。

diploma.m: 希腊语 diploma(对折的纸)→折起来的公文→毕业文凭
diploma.e: He received his diploma in nursing last year.
diploma.z: 他去年获得了护理专业文凭。

electorate.m: elector(选举人)+ate(集体名词)→全体选民
electorate.e: The electorate is increasingly concerned about housing.
electorate.z: 选民越来越关注住房问题。

persuasive.m: persuade(说服)+ive(形容词)→有说服力的
persuasive.e: She made a persuasive case for longer holidays.
persuasive.z: 她为延长假期提出了很有说服力的理由。

overtake.m: over(越过)+take(拿)→超过去→超过；赶上
overtake.e: China may overtake the US as the largest economy.
overtake.z: 中国可能超越美国成为最大经济体。

congestion.m: con(一起)+gest(带,运)+ion(名词)→堆运在一起→拥堵
congestion.e: Traffic congestion is a major problem in big cities.
congestion.z: 交通拥堵是大城市的主要问题。

tutor.m: tut(看护,保护)+or(人)→监护人→导师；家教
tutor.e: She hired a tutor to help with maths.

ostensibly.m: ostens(展示)+ible(可…的)+ly(副词)→表面展示出来的→表面上
ostensibly.e: The trip was ostensibly for business.
ostensibly.z: 这次出行表面上是为了公务。

infer.m: in(向内)+fer(带)→把意思带进来→推断
infer.e: What can we infer from these data?
infer.z: 从这些数据我们能推断出什么？

dissertation.m: dis(分开)+sert(连接,排列)+ation(名词)→分条排列论述→学位论文
dissertation.e: He spent a year on his master's dissertation.
dissertation.z: 他花了一年写硕士论文。

misguided.m: mis(错误)+guide(引导)+ed(形容词)→被引错方向的→误入歧途的
misguided.e: It is misguided to judge a school only by exam results.
misguided.z: 只凭考试成绩评判学校是错误的。

statistic.m: stat(国家,状态)+istic→国情数据→统计数据
statistic.e: One shocking statistic is that one in five children is poor.
statistic.z: 一项惊人的统计是五分之一的儿童贫困。

finite.m: fin(界限)+ite(形容词)→有界限的→有限的
finite.e: The earth has finite natural resources.
finite.z: 地球的自然资源是有限的。

denote.m: de(加强)+note(标记)→标记出→表示；指代
denote.e: The red line denotes the city boundary.

discrete.m: dis(分开)+cre(分辨,筛)+te→分辨开的→离散的；独立的
discrete.e: The course is divided into discrete units.
discrete.z: 课程分为若干独立单元。

markedly.e: Crime rates have fallen markedly this year.

accreditation.m: ac(去)+credit(信任)+ation(名词)→给予信任→认证；认可
accreditation.e: The college finally received official accreditation.
accreditation.z: 这所学院终于获得了官方认证。

thaw.m: 联想：读音像“扫”，太阳一扫，冰雪就化了→解冻
thaw.e: The ground begins to thaw in early spring.

simplistic.m: simple(简单的)+istic(形容词)→过于简单化的
simplistic.e: This is a simplistic view of a complex problem.
simplistic.z: 这是对复杂问题过于简单化的看法。

attainment.m: attain(达到)+ment(名词)→达到的成就→成就；学业成绩
attainment.e: Parental support affects students' educational attainment.
attainment.z: 家长支持影响学生的学业成绩。

noticeably.m: notice(注意)+able(可…的)+ly(副词)→能被注意到地→显著地
noticeably.e: The air is noticeably cleaner after the rain.

rainforest.e: The Amazon is the world's largest rainforest.
rainforest.z: 亚马孙是世界上最大的雨林。

predominant.m: pre(在前)+domin(统治)+ant(形容词)→占统治地位的→主要的
predominant.e: English is the predominant language of science.
predominant.z: 英语是科学界的主要语言。

precipitation.m: pre(向前)+cipit(头)+ation(名词)→头朝前栽下→降水
precipitation.e: Annual precipitation here is very low.

approximate.m: ap(去)+proxim(接近)+ate→去接近→大约的；近似
approximate.e: The approximate cost is two thousand pounds.

bullying.z: 学校必须严肃对待欺凌问题。

appendix.m: ap(去)+pend(悬挂)+ix→挂在后面的→附录；阑尾
appendix.e: Further data are given in the appendix.

negate.e: High costs may negate the benefits of the scheme.
negate.z: 高成本可能抵消该计划的好处。

marginally.m: marginal(边缘的,微小的)+ly(副词)→略微地
marginally.e: Prices rose only marginally last month.

pedagogy.m: ped(儿童)+agog(引导)+y(名词)→引导儿童→教学法
pedagogy.z: 现代教学法鼓励主动学习。

tundra.m: 源自萨米语/俄语 tundra(无树的高地)→冻原
tundra.e: Few trees can survive in the Arctic tundra.
tundra.z: 北极冻原上几乎没有树能存活。

legislate.m: legis(法律)+late(带来,提出)→提出法律→立法
legislate.e: The government plans to legislate against plastic bags.
legislate.z: 政府计划立法禁止塑料袋。

fluctuate.m: fluctu(波浪,流动)+ate(动词)→像波浪起伏→波动
fluctuate.e: Oil prices fluctuate from week to week.

analyse.m: ana(彻底)+lys(分解,松开)+e→彻底分解→分析
analyse.e: Researchers analysed data from over 2,000 schools.
analyse.z: 研究人员分析了两千多所学校的数据。

aggregate.m: ag(去)+greg(群)+ate→聚成一群→合计；总数
aggregate.e: The team with the highest aggregate score wins.

smog.e: Beijing used to suffer from heavy smog in winter.
smog.z: 北京过去冬天常遭受严重雾霾。

extracurricular.e: Students should take part in extracurricular activities.

deduce.m: de(向下)+duc(引导)+e→往下引出→推论；演绎
deduce.e: From the evidence, we can deduce that he was lying.
deduce.z: 从证据可以推断他在撒谎。

deforestation.m: de(去除)+forest(森林)+ation(名词)→去除森林→砍伐森林
deforestation.e: Deforestation is a major cause of climate change.
deforestation.z: 砍伐森林是气候变化的主要原因之一。

sedentary.m: sed(坐)+entary(形容词)→总坐着的→久坐不动的
sedentary.e: A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of heart disease.
sedentary.z: 久坐的生活方式增加患心脏病的风险。

deviate.m: de(离开)+via(道路)+ate(动词)→离开道路→偏离
deviate.e: The plane had to deviate from its usual route.
deviate.z: 飞机不得不偏离常规航线。

immigrate.m: im(向内)+migr(移动)+ate(动词)→移入→移民入境
immigrate.e: His parents immigrated to Canada in the 1990s.
immigrate.z: 他父母在九十年代移民到了加拿大。

advantageous.e: Speaking two languages is advantageous in business.
advantageous.z: 会说两种语言在商业中很有利。

diligent.m: dilig(喜爱,选择)+ent(形容词)→爱做事的→勤奋的
diligent.e: She is a diligent student who never misses class.
diligent.z: 她是个勤奋的学生，从不缺课。

unfounded.e: Fears about the vaccine proved unfounded.
unfounded.z: 对疫苗的担忧被证明是毫无根据的。

effluent.e: The factory was fined for releasing effluent into the river.
effluent.z: 该工厂因向河中排放废水被罚款。

irrespective.m: ir(不)+respective(各自的,考虑到的)→不考虑的→不论(of)
irrespective.e: Everyone is welcome, irrespective of age.

unequivocally.m: un(不)+equi(相等)+voc(声音)+al+ly→不含两种声音→明确地
unequivocally.e: The minister unequivocally denied the rumours.
unequivocally.z: 部长明确否认了这些传闻。

consequent.m: con(共同)+sequ(跟随)+ent(形容词)→随之而来的→因而发生的
consequent.e: The storm and consequent flooding closed the roads.
consequent.z: 暴风雨及随之而来的洪水导致道路封闭。

core.m: 源自拉丁语 cor(心)→果心；核心
core.e: Maths is a core subject in every school.
core.z: 数学是每所学校的核心科目。

syllabus.m: 源自拉丁语误读 sillybos(书签,标签)→列出的条目→教学大纲
syllabus.e: The syllabus covers both theory and practice.
syllabus.z: 教学大纲包括理论和实践两部分。

homeschooling.m: home(家)+school(上学)+ing(名词)→在家上学→家庭教育
homeschooling.e: Homeschooling has become more popular since the pandemic.
homeschooling.z: 疫情以来家庭教育变得更受欢迎。

far-fetched.m: far(远)+fetched(拿来的)→从远处硬拿来的→牵强的
far-fetched.z: 他的解释听起来相当牵强。

coursework.e: Coursework counts for 40 percent of the final grade.
coursework.z: 课程作业占最终成绩的40%。

labour.m: 源自拉丁语 labor(劳苦)→劳动；劳动力
labour.e: There is a shortage of skilled labour in the region.
labour.z: 该地区缺乏熟练劳动力。

nuanced.m: nuance(细微差别)+ed(形容词)→有细微差别的→细致入微的
nuanced.e: The issue requires a more nuanced approach.
nuanced.z: 这个问题需要更细致的处理方式。

rote.m: 联想：rote 像 route(路线)，按同一路线反复走→死记硬背
rote.e: Learning by rote is less effective than understanding.
rote.z: 死记硬背不如理解有效。

postgraduate.m: post(之后)+graduate(毕业生)→毕业后的→研究生
postgraduate.e: She is a postgraduate student in economics.

automate.m: 由 automation(自动化)逆构；auto(自己)→自己动→使自动化
automate.e: Many factory jobs have been automated.
automate.z: 许多工厂岗位已被自动化取代。

untenable.m: un(不)+ten(握住)+able(能…的)→握不住的→站不住脚的
untenable.e: His position became untenable after the scandal.
untenable.z: 丑闻之后他的立场站不住脚了。

exponential.m: ex(出)+pon(放)+ent+ial→(数学)放在外上角的指数→指数的；急剧的
exponential.e: The city has seen exponential population growth.
exponential.z: 这座城市人口呈指数级增长。

innovate.m: in(进入)+nov(新)+ate(动词)→引入新东西→创新
innovate.e: Companies must innovate to stay competitive.
innovate.z: 公司必须创新以保持竞争力。

incinerate.m: in(进入)+ciner(灰)+ate(动词)→变成灰→焚化
incinerate.e: Some cities incinerate waste to produce energy.
incinerate.z: 有些城市焚烧垃圾来发电。

biodegradable.m: bio(生物)+de(向下)+grad(级)+able(能…的)→能被生物分解的
biodegradable.e: Biodegradable packaging is better for the environment.
biodegradable.z: 可降解包装对环境更好。

irrefutable.m: ir(不)+refut(驳斥)+able(能…的)→无法驳斥的
irrefutable.e: There is irrefutable evidence that smoking causes cancer.
irrefutable.z: 有无可辩驳的证据表明吸烟致癌。

permafrost.e: Rising temperatures are melting the permafrost.
permafrost.z: 气温上升正在融化永久冻土。

percent.e: Sixty percent of students live on campus.
percent.z: 百分之六十的学生住在校内。

desertification.z: 过度放牧加剧了沙漠化。

truancy.e: Truancy is often linked to problems at home.
truancy.z: 逃学往往与家庭问题有关。

meritocracy.m: merit(功绩)+o+cracy(统治)→凭功绩治理→精英管理制度
meritocracy.e: Some argue that a true meritocracy does not exist.
meritocracy.z: 有人认为真正的精英制并不存在。

minimise.m: minim(最小)+ise(动词)→使最小→使降至最低
minimise.e: We should minimise waste at home.
minimise.z: 我们应尽量减少家里的浪费。

utilise.e: Farmers can utilise solar energy to pump water.
utilise.z: 农民可以利用太阳能抽水。

maximise.e: Good planning helps maximise your study time.
maximise.z: 好的规划有助于最大化利用学习时间。

fallacious.m: fall(欺骗,失误)+acious(形容词)→骗人的→谬误的
fallacious.e: The argument is based on a fallacious assumption.
fallacious.z: 这个论点建立在错误的假设之上。

fertiliser.m: fertile(肥沃的)+ise(使)+er(物)→使土地肥沃之物→肥料
fertiliser.e: Too much fertiliser can harm rivers.

licence.m: 源自拉丁语 licere(被允许)→许可→执照；许可证
licence.e: You need a licence to sell alcohol.

enrolment.m: en(使进入)+roll(名册)+ment(名词)→登入名册→注册；入学人数
enrolment.e: University enrolment has increased this year.
enrolment.z: 今年大学入学人数增加了。

fractionally.m: fraction(小部分,分数)+al+ly(副词)→一小部分地→略微地
fractionally.e: Sales were fractionally higher than last year.

standardised.e: Standardised tests are used to compare schools.
standardised.z: 标准化考试被用来比较学校。

ageing.e: Japan faces the challenge of an ageing population.
ageing.z: 日本面临人口老龄化的挑战。

numeracy.m: numer(数)+acy(名词,仿 literacy)→计算能力
numeracy.e: Basic numeracy is essential for everyday life.
numeracy.z: 基本的计算能力是日常生活所必需的。

overstated.m: over(过度)+stated(陈述的)→说过头的→夸大的
overstated.e: The dangers of social media are often overstated.
overstated.z: 社交媒体的危害常被夸大。

urbanisation.e: Rapid urbanisation has put pressure on housing.
urbanisation.z: 快速城市化给住房带来压力。

afforestation.m: af(去)+forest(森林)+ation(名词)→去造林→植树造林
afforestation.z: 植树造林有助于减少洪水。

globalisation.e: Globalisation has changed the way we work.
globalisation.z: 全球化改变了我们的工作方式。

case.m: cas(落下,发生)+e→落到头上的事→情况；案例
case.e: In this case, the policy failed.
case.z: 在这种情况下，该政策失败了。

system.m: sy(共同)+stem(放置,站立)→放在一起的整体→系统；制度

program.m: pro(在前)+gram(写)→预先写好的→计划；节目；程序
program.e: The government launched a new training program.
program.z: 政府启动了一项新的培训计划。

million.e: The city has a population of ten million.
million.z: 这座城市有一千万人口。

power.m: 源自拉丁语 posse(能够)→能力→力量；权力；电力
power.z: 风力发电正在变得更便宜。

political.m: polit(城邦,公民)+ical(形容词)→城邦事务的→政治的
political.e: Young people are becoming more political.
political.z: 年轻人越来越关心政治。

guy.m: 源自人名 Guy Fawkes(盖伊·福克斯)的人像→家伙

effect.m: ef(出)+fect(做)→做出来的→效果；影响
effect.e: Music has a calming effect on people.

former.m: form(=fore,前)+er(比较级)→更前面的→以前的；前者
former.e: The former president gave a speech.

economic.m: eco(家)+nom(管理)+ic(形容词)→管家的→经济的
economic.e: The country is facing an economic crisis.

rate.m: 源自拉丁语 rata(计算好的份额)→比率；速度
rate.e: The unemployment rate fell to 4 percent.

military.m: milit(士兵)+ary(形容词)→士兵的→军事的
military.e: Military spending has increased this year.

view.m: 源自拉丁语 videre(看)→看法；景色
view.e: In my view, homework is useful.
view.z: 在我看来，家庭作业是有用的。

relationship.e: They have a good relationship with their neighbours.

player.e: He is the best player on the team.

support.m: sup(在下)+port(运送,拿)→在下面托着→支持
support.e: Parents should support their children's interests.
support.z: 父母应支持孩子的兴趣。

event.m: e(出)+vent(来)→出来的事→事件；活动
event.e: The festival is the biggest event of the year.
event.z: 这个节日是一年中最大的活动。

center.m: 源自希腊语 kentron(圆规尖点)→中心
center.e: The museum is in the city center.

figure.m: fig(塑形)+ure(名词)→塑出的形→数字；人物；身材
figure.e: Official figures show a drop in crime.
figure.z: 官方数据显示犯罪下降。

product.m: pro(向前)+duct(引导)→引导出来的→产品
product.e: This product is made from recycled plastic.
product.z: 这种产品由再生塑料制成。

type.m: 源自希腊语 typos(印痕)→类型
type.e: What type of music do you like?
type.z: 你喜欢什么类型的音乐？

organization.m: organ(器官,组织)+ize(使)+ation(名词)→组织；机构
organization.e: She works for a charity organization.
organization.z: 她在一家慈善机构工作。

evidence.m: e(出)+vid(看)+ence(名词)→看得出来的→证据
evidence.e: There is little evidence to support this claim.
evidence.z: 几乎没有证据支持这一说法。

opportunity.m: op(朝向)+port(港口)+unity→顺风朝向港口→机会
opportunity.e: Studying abroad is a great opportunity.
opportunity.z: 出国留学是一个很好的机会。

congress.m: con(一起)+gress(走)→走到一起→代表大会；国会
congress.z: 国会通过了这项新法律。

campaign.m: 源自拉丁语 campania(平原,战场)→野战→运动；竞选
campaign.e: The campaign aims to reduce plastic use.
campaign.z: 这项运动旨在减少塑料使用。

material.m: mater(母亲,物质)+ial→万物之母→材料；物质
material.e: Wood is a natural building material.

current.m: curr(跑,流)+ent(形容词)→正在流动的→当前的；水流

behavior.m: be(使)+have(拥有,举止)+ior(名词)→举止→行为
behavior.z: 孩子会模仿父母的行为。

per.m: 拉丁语介词 per(通过,每)→每；按
per.e: The fee is ten pounds per person.

subject.m: sub(在下)+ject(扔)→扔在下面受支配的→科目；主题
subject.z: 历史是我最喜欢的科目。

performance.m: perform(表演,执行)+ance(名词)→表现；表演
performance.z: 睡眠影响学生的学习成绩。

represent.m: re(再)+present(呈现)→再次呈现→代表；表现
represent.e: This painting represents the four seasons.

agency.m: ag(做)+ency(名词)→代人做事的地方→机构；代理处
agency.e: She found the job through an agency.
agency.z: 她通过中介找到了这份工作。

color.m: 源自拉丁语 color(颜色,外表)→颜色
color.e: The leaves change color in autumn.

concern.m: con(加强)+cern(筛选,区分)→仔细分辨→关心；担忧
concern.e: There is growing concern about air pollution.
concern.z: 人们对空气污染的担忧日益增加。

response.e: The government's response was too slow.

stock.m: 源自古英语 stocc(树干)→根基储备→库存；股票
stock.e: The shop has a large stock of books.
stock.z: 这家店有大量书籍库存。

career.m: 源自拉丁语 carrus(车)→车道→人生跑道→职业生涯
career.e: She wants a career in medicine.

central.m: centr(中心)+al(形容词)→中心的；主要的
central.e: The hotel is in a central location.

thus.m: 联想：thus 读音近“这事”，因为这事→因此
thus.e: The road was closed, thus we were late.
thus.z: 道路封闭，因此我们迟到了。

sign.m: 源自拉丁语 signum(标记)→标志；签名
sign.e: There are signs that the economy is improving.
sign.z: 有迹象表明经济正在好转。

quality.m: qual(什么样的)+ity(名词)→什么样的性质→质量
quality.e: The quality of tap water here is excellent.
quality.z: 这里的自来水质量很好。

pressure.e: Students face huge pressure before exams.
pressure.z: 考试前学生面临巨大压力。

argue.m: 源自拉丁语 arguere(证明,阐明)→争论；论证
argue.e: Some argue that technology makes us lonely.
argue.z: 有人认为科技让我们孤独。

amount.m: a(向)+mount(山,登上)→向上堆成山→数量；总计
amount.e: We should reduce the amount of plastic we use.
amount.z: 我们应减少塑料的使用量。

staff.m: 源自古英语 stæf(棍,支撑)→撑起机构的人→全体员工

loss.m: lose(失去)的名词形式→损失；丧失
loss.e: Hearing loss is common in older people.
loss.z: 听力丧失在老年人中很常见。

attack.m: 联想：at+tack(图钉)→拿钉子扎过去→攻击
attack.e: He suffered a heart attack last year.

analysis.m: ana(彻底)+lys(分解)+is(名词)→彻底分解→分析
analysis.e: The analysis shows a clear trend.
analysis.z: 分析显示了一个明显的趋势。

sex.m: 源自拉丁语 sexus(性别)→性别；性
sex.e: The survey asked for age and sex.
sex.z: 调查询问了年龄和性别。

lawyer.e: She wants to become a lawyer.

environmental.m: environ(环绕)+ment(名词)+al(形容词)→周围环境的→环境的
environmental.z: 保护环境是每个人的责任。

professor.m: pro(在前)+fess(说)+or(人)→在众人前讲话的人→教授
professor.e: The professor gave an interesting lecture.
professor.z: 教授做了一场有趣的讲座。

financial.m: financ(e)(财政,源自 fin 结清)+ial(形容词)→财政的；金融的
financial.z: 许多学生面临经济困难。

crime.m: 源自拉丁语 crimen(指控)→罪行；犯罪
crime.e: Youth crime has fallen in recent years.
crime.z: 近年来青少年犯罪有所下降。

stage.m: st(站)+age(名词)→站立处→舞台；阶段
stage.e: The project is still in its early stages.
stage.z: 该项目仍处于早期阶段。

various.m: vari(变化)+ous(形容词)→多变的→各种各样的

executive.m: ex(出)+secut(跟随,执行)+ive→执行的；主管
executive.e: She is a senior executive at a bank.

claim.m: claim(喊,源自拉丁语 clamare)→喊出来要→声称；索赔
claim.e: He claims that the test was unfair.

trial.e: The new drug is undergoing clinical trials.
trial.z: 这种新药正在进行临床试验。

firm.m: firm(坚固的,源自拉丁语 firmus)→坚定的；(签字确认的)公司
firm.e: He works for a law firm.
firm.z: 他在一家律师事务所工作。

management.e: Time management is a key skill for students.
management.z: 时间管理是学生的关键技能。

statement.e: The company issued a statement on the issue.
statement.z: 公司就此事发表了声明。

charge.m: 源自拉丁语 carricare(装车)→加负担→收费；指控；充电
charge.e: There is no charge for entry.

weapon.m: 联想：we+a+pon(砰)→我们拿着砰砰响的家伙→武器
weapon.e: Nuclear weapons are a threat to everyone.
weapon.z: 核武器是对所有人的威胁。

employee.m: employ(雇用)+ee(被…者)→被雇的人→雇员

cultural.m: cult(耕种,培养)+ure+al(形容词)→培养出来的→文化的
cultural.e: London is a city of great cultural diversity.
cultural.z: 伦敦是一个文化非常多元的城市。

apply.m: ap(去)+ply(折,贴)→贴上去→申请；应用

measure.m: 源自拉丁语 metiri(测量)→测量；措施
measure.e: The government took measures to cut pollution.
measure.z: 政府采取措施减少污染。

candidate.m: candid(白色的)+ate→古罗马候选人穿白袍→候选人；考生
candidate.e: Each candidate must answer three questions.
candidate.z: 每位考生必须回答三个问题。

production.m: pro(向前)+duct(引导)+ion(名词)→引出来→生产
production.e: Food production must increase to feed the world.
production.z: 粮食产量必须增加以养活世界。

writer.e: He is a famous science fiction writer.

throughout.m: through(穿过)+out(完全)→自始至终；遍及

institution.m: in(在内)+stitut(设立)+ion(名词)→设立起来的→机构；制度
institution.z: 大学是重要的公共机构。

bar.m: 源自古法语 barre(横杆)→栅栏；酒吧(柜台横杆)；阻止
bar.e: They met at a bar near the station.
bar.z: 他们在车站附近的酒吧见面。

property.m: propr(自己的)+ty(名词)→自己拥有的→财产；房产
property.e: Property prices in London are very high.

stuff.m: 源自古法语 estoffe(材料)→东西；填塞
stuff.e: I need to move my stuff to the new flat.
stuff.z: 我得把东西搬到新公寓。

reflect.m: re(回)+flect(弯曲)→弯回去→反射；反映
reflect.e: The results reflect a change in attitudes.
reflect.z: 这些结果反映了态度的转变。

tough.m: 联想：tough 音近“塔夫”，像铁塔一样硬→坚韧的；困难的
tough.e: It was a tough decision to leave home.
tough.z: 离开家是个艰难的决定。

pattern.m: 源自 patron(样板,保护人)→照着做的模子→模式；图案
pattern.e: Sleep patterns change as we get older.
pattern.z: 随年龄增长睡眠模式会改变。

skin.m: 源自古诺尔斯语 skinn(兽皮)→皮肤
skin.e: Too much sun can damage your skin.

commercial.m: com(加强)+merc(贸易)+ial(形容词)→贸易的→商业的
commercial.e: The film was a huge commercial success.
commercial.z: 这部电影取得巨大商业成功。

investment.m: in(进入)+vest(衣服)+ment→给钱穿上衣服投入使用→投资
investment.e: Education is an investment in the future.

collection.m: col(一起)+lect(收集)+ion(名词)→收集；收藏品
collection.e: The museum has a large collection of paintings.
collection.z: 博物馆收藏了大量画作。

consumer.m: con(加强)+sum(拿,用)+er(人)→用掉东西的人→消费者
consumer.z: 消费者越来越多地网购。

budget.m: 源自古法语 bougette(小钱袋)→预算
budget.e: We are on a tight budget this month.

responsibility.m: respons(回应)+ibility(能力)→能回应承担的→责任
responsibility.e: Parents have a responsibility to educate their children.
responsibility.z: 父母有教育孩子的责任。

attorney.m: at(去)+torn(转)+ey→转交代办的人→律师；代理人
attorney.e: He hired an attorney to defend him.

account.m: ac(去)+count(计算)→去计算→账户；解释；描述

audience.m: audi(听)+ence(名词)→听的人→观众；听众

majority.m: major(较大的)+ity(名词)→较大部分→大多数
majority.e: The majority of students passed the exam.
majority.z: 大多数学生通过了考试。

senior.m: sen(老)+ior(比较级)→更老的→年长的；高级的
senior.e: Senior citizens get free bus travel.
senior.z: 老年人可免费乘坐公交车。

mission.m: miss(送,派)+ion(名词)→派出去的任务→使命
mission.e: The company's mission is to protect nature.
mission.z: 该公司的使命是保护自然。

customer.m: custom(习惯)+er(人)→习惯来买的人→顾客

eventually.e: He eventually found a job in London.
eventually.z: 他最终在伦敦找到了工作。

global.e: Climate change is a global problem.
global.z: 气候变化是全球性问题。

opinion.e: In my opinion, the plan is too expensive.
opinion.z: 在我看来这个计划太贵了。

critical.m: critic(评论,判断)+al(形容词)→批判的；关键的
critical.e: Critical thinking is important at university.
critical.z: 批判性思维在大学很重要。

effective.e: Exercise is an effective way to reduce stress.
effective.z: 锻炼是减压的有效方法。

original.m: origin(起源)+al(形容词)→起源的→原始的；独创的
original.e: The original building was built in 1850.

species.m: spec(看)+ies→看上去一样的一类→物种
species.e: Many species are in danger of extinction.
species.z: 许多物种面临灭绝危险。

track.m: 源自古法语 trac(足迹)→轨道；跟踪
track.e: This app helps you track your spending.
track.z: 这个应用帮你记录开支。

strike.m: 源自古英语 strican(划,打)→打击；罢工
strike.e: Train drivers went on strike yesterday.

freedom.e: Freedom of speech is a basic right.

client.m: 源自拉丁语 cliens(依附者)→委托人；客户
client.e: The lawyer met her client in the morning.
client.z: 律师上午会见了她的委托人。

attend.m: at(去)+tend(伸展)→把心思伸过去→出席；照料

variety.e: The market sells a wide variety of fruit.

investigation.m: in(进入)+vestig(足迹)+ation(名词)→循着足迹进去→调查

argument.e: This is a strong argument for free education.
argument.z: 这是支持免费教育的有力论据。

insurance.m: in(使)+sure(确定的)+ance(名词)→使有保障→保险

department.m: de(分开)+part(部分)+ment(名词)→分开的部分→部门；系
department.e: She works in the history department.

crisis.m: 源自希腊语 krisis(转折点,判断)→危机
crisis.e: The country faces a housing crisis.

vision.e: He has a clear vision for the company.
vision.z: 他对公司有清晰的愿景。

solution.m: solu(松开,解)+tion(名词)→解开→解决办法；溶液
solution.e: There is no easy solution to traffic jams.
solution.z: 交通拥堵没有简单的解决办法。

scale.m: 源自拉丁语 scala(梯子)→阶梯刻度→规模；比例；秤
scale.e: The problem is on a global scale.
scale.z: 这个问题是全球规模的。

attempt.m: at(去)+tempt(尝试)→去尝试→努力；企图
attempt.e: She passed the test at her first attempt.
attempt.z: 她第一次尝试就通过了考试。

spot.m: 源自中古荷兰语 spotte(斑点)→地点；斑点；发现
spot.e: This beach is a popular tourist spot.
spot.z: 这个海滩是热门旅游景点。

lack.m: 源自中古荷兰语 lak(缺陷)→缺乏

distance.m: di(分开)+st(站)+ance(名词)→分开站→距离
distance.e: The school is within walking distance.

roll.m: 源自拉丁语 rotula(小轮)→滚动；卷
roll.e: The ball rolled down the hill.

presence.m: pre(在前)+s(=es,存在)+ence(名词)→在面前存在→出席；存在
presence.e: Police presence on the streets has increased.
presence.z: 街上警察的数量增加了。

apartment.m: a(去)+part(部分)+ment(名词)→分出的部分→公寓
apartment.e: They rent a small apartment in the city.
apartment.z: 他们在城里租了一间小公寓。

strength.m: strong(强壮的)的名词形式→力量；长处
strength.e: Patience is one of her greatest strengths.
strength.z: 耐心是她最大的优点之一。

band.m: 源自古诺尔斯语 band(带子)→绑在一起的一伙→乐队；带子
band.e: He plays guitar in a band.

deliver.m: de(离开)+liver(=liber,自由)→放出去→递送；发表
deliver.e: The parcel will be delivered tomorrow.

observe.m: ob(在前)+serv(看守,注意)+e→在前面看守→观察；遵守
observe.e: Scientists observed the birds for months.
observe.z: 科学家们观察这些鸟数月之久。

flight.m: fly(飞)的名词形式→飞行；航班

facility.m: facil(容易的)+ity(名词)→使事情变容易的东西→设施
facility.e: The school has excellent sports facilities.
facility.z: 学校有很好的体育设施。

average.m: 源自意大利语 avaria(海损)→海损按份分摊→平均
average.e: The average age of students is 22.

basis.e: Decisions should be made on the basis of evidence.

sample.m: 源自 example 的缩略(古法语 essample)→样例→样本；抽样

block.m: 源自中古荷兰语 blok(木块)→块；街区；阻塞
block.e: The library is two blocks away.

settle.m: 源自古英语 setl(座位)→坐定→定居；解决
settle.e: They settled in a small village.
settle.z: 他们在一个小村庄定居。

additional.e: There is an additional fee for luggage.

identity.m: ident(相同)+ity(名词)→与自己相同→身份；认同
identity.e: Language is part of our cultural identity.
identity.z: 语言是我们文化认同的一部分。

title.m: 源自拉丁语 titulus(标签,铭文)→标题；头衔
title.e: What is the title of your essay?

faith.m: 源自拉丁语 fides(信任)→信任；信仰
faith.e: I have faith in my students.

border.m: 源自古法语 bordure(边缘)→边界；边境
border.e: They crossed the border into France.

associate.m: as(去)+soci(同伴)+ate(动词)→去做同伴→联想；联系
associate.e: Many people associate summer with holidays.
associate.z: 很多人把夏天和假期联系在一起。

procedure.m: pro(向前)+ced(走)+ure(名词)→向前走的步骤→程序；手术

regular.m: reg(规则,统治)+ular(形容词)→合规则的→定期的；规律的

religion.m: re(加强)+lig(捆绑)+ion(名词)→把人与神绑在一起→宗教
religion.e: Religion plays a big role in their culture.
religion.z: 宗教在他们的文化中起重要作用。

editor.m: edit(编辑,源自 e 出+dit 给)+or(人)→编辑
editor.e: She is the editor of a fashion magazine.
editor.z: 她是一本时尚杂志的编辑。

engage.m: en(使)+gage(誓约)→使立誓约→参与；吸引；订婚
engage.z: 好老师能吸引学生投入。

female.m: 源自拉丁语 femella(小女人)→女性的；雌性
female.e: Female students outnumber male students here.
female.z: 这里女生人数多于男生。

youth.m: young(年轻)的名词形式→青春；青年
youth.e: Youth unemployment is a serious problem.
youth.z: 青年失业是个严重问题。

wave.m: 源自古英语 wafian(挥动)→波浪；挥手；浪潮
wave.e: A wave of immigrants arrived in the 1950s.
wave.z: 一批移民在五十年代到来。

native.m: nat(出生)+ive(形容词)→出生地的→本地的；母语的
native.e: She is a native speaker of Spanish.

suit.m: 源自古法语 suite(跟随)→成套的衣服→西装；适合

construction.m: con(一起)+struct(建造)+ion(名词)→建造；建筑
construction.e: The new bridge is under construction.

committee.m: commit(委托)+ee(被…者)→受委托的人们→委员会
committee.e: The committee will make a decision soon.
committee.z: 委员会很快会作出决定。

location.e: The hotel is in a great location.

extend.m: ex(出)+tend(伸展)→伸出去→延长；扩大
extend.e: The library has extended its opening hours.
extend.z: 图书馆延长了开放时间。

chief.m: 源自拉丁语 caput(头)→首领；主要的
chief.e: Cost is the chief concern for most families.
chief.z: 费用是大多数家庭的首要顾虑。

combine.m: com(一起)+bin(两个)+e→两个放一起→结合
combine.e: Combine exercise with a healthy diet.
combine.z: 将锻炼与健康饮食结合起来。

hell.m: 源自古英语 hel(隐藏之地,冥界)→地狱
hell.e: The traffic this morning was hell.
hell.z: 今天早上的交通简直是地狱。

remind.m: re(再)+mind(头脑)→再进入脑中→提醒
remind.e: Please remind me to call my mum.
remind.z: 请提醒我给妈妈打电话。

moral.m: mor(风俗)+al(形容词)→风俗的→道德的
moral.e: We have a moral duty to help the poor.
moral.z: 我们有帮助穷人的道德义务。

negative.m: neg(否定)+ative(形容词)→否定的；消极的
negative.e: Social media can have negative effects on teenagers.
negative.z: 社交媒体可能对青少年有负面影响。

historical.e: The city has many historical buildings.
historical.z: 这座城市有许多历史建筑。

grab.m: 联想：g+rab(像 rob 抢)→一把抢过来→抓取
grab.e: Let's grab a coffee before class.
grab.z: 上课前我们去买杯咖啡吧。

familiar.m: famil(y)(家)+iar(形容词)→家里的→熟悉的

actor.e: He is a famous film actor.

eastern.m: east(东)+ern(方向的)→东方的；东部的
eastern.e: Eastern Europe has a long history.

device.m: 源自古法语 devis(设计)→设计出的东西→设备；装置
device.e: Mobile devices are banned during the exam.
device.z: 考试期间禁止使用移动设备。

exchange.e: We exchanged ideas in the seminar.
exchange.z: 我们在研讨会上交流了想法。

studio.m: 源自拉丁语 studium(学习,钻研)→工作室；演播室
studio.e: The band recorded the album in a London studio.
studio.z: 乐队在伦敦一家录音室录制了专辑。

colleague.m: col(共同)+leag(选派,结盟)+ue→一起被选派的人→同事
colleague.e: I often have lunch with my colleagues.
colleague.z: 我常和同事一起吃午饭。

application.m: ap(去)+plic(折,贴)+ation(名词)→贴上去→申请；应用

damage.z: 暴风雨造成了严重破坏。

otherwise.m: other(别的)+wise(方式)→以别的方式→否则
otherwise.e: Hurry up, otherwise we'll miss the bus.
otherwise.z: 快点，不然我们会错过公交。

male.m: 源自拉丁语 masculus(男性的)→男性的；雄性
male.e: Male nurses are still a minority.

abuse.m: ab(偏离)+use(使用)→用歪了→滥用；虐待
abuse.e: Drug abuse is a growing problem.
abuse.z: 药物滥用问题日益严重。

extra.m: 源自拉丁语 extra(之外)→额外的
extra.e: You have to pay extra for breakfast.

session.m: sess(坐)+ion(名词)→坐在一起开会→一段时间；会议
session.e: Each training session lasts an hour.

desire.m: 源自拉丁语 desiderare(渴望,盼望星辰)→渴望
desire.e: He has a strong desire to travel.

assessment.e: Teachers use different forms of assessment.
assessment.z: 老师使用不同形式的评估。

injury.m: in(不)+jur(法,正当)+y(名词)→不正当的对待→伤害
injury.e: He missed the match because of injury.

fuel.m: 源自古法语 fouaille(柴火)→燃料
fuel.z: 化石燃料造成空气污染。

engine.m: 源自拉丁语 ingenium(天赋,发明)→巧妙的发明→发动机
engine.e: The car has a powerful engine.
engine.z: 这辆车发动机动力强劲。

educational.m: e(出)+duc(引导)+ation+al(形容词)→引导出来的→教育的
educational.e: Museums are both fun and educational.
educational.z: 博物馆既有趣又有教育意义。

favorite.z: 披萨是我最喜欢的食物。

explore.m: 源自拉丁语 explorare(探查)→探索；探讨
explore.e: We explored the old town on foot.
explore.z: 我们步行游览了老城区。

athlete.m: 源自希腊语 athlon(奖品)+ete(人)→争夺奖品的人→运动员

scientific.e: There is no scientific evidence for this.

panel.m: 源自古法语 panel(一块布)→小块板→面板；专家小组
panel.e: A panel of experts will judge the competition.

instrument.m: in(在上)+stru(建造)+ment(名词)→用来建造的东西→仪器；乐器
instrument.e: Do you play a musical instrument?

commitment.m: commit(承诺,托付)+ment(名词)→承诺；投入

supreme.m: supre(上面,源自 super)+me(最高级)→最高的
supreme.e: The Supreme Court made a final decision.
supreme.z: 最高法院作出了最终裁决。

bear.m: 源自古英语 beran(承载)→承受；忍受；熊
bear.e: I can't bear the noise any longer.
bear.z: 我再也受不了这噪音了。

consequence.m: con(共同)+sequ(跟随)+ence(名词)→随之而来的→后果
consequence.z: 吸烟有严重的健康后果。

balance.e: It's hard to balance work and study.

adopt.e: The school adopted a new teaching method.
adopt.z: 学校采用了新的教学方法。

minority.m: minor(较小的)+ity(名词)→少数；少数民族
minority.e: Only a minority of people oppose the plan.
minority.z: 只有少数人反对这项计划。

regional.e: There are big regional differences in income.
regional.z: 收入存在很大的地区差异。

trail.m: 源自古法语 trailler(拖)→拖出的痕迹→小径；踪迹
trail.e: We followed a trail through the forest.

novel.m: nov(新)+el→新奇的故事→小说；新颖的
novel.e: She has just finished her first novel.

somehow.m: some(某种)+how(方式)→以某种方式→不知怎么地
somehow.e: Somehow, we managed to finish on time.
somehow.z: 不知怎么地我们按时完成了。

jury.m: jur(发誓)+y→宣誓过的一群人→陪审团
jury.e: The jury found him not guilty.

union.m: uni(一)+on(名词)→合为一体→联盟；工会
union.e: The union called for higher wages.

conclusion.m: con(加强)+clus(关闭)+ion(名词)→彻底关上→结论；结尾
conclusion.e: What conclusion can we draw from this?
conclusion.z: 我们能从中得出什么结论？

appearance.e: People often judge others by appearance.

propose.m: pro(向前)+pos(放)+e→放到前面→提议；求婚
propose.e: She proposed a new plan to the team.
propose.z: 她向团队提出了新计划。

loan.m: 联想：loan 音近“漏”，钱包漏了只好借钱→贷款
loan.e: Many students take out loans to pay fees.

profit.e: The company made a profit of two million.

capture.e: The photo captures the beauty of the city.
capture.z: 这张照片捕捉到了城市之美。

cash.m: 源自古法语 casse(钱箱)→现金
cash.e: Fewer people pay in cash today.
cash.z: 如今用现金付款的人越来越少。

beauty.m: beaut(美,源自拉丁语 bellus)+y(名词)→美；美人
beauty.e: The beauty of nature attracts tourists.

emergency.m: e(出)+merg(沉没,浸)+ency(名词)→从水中冒出的意外→紧急情况

content.m: con(一起)+tent(握住)→包含在内的→内容；满意的
content.e: The content of the course is interesting.

declare.m: de(加强)+clar(清楚)+e→说清楚→宣布；申报
declare.e: The government declared a state of emergency.
declare.z: 政府宣布进入紧急状态。

launch.m: 源自古法语 lancier(投掷长矛)→发射；发起
launch.e: The company will launch a new phone next month.
launch.z: 公司下月将发布新手机。

sheet.m: 源自古英语 sciete(布)→床单；一张(纸)
sheet.e: Write your name at the top of the sheet.
sheet.z: 在纸的顶部写上你的名字。

catholic.m: cata(遍及)+hol(整体)+ic(形容词)→普遍的→天主教的
catholic.e: She grew up in a Catholic family.
catholic.z: 她在一个天主教家庭长大。

extent.m: ex(出)+tent(伸展)→伸展出去的范围→程度；范围
extent.e: To some extent, I agree with this view.
extent.z: 在某种程度上我同意这个观点。

contribution.m: con(共同)+tribut(给予)+ion(名词)→共同给予→贡献；捐款
contribution.e: She made a big contribution to the project.
contribution.z: 她对项目做出了很大贡献。

guide.m: 源自古法语 guider(引导)→导游；指南；引导
guide.e: Our guide showed us around the museum.
guide.z: 导游带我们参观了博物馆。

slip.m: 联想：s+lip(嘴唇)→嘴一滑说错话→滑倒；失误
slip.e: Be careful not to slip on the ice.

percentage.e: A high percentage of graduates find jobs quickly.
percentage.z: 很大比例的毕业生很快找到工作。

soil.m: 源自拉丁语 solum(地面)→土壤
soil.e: Healthy soil is essential for farming.
soil.z: 健康的土壤对农业至关重要。

surgery.m: 源自希腊语 cheir(手)+ergon(工作)→用手做的工作→外科手术
surgery.e: He needs surgery on his knee.

due.m: 源自古法语 deu(欠的,源自 debere 欠)→应付的；到期的；由于
due.e: The essay is due next Monday.

blame.m: 联想：b+lame(跛的)→骂人是跛子→责备
blame.e: Don't blame others for your mistakes.
blame.z: 别把自己的错误怪到别人头上。

golf.m: 源自中古荷兰语 colf(球棒)→高尔夫球
golf.e: My father plays golf at weekends.

branch.m: 源自拉丁语 branca(爪子)→像爪子分开→树枝；分支；分店
branch.e: The bank has a branch in every town.
branch.z: 这家银行在每个镇都有分行。

relief.m: re(加强)+lief(轻,源自 levare 举起)→减轻→缓解；救济
relief.e: The medicine brought quick relief from pain.

motion.e: The motion was passed by a large majority.
motion.z: 该动议以绝对多数通过。

solve.m: 源自拉丁语 solvere(松开)→解开→解决
solve.e: We need to solve the housing problem.
solve.z: 我们需要解决住房问题。

landscape.e: The landscape here is beautiful in autumn.

equal.m: equ(相等)+al(形容词)→平等的；相等的
equal.e: Men and women should receive equal pay.

typical.m: typ(e)(类型)+ical(形容词)→有代表性的→典型的
typical.e: A typical day starts at seven.
typical.z: 典型的一天从七点开始。

host.m: 源自拉丁语 hospes(主人,客人)→主人；主办
host.e: Which city will host the next Olympics?
host.z: 哪座城市将举办下届奥运会？

appeal.m: ap(去)+peal(推,驱动)→推上去请求→呼吁；吸引；上诉
appeal.e: City life appeals to young people.

length.e: The essay should be 250 words in length.

association.m: as(去)+soci(同伴)+ation(名词)→结为同伴→协会；联系

variable.e: Weather is an important variable in farming.
variable.z: 天气是农业中的重要变量。

perception.m: per(完全)+cept(拿)+ion(名词)→完全拿住→感知；看法
perception.e: Public perception of the police has improved.
perception.z: 公众对警察的看法有所改善。

confidence.m: con(加强)+fid(信任)+ence(名词)→完全信任→信心
confidence.z: 口语练习能增强你的信心。

debt.m: 源自拉丁语 debitum(欠的东西)→债务
debt.e: Many graduates leave university in debt.
debt.z: 许多毕业生毕业时背着债务。

rare.m: 源自拉丁语 rarus(稀疏的)→稀有的；罕见的
rare.e: This plant is very rare in Britain.
rare.z: 这种植物在英国很罕见。

coverage.m: cover(覆盖)+age(名词)→覆盖范围；新闻报道
coverage.e: The event received wide media coverage.
coverage.z: 这一事件得到媒体广泛报道。

requirement.m: re(再)+quir(寻求)+ment(名词)→要求；必要条件
