requirement.e: English is a requirement for this course.
requirement.z: 英语是这门课的必要条件。

pour.m: 联想：pour 音近“泼”→倒；倾泻；下大雨

reference.m: re(回)+fer(带)+ence(名词)→带回查看→参考；提及
reference.e: Keep this book for future reference.
reference.z: 留着这本书以备日后参考。

tear.m: 源自古英语 teran(撕)/tear(眼泪)→撕裂；眼泪
tear.e: She was in tears after the film.

minister.m: minis(更小)+ter(人)→地位小的仆人→为国家服务的人→部长；牧师
minister.e: The education minister visited our school.
minister.z: 教育部长参观了我们学校。

industrial.e: Manchester was a major industrial city.
industrial.z: 曼彻斯特曾是重要的工业城市。

stretch.m: 源自古英语 streccan(伸展)→伸展；延伸；一段

fashion.m: 源自拉丁语 factio(制作,方式)→流行式样→时尚
fashion.e: Fast fashion creates a lot of waste.

intervention.m: inter(在中间)+vent(来)+ion(名词)→来到中间→干预
intervention.e: Early intervention can help children with learning problems.
intervention.z: 早期干预能帮助有学习困难的孩子。

aim.m: 源自古法语 esmer(估计,瞄准)→目标；瞄准
aim.e: The aim of this study is to compare two methods.
aim.z: 本研究的目的是比较两种方法。

improvement.e: There has been a big improvement in her writing.
improvement.z: 她的写作有了很大进步。

oppose.e: Many residents oppose the new airport.
oppose.z: 许多居民反对新建机场。

route.m: 源自拉丁语 rupta(via)(开辟的路)→路线
route.e: What is the fastest route to the station?
route.z: 去车站最快的路线是什么？

essential.m: essen(存在,本质)+tial(形容词)→本质的→必要的

criminal.m: crimin(罪)+al(形容词/人)→犯罪的；罪犯
criminal.e: The criminal was sent to prison.

household.m: house(房子)+hold(持有)→一家人；家庭的
household.e: Most households now have internet access.
household.z: 大多数家庭现在都能上网。

resolution.m: re(加强)+solu(松开)+tion(名词)→解开→解决；决心；分辨率
resolution.e: My New Year's resolution is to read more.
resolution.z: 我的新年决心是多读书。

abortion.m: ab(离开)+ort(出生,升起)+ion(名词)→未出生就离开→流产；堕胎
abortion.z: 堕胎仍是一个有争议的问题。

witness.m: wit(知道)+ness(名词)→知道情况的人→目击者；见证
witness.e: A witness saw the car hit the cyclist.
witness.z: 一名目击者看到汽车撞了骑车人。

barely.m: bare(赤裸的,仅有的)+ly(副词)→几乎没有；勉强
barely.e: I could barely hear the speaker.
barely.z: 我几乎听不见演讲者的话。

emphasize.m: em(在内)+phas(显示)+ize(动词)→显示出来→强调
emphasize.e: The report emphasizes the need for change.
emphasize.z: 报告强调了变革的必要性。

representative.m: represent(代表)+ative(形容词/人)→代表；有代表性的
representative.e: Is the sample representative of the population?
representative.z: 这个样本能代表总体吗？

mass.m: 源自拉丁语 massa(团块)→大量；质量；大众的
mass.z: 大众旅游会破坏脆弱的地方。

enormous.m: e(出)+norm(标准)+ous(形容词)→超出标准的→巨大的
enormous.e: The project cost an enormous amount of money.

massive.e: There was a massive increase in prices.

cable.m: 源自拉丁语 capulum(套索)→缆绳；电缆
cable.e: The internet relies on undersea cables.

rural.e: Many young people leave rural areas for cities.
rural.z: 许多年轻人离开农村去城市。

cream.m: 源自古法语 cresme(奶油)→奶油；乳霜
cream.e: I'd like a coffee with cream, please.
cream.z: 我要一杯加奶油的咖啡。

legislation.m: legis(法律)+lat(带来,提出)+ion(名词)→提出法律→立法；法规
legislation.e: New legislation bans smoking in cars.
legislation.z: 新法规禁止在车内吸烟。

achievement.e: Winning the prize was a great achievement.
achievement.z: 获奖是一项了不起的成就。

accuse.m: ac(去)+cus(e)(诉讼,原因)→去起诉→指控
accuse.e: He was accused of stealing money.

characteristic.m: character(特性)+istic(形容词/名词)→特征；典型的
characteristic.e: Patience is a characteristic of good teachers.

unusual.e: It's unusual to see snow here in May.
unusual.z: 五月在这里看到雪很不寻常。

convince.m: con(加强)+vinc(征服)+e→彻底征服→使信服
convince.e: She convinced me to study abroad.

physician.e: You should consult your physician first.

virtually.m: virtual(实际上的,虚拟的)+ly(副词)→几乎；实际上
virtually.e: Virtually every student owns a smartphone.
virtually.z: 几乎每个学生都有智能手机。

addition.m: ad(去)+dit(给)+ion(名词)→给进去→增加；加法
addition.e: In addition, the course is free.

sharp.m: 源自古英语 scearp(锋利的)→锋利的；急剧的
sharp.e: There has been a sharp rise in prices.

campus.m: 源自拉丁语 campus(田野,平地)→校园
campus.e: Most first-year students live on campus.
campus.z: 大多数一年级学生住在校内。

immigrant.m: im(向内)+migr(迁移)+ant(人)→移入的人→移民
immigrant.e: Immigrants contribute a lot to the economy.

illegal.m: il(不)+leg(法律)+al(形容词)→不合法的
illegal.e: It is illegal to drive without a licence.

column.m: 源自拉丁语 columna(柱子)→柱子；专栏；列
column.e: She writes a weekly column for a newspaper.
column.z: 她为一家报纸写每周专栏。

personality.m: person(人)+al+ity(名词)→个人特性→性格；名人

signal.e: There is no phone signal in the mountains.

assistance.m: as(在旁)+sist(站)+ance(名词)→站在旁边→帮助

wrap.m: 联想：wrap 音近“绕”，绕一圈裹起来→包；裹
wrap.e: She wrapped the gift in red paper.

asset.m: 源自古法语 asez(足够)→足以偿债的财产→资产；优势
asset.e: Good communication skills are a real asset.
asset.z: 良好的沟通能力是一大优势。

depression.m: de(向下)+press(压)+ion(名词)→往下压→抑郁；萧条
depression.e: Depression is common among young adults.
depression.z: 抑郁在年轻人中很常见。

spiritual.m: spirit(精神,源自 spir 呼吸)+ual(形容词)→精神的；心灵的
spiritual.e: Music can be a spiritual experience.
spiritual.z: 音乐可以是一种心灵体验。

musical.m: music(音乐)+al(形容词)→音乐的；音乐剧
musical.e: We saw a musical in the West End.
musical.z: 我们在伦敦西区看了一部音乐剧。

journalist.m: journ(日)+al+ist(人)→写每日报道的人→记者
journalist.e: She works as a journalist for the BBC.
journalist.z: 她是英国广播公司的记者。

suspect.m: su(在下)+spect(看)→从下往上偷看→怀疑；嫌疑人
suspect.e: Police arrested a suspect last night.
suspect.z: 警方昨晚逮捕了一名嫌疑人。

observation.e: The study is based on careful observation.
observation.z: 这项研究基于仔细的观察。

payment.e: Payment is due at the end of the month.

permit.m: per(通过)+mit(送)→送过去→允许；许可证

creation.e: The policy led to the creation of new jobs.
creation.z: 这项政策创造了新的就业岗位。

request.e: You can request a copy of the report.
request.z: 你可以申请一份报告副本。

emotion.m: e(出)+mot(动)+ion(名词)→从内心动出来→情感；情绪

dramatic.m: drama(戏剧)+tic(形容词)→戏剧性的；急剧的
dramatic.e: There was a dramatic fall in sales.

gap.m: 源自古诺尔斯语 gap(裂口)→缺口；差距
gap.e: The gap between rich and poor is growing.

agenda.m: ag(做)+enda(须…的事)→必须做的事→议程
agenda.e: Climate change is high on the agenda.

selection.e: The shop has a good selection of books.

initiative.m: initi(开始)+ative(名词)→主动开始→倡议；主动性
initiative.e: The new initiative aims to reduce waste.
initiative.z: 这项新倡议旨在减少浪费。

diet.m: 源自希腊语 diaita(生活方式)→饮食；节食
diet.e: A balanced diet keeps you healthy.
diet.z: 均衡饮食让你保持健康。

therapy.m: 源自希腊语 therapeia(治疗,照料)→治疗；疗法
therapy.z: 音乐疗法可以减轻焦虑。

violent.m: viol(暴力,力量)+ent(形容词)→暴力的；猛烈的
violent.e: Violent crime has decreased in the city.
violent.z: 该市暴力犯罪有所减少。

chip.m: 源自古英语 cipp(小木片)→碎片；芯片；薯条
chip.z: 现代手机装有强大的芯片。

settlement.m: settle(安顿)+ment(名词)→安顿下来→定居；解决
settlement.e: The dispute ended in a fair settlement for both sides.
settlement.z: 这场纠纷以对双方都公平的和解告终。

description.m: de(向下)+script(写)+ion(名词)→写下来→描述
description.e: Please give a brief description of the graph.

slide.m: 联想：「丝来的」→像丝一样滑过来→滑动
slide.e: Children love to slide down the hill in winter.
slide.z: 孩子们喜欢冬天从山坡上滑下来。

portion.m: port(部分，同part)+ion(名词)→分得的部分→份
portion.e: A large portion of income goes on rent.
portion.z: 收入的很大一部分花在房租上。

territory.m: terr(土地)+itory(场所)→属于某方的土地→领土
territory.e: Wolves defend their territory against other packs.
territory.z: 狼群会保卫领地，抵御其他狼群。

opponent.m: op(相对)+pon(放置)+ent(人)→放在对面的人→对手
opponent.e: She defeated her opponent in the final round.
opponent.z: 她在决赛轮击败了对手。

bother.m: 联想：「爸的」唠叨→总来烦扰你
bother.e: Sorry to bother you, but is this seat taken?
bother.z: 抱歉打扰，这个座位有人吗？

bend.m: 联想：b像弯腰的人+end(末端)→把末端弯下来→弯曲
bend.e: Bend your knees when you lift heavy boxes.
bend.z: 搬重箱子时要弯曲膝盖。

desert.m: de(去掉)+sert(连接)→断开联系→遗弃；荒漠
desert.e: Few plants can survive in the desert.
desert.z: 很少有植物能在沙漠中存活。

cop.e: A cop stopped the car for speeding.
cop.z: 一名警察因超速拦下了那辆车。

preserve.m: pre(预先)+serve(保持)→预先保护→保存
preserve.e: We must preserve historic buildings for future generations.
preserve.z: 我们必须为后代保护历史建筑。

formal.m: form(形式)+al(形容词)→讲形式的→正式的
formal.e: Use formal language in an academic essay.
formal.z: 学术文章中要使用正式的语言。

transition.m: trans(穿过)+it(走)+ion(名词)→从一处走到另一处→过渡
transition.e: The transition from school to work can be hard.
transition.z: 从学校到职场的过渡可能很艰难。

existence.e: Scientists question the existence of life on Mars.
existence.z: 科学家们质疑火星上是否存在生命。

album.m: alb(白色)+um→原指空白的板子→相册；专辑
album.e: The band released its first album last year.
album.z: 这支乐队去年发行了首张专辑。

opposite.m: op(相对)+pos(放)+ite(形容词)→放在对面的→相反的
opposite.e: The bank is opposite the post office.

deserve.m: de(完全)+serve(服务)→尽心服务了→应得
deserve.e: You deserve a rest after all that work.
deserve.z: 干了这么多活，你该休息一下了。

resistance.e: Exercise improves your resistance to illness.
resistance.z: 锻炼能提高你对疾病的抵抗力。

exposure.e: Too much sun exposure can damage your skin.

pose.m: pos(放置)→摆放出来→提出；摆姿势
pose.e: Climate change poses a serious threat to coastal cities.
pose.z: 气候变化对沿海城市构成严重威胁。

mine.m: 联想：mine也是「我的」→地下宝藏都是我的→矿
mine.e: The old coal mine closed in the 1980s.
mine.z: 那座老煤矿在20世纪80年代关闭了。

grand.m: 源自拉丁grandis(大的)→宏大的→壮观的
grand.e: The hotel has a grand entrance hall.
grand.z: 这家酒店有一个宏伟的入口大厅。

coalition.m: co(共同)+al(生长)+ition(名词)→一起长→联合
coalition.e: Two parties formed a coalition government.
coalition.z: 两个政党组成了联合政府。

symptom.m: sym(共同)+ptom(落下)→一起出现的情况→症状
symptom.e: A fever is a common symptom of flu.
symptom.z: 发烧是流感的常见症状。

occasion.m: oc(向)+cas(落下)+ion(名词)→恰好落到→时机；场合
occasion.e: Wear a suit for a formal occasion.

dust.m: 联想：「打死它」→把灰尘拍掉
dust.e: The shelves were covered in dust.

ordinary.m: ordin(顺序)+ary(形容词)→按常规顺序的→普通的
ordinary.e: It was just an ordinary day at work.
ordinary.z: 那只是平常的一个工作日。

rarely.e: He rarely eats breakfast before class.

suicide.e: The charity works to prevent suicide among teenagers.
suicide.z: 该慈善机构致力于预防青少年自杀。

numerous.m: numer(数)+ous(多…的)→数目多的→众多的

discipline.m: disciple(门徒)+ine→对门徒的训练→纪律；学科
discipline.e: Psychology is a relatively young discipline.
discipline.z: 心理学是一门相对年轻的学科。

elsewhere.e: Prices are lower elsewhere in the city.
elsewhere.z: 城里别的地方价格更低。

practical.m: practic(实践)+al(形容词)→实践的→实际的
practical.e: We need a practical solution to traffic jams.
practical.z: 我们需要一个解决交通拥堵的实际方案。

moreover.m: more(更多)+over(超过)→还有更多→此外
moreover.e: The plan is cheap; moreover, it is easy to run.
moreover.z: 这个方案很便宜，而且易于实施。

passion.m: pass(=pati忍受)+ion(名词)→原义受苦→强烈情感→激情
passion.e: She has a real passion for music.

volunteer.m: vol(意愿)+unt+eer(人)→自愿的人→志愿者
volunteer.e: Many students volunteer at local hospitals.
volunteer.z: 许多学生在当地医院做志愿者。

gene.m: gen(产生)→生命产生的遗传单位→基因
gene.z: 这个基因影响眼睛的颜色。

sauce.m: 源自拉丁sal(盐)→加盐的调料→酱汁
sauce.e: Pour the tomato sauce over the pasta.
sauce.z: 把番茄酱浇在意大利面上。

independence.m: in(不)+depend(依靠)+ence(名词)→不依靠→独立
independence.z: 在国外生活让我学会了独立。

employer.e: My employer pays for my training courses.
employer.z: 我的雇主为我的培训课程付费。

shock.e: The news came as a shock to everyone.
shock.z: 这个消息让所有人震惊。

inspire.m: in(向内)+spir(呼吸)+e→吹入气息→激发灵感
inspire.e: Her story inspired me to study harder.
inspire.z: 她的故事激励我更加努力学习。

competitive.e: The job market is highly competitive.
competitive.z: 就业市场竞争非常激烈。

disaster.e: The flood was a natural disaster.
disaster.z: 那场洪水是一场自然灾害。

complaint.e: The hotel received many complaints about noise.
complaint.z: 酒店收到了很多关于噪音的投诉。

severe.m: 联想：se(=seven七)+vere→七级严重→严重的
severe.e: The region faces a severe water shortage.

poverty.e: Education can help people escape poverty.
poverty.z: 教育能帮助人们摆脱贫困。

entry.e: Entry to the museum is free.

mood.m: 联想：「木的」→心情不好时人发木→心情
mood.e: Sunny weather puts me in a good mood.

accomplish.m: ac(加强)+compl(填满)+ish(动词)→完全填满→完成
accomplish.e: We accomplished the task ahead of schedule.

boot.m: 联想：「布特」→穿靴子去踢→长靴

entertainment.e: The city offers plenty of entertainment for tourists.
entertainment.z: 这座城市为游客提供丰富的娱乐活动。

digital.m: digit(手指；数字)+al(形容词)→数字的
digital.e: Digital technology has changed how we learn.
digital.z: 数字技术改变了我们的学习方式。

psychological.m: psycho(心理)+log(学)+ical(形容词)→心理学的

anger.e: He couldn't hide his anger at the decision.
anger.z: 他无法掩饰对这个决定的愤怒。

peak.m: 联想：pea(豌豆)尖+k→尖顶→山峰；顶峰
peak.e: Traffic reaches its peak at 8 a.m.
peak.z: 交通在早上8点达到高峰。

missile.m: miss(=mit发送)+ile(物)→发射出去的东西→导弹

disorder.m: dis(不)+order(秩序)→无秩序→混乱；失调
disorder.e: She suffers from an eating disorder.

distribution.m: dis(分开)+tribut(给予)+ion(名词)→分给→分配
distribution.e: The distribution of wealth is uneven.

transportation.m: trans(越过)+port(运)+ation(名词)→运过去→运输
transportation.z: 公共交通能减少空气污染。

engineering.e: He is studying civil engineering at university.
engineering.z: 他在大学学习土木工程。

clinic.e: The clinic opens at nine every morning.
clinic.z: 这家诊所每天早上九点开门。

veteran.e: He is a veteran of the Second World War.

toss.m: 联想：「掏死」→掏出来扔掉→投掷
toss.e: Let's toss a coin to decide.

exception.m: ex(出)+cept(拿)+ion(名词)→拿出去的→例外
exception.z: 除了一个人外，大家都及格了。

deficit.m: de(向下)+fic(做)+it→做得不够→不足；赤字
deficit.e: The government plans to cut the budget deficit.
deficit.z: 政府计划削减预算赤字。

electronic.e: Electronic waste is a growing problem.
electronic.z: 电子垃圾问题日益严重。

ally.e: Britain is a close ally of the US.
ally.z: 英国是美国的亲密盟友。

reputation.m: re(反复)+put(想)+ation(名词)→被人反复想起→名声
reputation.e: The university has an excellent reputation.
reputation.z: 这所大学享有极好的声誉。

mixture.e: The city is a mixture of old and new.

confront.m: con(共同)+front(前面；额头)→面对面→对抗
confront.e: We must confront the problem directly.
confront.z: 我们必须直面这个问题。

pure.e: The air in the mountains is pure.

designer.e: She works as a fashion designer.

retirement.e: He plans to travel after retirement.

junior.m: jun(年轻)+ior(比较级)→更年轻的→年少者
junior.e: She is a junior doctor at the hospital.

throat.m: 联想：throw(扔)+at→把食物扔进喉咙→喉咙
throat.e: I have a sore throat and a cough.

salary.m: sal(盐)+ary→古罗马士兵领盐钱→薪水
salary.e: Teachers' salaries have risen this year.
salary.z: 今年教师的工资上涨了。

crop.m: 联想：c+rop(谐音「肉皮」)→地里长出的庄稼
crop.e: Rice is the main crop in this region.
crop.z: 水稻是该地区的主要作物。

permanent.m: per(贯穿)+man(停留)+ent(形容词)→一直停留的→永久的
permanent.e: She finally found a permanent job.
permanent.z: 她终于找到了一份长期工作。

anxiety.m: anx(=ang勒紧)+iety(名词)→心里发紧→焦虑
anxiety.e: Exams often cause anxiety among students.
anxiety.z: 考试常常引起学生焦虑。

literally.m: liter(文字)+al+ly(副词)→按文字地→字面上地
literally.e: The word literally means 'love of wisdom'.
literally.z: 这个词的字面意思是「爱智慧」。

convention.m: con(共同)+vent(来)+ion(名词)→大家一起来→大会；惯例
convention.e: Shaking hands is a social convention.

embrace.m: em(进入)+brace(双臂)→抱入双臂→拥抱；接受
embrace.e: Many firms embrace new technology quickly.
embrace.z: 许多公司迅速接纳新技术。

exhibition.m: ex(出)+hibit(拿着)+ion(名词)→拿出来给人看→展览
exhibition.e: The art exhibition attracted thousands of visitors.
exhibition.z: 这场艺术展吸引了数千名参观者。

consultant.m: consult(咨询)+ant(人)→被咨询的人→顾问
consultant.e: She works as a financial consultant.

administrator.e: The school administrator approved the new timetable.
administrator.z: 学校管理人员批准了新课表。

historic.m: histor(y)(历史)+ic(形容词)→有历史意义的
historic.e: This is a historic moment for the country.
historic.z: 这是这个国家的历史性时刻。

buck.m: 联想：「巴克」→雄鹿；美俚语一元钱
buck.e: This T-shirt only cost ten bucks.

bind.m: 联想：b+ind(印度)→把东西绑起来→捆绑；约束
bind.z: 这份合同对双方都有约束力。

enterprise.m: enter(在…之间)+prise(抓住)→抓住机会→企业；进取心
enterprise.e: Small enterprises create many local jobs.
enterprise.z: 小企业创造了许多本地就业岗位。

favor.m: 联想：「飞吻」→表示喜爱→好意；偏爱
favor.e: Could you do me a favor?

install.m: in(进入)+stall(位置)→放进位置→安装
install.e: We installed solar panels on the roof.
install.z: 我们在屋顶上安装了太阳能板。

sensitive.m: sens(感觉)+itive(形容词)→感觉灵敏的→敏感的
sensitive.e: Her skin is very sensitive to sunlight.
sensitive.z: 她的皮肤对阳光非常敏感。

recipe.m: 源自拉丁recipe(「拿取」，药方首字)→处方→食谱
recipe.z: 这个食谱需要三个鸡蛋。

reasonable.m: reason(道理)+able(能…的)→讲道理的→合理的
reasonable.e: The price seems reasonable for the quality.
reasonable.z: 就质量而言价格似乎合理。

elementary.m: element(元素)+ary(形容词)→最基本的→初级的
elementary.e: He has only elementary knowledge of French.

aggressive.m: ag(向)+gress(走)+ive(形容词)→向人走去→侵略的
aggressive.e: Some dogs become aggressive when scared.
aggressive.z: 有些狗受惊时会变得具有攻击性。

rail.m: 联想：rail像rule(尺)→直尺般的横杆→栏杆；铁路
rail.e: Hold the rail when going downstairs.

anniversary.m: anni(年)+vers(转)+ary→每年转回来的日子→周年纪念
anniversary.e: They celebrated their tenth wedding anniversary.
anniversary.z: 他们庆祝了结婚十周年。

couch.m: 联想：「靠吃」→靠在沙发上吃零食
couch.e: He fell asleep on the couch.

alliance.m: al(=ad向)+li(捆绑)+ance(名词)→绑在一起→联盟
alliance.e: The two firms formed an alliance.

compose.m: com(共同)+pos(放)+e→放在一起→组成；创作
compose.e: Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen.

mess.m: 联想：「麦死」→乱成一团→混乱
mess.e: My room is in a mess.

legend.m: leg(读)+end→供人诵读的故事→传说
legend.e: According to legend, a dragon lived here.
legend.z: 据传说，这里曾住着一条龙。

norm.m: 源自拉丁norma(木匠的直角尺)→标准→规范
norm.e: Working from home is becoming the norm.

remark.m: re(加强)+mark(标记；注意)→注意到并说出→评论
remark.e: He made a rude remark about her dress.
remark.z: 他对她的裙子说了句无礼的话。

resign.m: re(取消)+sign(签名)→取消签约→辞职
resign.e: The manager resigned after the scandal.

reward.m: re(回)+ward(看守；关注)→回报→报酬；奖赏
reward.e: Hard work brings its own reward.

gentle.m: gent(出身；氏族)+le→出身好的→温和的
gentle.e: Speak to children in a gentle voice.
gentle.z: 用温柔的声音和孩子说话。

organ.m: 源自希腊organon(工具)→身体的工具→器官；风琴
organ.e: The heart is a vital organ.

ritual.e: Morning coffee is a daily ritual for me.
ritual.z: 早上喝咖啡是我每天的固定习惯。

insect.m: in(进入)+sect(切)→身体被切成节的→昆虫

superior.m: super(在上)+ior(比较级)→更上面的→上级；更好的
superior.e: This model is superior to the old one.

combat.m: com(共同)+bat(打)→一起打→战斗；打击
combat.e: New measures were taken to combat crime.
combat.z: 采取了新措施打击犯罪。

surgeon.m: 源自希腊kheirourgos(手+工作)→用手干活的→外科医生
surgeon.e: The surgeon performed a heart operation.
surgeon.z: 外科医生做了心脏手术。

stem.m: 联想：s+tem(谐音「藤」)→植物茎干→源于
stem.e: Many health problems stem from poor diet.
stem.z: 许多健康问题源于饮食不良。

counsel.m: coun(=con共同)+sel(召集；商量)→一起商量→忠告
counsel.e: Students can get counsel on career choices.
counsel.z: 学生可以获得职业选择方面的建议。

hunt.m: 联想：「憨的」猎人去狩猎→打猎；搜寻
hunt.e: I'm hunting for a new flat.

log.m: 联想：「捞个」木头→圆木；日志记录
log.e: Keep a log of your daily spending.

echo.m: 源自希腊神话仙女Echo(回声女神)→回声
echo.e: Our voices echoed in the empty hall.
echo.z: 我们的声音在空荡荡的大厅里回响。

sculpture.e: There is a bronze sculpture in the square.

flour.m: flower(花)同源→谷物的「精华」→面粉
flour.e: Mix the flour with milk and eggs.
flour.z: 把面粉和牛奶、鸡蛋混合。

bare.m: 联想：bear(熊)去掉e→熊掌赤裸→赤裸的
bare.e: Don't walk on the hot sand in bare feet.

slope.e: We skied down the gentle slope.
slope.z: 我们从缓坡上滑雪下来。

subtle.m: sub(下)+tle(=tela织物)→织在下面的细线→微妙的
subtle.e: There are subtle differences between the two words.
subtle.z: 这两个词之间有细微差别。

pump.m: 拟声「嘭嘭」→打气筒；抽水机
pump.e: The heart pumps blood around the body.
pump.z: 心脏把血液泵送到全身。

medal.m: 联想：metal(金属)换一字母→金属奖牌
medal.e: She won a gold medal at the Olympics.
medal.z: 她在奥运会上获得金牌。

sponsor.m: spons(承诺)+or(人)→承诺出钱的人→赞助者
sponsor.z: 一家银行赞助了马拉松。

ethical.e: Testing on animals raises ethical questions.
ethical.z: 动物实验引发伦理问题。

secondary.m: second(第二)+ary(形容词)→第二级的→中等的；次要的
secondary.e: She teaches at a secondary school.

experimental.z: 这种疗法仍处于试验阶段。

midnight.e: The shop stays open until midnight.

curve.e: The road follows the curve of the river.
curve.z: 这条路沿着河流的弯道延伸。

integrity.m: integr(完整)+ity(名词)→品格完整→正直
integrity.e: A good leader must have integrity.

entitle.m: en(使)+title(名称；权利)→给予名分→使有权
entitle.e: Students are entitled to a discount.

essence.m: ess(=esse存在)+ence(名词)→存在的根本→本质
essence.e: Time is of the essence in an emergency.
essence.z: 紧急情况下时间至关重要。

harsh.m: 联想：「哈市」冬天→严酷的；刺耳的
harsh.e: The plants cannot survive harsh winters.
harsh.z: 这些植物无法熬过严冬。

closet.m: close(关闭)+t→关起来的小室→壁橱
closet.e: Hang your coat in the closet.

interior.m: inter(内部)+ior(比较级)→更里面的→内部
interior.e: The car's interior is very comfortable.

retail.m: re(再)+tail(切)→再切成小份卖→零售
retail.e: He works in retail as a sales assistant.

classical.e: I listen to classical music while studying.

flash.m: 联想：fl(飞)+ash(灰)→火光一闪→闪光
flash.e: A flash of lightning lit the sky.

humanity.e: Climate change is a threat to humanity.
humanity.z: 气候变化是对人类的威胁。

correlation.m: cor(共同)+relat(关联)+ion(名词)→相互关联→相关性
correlation.e: There is a strong correlation between diet and health.
correlation.z: 饮食与健康之间有很强的相关性。

reliable.e: Public transport here is cheap and reliable.
reliable.z: 这里的公共交通便宜又可靠。

excitement.m: ex(出)+cit(唤起)+e+ment(名词)→唤起情绪→兴奋
excitement.e: The children were full of excitement.

architecture.e: The city is famous for its modern architecture.
architecture.z: 这座城市以现代建筑闻名。

elbow.m: el(=ell前臂)+bow(弯)→手臂弯曲处→手肘
elbow.e: He hurt his elbow playing tennis.

deadly.e: The virus can be deadly for older people.
deadly.z: 这种病毒对老年人可能致命。

confuse.m: con(共同)+fus(倒；流)+e→倒在一起→使混乱
confuse.e: People often confuse the two words.

dose.m: 源自希腊dosis(给予)→给的药量→剂量
dose.e: Take one dose of this medicine twice a day.
dose.z: 这种药每天服两次，每次一剂。

plead.e: She pleaded with him to stay.

mainstream.e: Online learning has entered the mainstream.

suburb.m: sub(接近；下)+urb(城市)→城市附近→郊区
suburb.e: Many families move to the suburbs for space.
suburb.z: 许多家庭为了更大空间搬到郊区。

trunk.m: 联想：「船客」的行李箱→树干；象鼻；后备箱
trunk.e: Put the bags in the trunk of the car.

motivate.e: Good teachers motivate students to learn.
motivate.z: 好老师能激发学生学习的动力。

swallow.m: 联想：swa(刷)+llow(low低)→燕子低飞刷过水面，一口吞下虫子
swallow.e: Swallows migrate south when the weather turns cold.
swallow.z: 天气变冷时，燕子向南迁徙。

render.m: re(回)+nd(=dare给)+er→给回去→提供；使成为
render.e: The heavy rain rendered the roads unsafe.
render.z: 大雨使道路变得不安全。

trap.m: 联想：倒过来是part(部分)→掉进陷阱只剩一部分
trap.e: Many animals are caught in traps set by hunters.
trap.z: 许多动物被猎人设下的陷阱捕获。

cloth.m: 联想：clothes(衣服)去掉es→做衣服的布料
cloth.e: She wiped the table with a damp cloth.

seemingly.e: The task was seemingly simple at first.
seemingly.z: 这项任务起初看似简单。

lens.m: 源自拉丁lens(小扁豆)→形似扁豆的透镜
lens.e: He cleaned the camera lens before taking photos.
lens.z: 拍照前他擦了擦相机镜头。

companion.m: com(共同)+pan(面包)+ion(人)→同吃面包的人→同伴
companion.e: A dog can be a loyal companion for elderly people.
companion.z: 狗可以成为老人忠实的伙伴。

fraud.e: Online fraud has become a serious problem.
fraud.z: 网络诈骗已成为严重问题。

contend.m: con(共同)+tend(伸展)→一起伸手争→竞争；主张
contend.e: Some experts contend that homework is unnecessary.
contend.z: 一些专家主张家庭作业没有必要。

array.m: ar(=ad向)+ray(准备，排列)→排列整齐；一系列
array.e: The shop offers a wide array of local products.
array.z: 这家店提供各种各样的本地产品。

assemble.m: as(=ad向)+semble(一起，同)→聚到一起→集合；组装
assemble.e: Students assembled in the hall for the ceremony.
assemble.z: 学生们在礼堂集合参加典礼。

cave.m: 源自拉丁cavus(空的)→空洞→洞穴
cave.e: Ancient paintings were found inside the cave.
cave.z: 洞穴里发现了古代壁画。

monster.m: 源自拉丁monere(警告)→神示警的怪物
monster.e: Children love stories about friendly monsters.
monster.z: 孩子们喜欢关于友善怪物的故事。

obstacle.m: ob(对着)+sta(站)+cle(名词)→挡在对面站着→障碍
obstacle.e: Lack of funding is the main obstacle to research.
obstacle.z: 缺乏资金是研究的主要障碍。

rip.m: 联想：撕(rip)拉一声→撕裂；裂口
rip.e: He accidentally ripped his jeans on a nail.
rip.z: 他不小心被钉子刮破了牛仔裤。

herb.e: Fresh herbs make the soup taste much better.
herb.z: 新鲜香草让汤的味道好多了。

crystal.m: 源自希腊krystallos(冰)→像冰一样透明→水晶
crystal.e: The lake water was as clear as crystal.

recession.m: re(向后)+cess(走)+ion(名词)→经济往后退→衰退
recession.e: Many people lost their jobs during the recession.
recession.z: 经济衰退期间许多人失业了。

ownership.e: Home ownership is rising among young people.
ownership.z: 年轻人中拥有住房的比例在上升。

nightmare.m: night(夜)+mare(古英语:梦魔)→夜里的梦魔→噩梦
nightmare.e: Traffic in the city centre is a nightmare.
nightmare.z: 市中心的交通简直是噩梦。

inspection.m: in(向内)+spect(看)+ion(名词)→向里看→检查
inspection.e: All restaurants must pass a health inspection.
inspection.z: 所有餐馆都必须通过卫生检查。

supervisor.m: super(在上)+vis(看)+or(人)→在上面看的人→监督者
supervisor.e: My supervisor gave me useful advice on my thesis.
supervisor.z: 我的导师对我的论文提出了有用建议。

arena.m: 源自拉丁(h)arena(沙)→铺沙的角斗场→舞台
arena.e: The concert was held in a huge indoor arena.
arena.z: 音乐会在一个巨大的室内场馆举行。

possession.m: pos(能力)+sess(坐)+ion→有权坐着占着→拥有
possession.e: Mobile phones are now a common possession.
possession.z: 手机现在是人们常有的物品。

forgive.m: for(完全)+give(给)→完全给出(怨气)→原谅
forgive.e: It is hard to forgive someone who lies to you.
forgive.z: 原谅对你撒谎的人很难。

basement.m: base(底部)+ment(名词)→房屋底部→地下室
basement.e: They turned the basement into a home office.
basement.z: 他们把地下室改成了家庭办公室。

drift.m: drive(驱动)的同源词→被风浪推动→漂流
drift.e: The boat drifted slowly down the river.

drain.m: 源自古英语dry(干)同源→把水弄干→排水；耗尽
drain.e: Long meetings can drain your energy.
drain.z: 冗长的会议会耗尽你的精力。

maximum.e: The maximum speed on this road is 60 km/h.
maximum.z: 这条路的最高时速是60公里。

announcement.m: an(=ad向)+nounce(报告)+ment(名词)→向众人报告→公告
announcement.e: The university made an announcement about fees.
announcement.z: 大学发布了一则关于学费的公告。

prosecution.m: pro(向前)+secut(跟随)+ion→向前追究→起诉
prosecution.e: The prosecution presented new evidence in court.
prosecution.z: 控方在法庭上出示了新证据。

questionnaire.e: Please fill in this short questionnaire.
questionnaire.z: 请填写这份简短的问卷。

bacteria.m: 源自希腊baktron(小杆)→杆状微生物→细菌
bacteria.e: Washing hands removes most harmful bacteria.
bacteria.z: 洗手可以去除大部分有害细菌。

privilege.m: privi(私人)+leg(法律)→为个人立的法→特权
privilege.e: Education should be a right, not a privilege.
privilege.z: 教育应是权利，而非特权。

temple.e: We visited an ancient temple in Kyoto.
temple.z: 我们参观了京都的一座古寺。

suck.m: 联想：拟声词，吸溜吸溜→吸；吮
suck.e: The baby sucked milk from the bottle.

leap.m: 联想：lea像lift→一下跳起→跳跃；剧增
leap.e: Sales took a big leap after the advert.
leap.z: 广告之后销量大幅跃升。

weird.m: 源自古英语wyrd(命运)→命运女神的神秘→怪异的
weird.e: I heard a weird noise outside last night.
weird.z: 昨晚我听到外面有奇怪的声音。

fiscal.m: 源自拉丁fiscus(钱篮，国库)→财政的
fiscal.e: The government announced new fiscal policies.
fiscal.z: 政府宣布了新的财政政策。

dump.m: 联想：蹲(dum)着把垃圾一倒→倾倒；垃圾场
dump.e: People should not dump rubbish in rivers.
dump.z: 人们不应往河里倾倒垃圾。

database.e: The library has an online database of articles.
database.z: 图书馆有一个在线文章数据库。

uncomfortable.m: un(不)+comfort(舒适)+able(形容词)→不舒服的
uncomfortable.e: These shoes are uncomfortable for long walks.
uncomfortable.z: 这双鞋长距离走路不舒服。

limb.m: 联想：lim像limit边缘→身体边缘的部分→四肢
limb.e: He broke a limb in the accident.
limb.z: 他在事故中断了一条胳膊或腿。

tune.e: She hummed a cheerful tune while cooking.
tune.z: 她做饭时哼着欢快的曲子。

radiation.m: radi(光线)+ation(名词)→放射光线→辐射
radiation.e: Too much sun radiation can damage skin.
radiation.z: 过多的太阳辐射会损伤皮肤。

chronic.m: chron(时间)+ic(形容词)→时间长的→慢性的
chronic.e: Chronic stress affects both mind and body.

replacement.m: re(再)+place(放)+ment(名词)→再放一个→更换
replacement.e: We need a replacement for the broken printer.
replacement.z: 我们需要换一台坏掉的打印机。

innovation.m: in(进入)+nov(新)+ation(名词)→引入新的→创新
innovation.z: 技术创新推动经济增长。

strain.m: 源自拉丁stringere(拉紧)→拉紧；紧张
strain.e: Working night shifts puts a strain on health.
strain.z: 上夜班会给健康带来压力。

behave.m: be(使)+have(拥有，持有)→持有自己→举止
behave.e: Children usually behave well at school.
behave.z: 孩子们在学校通常表现良好。

administer.m: ad(向)+minister(服务)→为…服务→管理；给予

dancer.e: She has been a professional dancer for ten years.
dancer.z: 她当职业舞者已有十年。

pad.e: He put a pad under his knee for support.
pad.z: 他在膝盖下垫了个垫子。

transmission.m: trans(穿过)+miss(送)+ion(名词)→送过去→传输
transmission.e: Masks reduce the transmission of viruses.

trigger.m: 源自荷兰语trekken(拉)→扣动扳机→引发
trigger.e: Loud noises can trigger anxiety in some people.
trigger.z: 噪音会引发一些人的焦虑。

spill.m: 联想：s+pill(药片)→药片撒了一地→溢出
spill.e: Be careful not to spill coffee on the laptop.
spill.z: 小心别把咖啡洒在笔记本电脑上。

grateful.e: I am grateful for your help.

colony.m: col(耕种，居住)+ony→去耕种定居的地方→殖民地
colony.e: Australia was once a British colony.
colony.z: 澳大利亚曾是英国殖民地。

adoption.m: ad(向)+opt(选择)+ion(名词)→选中→采纳；收养
adoption.e: The adoption of solar energy is increasing.
adoption.z: 太阳能的采用正在增加。

convict.m: con(加强)+vict(征服)→被彻底制服→定罪
convict.e: He was convicted of stealing a car.

indigenous.m: indi(内)+gen(生)+ous(形容词)→在本地出生的→本土的

particle.e: Dust particles in the air harm our lungs.
particle.z: 空气中的尘粒损害我们的肺。

boost.m: 联想：boo+st，像火箭助推升空→提高

alarm.m: 源自意大利all'arme(拿起武器)→警报；惊恐
alarm.e: My alarm goes off at seven every morning.
alarm.z: 我的闹钟每天早上七点响。

grip.e: Hold the handle with a firm grip.

undermine.m: under(在下)+mine(挖矿)→在底下挖→削弱
undermine.e: Lack of sleep can undermine your health.

ballot.m: 源自意大利ballotta(小球)→古时用小球投票→选票
ballot.e: Voters cast their ballots on Sunday.

web.e: A spider spun a web in the corner.
web.z: 一只蜘蛛在角落里织了网。

intelligent.m: intel(=inter之间)+lig(选择)+ent→能在中间选择→聪明的
intelligent.z: 海豚是非常聪明的动物。

rhetoric.m: 源自希腊rhetor(演说家)→演说术→修辞；空话
rhetoric.e: Voters are tired of empty political rhetoric.
rhetoric.z: 选民厌倦了空洞的政治辞令。

vitamin.m: vita(生命)+amin(胺)→生命必需的胺→维生素
vitamin.e: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.

enthusiasm.e: She talked about her project with great enthusiasm.
enthusiasm.z: 她满怀热情地谈论她的项目。

wilderness.e: They spent a week hiking in the wilderness.
wilderness.z: 他们在荒野中徒步了一周。

mandate.m: man(手)+date(给)→交到手里→授权；命令
mandate.e: The new law mandates recycling in all homes.
mandate.z: 新法要求所有家庭进行垃圾回收。

respectively.e: Tom and Amy are 20 and 22 respectively.
respectively.z: 汤姆和艾米分别是20岁和22岁。

chaos.m: 源自希腊chaos(空虚，混沌)→大混乱
chaos.e: The storm caused chaos at the airport.
chaos.z: 风暴导致机场一片混乱。

format.e: The essay must follow the standard format.
format.z: 论文必须遵循标准格式。

canvas.m: 源自拉丁cannabis(大麻)→大麻纤维织的布→帆布；画布
canvas.e: The artist painted on a large canvas.
canvas.z: 艺术家在一块大画布上作画。

profound.m: pro(向前)+found(底部)→向前深达底部→深刻的
profound.e: The internet has had a profound impact on education.
profound.z: 互联网对教育产生了深远影响。

lobby.m: 源自意大利loggia(走廊)→在议会走廊拉关系→游说；大厅
lobby.e: Environmental groups lobby for stricter laws.
lobby.z: 环保团体游说要求更严格的法律。

trait.m: 源自拉丁tractus(拉，画线)→画出的线条→特征

barn.m: 源自古英语bere(大麦)+ærn(房)→存大麦的房→谷仓
barn.e: The farmer keeps hay in the barn.
barn.z: 农民把干草存在谷仓里。

specialize.m: special(特别的)+ize(动词)→使专门化→专攻

carpet.m: 联想：car+pet，车里铺地毯给宠物睡→地毯
carpet.e: We bought a new carpet for the living room.
carpet.z: 我们给客厅买了一块新地毯。

tuck.m: 联想：tuck读"塔克"，塞进去→塞；折起

faint.m: 与feign(假装)同源→软弱无力→昏厥；微弱的
faint.e: She felt faint in the hot room.
faint.z: 在闷热的房间里她感到头晕。

dilemma.m: di(二)+lemma(前提)→两个前提都难→困境
dilemma.e: Many students face the dilemma of work or study.
dilemma.z: 许多学生面临工作还是读书的两难。

liability.m: li(=lig捆绑)+ability→被法律捆住→责任；负债

shallow.z: 孩子们应在浅水区游泳。

stadium.m: 源自希腊stadion(赛跑距离单位)→赛跑场→体育场

lane.m: 联想：lane像line(线)→窄窄一条→小路；车道
lane.e: Cyclists should stay in the bike lane.
lane.z: 骑车人应待在自行车道内。

ancestor.m: ance(=ante先)+cest(走)+or(人)→走在前面的人→祖先
ancestor.e: Our ancestors lived by hunting and farming.
ancestor.z: 我们的祖先以狩猎和耕作为生。

condemn.m: con(加强)+demn(损害，罚)→严加惩罚→谴责
condemn.z: 联合国谴责了这次袭击。

steam.m: 联想：st+eam→水烧开冒出的气→蒸汽
steam.e: Steam rose from the hot cup of tea.

rack.e: Put your bag on the luggage rack.
rack.z: 把你的包放在行李架上。

costume.m: 与custom(习俗)同源→按习俗穿的衣服→服装
costume.e: The children wore costumes for the festival.

statute.m: stat(站，立)+ute→立下的规定→成文法
statute.e: The new statute protects workers' rights.

grin.m: 联想：grin读"格林"，咧嘴笑→露齿笑
grin.e: He grinned when he heard the good news.
grin.z: 听到好消息他咧嘴笑了。

cartoon.m: cart(=chart纸)+oon(大)→大张纸上的画→漫画
cartoon.e: Many children watch cartoons on Saturday mornings.
cartoon.z: 许多孩子周六早上看动画片。

productivity.e: Good sleep improves productivity at work.
productivity.z: 良好的睡眠提高工作效率。

bug.m: 联想：bug读"八哥"，小虫子钻进程序→虫子；故障
bug.e: The app crashed because of a bug.
bug.z: 这个应用因程序错误崩溃了。

bless.m: 源自古英语blod(血)→以血祝圣→祝福

hostile.m: host(敌人，陌生人)+ile(形容词)→敌对的
hostile.e: The animals were hostile to strangers.
hostile.z: 这些动物对陌生人有敌意。

agriculture.m: agri(田地)+cult(耕种)+ure(名词)→耕田→农业
agriculture.e: Agriculture uses a large amount of fresh water.

conceive.m: con(加强)+ceive(拿)→拿住想法→构想；怀孕
conceive.e: It is hard to conceive of life without phones.
conceive.z: 很难想象没有手机的生活。

bonus.m: 源自拉丁bonus(好的)→好东西→奖金
bonus.e: Staff received a bonus at the end of the year.
bonus.z: 员工在年底拿到了奖金。

vaccine.m: vacc(母牛)+ine→最早取自牛痘→疫苗
vaccine.e: A new vaccine was developed within a year.
vaccine.z: 一年内研制出了一种新疫苗。

collaboration.m: col(共同)+labor(劳动)+ation→共同劳动→合作
collaboration.e: The project is a collaboration between two universities.
collaboration.z: 这个项目是两所大学合作的成果。

orbit.e: The satellite is in orbit around the Earth.
orbit.z: 卫星在绕地球轨道上运行。

tropical.e: Tropical rainforests are home to many species.
tropical.z: 热带雨林是众多物种的家园。

patrol.m: 联想：pat(拍)+rol(roll转)→拍拍各处转一圈→巡逻
patrol.e: Police patrol the streets at night.

jewelry.e: She keeps her jewelry in a small box.
jewelry.z: 她把首饰放在一个小盒子里。

haul.m: 联想：haul像hall，把东西拖进大厅→拖运

concede.m: con(加强)+cede(走，让)→退让→承认；让步
concede.e: He conceded that he had made a mistake.

spectacular.m: spect(看)+acul+ar(形容词)→值得一看的→壮观的
spectacular.e: The view from the mountain is spectacular.

sheer.m: 联想：sheer像"纯儿"→纯粹的；全然的
sheer.e: The sheer size of the city surprised me.
sheer.z: 这座城市之大令我吃惊。

immune.m: im(无)+mune(义务，服务)→免除负担→免疫的
immune.e: Some people are immune to the disease.
immune.z: 有些人对这种疾病免疫。

alongside.z: 机器人如今与人类并肩工作。

exotic.m: exo(外)+tic(形容词)→外来的→异国情调的
exotic.z: 这个市场出售异国水果。

bull.m: 联想：bull读"布尔"，斗牛场上的公牛→公牛
bull.e: A bull market means prices are rising.
bull.z: 牛市意味着价格在上涨。

clip.m: 联想：拟声"咔"一剪→剪；夹子
clip.e: Use a paper clip to hold the pages.
clip.z: 用回形针把纸夹在一起。

thigh.m: 联想：thigh读"赛"，赛跑靠大腿→大腿
thigh.e: He injured his thigh during the match.

intimate.m: intim(最里面的)+ate→最内心的→亲密的
intimate.e: They have been intimate friends since childhood.
intimate.z: 他们从小就是亲密的朋友。

secular.m: 源自拉丁saeculum(世俗，时代)→世俗的

cab.m: cabriolet(轻便马车)的缩写→出租车

tender.m: 源自拉丁tener(柔嫩的)→嫩的；温柔的

progressive.m: pro(向前)+gress(走)+ive(形容词)→向前走的→进步的
progressive.e: The country has progressive tax laws.
progressive.z: 这个国家实行累进税法。

casualty.m: casual(偶然的)+ty(名词)→意外→伤亡人员

execution.m: ex(出)+(s)ecut(跟随)+ion→跟到底→执行；处决

terrific.m: terr(惊吓)+ific(产生…的)→吓人的→极好的
terrific.e: We had a terrific time at the beach.

instinct.m: in(在内)+stinct(刺激)→内在的刺激→本能

verdict.e: The jury reached a verdict of not guilty.

loop.m: 联想：loop像两个o连成圈→环；回路
loop.e: The road forms a loop around the lake.
loop.z: 这条路绕湖形成一个环。

whip.m: 联想：拟声"嗖"一鞭→鞭子；抽打

puzzle.m: 联想：puzzle像"怕走"，迷路不敢走→难题；迷惑

puzzle.z: 这个填字游戏花了我一个小时。

mushroom.e: New cafes have mushroomed in the area.
mushroom.z: 这个地区新咖啡馆如雨后春笋般涌现。

boil.m: 源自拉丁bulla(气泡)→冒泡→煮沸

earthquake.e: The earthquake destroyed hundreds of homes.
earthquake.z: 地震摧毁了数百所房屋。

isolation.e: Many elderly people suffer from social isolation.
isolation.z: 许多老人遭受社交孤立。

entrepreneur.m: entre(之间)+pren(拿)+eur(人)→在中间承担的人→企业家
entrepreneur.e: She became a successful entrepreneur at 25.
entrepreneur.z: 她25岁时成为成功的企业家。

ambition.m: amb(周围)+it(走)+ion→四处走动拉票→野心；抱负

breeze.m: 联想：breeze读"不累死"，微风吹着很舒服→微风

costly.e: Mistakes in medicine can be costly.
costly.z: 医疗中的错误代价高昂。

ambitious.e: The city has an ambitious plan to cut pollution.
ambitious.z: 该市制定了雄心勃勃的减污计划。

presumably.e: The train is late, presumably because of snow.
presumably.z: 火车晚点了，大概是因为下雪。

metropolitan.m: metro(母亲)+polit(城市)+an→母城→大都市的
metropolitan.e: The metropolitan area has ten million people.
metropolitan.z: 这一大都市区有一千万人口。

dissolve.m: dis(分开)+solv(松开)+e→松开分散→溶解；解散
dissolve.e: Sugar dissolves quickly in hot water.
dissolve.z: 糖在热水中溶解得很快。

aesthetic.m: 源自希腊aisthesis(感知)→感官的→审美的
aesthetic.e: The building has great aesthetic value.
aesthetic.z: 这座建筑具有很高的审美价值。

booth.m: 联想：booth像boot(靴子)摊→货摊；亭子

helmet.e: Always wear a helmet when cycling.

royal.m: roy(=rex国王)+al(形容词)→国王的→皇家的
royal.e: We visited the royal palace in London.
royal.z: 我们参观了伦敦的王宫。

panic.m: 源自希腊牧神Pan，其吼声令人惊恐→恐慌
panic.e: People panicked when the fire alarm rang.
panic.z: 火警响起时人们惊慌失措。

crush.m: 联想：拟声"咔嚓"压碎→压碎；迷恋
crush.e: Crush the garlic before adding it to the pan.
crush.z: 先把大蒜压碎再放进锅里。

cliff.m: 联想：cliff像"克利夫"峭壁→悬崖

minimal.m: minim(=minimum最小)+al(形容词)→极少的；最低的
minimal.e: The changes will have minimal impact.

cocaine.m: coca(古柯)+ine(化学物)→古柯碱→可卡因

illusion.m: il(=in在上)+lus(玩弄)+ion→玩弄视觉→幻觉
illusion.e: Mirrors create the illusion of more space.
illusion.z: 镜子营造出空间更大的错觉。

anonymous.m: an(无)+onym(名字)+ous(形容词)→无名的→匿名的

decorate.e: We decorated the room with flowers.
decorate.z: 我们用鲜花装饰了房间。

momentum.m: mo(=mov动)+mentum→运动的力量→势头；动量
momentum.z: 这场运动正在获得势头。

donation.e: The museum relies on public donations.

sibling.m: sib(亲属)+ling(小)→同亲的人→兄弟姐妹
sibling.e: I have two siblings, a brother and a sister.
sibling.z: 我有两个兄弟姐妹，一个哥哥和一个妹妹。

irony.m: 源自希腊eironeia(佯装无知)→反语；讽刺
irony.e: The irony is that he hates flying but works as a pilot.
irony.z: 讽刺的是他讨厌坐飞机却当了飞行员。

alley.m: 联想：all+ey，所有人都走的小巷→小巷
alley.e: The restaurant is in a narrow alley.
alley.z: 那家餐馆在一条窄巷里。

cute.m: acute(敏锐的)的缩略→机灵；可爱的

rival.m: 源自拉丁rivalis(同用一条河的人)→争水者→对手
rival.e: The two companies are fierce rivals.
rival.z: 这两家公司是激烈的竞争对手。

pin.m: 联想：pin像针的形状→大头针；钉住
pin.e: She pinned the notice to the board.
pin.z: 她把通知钉在布告板上。

persist.m: per(始终)+sist(站立)→始终站着→坚持；持续
persist.e: If symptoms persist, see a doctor.
persist.z: 如果症状持续，请去看医生。

foster.m: 源自古英语fostor(食物，养育)→养育；促进
foster.e: Schools should foster creativity in students.
foster.z: 学校应培养学生的创造力。

filter.m: 源自中世纪拉丁filtrum(毛毡)→用毡过滤→过滤器
filter.e: Use a filter to clean the drinking water.

heal.m: 与health(健康)同源→恢复健康→痊愈
heal.e: The wound healed in two weeks.

organism.m: organ(器官)+ism→由器官组成的→生物体

accessible.m: ac(=ad向)+cess(走)+ible(能…的)→能走近的→可进入的
accessible.e: The museum is accessible to wheelchair users.
accessible.z: 这座博物馆方便轮椅使用者进入。

charter.m: 源自拉丁charta(纸，文件)→特许状；包租
charter.e: The school received a royal charter in 1850.
charter.z: 这所学校于1850年获得皇家特许状。

placement.e: She did a work placement at a bank.

dam.m: 联想：dam像"堵"→挡水的堵墙→水坝
dam.e: The dam provides electricity for the region.
dam.z: 这座水坝为该地区供电。

outfit.m: out(出)+fit(合适)→出门穿得合适→全套服装
outfit.e: She bought a new outfit for the interview.
outfit.z: 她为面试买了一套新衣服。

preliminary.m: pre(在前)+limin(门槛)+ary→门槛之前的→初步的
preliminary.e: Preliminary results show the drug is effective.
preliminary.z: 初步结果显示这种药有效。

patent.m: 源自拉丁patere(敞开)→公开的证书→专利
patent.e: The company holds a patent for the design.
patent.z: 公司拥有这项设计的专利。

gross.m: 源自拉丁grossus(粗大的)→总的；粗俗的
gross.e: The country's gross domestic product rose by 3%.
gross.z: 该国国内生产总值增长了3%。

texture.m: text(编织)+ure(名词)→编织出的质地→质地
texture.e: This bread has a soft texture.

spray.m: 联想：拟声"噗"喷出→喷雾；喷洒
spray.z: 农民向庄稼喷洒化学品。

disclose.e: The company refused to disclose its profits.

outline.m: out(外)+line(线)→外面的线→轮廓；概述
outline.e: First, outline the main points of your essay.
outline.z: 首先，列出你文章的要点。

speculation.m: spec(看)+ulat+ion(名词)→观察推想→推测；投机
speculation.e: There is speculation that prices will rise.

attendance.m: at(=ad向)+tend(伸)+ance(名词)→伸向某处→出席

stimulate.m: stimul(刺棒)+ate(动词)→用刺棒戳→刺激

tag.e: Check the price tag before you buy.

catalog.m: cata(全部)+log(说，记录)→全部记下→目录
catalog.e: The library catalog is available online.
catalog.z: 图书馆目录可在线查询。

fleet.m: 源自古英语fleot(船，漂浮)→船队；车队
fleet.e: The company owns a fleet of electric buses.
fleet.z: 该公司拥有一支电动公交车队。

vertical.m: vertex(顶点，vert转)+ical(形容词)→指向顶点的→垂直的
vertical.e: Draw a vertical line on the page.

compel.e: Bad weather compelled us to cancel the trip.
compel.z: 恶劣天气迫使我们取消了旅行。

proclaim.m: pro(向前)+claim(喊)→向众人大喊→宣布
proclaim.e: The country proclaimed its independence in 1960.

hike.m: 联想：hike读"嗨客"，嗨起来去远足→远足；上涨
hike.e: We went for a hike in the mountains.

scent.m: sent(感觉)加c→闻到的感觉→气味
scent.e: The scent of roses filled the garden.
scent.z: 花园里弥漫着玫瑰的香味。

stack.m: 联想：stack像stick堆起来→一堆；堆叠
stack.e: There is a stack of books on my desk.

sack.m: 源自希腊sakkos(粗麻布)→麻袋；解雇
sack.e: He got the sack for being late.

inherit.m: in(进入)+herit(继承人)→成为继承人→继承
inherit.e: She inherited the house from her grandmother.
inherit.z: 她从祖母那里继承了这所房子。

pioneer.m: 源自古法语peon(步兵)→开路的步兵→先驱
pioneer.e: He was a pioneer of modern medicine.

textbook.e: Open your textbook to page ten.

shrink.e: Wool shrinks if you wash it in hot water.

nasty.m: 联想：nasty像nest(窝)脏乱→令人厌恶的
nasty.e: The medicine has a nasty taste.

dot.e: The town is a small dot on the map.
dot.z: 这个小镇在地图上只是一个小点。

fierce.m: 源自拉丁ferus(野性的)→凶猛的；激烈的
fierce.e: There is fierce competition for jobs.

aisle.m: 源自拉丁ala(翼)→教堂侧翼→过道
aisle.e: I prefer an aisle seat on long flights.
aisle.z: 长途飞行我喜欢靠过道的座位。

protocol.m: proto(最初)+col(胶粘)→粘在卷首的第一页→协议；规程
protocol.z: 员工必须遵守安全规程。

exclusively.m: exclusive(独有的)+ly(副词)→专门地；仅仅
exclusively.e: This offer is exclusively for students.

terrain.e: The terrain is too rough for cars.
terrain.z: 地形太崎岖，汽车无法通行。

unfair.e: It is unfair to judge people by their looks.

distract.m: dis(分开)+tract(拉)→把注意力拉开→分心

planner.e: City planners want more green spaces.
planner.z: 城市规划者希望有更多绿地。

merit.m: 源自拉丁meritum(应得的)→优点；值得
merit.e: Each idea should be judged on its merits.
merit.z: 每个想法都应根据其优点来评判。

chunk.e: A large chunk of my salary goes on rent.
chunk.z: 我工资的一大块用于付房租。

discount.m: dis(去掉)+count(计算)→少算一些→折扣

invade.e: Tourists invade the beach every summer.
invade.z: 每年夏天游客涌入海滩。

hurricane.m: 源自加勒比土语huracan(风暴之神)→飓风
hurricane.e: The hurricane destroyed thousands of homes.
hurricane.z: 飓风摧毁了数千所房屋。

skip.e: Never skip breakfast before an exam.
skip.z: 考试前千万别不吃早餐。

ambassador.m: 源自拉丁ambactus(仆从，使者)→大使

stimulus.e: The government introduced an economic stimulus package.
stimulus.z: 政府推出了一揽子经济刺激计划。

ecosystem.e: Plastic waste harms the ocean ecosystem.
ecosystem.z: 塑料垃圾危害海洋生态系统。

likewise.e: He worked hard, and his sister did likewise.
likewise.z: 他努力工作，他妹妹也一样。

sphere.e: She is an expert in the sphere of education.

boast.m: 联想：boa(蟒蛇)+st，吹牛吹得比蟒蛇还长→吹嘘
boast.e: The city boasts many fine museums.
boast.z: 这座城市拥有许多优秀的博物馆。

tighten.e: The government tightened rules on smoking.

publicity.m: public(公众)+ity(名词)→公众关注→宣传；名声
publicity.e: The event attracted a lot of publicity.
publicity.z: 这个活动引起了广泛关注。

unfold.m: un(相反)+fold(折叠)→打开折叠→展开
unfold.e: She unfolded the map on the table.

validity.e: Researchers questioned the validity of the data.
validity.z: 研究人员质疑数据的有效性。

partial.m: part(部分)+ial(形容词)→部分的；偏袒的
partial.e: The plan was only a partial success.
partial.z: 这个计划只取得了部分成功。

compliance.e: Compliance with safety rules is required.

deem.z: 这栋楼被认定为不安全。

glimpse.e: I caught a glimpse of the singer.

premise.m: pre(在前)+mis(放)+e→放在前面的话→前提
premise.e: The argument is based on a false premise.
premise.z: 这个论点基于一个错误的前提。

mentor.m: 源自希腊史诗人物Mentor(奥德修斯之子的导师)→导师
mentor.e: A good mentor can change your career.
mentor.z: 一位好导师能改变你的职业生涯。

excessive.m: ex(出)+cess(走)+ive(形容词)→走出界限→过度的
excessive.e: Excessive screen time harms children's eyes.
excessive.z: 过多看屏幕伤害孩子的眼睛。

debris.m: de(下)+bris(打碎)→打碎落下→碎片；残骸
debris.e: Workers cleared the debris after the storm.
debris.z: 风暴过后工人清理了残骸。

blank.e: Fill in the blanks with the correct words.

cure.m: 源自拉丁cura(关心，照料)→治疗；疗法
cure.e: There is no cure for the common cold.
cure.z: 普通感冒没有特效疗法。

cemetery.m: 源自希腊koimeterion(睡觉之处)→长眠之地→墓地
cemetery.e: The poet is buried in a local cemetery.
cemetery.z: 这位诗人葬在当地墓地。

harassment.e: The company has strict rules against harassment.
harassment.z: 公司有严格的反骚扰规定。

fame.m: 源自拉丁fama(传言，名声)→名声
fame.e: The actor rose to fame after one film.
fame.z: 这位演员凭一部电影成名。

likelihood.e: Exercise reduces the likelihood of heart disease.
likelihood.z: 运动降低患心脏病的可能性。

carrot.m: 源自希腊karoton(胡萝卜)；联想：car(车)+rot(烂)→车里放烂的胡萝卜
carrot.e: Carrots are good for your eyesight.

toll.m: 源自希腊telos(税)→通行费；伤亡人数
toll.e: The death toll from the flood has risen.
toll.z: 洪水的死亡人数上升了。

rim.m: 联想：rim像"圈"的边→边缘；轮缘
rim.e: The cup has a gold rim.

suspicious.m: sus(=sub下)+spic(看)+ious→从下往上偷看→可疑的；多疑的
suspicious.e: Report any suspicious bags to staff.
suspicious.z: 发现可疑包裹请报告工作人员。

cling.m: 联想：cling像"粘"住发出叮(clink)声→紧贴；依附
cling.e: Wet clothes cling to your body.

blink.m: 联想：b+link(连接)→上下眼皮一连→眨眼
blink.e: She blinked in the bright sunlight.
blink.z: 她在强烈的阳光下眨了眨眼。

eligible.m: e(出)+lig(选)+ible(可…的)→可被选出的→有资格的
eligible.e: Students over 18 are eligible to vote.

plunge.m: 与plumb(铅锤)同源→像铅锤一样落下→跳入；骤降
plunge.e: Temperatures plunged below zero last night.
plunge.z: 昨晚气温骤降到零度以下。

demographic.m: demo(人民)+graph(写)+ic→描写人口的→人口统计的
demographic.e: Demographic changes affect the job market.
demographic.z: 人口结构变化影响就业市场。

chill.e: There was a chill in the air this morning.
chill.z: 今早空气中有一丝寒意。

rally.m: re(再)+ally(联合)→重新联合→集会；重整
rally.z: 数千人参加了气候集会。

steer.m: 联想：steer像"死贴儿"，紧握方向盘→驾驶；引导
steer.e: She steered the conversation to a new topic.
steer.z: 她把话题引向新的方向。

outlet.m: out(出)+let(让)→让东西出去→出口；排遣；商店
outlet.e: Sport is a good outlet for stress.
outlet.z: 运动是释放压力的好方式。

intact.m: in(不)+tact(触摸)→未被触碰的→完好无损的

thrive.m: 源自古挪威语thrifask(抓住，兴旺)→茁壮成长；繁荣
thrive.e: Tourism thrives in this coastal town.
thrive.z: 旅游业在这个海滨小镇十分兴旺。

elaborate.m: e(出)+labor(劳动)+ate→花力气做出来→精心的；详述
elaborate.e: Could you elaborate on your idea?
elaborate.z: 你能详细说说你的想法吗？

chew.m: 联想：chew读"啾"，嚼东西的声音→咀嚼

auction.m: 源自拉丁augere(增加)→价格不断增加→拍卖
auction.e: The painting was sold at auction.
auction.z: 这幅画在拍卖会上售出。

steak.m: 源自古挪威语steik(烤)→烤肉→牛排
steak.e: I'd like my steak medium, please.

conception.m: con(加强)+cept(拿)+ion(名词)→拿住的想法→观念
conception.e: Children have a different conception of time.
conception.z: 孩子对时间有不同的概念。

comply.m: com(加强)+ply(=ple满足)→完全满足要求→遵守
comply.e: All buildings must comply with fire rules.
comply.z: 所有建筑必须遵守消防规定。

triumph.m: 源自拉丁triumphus(凯旋式)→胜利；成功
triumph.e: The team returned home in triumph.

comparable.e: The two cities are comparable in size.

conscience.m: con(加强)+sci(知道)+ence→内心清楚知道对错→良心
conscience.e: He had a guilty conscience after lying.

scratch.m: 联想：拟声"刺啦"一抓→抓；划痕；从头开始
scratch.e: We had to start again from scratch.

commerce.m: com(共同)+merc(贸易)+e→共同买卖→商业

jurisdiction.m: juris(法律)+dict(说)+ion→依法说了算→管辖权
jurisdiction.e: The case is outside the court's jurisdiction.
jurisdiction.z: 该案件不在这家法院的管辖范围内。

expedition.m: ex(出)+ped(脚)+ition→迈出脚去→远征；探险
expedition.e: They joined an expedition to the Arctic.
expedition.z: 他们参加了一次北极探险。

dumb.m: 联想：dumb读"当木"，像木头一样不说话→哑的；愚蠢的

conversion.e: The conversion of the factory into flats took a year.
conversion.z: 将工厂改建成公寓花了一年。

patron.m: patr(父亲)+on→像父亲一样支持的人→赞助人；顾客
patron.e: The library is popular with its patrons.
patron.z: 这家图书馆很受读者欢迎。

municipal.m: muni(职责)+cip(拿)+al→承担公共职责的→市政的
municipal.e: Municipal buses are free for the elderly.
municipal.z: 老年人乘市政公交免费。

harmony.m: 源自希腊harmonia(连接，协调)→和谐
harmony.e: People of different cultures live in harmony here.
harmony.z: 不同文化的人在这里和谐共处。

tolerance.e: We should show tolerance towards other opinions.
tolerance.z: 我们应宽容对待不同意见。

cruise.m: 源自荷兰语kruisen(横渡，交叉)→巡游；乘船游览
cruise.e: They went on a cruise around the Mediterranean.
cruise.z: 他们乘游轮游览了地中海。

neat.m: 源自拉丁nitidus(光亮的)→整洁的
neat.e: Keep your notes neat and clear.

mobile.e: Mobile phones have changed how we communicate.
mobile.z: 手机改变了我们的交流方式。

calendar.m: 源自拉丁kalendae(每月初一)→日历
calendar.e: I marked the exam date on my calendar.
calendar.z: 我在日历上标出了考试日期。

beard.m: 联想：bear(熊)+d→像熊一样满脸毛→胡须
beard.e: My grandfather has a long white beard.
beard.z: 我爷爷留着长长的白胡子。

deposit.e: You need to pay a deposit to rent the flat.
deposit.z: 租这套公寓需要付押金。

brake.m: break(打破)的同源词→打断车速→刹车
brake.e: The driver hit the brakes suddenly.

impulse.m: im(向内)+puls(推)+e→内心的推动→冲动
impulse.e: I bought the dress on impulse.
impulse.z: 我一时冲动买了这条裙子。

brutal.m: brute(野兽)+al(形容词)→野兽般的→残忍的
brutal.e: The war was long and brutal.

predator.e: Lions are top predators in Africa.
predator.z: 狮子是非洲的顶级捕食者。

fur.m: 联想：fur读"服"，动物的衣服→毛皮
fur.e: The cat has soft white fur.

poke.e: He poked me in the arm to wake me up.
poke.z: 他戳我的胳膊把我叫醒。

opt.e: Many students opt to study abroad.
opt.z: 许多学生选择出国留学。

forum.m: 源自拉丁forum(古罗马广场)→论坛
forum.e: The forum lets students share their views.
forum.z: 该论坛让学生分享观点。

soar.m: 源自拉丁ex(出)+aura(空气)→飞入高空→飙升
soar.e: House prices have soared this year.

enact.m: en(使)+act(法案)→使成为法案→颁布
enact.e: The government enacted a new privacy law.
enact.z: 政府颁布了一项新的隐私法。

removal.e: The removal of trees caused flooding.
removal.z: 树木被砍伐导致了洪水。

autonomy.m: auto(自己)+nom(法则)+y→自己定规则→自主权
autonomy.e: Universities want more autonomy from the state.
autonomy.z: 大学希望拥有更多自主权。

landmark.e: The tower is the city's most famous landmark.
landmark.z: 这座塔是该市最著名的地标。

fraction.m: fract(破碎)+ion(名词)→碎片→小部分；分数
fraction.e: Only a fraction of plastic is recycled.
fraction.z: 只有一小部分塑料被回收。

offender.e: Young offenders need education, not just punishment.
offender.z: 少年犯需要教育，而不只是惩罚。

threshold.m: 源自古英语therscold(门槛)→门槛；阈值
threshold.e: Your income is below the tax threshold.

suite.m: 与suit同源，源自法语suivre(跟随)→一套；套房
suite.e: They stayed in a luxury hotel suite.
suite.z: 他们住在豪华酒店套房里。

fragile.m: frag(破碎)+ile(易…的)→易碎的；脆弱的
fragile.e: The ecosystem of the reef is very fragile.
fragile.z: 珊瑚礁的生态系统非常脆弱。

exhaust.m: ex(出)+haust(抽取)→全抽出→耗尽；尾气
exhaust.e: Car exhaust is a major cause of air pollution.
exhaust.z: 汽车尾气是空气污染的主要原因。

objection.m: ob(反对)+ject(扔)+ion→扔回去→反对；异议
objection.e: Does anyone have any objection to the plan?

blast.m: 与blow(吹)同源→一阵强风；爆炸
blast.e: The blast broke windows across the street.
blast.z: 爆炸震碎了街对面的窗户。

prevail.m: pre(在前)+vail(强大，价值)→更强大→盛行；占优势
prevail.e: Justice will prevail in the end.

denial.e: His denial of the charges did not convince the jury.
denial.z: 他对指控的否认没能说服陪审团。

fragment.m: frag(=frang破碎)+ment(名词)→打碎的部分→碎片
fragment.e: Archaeologists found fragments of ancient pottery near the river.
fragment.z: 考古学家在河边发现了古代陶器碎片。

rental.m: rent(租)+al(名词/形容词)→租金；出租的
rental.e: The monthly rental for this flat is quite reasonable.
rental.z: 这套公寓的月租金相当合理。

screw.m: 联想：s+crew(船员)→船员拧紧螺丝钉
screw.e: You need a screwdriver to tighten this screw.
screw.z: 你需要一把螺丝刀来拧紧这颗螺丝。

suitable.e: This course is suitable for beginners.

drill.m: 源自中古荷兰语drillen(钻孔)→钻；操练
drill.e: Workers used a drill to make holes in the wall.
drill.z: 工人们用电钻在墙上打孔。

mansion.m: mans(=man停留)+ion(名词)→住处→大厦、宅邸
mansion.e: The family lives in a huge mansion by the lake.
mansion.z: 那家人住在湖边一座巨大的宅邸里。

cottage.e: We rented a cottage in the countryside for the summer.
cottage.z: 我们夏天在乡下租了一间小屋。

authorize.m: author(创始者,权威)+ize(使…)→使有权→授权
authorize.z: 只有经理才能批准退款。

charm.m: 源自拉丁carmen(歌,咒语)→咒语→魅力
charm.e: The old town has a special charm for tourists.
charm.z: 这座古镇对游客有一种独特的魅力。

loyal.m: 源自拉丁legalis(合法的)→守法守信→忠诚的
loyal.e: Loyal customers often receive special discounts.
loyal.z: 忠实顾客常常能享受特别折扣。

ego.e: Winning the prize gave his ego a boost.
ego.z: 获奖让他的自尊心大大增强。

fare.m: 源自古英语faran(去,旅行)→路费→车费
fare.e: Bus fares have risen again this year.

disc.m: 源自希腊diskos(铁饼,圆盘)→圆盘；光盘
disc.e: The data is stored on a small disc.
disc.z: 数据存储在一张小光盘上。

radar.m: 缩略词：radio detecting and ranging(无线电探测测距)→雷达
radar.e: Radar can detect aircraft in bad weather.
radar.z: 雷达能在恶劣天气中探测飞机。

frown.m: 联想：f+rown(谐音"肉")→脸上的肉皱起来→皱眉
frown.e: She frowned when she read the bad news.
frown.z: 她读到坏消息时皱起了眉头。

molecule.e: A water molecule consists of hydrogen and oxygen.

retreat.m: re(向后)+treat(=tract拉)→向后拉→撤退；静修处
retreat.e: The army was forced to retreat.

rehabilitation.m: re(再)+habilit(使能够)+ation(名词)→使重新能做→康复
rehabilitation.e: He spent months in rehabilitation after the accident.
rehabilitation.z: 事故后他花了几个月进行康复治疗。

youngster.e: Many youngsters spend hours online every day.
youngster.z: 许多年轻人每天花几个小时上网。

accountability.m: account(说明,交代)+abil(能)+ity(名词)→能作交代→问责
accountability.e: Governments must have accountability to the public.

premium.m: pre(前)+em(取,买)+ium→优先取得→奖金；保险费；优质的
premium.e: Customers pay a premium for organic food.
premium.z: 顾客为有机食品支付溢价。

contemplate.m: con(加强)+templ(神庙,观测处)+ate(动词)→在神庙中观察→沉思；考虑
contemplate.e: She is contemplating a career change.

update.m: up(向上)+date(日期)→更新到最新日期→更新

overwhelm.m: over(在上)+whelm(淹没)→完全淹没→压倒；使不知所措
overwhelm.e: New students often feel overwhelmed by the workload.
overwhelm.z: 新生常常被繁重的学业压得喘不过气。

spark.m: 源自古英语spearca(火花)→火花；引发
spark.e: The speech sparked a heated debate.
spark.z: 这次演讲引发了激烈的辩论。

fatigue.e: Long working hours can cause fatigue.
fatigue.z: 长时间工作会导致疲劳。

ironically.e: Ironically, the fire station burned down.
ironically.z: 讽刺的是，消防站被烧毁了。

speculate.m: specul(观察,瞭望)+ate(动词)→观望推测→推测；投机
speculate.e: Scientists speculate that life may exist on Mars.
speculate.z: 科学家推测火星上可能存在生命。

bucket.m: 联想：buck(雄鹿)+et→小鹿踢翻水桶→桶
bucket.e: She filled the bucket with water.

preach.m: pre(前)+ach(=dic说)→在人前宣说→布道；说教
preach.e: Parents should practise what they preach.

blond.m: 源自古法语blond(金黄色)→金发的
blond.e: The girl with blond hair is my cousin.
blond.z: 那个金发女孩是我表妹。

marble.m: 源自希腊marmaros(闪亮的石头)→大理石；弹珠
marble.e: The hall has a beautiful marble floor.
marble.z: 大厅铺着漂亮的大理石地板。

provoke.m: pro(向前)+voke(喊)→向前喊叫→激怒；引起
provoke.z: 他的言论招致了强烈批评。

trauma.e: Many survivors suffer from emotional trauma.
trauma.z: 许多幸存者遭受心理创伤。

depart.m: de(离开)+part(分开)→分开离去→离开；出发
depart.e: The train departs at nine o'clock.

magnetic.m: magnet(磁铁)+ic(形容词)→磁的；有吸引力的
magnetic.e: The Earth has a magnetic field.

technician.e: A technician came to fix the printer.
technician.z: 一名技术员来修理打印机。

soak.m: 源自古英语socian(浸泡)→浸泡；浸透
soak.e: Soak the beans in water overnight.

mutter.m: 拟声词：mut-像嘴里嘟哝的声音→咕哝
mutter.e: He muttered something under his breath.

ribbon.m: 联想：rib(肋骨)+bon→缠在腰肋上的缎带→丝带
ribbon.e: She tied her hair with a red ribbon.
ribbon.z: 她用一根红丝带扎起头发。

harvest.m: 源自古英语hærfest(秋天)→收获季→收获
harvest.e: Farmers are busy during the harvest season.

slot.m: 联想：s+lot(一份)→放一份东西的口子→狭槽；时段
slot.e: Put a coin in the slot to start the machine.
slot.z: 往投币口投一枚硬币启动机器。

consecutive.m: con(共同)+secut(跟随)+ive(形容词)→一个跟一个→连续的
consecutive.e: It rained for five consecutive days.

riot.e: The police were called to stop the riot.

sovereignty.z: 每个国家都捍卫自己的主权。

ridge.m: 源自古英语hrycg(脊背)→山脊；隆起
ridge.e: We walked along the mountain ridge.

frustrate.m: frustr(徒劳)+ate(使)→使徒劳→挫败；使沮丧
frustrate.z: 网速慢让许多学生很恼火。

electronics.m: electron(电子)+ics(学科)→电子学；电子产品
electronics.z: 电子产品在网上更便宜。

dense.m: 源自拉丁densus(浓密的)→密集的；浓厚的
dense.e: The city has a dense population.

articulate.m: articul(关节,分节)+ate→一节节分清→清楚表达的；表达
articulate.z: 她是一位口齿清晰的演讲者。

swell.m: 源自古英语swellan(膨胀)→肿胀；增加
swell.e: His ankle swelled after the fall.

cue.z: 那位演员错过了上场提示。

biography.e: I am reading a biography of Einstein.
biography.z: 我在读一本爱因斯坦传记。

hazard.m: 源自阿拉伯语az-zahr(骰子)→赌运→危险
hazard.e: Smoking is a serious health hazard.

tile.m: 源自拉丁tegula(覆盖物,瓦)→瓦片；瓷砖
tile.e: The bathroom floor is covered with white tiles.
tile.z: 浴室地板铺着白色瓷砖。

convenience.m: con(共同)+ven(来)+ience(名词)→来到一起正合适→便利

plea.m: 源自拉丁placitum(主张,意见)→请求；抗辩
plea.e: The family made a plea for help.
plea.z: 那家人发出了求助的恳求。

timber.m: 源自古英语timber(建筑木材)→木材
timber.e: The house is built of timber.

bolt.m: 源自古英语bolt(箭)→门闩；螺栓；闪电
bolt.e: Lock the door and slide the bolt.

bulb.m: 源自希腊bolbos(球根)→球茎；灯泡

narrator.e: The narrator of the story is a child.
narrator.z: 故事的叙述者是个孩子。

dock.m: 源自中古荷兰语docke(船坞)→码头；停靠
dock.e: The ship docked in the harbour.

tribunal.m: tribun(古罗马保民官)+al→审判席→法庭
tribunal.e: The case went to an employment tribunal.
tribunal.z: 此案提交到了劳资仲裁庭。

affluent.m: af(朝向)+flu(流)+ent(…的)→财富流来→富裕的
affluent.e: They live in an affluent suburb.
affluent.z: 他们住在一个富裕的郊区。

exacerbate.m: ex(强调)+acerb(苦涩，尖刻)+ate(使)→使更尖锐→加剧

tangible.m: tang(触摸)+ible(可…的)→可触摸的→切实的
tangible.e: The policy has brought tangible benefits.
tangible.z: 这项政策带来了切实的好处。

feat.m: fact(做)的古法语变体→做成的事→壮举
feat.e: Climbing Everest is a remarkable feat.
feat.z: 攀登珠峰是了不起的壮举。

groan.m: 拟声：痛苦的“咕~嗯”声→呻吟

militant.m: milit(士兵，军事)+ant(…的)→好战的；激进的

dwell.m: 联想：d+well(好)→住得好→居住；老想着

torch.m: tor(扭，拧)+ch→扭成的火把→火炬；手电筒
torch.e: Take a torch in case it gets dark.

lurk.m: 联想：“了客”→暗处埋伏的客人→潜伏
lurk.e: Danger lurks beneath the calm surface.
lurk.z: 平静的表面下潜伏着危险。

huddle.m: 联想：“哈都”→冷得哈气，大家都挤一起→挤作一团

constellation.m: con(一起)+stell(星)+ation(名词)→星星聚在一起→星座

maneuver.m: man(手)+euver(=oper工作)→用手操作→操纵；演习
maneuver.e: The pilot made a quick maneuver to avoid the bird.
maneuver.z: 飞行员迅速操控避开了鸟。

probation.m: prob(检验，同prove)+ation(名词)→检验期→试用期；缓刑
probation.e: New staff are on probation for three months.
probation.z: 新员工有三个月试用期。

wreck.m: 联想：wr+eck(像“噎克”)→撞得稀碎→残骸；毁坏

renowned.m: re(反复)+nown(=nom名)+ed→名字被反复提起→著名的
renowned.e: The city is renowned for its food.

masculine.e: He has a deep masculine voice.
masculine.z: 他的声音低沉，很有男子气概。

crumb.m: 联想：“渴爬”→小蚂蚁爬去吃碎屑→面包屑
crumb.e: There were crumbs all over the table.

disposition.m: dis(分开)+pos(放)+ition(名词)→分开安放→处置；天性

allergy.m: all(=allo其他)+erg(作用)+y→异常反应→过敏

batter.m: batt(打，同battle)+er(反复)→连续猛打；面糊

dart.m: 联想：“打它”→掷出飞镖打它→飞镖；猛冲
dart.e: The cat darted across the road.

wax.m: 联想：“蜡”软软的，wax像蜡烛弯曲形状→蜡
wax.e: The candle is made of beeswax.

allegiance.e: They pledged allegiance to the flag.

felony.m: 联想：fell(倒下)+ony→犯下令人倒下的大罪→重罪
felony.e: Robbery is a felony in most countries.
felony.z: 抢劫在大多数国家属于重罪。

retiree.e: Many retirees move to the coast.
retiree.z: 许多退休人员搬到海边居住。

wholesale.e: They buy goods at wholesale prices.
wholesale.z: 他们以批发价购进货物。

fusion.e: The restaurant serves Asian fusion food.
fusion.z: 这家餐厅供应亚洲融合菜。

voucher.m: vouch(担保)+er→担保凭证→代金券；凭单
voucher.e: I got a gift voucher for my birthday.
voucher.z: 我生日时收到一张礼品券。

shovel.m: shove(推)+l→往前推土的工具→铲子
shovel.e: He used a shovel to clear the snow.

chapel.m: chap(=cape斗篷)+el→存放圣徒斗篷的小堂→小教堂
chapel.e: The wedding was held in a small chapel.
chapel.z: 婚礼在一座小教堂举行。

intricate.m: in(在内)+tric(复杂，阻碍)+ate→内部纠缠的→错综复杂的
intricate.e: The carpet has an intricate pattern.
intricate.z: 这块地毯有复杂的图案。

orchard.e: We picked apples in the orchard.

renovation.e: The museum is closed for renovation.

burger.e: I ordered a burger and fries.
burger.z: 我点了一个汉堡和薯条。

glue.m: 联想：“胶”粘得“咕噜”→胶水；粘
glue.e: Use glue to stick the pieces together.

chord.e: He played a few chords on the guitar.
chord.z: 他在吉他上弹了几个和弦。

turbine.m: turb(旋转，扰动)+ine→旋转的机器→涡轮机
turbine.z: 风力涡轮机产生清洁能源。

baggage.e: Please collect your baggage at Belt 3.

bleak.m: 联想：black(黑)→前途一片黑→荒凉的；暗淡的
bleak.e: The future looks bleak for the industry.

setback.e: The injury was a major setback for him.

veil.m: 联想：“喂哦”→面纱遮脸→面纱；掩盖
veil.e: The bride wore a white veil.

restless.m: rest(休息)+less(无)→不得休息的→不安的
restless.e: The children grew restless during the long trip.
restless.z: 长途旅行中孩子们变得焦躁不安。

cheerful.m: cheer(欢呼，高兴)+ful(充满…的)→快乐的
cheerful.e: She is always cheerful in the morning.

entitlement.m: en(使)+title(资格，名称)+ment(名词)→享有资格→权利；津贴
entitlement.e: Workers have an entitlement to paid leave.
entitlement.z: 员工有权享受带薪休假。

diagram.m: dia(穿过)+gram(写，画)→画出来的图→图表
diagram.e: The diagram shows the water cycle.

hurl.m: 联想：hur(像hurry急)+l→急速扔出→猛掷
hurl.e: Protesters hurled stones at the police.

furnish.m: 联想：furniture(家具)→给房子配家具→提供；装备
furnish.z: 这套公寓配有全套家具。

friction.e: There was friction between the two colleagues.

analytical.e: The job requires strong analytical skills.
analytical.z: 这份工作需要很强的分析能力。

aerial.e: The photo was taken from an aerial view.
aerial.z: 这张照片是从空中拍摄的。

kin.m: 联想：kind(种类)→同类同族→亲属

forensic.m: 源自forum(古罗马公共广场，法庭)+ic→法庭的→法医的
forensic.e: Forensic evidence linked him to the crime.
forensic.z: 法医证据将他与罪行联系起来。

mid.e: The festival takes place in mid-July.

giggle.e: The girls giggled at the joke.
giggle.z: 女孩们听了笑话咯咯地笑。

tariff.m: 联想：“太费”→加关税太费钱→关税
tariff.e: The government raised tariffs on imports.

tick.m: 拟声：钟表“嘀嗒”声→滴答；打勾
tick.z: 请在正确的方框内打勾。

dine.e: We dined at a small Italian restaurant.
dine.z: 我们在一家小意大利餐厅用餐。

dispatch.m: 联想：dis(分开)+patch(补丁)→打完补丁分头送出→派遣；发送
dispatch.e: Your order will be dispatched within 24 hours.
dispatch.z: 您的订单将在24小时内发货。

disguise.m: dis(去掉)+guise(外表)→去掉原貌→伪装
disguise.e: He wore a hat as a disguise.
disguise.z: 他戴了顶帽子作为伪装。

hatch.m: 联想：hat(帽子)+ch→小鸡顶开蛋壳像戴帽→孵化；舱口
hatch.e: The eggs will hatch in two weeks.

mediate.m: medi(中间)+ate(动词)→站在中间→调解
mediate.e: The UN tried to mediate between the two sides.
mediate.z: 联合国试图在双方之间调停。

imitation.e: Children learn language largely through imitation of adults.
imitation.z: 儿童学习语言很大程度上靠模仿大人。

raft.m: 联想：raft像“乱浮”，几根木头乱浮在水上→木筏
raft.e: They crossed the river on a wooden raft.
raft.z: 他们乘木筏渡过了那条河。

cathedral.m: cathedra(主教座椅)+al(…的)→设有主教座位的教堂→大教堂
cathedral.e: The old cathedral attracts thousands of tourists every year.
cathedral.z: 这座古老的大教堂每年吸引成千上万的游客。

lament.m: 源自拉丁 lamentum(哀号)→悲叹；联想：la(啦)+ment→哭啦啦
lament.e: Many people lament the loss of traditional village life.
lament.z: 许多人为传统乡村生活的消失而惋惜。

ignite.e: A single spark can ignite a forest fire.
ignite.z: 一个火星就能引发一场森林大火。

revolve.m: re(回)+volv(转)+e→转回来→旋转；反复考虑
revolve.e: The Earth revolves around the Sun once a year.
revolve.z: 地球每年绕太阳公转一周。

alternate.m: alter(另一个)+n+ate(动/形)→换成另一个→交替的；轮流
alternate.e: We alternate between working from home and the office.
alternate.z: 我们轮流在家和办公室工作。

bully.m: 联想：bull(公牛)+y→像公牛一样横冲直撞欺负人→恶霸；欺凌
bully.e: Schools should take firm action against anyone who bullies others.
bully.z: 学校应对欺凌他人者采取坚决措施。

contaminate.m: con(共同)+tamin(接触)+ate(使)→接触到脏东西→污染
contaminate.e: Industrial waste can contaminate local water supplies.
contaminate.z: 工业废物会污染当地的供水。

plight.m: 联想：p+light(光)→看不到光的处境→困境
plight.e: The documentary highlights the plight of refugees.
plight.z: 这部纪录片突显了难民的困境。

default.m: de(离开)+fault(欠缺,同fail)→该做的没做→违约；默认
default.e: The company may default on its loan repayments.
default.z: 这家公司可能无法偿还贷款。

sickness.e: Motion sickness is common among young children.
sickness.z: 晕动症在幼儿中很常见。

disperse.e: The police used water to disperse the crowd.

sober.m: so(=se,无)+bri(醉)→不醉的→清醒的；稳重的
sober.e: He stayed sober so he could drive everyone home.
sober.z: 他保持清醒，好开车送大家回家。

nap.m: 联想：nap谐音“nap(哪趴)”，哪儿都能趴着睡一会→小睡
nap.e: A short nap after lunch can improve concentration.
nap.z: 午饭后小睡一会儿能提升注意力。

impair.m: im(使)+pair(源自 pejor 更坏)→使变坏→损害
impair.e: Lack of sleep can impair your judgment.
impair.z: 缺乏睡眠会损害你的判断力。

frantic.m: 源自希腊 phrenitis(脑炎)→神志错乱→狂乱的；联想：frenzy(狂热)
frantic.e: She made a frantic search for her lost passport.
frantic.z: 她发疯似地寻找丢失的护照。

intrinsic.m: intr(内部)+insic(拉丁secus,在旁)→在内部的→内在的；固有的
intrinsic.e: Students learn best when they have intrinsic motivation.
intrinsic.z: 学生有内在动力时学得最好。

starve.m: 联想：star(星星)+ve→饿得眼冒金星→挨饿；饿死
starve.e: Millions of people starved during the famine.
starve.z: 饥荒期间数百万人饿死。

reclaim.m: re(回)+claim(喊,要求)→喊回来→收回；开垦(土地)
reclaim.e: The land was reclaimed from the sea for farming.
reclaim.z: 这片土地是从海里填出来用于耕种的。

sewer.m: 联想：sew(缝)+er→城市地下缝隙里的管道→下水道
sewer.e: Heavy rain caused the city's sewers to overflow.
sewer.z: 大雨导致城市下水道漫溢。

fertile.m: fert(=fer,带来)+ile(能…的)→能带来收成的→肥沃的；能生育的
fertile.e: The river valley has fertile soil for growing rice.
fertile.z: 这个河谷土壤肥沃，适合种植水稻。

wield.m: 联想：wie(伪)+ld→挥舞权杖→行使(权力)；挥舞
wield.e: Large tech companies wield enormous influence over public opinion.
wield.z: 大型科技公司对舆论有巨大的影响力。

slab.m: 联想：s+lab(实验室)→实验室里的厚石板台面→平板；厚片
slab.e: The path was made of large stone slabs.
slab.z: 这条小路是用大石板铺成的。

timely.e: Timely treatment can prevent serious complications.
timely.z: 及时治疗能防止严重并发症。

daunting.m: daunt(使畏惧，源自拉丁 domare 驯服)+ing→令人生畏的
daunting.e: Moving to a new country can be a daunting experience.
daunting.z: 移居新的国家可能是一段令人生畏的经历。

disgust.m: dis(不)+gust(品尝)→尝着不合口味→厌恶
disgust.e: She looked at the dirty kitchen in disgust.
disgust.z: 她厌恶地看着那间脏厨房。

doom.m: 联想：doom谐音“都没”→命运全都没了→厄运；注定
doom.e: Critics predicted the project was doomed to fail.
doom.z: 评论人士预言该项目注定失败。

layout.m: 复合：lay out(摆开)→摆放的方式→布局
layout.e: The new layout of the library makes it easier to find books.
layout.z: 图书馆的新布局让找书更方便。

capsule.m: caps(=cap,盒)+ule(小)→小盒子→胶囊；太空舱
capsule.e: Take one capsule twice a day after meals.
capsule.z: 每天两次，饭后服用一粒胶囊。

lever.m: lev(举起)+er(物)→用来举起东西的工具→杠杆
lever.e: Pull the lever to open the gate.

upright.m: 复合：up(向上)+right(直的)→笔直的→正直的
upright.e: He was respected as an upright and honest official.
upright.z: 他作为正直诚实的官员受人尊敬。

abolish.m: 源自拉丁 abolere(毁掉)：ab(离开)+olere(生长)→不让长→废除
abolish.e: Many countries have abolished the death penalty.

fort.m: fort(强大)→坚固的地方→堡垒；要塞
fort.e: The ancient fort overlooks the harbour.

anonymity.m: an(无)+onym(名字)+ity(名词)→没有名字→匿名
anonymity.e: The witness agreed to speak on condition of anonymity.
anonymity.z: 证人同意在匿名的条件下发言。

autonomous.m: auto(自己)+nom(法则)+ous(…的)→自己定规则→自主的
autonomous.e: Autonomous vehicles may reduce traffic accidents in the future.
autonomous.z: 自动驾驶汽车将来可能减少交通事故。

liner.m: line(航线)+er(物)→按固定航线行驶的船→班轮；衬里
liner.e: The ocean liner carried over two thousand passengers.
liner.z: 这艘远洋班轮载了两千多名乘客。

inferior.m: infer(=infra,下面)+ior(比较级)→更下面的→次等的
inferior.e: Cheap products are often inferior in quality.
inferior.z: 廉价产品质量往往较差。

morale.m: moral(道德,精神)+e→精神状态→士气
morale.e: Regular praise helps keep staff morale high.
morale.z: 经常表扬有助于保持员工士气高涨。

diversion.m: di(分开)+vers(转)+ion(名词)→转向别处→转移；消遣
diversion.e: A road closure caused a long traffic diversion.
diversion.z: 道路封闭导致交通长距离绕行。

subsidiary.m: sub(下)+sid(坐)+iary(…的)→坐在下面的→附属的；子公司
subsidiary.e: The firm opened a subsidiary in Singapore.
subsidiary.z: 该公司在新加坡开设了一家子公司。

pragmatic.m: pragmat(行为,事务)+ic(…的)→注重实际行动的→务实的
pragmatic.e: We need a pragmatic approach to reducing pollution.
pragmatic.z: 我们需要一种务实的方法来减少污染。

orphan.m: 源自希腊 orphanos(失去亲人的)→孤儿；联想：or(或)+phan→或许无父母
orphan.e: The charity supports orphans in rural areas.
orphan.z: 这家慈善机构资助农村地区的孤儿。

graze.e: Sheep were grazing peacefully on the hillside.
graze.z: 羊在山坡上安静地吃草。

reel.m: 联想：reel谐音“绕”→绕线的卷轴；（因晕）摇晃
reel.e: He bought a new fishing reel for the trip.
reel.z: 他为这次旅行买了个新的钓鱼线轮。

alleviate.m: al(加强)+lev(轻)+iate(使)→使变轻→减轻；缓解
alleviate.e: The new bridge should alleviate traffic congestion.
alleviate.z: 新桥应能缓解交通拥堵。

mock.m: 联想：mock谐音“模壳”→模仿别人的样子取笑→嘲笑；模拟的
mock.e: Students take mock exams before the real IELTS test.
mock.z: 学生在正式雅思考试前参加模拟考试。

escalate.m: escal(梯子,同escalator)+ate(动词)→像上扶梯一样上升→升级；加剧
escalate.e: The dispute quickly escalated into a major conflict.
escalate.z: 这场争端迅速升级为重大冲突。

stubborn.m: 联想：stub(树桩)+born→生来像树桩一样不动→顽固的
stubborn.e: He is too stubborn to admit his mistake.
stubborn.z: 他太固执了，不肯承认错误。

rubble.m: 联想：rub(摩擦)+ble→磨碎的石块→瓦砾；碎石
rubble.e: Rescuers searched the rubble for survivors.
rubble.z: 救援人员在瓦砾中搜寻幸存者。

bathe.e: Bathe the wound gently with warm water.

resemblance.e: There is a strong resemblance between the two sisters.

avert.m: a(=ab,离开)+vert(转)→转开→避免；转移(目光)
avert.e: Quick action helped avert a disaster.
avert.z: 迅速行动帮助避免了一场灾难。

cavity.e: Eating too much sugar can cause cavities in your teeth.

conjunction.m: con(共同)+junct(连接)+ion(名词)→连在一起→联合；连词
conjunction.e: The police worked in conjunction with local schools.
conjunction.z: 警方与当地学校联合开展工作。

detain.m: de(加强)+tain(握住)→牢牢抓住→扣留
detain.e: Two suspects were detained for questioning.
detain.z: 两名嫌疑人被扣留接受讯问。

novice.e: This course is suitable for complete novices.
novice.z: 这门课程适合完全的新手。

catastrophic.m: cata(向下)+stroph(转)+ic(…的)→翻转倒下→灾难性的
catastrophic.e: Rising sea levels could have catastrophic effects on coastal cities.
catastrophic.z: 海平面上升可能给沿海城市带来灾难性影响。

compliment.m: 源自拉丁 complere(使完满)→让人圆满的客套话→称赞；恭维
compliment.e: She received many compliments on her presentation.
compliment.z: 她的演讲得到了许多称赞。

pedestrian.e: The city centre is now open only to pedestrians.
pedestrian.z: 市中心现在只对行人开放。

agony.m: 源自希腊 agon(竞赛,挣扎)+y→搏斗中的痛苦→极度痛苦
agony.e: He was in agony after breaking his leg.

empathy.m: em(进入)+path(感情)+y(名词)→进入他人感情→同理心
empathy.e: Good teachers show empathy towards struggling students.
empathy.z: 好老师对学习吃力的学生抱有同理心。

deteriorate.m: deterior(拉丁:更差的)+ate(动词)→变得更差→恶化
deteriorate.e: His health deteriorated rapidly last winter.
deteriorate.z: 去年冬天他的健康状况迅速恶化。

collide.m: col(共同)+lid(=laed,击打)+e→互相撞击→碰撞
collide.e: Two cars collided at the busy junction.
collide.z: 两辆车在繁忙的路口相撞。

reap.m: 联想：reap谐音“利谱”→收获利益；收割
reap.e: Students who study regularly reap the rewards later.
reap.z: 经常学习的学生日后会得到回报。

feasible.e: Is it feasible to finish the project by Friday?
feasible.z: 在周五前完成这个项目可行吗？

preventive.m: pre(预先)+vent(来)+ive(…的)→预先来挡住→预防性的
preventive.e: Preventive healthcare can save money in the long run.
preventive.z: 预防性医疗从长远看能节省开支。

arrogant.m: ar(加强)+rog(要求)+ant(…的)→过分要求别人→傲慢的
arrogant.e: His arrogant attitude annoyed his colleagues.
arrogant.z: 他傲慢的态度惹恼了同事。

dubious.m: dub(=du,二)+ious(…的)→心中有两种想法→可疑的
dubious.e: I am dubious about the claims in this advertisement.
dubious.z: 我对这则广告的说法表示怀疑。

bypass.m: 复合：by(旁边)+pass(通过)→从旁边过→绕道；绕过
bypass.e: The new bypass keeps lorries out of the town centre.
bypass.z: 新的绕城公路让货车不必进入市中心。

playwright.m: 复合：play(剧本)+wright(工匠)→写剧本的匠人→剧作家
playwright.e: Shakespeare is the most famous English playwright.
playwright.z: 莎士比亚是最著名的英国剧作家。

phd.m: 缩写：Philosophiae Doctor(拉丁:哲学博士)→博士学位
phd.e: She is doing a PhD in environmental science.
phd.z: 她正在攻读环境科学博士学位。

vent.e: Make sure the air vent is not blocked.
vent.z: 确保通风口没有被堵住。

eclipse.m: ec(=ex,出)+lip(=leip,离开)+se→光离开→日食；月食
eclipse.e: A total solar eclipse is a rare and spectacular event.
eclipse.z: 日全食是罕见而壮观的现象。

foresee.e: Nobody could foresee how quickly the technology would spread.
foresee.z: 没人能预见到这项技术传播得如此之快。

peril.m: 源自拉丁 periculum(试验,危险)→冒险尝试→危险
peril.e: Climate change puts many species in peril.
peril.z: 气候变化使许多物种身处险境。

bracket.m: 联想：bra(胸罩)+cket→托着东西的支架→支架；括号
bracket.e: Write the answers in brackets after each question.
bracket.z: 把答案写在每道题后面的括号里。

bruise.m: 联想：bru(布鲁,不露)+ise→撞得青一块不想露出来→青肿
bruise.e: She had a bruise on her arm after the fall.
bruise.z: 摔倒后她胳膊上有一块淤青。

poultry.m: poult(小鸡,同pullet)+ry(总称)→鸡鸭类总称→家禽
poultry.e: Poultry farming is a major industry in this region.
poultry.z: 家禽养殖是该地区的主要产业。

reign.m: 源自拉丁 regnum(王权),同reg(统治)→为王；统治时期
reign.e: The castle was built during the reign of Henry VIII.
reign.z: 这座城堡建于亨利八世统治时期。

conquest.m: con(加强)+quest(寻求,获取)→全力夺取→征服
conquest.e: The Norman conquest of England began in 1066.
conquest.z: 诺曼人征服英格兰始于1066年。

packaging.e: Supermarkets are trying to reduce plastic packaging.
packaging.z: 超市正在努力减少塑料包装。

expectancy.m: ex(出)+spect(看)+ancy(名词)→向外盼望→期望；(预期)寿命
expectancy.e: Life expectancy has risen steadily over the past century.
expectancy.z: 过去一个世纪人均预期寿命稳步上升。

inheritance.m: in(使)+herit(继承人,heir)+ance(名词)→成为继承人→遗产；继承
inheritance.e: She used her inheritance to buy a small flat.
inheritance.z: 她用继承的遗产买了一套小公寓。

briefcase.m: 复合：brief(文件,简报)+case(箱)→装文件的箱→公文包
briefcase.e: He left his briefcase on the train.
briefcase.z: 他把公文包落在了火车上。

quantitative.m: quant(多少,数量)+it+ative(…的)→数量的；定量的
quantitative.e: The study combines quantitative and qualitative research methods.
quantitative.z: 这项研究结合了定量和定性研究方法。

brink.m: 联想：b+rink(溜冰场)→站在冰场边缘→边缘
brink.e: The species is on the brink of extinction.

symphony.m: sym(共同)+phon(声音)+y(名词)→声音和谐共鸣→交响乐
symphony.e: The orchestra performed Beethoven's Fifth Symphony.
symphony.z: 管弦乐团演奏了贝多芬第五交响曲。

cellar.m: cell(小室)+ar(地方)→地下小储藏室→地窖
cellar.e: They keep wine and potatoes in the cellar.
cellar.z: 他们把葡萄酒和土豆放在地窖里。

recede.m: re(向后)+ced(走)+e→向后走→后退；减弱
recede.e: The floodwaters slowly receded after the storm.
recede.z: 暴风雨过后洪水慢慢退去。

abound.m: ab(加强)+ound(=und,波浪)→像波浪一样涌出→大量存在
abound.e: Wildlife abounds in the national park.
abound.z: 国家公园里野生动物众多。

allowance.m: allow(允许)+ance(名词)→允许给的钱→津贴；零用钱
allowance.e: Her parents give her a weekly allowance.
allowance.z: 她父母每周给她零花钱。

roast.m: 联想：roast谐音“肉死他”→把肉烤透→烘烤；烤肉
roast.e: We had roast chicken for Sunday lunch.
roast.z: 我们周日午餐吃了烤鸡。

plummet.m: plumb(铅锤)+et(小)→小铅锤直坠→暴跌；骤降
plummet.e: Temperatures plummeted to minus twenty overnight.
plummet.z: 一夜之间气温骤降到零下二十度。

masterpiece.m: 复合：master(大师)+piece(作品)→大师之作→杰作
masterpiece.e: The Mona Lisa is considered a masterpiece of Renaissance art.
masterpiece.z: 《蒙娜丽莎》被视为文艺复兴艺术的杰作。

culminate.m: culmin(顶点,拉丁culmen)+ate(动词)→到达顶点→达到高潮
culminate.e: Years of research culminated in a major breakthrough.
culminate.z: 多年的研究最终带来了重大突破。

pronounced.m: pro(向前)+nounc(说,宣布)+ed→明确说出来的→明显的
pronounced.e: There has been a pronounced rise in online shopping.

drainage.m: drain(排水)+age(名词)→排水；排水系统
drainage.e: Poor drainage causes flooding in heavy rain.
drainage.z: 排水不畅导致大雨时出现内涝。

multinational.m: multi(多)+nation(国家)+al(…的)→多国的→跨国的；跨国公司
multinational.e: Many multinationals have offices in Shanghai.
multinational.z: 许多跨国公司在上海设有办事处。

ordeal.m: 源自古英语 ordal(神判)→古代严酷的神明裁判→严峻考验
ordeal.e: Being lost at sea for three days was a terrible ordeal.
ordeal.z: 在海上漂流三天是一段可怕的磨难。

adore.m: ad(向)+or(说,祈祷)+e→向…祈祷→崇拜；热爱
adore.z: 孩子们非常爱他们的奶奶。

slippery.e: Be careful, the floor is slippery when wet.

splendid.m: splend(发光)+id(…的)→光彩夺目的→壮丽的；极好的
splendid.e: We had a splendid view of the mountains.
splendid.z: 我们看到了壮丽的山景。

mesh.m: 联想：mesh谐音“密丝”→密密的丝线→网孔；网
mesh.e: A fine wire mesh keeps insects out of the room.
mesh.z: 细铁丝网能把虫子挡在屋外。

discern.m: dis(分开)+cern(区分,筛)→分辨开→辨别；察觉
discern.e: It is hard to discern any pattern in the data.
discern.z: 很难从数据中看出任何规律。

foul.m: 联想：foul谐音“犯”→犯规；肮脏的、恶臭的
foul.e: A foul smell was coming from the drain.
foul.z: 下水道里飘出一股恶臭。

alarming.m: alarm(警报)+ing(令人…的)→令人惊恐的→令人担忧的
alarming.e: Plastic is entering the oceans at an alarming rate.
alarming.z: 塑料正以惊人的速度进入海洋。

tentative.m: tent(=tempt,尝试)+ative(…的)→尝试性的→暂定的
tentative.e: We made tentative plans to meet next week.
tentative.z: 我们初步计划下周见面。

stagger.m: 联想：s+tag(标签)+ger→脚步像乱贴的标签东倒西歪→蹒跚；错开
stagger.e: He staggered home after the long hike.
stagger.z: 长途徒步后他踉踉跄跄地回了家。

trajectory.m: tra(=trans,越过)+ject(投掷)+ory(名词)→投掷物越过的路线→轨迹
trajectory.e: The rocket followed a curved trajectory.
trajectory.z: 火箭沿着一条弧形轨迹飞行。

parcel.e: The parcel was delivered to the wrong address.

wicked.m: wick(古英语wicca,巫师)+ed→巫师般的→邪恶的
wicked.e: In the story, a wicked witch puts a curse on the princess.
wicked.z: 故事里，邪恶的女巫给公主下了诅咒。

ornament.e: They hung glass ornaments on the Christmas tree.
ornament.z: 他们在圣诞树上挂了玻璃装饰品。

observatory.m: ob(向)+serv(看守)+atory(场所)→观察的场所→天文台
observatory.e: Astronomers at the observatory discovered a new comet.
observatory.z: 天文台的天文学家发现了一颗新彗星。

endurance.m: en(使)+dur(持久)+ance(名词)→持久的能力→耐力
endurance.e: Marathon running requires great physical endurance.
endurance.z: 跑马拉松需要极强的体力耐力。

pinch.m: 联想：pinch谐音“拼取”→用手指拼命捏一下→捏；拧
pinch.e: Add a pinch of salt to the soup.

orderly.m: order(秩序)+ly(…的)→有秩序的；整齐的
orderly.e: Passengers left the plane in an orderly manner.
orderly.z: 乘客们有序地下了飞机。

nationality.m: nation(国家)+al+ity(名词)→国家属性→国籍
nationality.e: Students of over fifty nationalities study here.
nationality.z: 来自五十多个国家的学生在这里学习。

flake.m: 联想：f+lake(湖)→湖面结出的薄冰片→小薄片；雪花
flake.e: Large flakes of snow drifted past the window.
flake.z: 大片的雪花从窗前飘过。

appraisal.m: ap(加强)+prais(=price,价值)+al(名词)→定出价值→评价；估价
appraisal.e: Staff have an annual performance appraisal.
appraisal.z: 员工每年都有一次绩效评估。

asylum.m: a(无)+syl(抢夺,希腊sylon)+um→不可侵犯之地→庇护
asylum.e: Thousands of people applied for political asylum last year.
asylum.z: 去年有数千人申请政治庇护。

exemplify.m: exempl(=example,例子)+ify(使)→举例→例证；是…的典型
exemplify.e: This building exemplifies modern sustainable design.
exemplify.z: 这栋建筑是现代可持续设计的典范。

pedal.m: ped(脚)+al(…的/物)→用脚踩的东西→踏板
pedal.e: She pedalled hard to get up the hill.

gigantic.m: gigant(巨人,giant)+ic(…的)→巨人般的→巨大的
gigantic.e: A gigantic wave hit the coastline.

repertoire.m: re(再)+pert(=par,产出)+oire(场所)→可反复演出的储备→全部曲目
repertoire.e: The band has a large repertoire of folk songs.
repertoire.z: 这支乐队有大量民歌曲目。

layoff.m: 复合：lay off(下岗,停工)→裁员
layoff.e: The factory announced hundreds of layoffs this month.
layoff.z: 该工厂本月宣布裁员数百人。

marvel.m: 源自拉丁 mirabilis(奇妙的),同mir(惊奇)→奇迹；惊叹
marvel.e: Tourists marvel at the size of the Great Wall.
marvel.z: 游客们惊叹于长城的规模。

ceramic.m: 源自希腊 keramos(陶土)+ic(…的)→陶瓷的
ceramic.e: She collects ceramic bowls from different countries.
ceramic.z: 她收集来自不同国家的陶瓷碗。

wrinkle.m: 联想：w+rink(溜冰场)+le→溜冰场上的冰面皱起→皱纹
wrinkle.e: Too much sun exposure can cause wrinkles.

interviewer.m: inter(之间)+view(看)+er(人)→相互看的人→面试官；采访者
interviewer.e: The interviewer asked about my previous experience.
interviewer.z: 面试官询问了我以前的经历。

aspire.m: a(=ad,向)+spir(呼吸)+e→朝着目标呼吸→渴望；立志
aspire.e: Many young people aspire to work in the tech industry.
aspire.z: 许多年轻人渴望在科技行业工作。

specification.m: spec(看)+ific(使)+ation(名词)→详细标明→规格；详述
specification.e: The laptop's specifications include sixteen gigabytes of memory.
specification.z: 这款笔记本电脑的配置包括16GB内存。

aspirin.m: a(乙酰基)+spir(绣线菊属Spiraea)+in(药名)→阿司匹林
aspirin.e: Take an aspirin for your headache.
aspirin.z: 头疼就吃片阿司匹林吧。

pier.m: 联想：pier谐音“皮耳”→伸入海里像耳朵的长堤→码头；桥墩
pier.e: We walked along the pier at sunset.
pier.z: 日落时我们沿着码头散步。

nickel.m: 源自德语 Kupfernickel(魔鬼铜)→镍；美国五分镍币
nickel.e: Nickel is widely used in batteries for electric cars.
nickel.z: 镍被广泛用于电动汽车电池。

geometry.m: geo(地)+metr(测量)+y(名词)→测量土地→几何学
geometry.e: Ancient Egyptians used geometry to build the pyramids.
geometry.z: 古埃及人运用几何学建造了金字塔。

breach.m: 同源 break(破)→打破→违反；缺口
breach.e: Sharing customer data without consent is a breach of privacy.
breach.z: 未经同意分享客户数据是侵犯隐私。

knob.m: 联想：knob谐音“拿把”→拿着的把手→旋钮；门把手
knob.e: Turn the knob to adjust the volume.

tablet.m: table(桌,板)+t+let(小)→小板→药片；平板电脑
tablet.e: Many students now take notes on a tablet.
tablet.z: 现在许多学生用平板电脑记笔记。

yoga.m: 源自梵语 yoga(结合,轭)→身心结合的修炼→瑜伽
yoga.e: She does yoga every morning to relieve stress.
yoga.z: 她每天早上练瑜伽来缓解压力。

sediment.m: sed(坐)+i+ment(名词)→坐到底下的东西→沉积物
sediment.e: Rivers carry sediment down to the sea.
sediment.z: 河流把沉积物带入大海。

akin.m: a(处于)+kin(亲属)→像亲戚一样→类似的
akin.e: Learning a language is akin to learning music.

evaporate.m: e(出)+vapor(蒸汽)+ate(动词)→变成蒸汽出去→蒸发
evaporate.e: Water evaporates quickly in hot weather.

succumb.e: Many trees succumbed to the disease.

radioactive.m: radio(放射)+active(活跃的)→有放射活性的→放射性的
radioactive.e: Radioactive waste must be stored safely for centuries.
radioactive.z: 放射性废物必须安全储存数百年。

intrigue.m: in(进入)+trigue(=tric,纠缠)→使陷入纠缠→阴谋；激起兴趣
intrigue.z: 这些古代遗迹激起了考古学家的兴趣。

coarse.m: 联想：coarse与course(课程)同音→粗糙的课程→粗糙的；粗俗的
coarse.e: The beach is covered in coarse sand.

incumbent.m: in(在上)+cumb(躺)+ent(…的)→躺在职位上的→现任的
incumbent.e: The incumbent president is running for re-election.
incumbent.z: 现任总统正在竞选连任。

perpetrator.m: per(彻底)+petr(=patr,实行)+ator(人)→干坏事的人→作恶者
perpetrator.e: The police are still looking for the perpetrators.

catalyst.m: cata(向下,彻底)+lys(分解)+t→加速分解之物→催化剂
catalyst.e: The internet was a catalyst for globalisation.
catalyst.z: 互联网是全球化的催化剂。

wardrobe.m: ward(看守)+robe(长袍)→看管衣服的地方→衣橱
wardrobe.e: Her wardrobe is full of clothes she never wears.
wardrobe.z: 她的衣橱里满是从来不穿的衣服。

grease.m: 源自拉丁 crassus(肥厚的)→油脂；联想：grease谐音“格力死”油腻
grease.e: Wipe the grease off the pan with hot water.
grease.z: 用热水擦掉锅上的油污。

aviation.m: avi(鸟)+ation(名词)→像鸟一样飞→航空
aviation.e: Aviation is a major source of carbon emissions.
aviation.z: 航空业是碳排放的主要来源之一。

hawk.m: 联想：hawk谐音“豪客”→天空中的豪客→鹰；(喻)鹰派
hawk.e: A hawk circled high above the field.
hawk.z: 一只鹰在田野上空盘旋。

imaginative.e: The museum offers imaginative activities for children.
imaginative.z: 博物馆为儿童提供富有想象力的活动。

pathetic.m: path(感情,痛苦)+etic(…的)→引起痛苦感情的→可怜的
pathetic.e: The injured puppy looked pathetic in the rain.
pathetic.z: 受伤的小狗在雨中显得很可怜。

decay.m: de(向下)+cay(=cad,落下)→掉下来→腐烂；衰退
decay.e: Sugar is the main cause of tooth decay.

conserve.m: con(加强)+serv(保持)+e→全力保持→保护；节约
conserve.e: We should conserve water during dry summers.
conserve.z: 干燥的夏季我们应节约用水。

durable.m: dur(持久)+able(能…的)→能持久的→耐用的
durable.e: These boots are made of durable leather.
durable.z: 这双靴子由耐用的皮革制成。

compass.m: com(共同)+pass(步)→用步子量出的范围→罗盘；范围
compass.e: Hikers should carry a map and a compass.
compass.z: 徒步者应携带地图和指南针。

novelty.e: The novelty of city life soon wore off.
novelty.z: 城市生活的新鲜感很快就消退了。

outset.m: 复合：out(出)+set(开始)→出发之时→开端
outset.e: Make your goals clear from the outset.
outset.z: 从一开始就要明确你的目标。

martial.m: 源自 Mars(战神马尔斯)+ial(…的)→战争的；军事的
martial.e: He has practised martial arts since childhood.

cardiovascular.e: Regular exercise reduces the risk of cardiovascular disease.
cardiovascular.z: 经常运动可降低患心血管疾病的风险。

subscribe.m: sub(下)+scrib(写)+e→在下面签名→订阅；签署；捐款
subscribe.e: I subscribe to several science magazines.
subscribe.z: 我订阅了几本科学杂志。

sprout.m: 联想：s+pr+out(出)→芽从土里冒出来→发芽；新芽
sprout.e: Seeds will sprout within a week in warm weather.
sprout.z: 天气暖和时种子一周内就会发芽。

heighten.m: height(高度)+en(使)→使变高→提高；加强
heighten.e: The news heightened fears of a recession.
heighten.z: 这条消息加剧了人们对经济衰退的担忧。

gland.m: 源自拉丁 glans(橡子)→形似橡子的器官→腺
gland.e: Sweat glands help control body temperature.

latitude.m: lat(宽)+itude(名词)→宽度→纬度；(行动)自由
latitude.e: The city lies at a latitude of thirty degrees north.
latitude.z: 这座城市位于北纬三十度。

gig.m: 联想：gig谐音“go go”→到处跑场演出→演出；临时工作
gig.e: Many young people now work in the gig economy.
gig.z: 如今许多年轻人在零工经济中工作。

yearn.m: 联想：year(年)+n→年年盼望→渴望；想念
yearn.e: After years abroad, she yearned to return home.
yearn.z: 在国外多年后，她渴望回家。

sociology.e: She chose sociology because she is interested in social inequality.
sociology.z: 她选社会学是因为她对社会不平等感兴趣。

unify.e: The leader tried to unify the divided country.
unify.z: 这位领导人努力统一分裂的国家。

pharmacy.e: You can buy this medicine at any pharmacy.
pharmacy.z: 你可以在任何药店买到这种药。

contingency.m: con(共同)+ting(=tang,接触)+ency(名词)→偶然碰上的事→意外情况
contingency.e: We have a contingency plan in case of bad weather.
contingency.z: 我们有应对恶劣天气的应急预案。

spiral.m: spir(螺旋,拉丁spira)+al(…的)→螺旋形的；螺旋上升
spiral.e: House prices have spiralled out of control.

whirl.m: 联想：wh+irl(=girl)→女孩跳舞时旋转→旋转；回旋
whirl.e: Leaves whirled around in the wind.

flirt.m: 联想：f+lirt谐音“撩”→撩人→调情；轻率对待
flirt.e: He used to flirt with the idea of becoming an actor.

sovereign.m: sover(=super,在上)+eign(统治,reign)→在上统治者→君主；主权的
sovereign.e: Every sovereign state controls its own borders.
sovereign.z: 每个主权国家都控制自己的边界。

flutter.m: 联想：f+lutter谐音“乐他”→蝴蝶乐得扑腾翅膀→飘动；拍翅

incur.m: in(进入)+cur(跑)→跑进去→招致；承担(费用)
incur.e: You may incur extra charges for late payment.
incur.z: 逾期付款可能会产生额外费用。

flicker.m: flick(轻弹)+er(反复)→光反复轻跳→闪烁
flicker.e: The lights flickered during the storm.
flicker.z: 暴风雨中灯光闪烁不定。

delete.m: 源自拉丁 delere(抹去)→删除
delete.e: Please delete any emails from unknown senders.
