delete.z: 请删除所有来自陌生发件人的邮件。

plank.m: 联想：p+lank(瘦长的)→又长又扁的木头→厚木板
plank.e: The bridge was made of wooden planks.
plank.z: 这座桥是用木板搭成的。

blaze.m: 联想：b+laze(像lazy)→火可一点不懒,熊熊燃烧→火焰；燃烧
blaze.e: Firefighters spent hours bringing the blaze under control.
blaze.z: 消防员花了数小时才控制住大火。

physiological.m: physio(自然,身体)+log(学)+ical(…的)→生理学的
physiological.e: Stress has both physiological and psychological effects.
physiological.z: 压力会产生生理和心理两方面的影响。

carpenter.m: carpent(拉丁carpentum,马车)+er(人)→造车的工匠→木匠
carpenter.e: A local carpenter built our kitchen cupboards.
carpenter.z: 一位本地木匠为我们打了厨房橱柜。

slate.m: 联想：s+late(迟)→迟到者的名字被写在石板上→板岩；石板
slate.e: The roof is covered with grey slate tiles.
slate.z: 屋顶铺着灰色的石板瓦。

relaxation.e: Reading is my favourite form of relaxation.
relaxation.z: 阅读是我最喜欢的放松方式。

souvenir.m: sou(=sub,下)+venir(来)→从心底浮上来的记忆→纪念品
souvenir.e: I bought a small souvenir for each of my friends.
souvenir.z: 我给每个朋友都买了一件小纪念品。

conversely.m: con(加强)+vers(转)+e+ly(副词)→转过来说→相反地
conversely.e: Some people work better alone; conversely, others need a team.
conversely.z: 有些人独自工作效率高；相反，另一些人需要团队。

nostalgia.m: nost(回家,希腊nostos)+algia(痛)→想回家的痛→乡愁；怀旧
nostalgia.e: Old songs often fill people with nostalgia.
nostalgia.z: 老歌常让人满怀怀旧之情。

uneven.m: un(不)+even(平坦的,均匀的)→不平坦的；不均衡的
uneven.e: Economic growth has been uneven across regions.
uneven.z: 各地区经济增长并不均衡。

thunder.m: 源自古英语 thunor(雷神Thor)→雷；雷声
thunder.e: We heard thunder in the distance.
thunder.z: 我们听到远处传来雷声。

waterfall.m: 复合：water(水)+fall(落下)→落下的水→瀑布
waterfall.e: The waterfall is the park's main attraction.
waterfall.z: 这座瀑布是公园的主要景点。

litter.m: 源自拉丁 lectus(床)→草铺→散乱杂物；联想：little小垃圾
litter.e: Visitors are fined for dropping litter in the park.
litter.z: 游客在公园乱扔垃圾会被罚款。

exquisite.m: ex(出)+quisit(寻求)+e→精心找出来的→精美的
exquisite.e: The museum displays exquisite Chinese silk paintings.
exquisite.z: 博物馆展出了精美的中国绢画。

immerse.e: The best way to learn a language is to immerse yourself in it.
immerse.z: 学语言最好的方法就是沉浸其中。

petroleum.e: Plastics are made from petroleum products.

flap.m: 拟声：flap像翅膀拍打声→拍打；摆动；(口袋)盖片
flap.e: The bird flapped its wings and flew away.

drastic.m: 源自希腊 drastikos(有效的,猛烈的)→激烈的；严厉的
drastic.e: The government took drastic measures to cut pollution.
drastic.z: 政府采取了严厉措施来减少污染。

farewell.m: 复合：fare(过活,走)+well(好)→一路走好→告别
farewell.e: We held a farewell party for our teacher.
farewell.z: 我们为老师举办了欢送会。

ripple.m: 联想：rip(撕开)+ple→水面被轻轻撕开的波纹→涟漪
ripple.e: The stone made ripples across the pond.
ripple.z: 石头在池塘里激起了圈圈涟漪。

patriotism.m: patri(父亲,祖国)+ot+ism(主义)→爱国主义
patriotism.e: The national anthem inspires a sense of patriotism.
patriotism.z: 国歌激发人们的爱国情怀。

advent.e: The advent of smartphones changed how we communicate.
advent.z: 智能手机的出现改变了我们的交流方式。

seam.m: 同源 sew(缝)→缝起来的线→接缝；煤层
seam.e: The seam of my jacket has split.

alienate.m: alien(外人,陌生的)+ate(使)→使成陌生人→疏远
alienate.e: Strict rules may alienate young voters.
alienate.z: 严苛的规定可能会疏远年轻选民。

sting.m: 联想：s+ting(谐音“疼”)→被叮一下好疼→叮；刺痛
sting.e: A bee sting can be dangerous for some people.
sting.z: 蜂蜇对某些人可能很危险。

idle.m: 联想：idle谐音“爱斗”→闲得没事爱斗嘴→闲散的；懒惰的
idle.e: Many factories stood idle during the lockdown.
idle.z: 封控期间许多工厂处于停工状态。

ubiquitous.m: ubiqu(拉丁ubique,到处)+itous(…的)→无处不在的
ubiquitous.e: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.
ubiquitous.z: 智能手机在现代生活中已无处不在。

pinpoint.m: 复合：pin(针)+point(点)→针尖→精确定位
pinpoint.e: Scientists are trying to pinpoint the cause of the disease.
pinpoint.z: 科学家正努力查明这种疾病的病因。

scenery.e: The scenery along the coast is breathtaking.
scenery.z: 沿海的风景令人叹为观止。

glamour.m: 源自 grammar(学问)的变体→古指魔法咒语→魅力；魔力
glamour.e: Many young people are attracted by the glamour of fame.
glamour.z: 许多年轻人被名气的光环吸引。

pivotal.m: pivot(枢轴)+al(…的)→处在枢轴上的→关键的
pivotal.e: Teachers play a pivotal role in a child's development.
pivotal.z: 老师在孩子的成长中起着关键作用。

cosmos.m: 源自希腊 kosmos(秩序)→有秩序的整体→宇宙
cosmos.e: Humans have always wondered about our place in the cosmos.
cosmos.z: 人类一直思索自己在宇宙中的位置。

dissent.m: dis(分开)+sent(感觉)→感觉不同→异议
dissent.e: There was little dissent from the committee's decision.
dissent.z: 委员会的决定几乎没有遭到异议。

scenic.e: We took the scenic route through the mountains.
scenic.z: 我们走了穿过山区的风景路线。

fragrance.m: fragr(散发香气,拉丁fragrare)+ance(名词)→芬芳
fragrance.e: The garden was filled with the fragrance of roses.
fragrance.z: 花园里弥漫着玫瑰的芬芳。

authenticity.e: Experts questioned the authenticity of the painting.
authenticity.z: 专家对这幅画的真伪提出质疑。

converge.m: con(共同)+verg(倾斜,转向)+e→向同一处倾→汇聚
converge.e: Thousands of fans converged on the stadium.
converge.z: 成千上万的球迷涌向体育场。

trivial.m: tri(三)+via(路)+al→三岔路口闲谈的→琐碎的
trivial.e: Don't waste time arguing about trivial matters.

porcelain.m: 源自意大利语 porcellana(宝贝贝壳,质地似瓷)→瓷器
porcelain.e: China has been famous for its porcelain for centuries.
porcelain.z: 几个世纪以来中国以瓷器闻名。

inventor.m: in(进入)+vent(来)+or(人)→想出来新东西的人→发明者
inventor.e: Edison was one of the greatest inventors in history.
inventor.z: 爱迪生是历史上最伟大的发明家之一。

buzz.m: 拟声：buzz像蜜蜂的嗡嗡声→嗡嗡声；热议
buzz.e: The new film has created a lot of buzz online.
buzz.z: 这部新电影在网上引起了热议。

famine.e: The drought led to a severe famine.
famine.z: 旱灾导致了严重的饥荒。

aquatic.e: The lake supports many aquatic plants and animals.
aquatic.z: 这片湖滋养着许多水生动植物。

liaison.m: 源自法语 lier(捆绑,联系)+son→联络；联络人
liaison.e: She acts as a liaison between the school and parents.
liaison.z: 她担任学校和家长之间的联络人。

cassette.e: My parents still keep their old music cassettes.
cassette.z: 我父母还保留着他们的老音乐磁带。

directory.m: direct(指引)+ory(名词)→指引用的名录→目录；名录
directory.e: Look up the number in the telephone directory.
directory.z: 在电话簿里查一下号码。

dwelling.e: Most dwellings in the village are made of stone.
dwelling.z: 村里的大多数住宅是石头建的。

clamp.m: 联想：c+lamp(灯)→把台灯夹在桌边的夹子→夹钳；夹紧
clamp.e: Use a clamp to hold the wood in place.

hinder.m: hind(后面的)+er(动词)→拖在后面→阻碍
hinder.e: Poor transport links hinder economic growth.
hinder.z: 交通不便阻碍经济增长。

algorithm.m: 源自数学家花拉子米(al-Khwarizmi)之名→算法
algorithm.e: Social media algorithms decide what content we see.
algorithm.z: 社交媒体的算法决定我们看到什么内容。

navigation.m: nav(船)+ig(驱使)+ation(名词)→驱船→航行；导航
navigation.e: Satellite navigation has made driving much easier.
navigation.z: 卫星导航让开车方便多了。

plaster.m: 源自希腊 emplastron(敷料)→石膏；灰泥；膏药
plaster.e: The old plaster on the walls was cracking.
plaster.z: 墙上的旧灰泥正在开裂。

abnormal.m: ab(偏离)+norm(标准)+al(…的)→偏离标准的→反常的
abnormal.e: Doctors found abnormal levels of sugar in his blood.
abnormal.z: 医生发现他血糖水平异常。

prosper.m: pro(向前)+sper(希望)→朝希望前进→繁荣；成功
prosper.e: Small businesses prospered after the new road opened.
prosper.z: 新路开通后小商户生意兴隆。

pianist.e: The young pianist won an international competition.
pianist.z: 这位年轻钢琴家赢得了一项国际比赛。

heartbeat.e: The doctor listened to the baby's heartbeat.

synthesis.m: syn(共同)+thesis(放置)→放在一起→综合；合成
synthesis.e: Plants use sunlight in the synthesis of sugars.
synthesis.z: 植物利用阳光合成糖类。

inclination.e: I have no inclination to go out tonight.

inclusive.m: in(进入)+clus(关闭)+ive(…的)→关在里面的→包括的；包容的
inclusive.e: The price is inclusive of breakfast and taxes.

superficial.m: super(在上)+fic(=face,面)+ial(…的)→在表面的→肤浅的
superficial.e: The damage to the car was only superficial.

rig.m: 联想：rig谐音“锐给”→给船配上装备→装备；操纵(选举等)
rig.e: An oil rig stands far off the coast.
rig.z: 一座石油钻井平台矗立在远离海岸的地方。

excursion.m: ex(出)+curs(跑)+ion(名词)→跑出去→短途旅行
excursion.e: The class went on an excursion to the science museum.
excursion.z: 全班去科学馆进行了一次短途参观。

vocational.m: voc(叫喊,召唤)+ation+al(…的)→受召唤的职业→职业的
vocational.e: Vocational training helps young people find jobs.
vocational.z: 职业培训帮助年轻人找到工作。

cucumber.m: 源自拉丁 cucumis(黄瓜)；联想：cu+cumber谐音“看把”→黄瓜
cucumber.e: I like adding cucumber to my salad.
cucumber.z: 我喜欢在沙拉里加黄瓜。

liable.m: li(=lig,捆绑)+able(能…的)→被(责任)捆住的→有责任的；易于
liable.e: Drivers are liable for any damage they cause.
liable.z: 司机须对其造成的任何损失负责。

microscope.m: micro(微小)+scope(看,镜)→看微小物体的镜子→显微镜
microscope.e: Bacteria can only be seen under a microscope.
microscope.z: 细菌只能在显微镜下看到。

bloc.m: 源自法语 bloc(块)，同block→结成一块的国家→集团
bloc.e: The trade bloc includes ten Asian countries.
bloc.z: 这个贸易集团包括十个亚洲国家。

overtime.m: 复合：over(超过)+time(时间)→超时→加班
overtime.e: Many workers do unpaid overtime every week.
overtime.z: 许多员工每周都无偿加班。

lateral.m: later(=lat,侧面,拉丁latus)+al(…的)→侧面的；横向的
lateral.e: Lateral thinking can help solve difficult problems.
lateral.z: 横向思维有助于解决难题。

relay.m: re(再)+lay(=laxare,放开)→驿站换马重新放出→接力；转播
relay.e: The match was relayed live to millions of viewers.
relay.z: 这场比赛向数百万观众进行了现场转播。

buffet.m: 源自法语 buffet(餐具柜)→摆在柜上自取→自助餐
buffet.e: The hotel serves a breakfast buffet every morning.
buffet.z: 酒店每天早上提供自助早餐。

jog.m: 联想：jog谐音“走个”→慢慢走个、跑个→慢跑；轻推
jog.e: I jog in the park before work.

plateau.m: plat(平的)+eau(名词)→平坦的高地→高原；平稳期
plateau.e: My progress in English has reached a plateau.
plateau.z: 我的英语进步进入了平台期。

slaughter.e: Thousands of cattle were slaughtered to stop the disease.
slaughter.z: 为阻止疫病，数千头牛被宰杀。

heroine.m: hero(英雄)+ine(阴性后缀)→女英雄；女主角
heroine.e: The heroine of the novel is a brave young doctor.
heroine.z: 小说的女主人公是一位勇敢的年轻医生。

retrospect.e: In retrospect, I should have studied harder.
retrospect.z: 回想起来，我当初应该更努力学习。

mingle.m: 联想：ming(谐音“混”入)+le→混在人群中→混合；交往
mingle.e: Guests mingled in the garden after dinner.
mingle.z: 晚饭后客人们在花园里相互交谈。

hospitality.m: hospit(客人,主人)+al+ity(名词)→待客之道→款待；酒店业
hospitality.e: We were touched by the hospitality of the local people.
hospitality.z: 当地人的热情款待让我们很感动。

imperative.m: imper(命令)+ative(…的)→命令式的→必要的；紧迫的
imperative.e: It is imperative that we act now on climate change.
imperative.z: 我们必须立刻就气候变化采取行动。

indifferent.m: in(不)+different(不同的)→觉得没区别→漠不关心的
indifferent.e: Many young people seem indifferent to politics.
indifferent.z: 许多年轻人似乎对政治漠不关心。

impoverished.m: im(使)+pover(=poor,穷)+ish(使)+ed→使变穷的→贫困的
impoverished.e: The charity builds schools in impoverished areas.
impoverished.z: 这家慈善机构在贫困地区建学校。

martyr.m: 源自希腊 martyr(见证人)→以死证信仰者→烈士；殉道者
martyr.e: He was remembered as a martyr for freedom.
martyr.z: 他作为争取自由的烈士被人们铭记。

ominous.e: Dark clouds gave an ominous sign of the coming storm.
ominous.z: 乌云预示着暴风雨即将来临。

howl.m: 拟声：howl像狼嚎“嗷呜”→嚎叫；怒吼
howl.e: We could hear wolves howling in the night.

cricket.m: 拟声：源自古法语 criquer(吱吱叫)→蟋蟀；板球
cricket.e: Cricket is a hugely popular sport in India.

deceive.m: de(坏)+ceive(拿取)→用坏手段拿走→欺骗
deceive.e: Some advertisements deceive consumers with false claims.
deceive.z: 一些广告用虚假宣传欺骗消费者。

footprint.e: Cycling to work reduces your carbon footprint.
footprint.z: 骑车上班能减少你的碳足迹。

irregular.e: Irregular sleep patterns can harm your health.
irregular.z: 作息不规律会损害健康。

decree.m: de(加强)+cree(=cern,决定)→正式决定→法令
decree.e: The president issued a decree banning the protest.
decree.z: 总统颁布法令禁止这次抗议。

downturn.m: 复合：down(向下)+turn(转)→向下转→(经济)衰退
downturn.e: Tourism suffered during the economic downturn.
downturn.z: 经济衰退期间旅游业受到冲击。

butcher.m: 源自古法语 bouchier(屠宰公羊的人,bouc公羊)→屠夫；肉商
butcher.e: I bought fresh sausages from the local butcher.
butcher.z: 我在本地肉店买了新鲜香肠。

temperament.m: temper(调和)+a+ment(名词)→(体液)调和的状态→气质；性情
temperament.e: The two brothers have very different temperaments.

muster.m: 源自拉丁 monstrare(展示)→集合展示→召集；鼓起(勇气)
muster.e: She mustered the courage to speak in public.

cannon.e: The old cannon is fired every day at noon.
cannon.z: 那门古炮每天中午都会鸣放。

oblivious.m: ob(加强)+livi(=lev,抹平)+ous→记忆被抹平→浑然不觉的
oblivious.e: He was oblivious to the danger around him.
oblivious.z: 他对周围的危险浑然不觉。

narcotic.m: narc(麻木,希腊narke)+otic(…的)→使麻木的→麻醉药
narcotic.e: Narcotic drugs are strictly controlled by law.
narcotic.z: 麻醉药品受法律严格管制。

multitude.e: The city offers a multitude of cultural activities.
multitude.z: 这座城市提供大量文化活动。

degrade.m: de(向下)+grad(等级,步)+e→降级→降解；使退化
degrade.e: Plastic bags take hundreds of years to degrade.
degrade.z: 塑料袋需要数百年才能降解。

cumulative.m: cumul(堆积)+ative(…的)→堆积起来的→累积的
cumulative.e: The cumulative effect of small changes can be huge.
cumulative.z: 小变化的累积效应可能很大。

lag.m: 联想：lag谐音“落个”→落个在后→落后；滞后
lag.e: Rural areas still lag behind cities in internet access.
lag.z: 农村地区在网络普及方面仍落后于城市。

nylon.m: 杜邦公司造的商标词→尼龙(音译)
nylon.e: Nylon is often used to make sportswear.
nylon.z: 尼龙常被用于制作运动服。

flank.m: 联想：f+lank(瘦长的)→身体瘦长的侧面→侧腹；侧翼
flank.e: The road is flanked by tall trees.
flank.z: 道路两旁是高大的树木。

lash.m: 联想：lash谐音“拉死”→用鞭子抽→鞭打；猛击；睫毛
lash.e: Heavy rain lashed the coast all night.
lash.z: 大雨整夜猛烈冲刷着海岸。

outskirts.m: 复合：out(外)+skirt(裙边)+s→城市的外裙边→郊区
outskirts.e: They live on the outskirts of London.

abide.m: a(加强)+bide(等待,停留)→停留在规则里→遵守；忍受
abide.e: All members must abide by the club's rules.
abide.z: 所有会员必须遵守俱乐部的规定。

enclose.m: en(使)+close(关闭)→使关在里面→围住；附上
enclose.e: Please enclose a copy of your passport.

insulation.m: insul(岛)+ation(名词)→使成孤岛→隔热；绝缘
insulation.e: Good insulation keeps the house warm in winter.
insulation.z: 良好的隔热让房子冬天保持温暖。

irritate.m: 源自拉丁 irritare(刺激,激怒)→激怒；刺激(皮肤)
irritate.e: Some soaps can irritate sensitive skin.
irritate.z: 一些肥皂会刺激敏感肌肤。

flare.m: 联想：f+lare谐音“来”→火苗忽地一下来了→闪耀；突然爆发
flare.e: Tensions flared between the two groups.
flare.z: 两派之间的紧张关系骤然升级。

cape.m: cap(头)+e→陆地的头部→海角；披肩
cape.e: The lighthouse stands at the tip of the cape.

devour.m: de(加强)+vour(吃,拉丁vorare)→狼吞虎咽→吞食；如饥似渴地读
devour.e: She devoured the novel in a single evening.
devour.z: 她一个晚上就读完了这本小说。

parasite.m: para(旁边)+sit(=sitos,食物)+e→在旁边吃别人的→寄生虫
parasite.e: The parasite lives inside the fish's gut.
parasite.z: 这种寄生虫生活在鱼的肠道里。

simplify.e: The new system will simplify the application process.
simplify.z: 新系统将简化申请流程。

envy.e: Her friends envy her ability to speak five languages.
envy.z: 朋友们羡慕她会说五种语言。

radiate.m: radi(光线)+ate(动词)→发出光线→放射；散发
radiate.e: The stove radiates heat throughout the room.
radiate.z: 炉子把热量散发到整个房间。

whereby.m: 复合：where(那个)+by(通过)→通过那个→借以；凭此
whereby.e: They set up a system whereby students can borrow laptops.
whereby.z: 他们建立了一个让学生借用笔记本电脑的系统。

pry.m: 联想：pry谐音“派”→派人去打探→窥探；撬开
pry.e: Celebrities often complain that the media pry into their lives.
pry.z: 名人常抱怨媒体窥探他们的生活。

denomination.m: de(加强)+nomin(名字)+ation(名词)→命名→面额；教派
denomination.e: The machine accepts notes of any denomination.
denomination.z: 这台机器接受任何面额的纸币。

customary.e: It is customary to remove your shoes before entering.

grate.m: 联想：grate与great同音→吵得“great”难受→磨碎；炉栅；刺耳
grate.e: Grate some cheese over the pasta.
grate.z: 在意面上擦一些奶酪碎。

metallic.e: The water had a strange metallic taste.
metallic.z: 水有一股奇怪的金属味。

boycott.m: 源自19世纪爱尔兰地产代理人 Boycott 被集体抵制→联合抵制
boycott.e: Consumers boycotted the brand after the scandal.
boycott.z: 丑闻曝光后消费者抵制了这个品牌。

skim.m: 联想：s+kim→像撇浮沫一样只掠过表面→撇去；略读
skim.e: Skim the passage first to get the main idea.

referee.m: refer(提交)+ee(被…者)→被提交争议的人→裁判；推荐人
referee.e: The referee showed him a red card.

intuition.m: in(向内)+tuit(看,拉丁tueri)+ion(名词)→向内看→直觉
intuition.e: Sometimes you should trust your intuition.
intuition.z: 有时你应该相信自己的直觉。

reckon.m: 联想：reck谐音“掰扣”→掰着手指算→计算；认为
reckon.e: I reckon it will rain later today.
reckon.z: 我估计今天晚些时候会下雨。

eccentric.m: ec(=ex,出)+centr(中心)+ic(…的)→偏离中心的→古怪的
eccentric.e: The eccentric professor always wore two watches.
eccentric.z: 那位古怪的教授总是戴着两块手表。

transparency.m: trans(穿过)+par(出现)+ency(名词)→光穿过能看见→透明度
transparency.e: Voters demand greater transparency in government spending.
transparency.z: 选民要求政府开支更加透明。

overhear.m: 复合：over(越过)+hear(听)→越过旁人听到→无意中听到
overhear.e: I overheard two students talking about the exam.
overhear.z: 我无意中听到两个学生在谈论考试。

gracious.m: grac(=grace,优雅,恩惠)+ious(…的)→亲切的；仁慈的
gracious.e: She was gracious enough to thank everyone for coming.
gracious.z: 她很得体地感谢了每位到场的人。

zoning.m: zone(区域)+ing(名词)→划分区域→区域规划
zoning.e: Zoning laws prevent factories from being built near homes.
zoning.z: 区域规划法禁止在住宅附近建工厂。

overthrow.e: The rebels tried to overthrow the government.
overthrow.z: 叛乱分子试图推翻政府。

grumble.m: 拟声：grum像低声咕哝+ble(反复)→抱怨；发牢骚
grumble.e: Passengers grumbled about the delayed train.
grumble.z: 乘客们对火车晚点满腹牢骚。

reckless.m: reck(顾虑,古英语)+less(无)→毫无顾虑的→鲁莽的
reckless.e: He was fined for reckless driving.

drawback.m: 复合：draw(拉)+back(后)→往后拉的东西→缺点
drawback.e: The main drawback of the plan is its cost.
drawback.z: 这个计划的主要缺点是成本高。

freight.m: 联想：fr+eight(八)→货车上装了八箱货→货运；货物
freight.e: Most freight is now transported by sea.
freight.z: 现在大部分货物通过海运运输。

vengeance.e: The film is about a man seeking vengeance.
vengeance.z: 这部电影讲述一个男人寻求复仇的故事。

mar.m: 联想：mar谐音“抹”→抹黑了→损坏；破坏
mar.e: The holiday was marred by bad weather.
mar.z: 糟糕的天气破坏了这次假期。

ape.m: 联想：ape谐音“哎坡”→猿在山坡上叫→猿；模仿
ape.e: Chimpanzees and gorillas are both apes.
ape.z: 黑猩猩和大猩猩都属于猿类。

sprint.m: 联想：s+print(印)→冲刺时脚印一个接一个→短跑；冲刺
sprint.e: He sprinted to catch the last bus.
sprint.z: 他冲刺去赶最后一班公交车。

influx.e: The city has seen a large influx of tourists this summer.
influx.z: 今年夏天这座城市涌入了大量游客。

handicap.m: 源自 hand in cap(手放帽里抽签的旧游戏)→让对手受限→障碍；残疾
handicap.e: Not speaking English can be a handicap when travelling.
handicap.z: 旅行时不会说英语可能是个障碍。

hemisphere.e: Australia is in the southern hemisphere.

apprentice.m: appren(=apprehend,学习掌握)+tice→学手艺的人→学徒
apprentice.e: He worked as an apprentice electrician for three years.

amaze.m: a(加强)+maze(迷宫)→像进了迷宫一样→使吃惊
amaze.e: The speed of technological change never fails to amaze me.
amaze.z: 技术变革的速度总让我惊叹。

renovate.m: re(再)+nov(新)+ate(使)→使再次变新→翻新
renovate.e: They spent a year renovating the old farmhouse.
renovate.z: 他们花了一年时间翻修那座老农舍。

mutation.e: A genetic mutation can cause this rare disease.
mutation.z: 基因突变可能导致这种罕见病。

minus.m: 源自拉丁 minus(更少)，同min(小)→减；负的；不足
minus.e: Temperatures can drop to minus thirty in winter.
minus.z: 冬天气温可能降到零下三十度。

pathogen.m: path(疾病)+o+gen(产生)→产生疾病的东西→病原体
pathogen.e: Washing hands helps stop the spread of pathogens.
pathogen.z: 勤洗手有助于阻止病原体传播。

cradle.m: 联想：cra(谐音“摇”)+dle→摇来摇去的小床→摇篮；发源地
cradle.e: Greece is often called the cradle of democracy.
cradle.z: 希腊常被称为民主的摇篮。

thriller.m: thrill(使激动,战栗)+er(物)→惊悚片；惊险小说
thriller.e: I watched a gripping thriller last night.
thriller.z: 我昨晚看了一部扣人心弦的惊悚片。

pulp.m: 源自拉丁 pulpa(果肉)→果肉；纸浆
pulp.e: Wood pulp is used to make paper.

spacious.m: spac(=space,空间)+ious(…的)→空间大的→宽敞的
spacious.e: The new library has a bright and spacious reading room.
spacious.z: 新图书馆有一个明亮宽敞的阅览室。

seep.m: 联想：seep谐音“细浦”→水细细地渗出来→渗出；渗漏
seep.e: Water was seeping through the ceiling.

cherish.m: cher(亲爱的,法语cher)+ish(动词)→珍爱；怀有
cherish.e: I cherish the time I spend with my family.
cherish.z: 我珍惜和家人在一起的时光。

unravel.m: un(解开)+ravel(纠缠)→解开纠缠→阐明；解决
unravel.e: Scientists are still trying to unravel the mystery.
unravel.z: 科学家仍在努力解开这个谜团。

censorship.e: The film faced strict censorship in several countries.
censorship.z: 这部电影在多个国家遭到严格审查。

smuggle.m: 联想：s+mug(杯子)+gle→把东西藏在杯子里偷偷带→走私
smuggle.e: They tried to smuggle ivory across the border.
smuggle.z: 他们试图越境走私象牙。

commonplace.m: 复合：common(普通的)+place(地方)→随处可见的→平凡的；常见事
commonplace.z: 在线学习已经变得很普遍。

visualize.m: visu(看)+al+ize(使)→使看得见→想象；使形象化
visualize.e: Try to visualize yourself succeeding in the exam.
visualize.z: 试着想象自己在考试中成功的样子。

mint.m: 源自拉丁 moneta(钱币,造币所)→造币厂；薄荷另源→薄荷
mint.e: I always drink mint tea after dinner.

incidentally.m: incident(事件)+al+ly(副词)→附带发生地→顺便说一句
incidentally.e: Incidentally, the library will be closed on Monday.
incidentally.z: 顺便说一句，图书馆周一闭馆。

municipality.m: muni(职责)+cip(拿)+al+ity→承担职责的城→自治市；市政当局
municipality.e: The municipality provides free public transport for the elderly.
municipality.z: 市政当局为老年人提供免费公共交通。

inaccurate.e: The map we used was completely inaccurate.
inaccurate.z: 我们用的那张地图完全不准确。

commemorate.m: com(共同)+memor(记忆)+ate(动词)→一起记住→纪念
commemorate.e: A statue was built to commemorate the victims.
commemorate.z: 人们建了一座雕像来纪念遇难者。

mythology.e: Dragons appear frequently in Chinese mythology.
mythology.z: 龙在中国神话中频繁出现。

simultaneous.e: The conference offers simultaneous translation into five languages.
simultaneous.z: 会议提供五种语言的同声传译。

defer.m: de(离开)+fer(带)→带开→推迟；(defer to)听从
defer.e: She decided to defer her university place for a year.
defer.z: 她决定把大学入学推迟一年。

outweigh.m: 复合：out(超过)+weigh(重量)→比…更重→超过；比…重要
outweigh.e: The benefits of exercise far outweigh the risks.
outweigh.z: 运动的益处远大于风险。

abrupt.m: ab(离开)+rupt(断)→突然断开→突然的；唐突的
abrupt.e: The meeting came to an abrupt end.

rampant.m: 源自古法语 ramper(攀爬,跃立)→(像兽一样)张牙舞爪→猖獗的
rampant.e: Corruption was rampant in the old regime.

shred.m: 联想：s+hred(像red红)→把红纸撕成碎条→碎片；撕碎
shred.e: Always shred documents containing personal information.
shred.z: 含有个人信息的文件一定要用碎纸机销毁。

tabloid.m: tabl(=tablet,药片)+oid(像…的)→像药片一样浓缩的→小报
tabloid.e: The tabloids are full of celebrity gossip.

heater.e: Turn on the heater if you feel cold.

ailment.e: Many common ailments can be treated at home.
ailment.z: 许多常见小病在家就能处理。

versatile.m: vers(转)+atile(能…的)→能多方转换的→多才多艺的；多用途的
versatile.e: Rice is a versatile ingredient used in many dishes.
versatile.z: 大米是一种用途多样的食材，用于很多菜肴。

semiconductor.e: Semiconductors are essential to modern electronics.
semiconductor.z: 半导体对现代电子产品至关重要。

nuisance.m: 源自古法语 nuisance(伤害)，拉丁nocere(伤害)→讨厌的人或事
nuisance.e: Noisy neighbours can be a real nuisance.
nuisance.z: 吵闹的邻居真的很烦人。

dizzy.m: 联想：dizzy谐音“地转”→天旋地转→头晕的
dizzy.e: I felt dizzy after standing in the sun for hours.
dizzy.z: 在太阳下站了几个小时后我感到头晕。

growl.m: 拟声：growl像狗发怒的“咕噜”声→低吼；咆哮
growl.e: The dog growled at the stranger.

purity.e: The purity of the water is tested every day.
purity.z: 每天都要检测水的纯度。

vomit.m: 源自拉丁 vomere(吐出)→呕吐
vomit.e: The child vomited after eating too much candy.
vomit.z: 孩子吃了太多糖果后呕吐了。

exterior.m: exter(外面)+ior(比较级)→更外面的→外部(的)
exterior.e: The exterior of the building is made of glass.
exterior.z: 这栋楼的外立面是玻璃做的。

perpetual.m: per(贯穿)+pet(追求)+ual(…的)→一直追下去的→永久的；不断的
perpetual.e: Big cities live in a state of perpetual noise.
perpetual.z: 大城市一直处在不断的噪音中。

facet.m: fac(=face,面)+et(小)→小面→(宝石的)刻面；方面
facet.e: Music is an important facet of our culture.
facet.z: 音乐是我们文化的一个重要方面。

improvise.m: im(不)+pro(预先)+vis(看)+e→没预先看过→即兴创作；临时凑合
improvise.e: I forgot my notes, so I had to improvise.
improvise.z: 我忘了带讲稿，只好即兴发挥。

freelance.m: 复合：free(自由)+lance(长矛)→中世纪自由雇佣骑士→自由职业的
freelance.e: She works as a freelance graphic designer.
freelance.z: 她是一名自由职业平面设计师。

impede.e: Heavy snow impeded the rescue efforts.

subside.e: The pain gradually subsided after I took the medicine.
subside.z: 吃药后疼痛渐渐消退了。

outspoken.m: 复合：out(出)+spoken(说的)→全说出来的→直言不讳的
outspoken.e: She is an outspoken critic of the new policy.
outspoken.z: 她是新政策的直言批评者。

petal.m: 源自希腊 petalon(叶片,展开的)→花瓣
petal.e: The wind blew petals across the garden.
petal.z: 风把花瓣吹得满园都是。

graffiti.m: 源自意大利语 graffio(刮,划)→墙上刻划→涂鸦
graffiti.e: The walls of the station were covered in graffiti.

cliche.m: 源自法语 clicher(浇铸铅版,拟声)→反复印的版→陈词滥调
cliche.e: It's a cliche, but practice really does make perfect.
cliche.z: 这话虽是老生常谈，但熟能生巧确实不假。

barren.m: 联想：bar(栅栏)+ren→被栅栏围住长不出庄稼→贫瘠的；不育的
barren.e: The desert is a barren and empty landscape.
barren.z: 沙漠是一片贫瘠而空旷的景象。

hinge.m: 同源 hang(悬挂)→门挂在上面的部件→铰链；关键
hinge.e: The success of the project hinges on funding.
hinge.z: 项目成功与否取决于资金。

timetable.m: 复合：time(时间)+table(表)→时间表；时刻表
timetable.e: Check the bus timetable before you leave.
timetable.z: 出门前看看公交时刻表。

mundane.m: mund(世界,拉丁mundus)+ane(…的)→尘世的→平凡的；世俗的
mundane.e: Robots can take over many mundane tasks.
mundane.z: 机器人可以接手许多平凡琐碎的工作。

unanimous.m: un(=uni,一)+anim(心,精神)+ous(…的)→同一条心→一致同意的
unanimous.e: The committee reached a unanimous decision.
unanimous.z: 委员会一致作出了决定。

intellect.m: intel(=inter,之间)+lect(选择)→在其中选择的能力→智力
intellect.e: She is admired for her sharp intellect.
intellect.z: 她因敏锐的头脑而受人钦佩。

outright.m: 复合：out(彻底)+right(直接)→彻底的；直率的；完全地
outright.e: The government announced an outright ban on smoking indoors.
outright.z: 政府宣布全面禁止室内吸烟。

trickle.m: 联想：trick(诡计)+le→水像耍诡计一样一点点漏→滴流；细流
trickle.z: 泪水顺着她的脸颊流下。

perennial.m: per(贯穿)+enn(年)+ial(…的)→贯穿整年的→常年的；多年生的
perennial.e: Traffic jams are a perennial problem in big cities.
perennial.z: 交通拥堵是大城市长期存在的问题。

overlap.m: 复合：over(在上)+lap(搭,重叠)→搭在上面→重叠
overlap.e: The two courses overlap in content.
overlap.z: 这两门课程在内容上有重叠。

longevity.m: long(长)+ev(年龄,时代)+ity(名词)→长的年龄→长寿
longevity.e: A healthy diet contributes to longevity.

obsolete.m: ob(离开)+solet(=solere,习惯)+e→不再习惯用→过时的
obsolete.e: Fax machines are now almost obsolete.
obsolete.z: 传真机现在几乎被淘汰了。

bankrupt.m: bank(银行,长凳)+rupt(断)→钱庄的长凳被折断→破产的
bankrupt.e: The company went bankrupt during the recession.
bankrupt.z: 这家公司在经济衰退中破产了。

anomaly.m: a(不)+nomal(=homalos,平的,规则)+y→不规则→异常
anomaly.e: The cold weather this month is a statistical anomaly.
anomaly.z: 本月的寒冷天气在统计上属于异常。

variant.e: Scientists are tracking a new variant of the virus.
variant.z: 科学家正在追踪该病毒的一种新变种。

wail.m: 拟声：wail像“哇哎”的哭声→恸哭；哀号
wail.e: We heard the wail of an ambulance siren.
wail.z: 我们听到救护车警笛的呼啸声。

kinship.e: Kinship ties are very important in rural communities.
kinship.z: 亲属关系在农村社区中非常重要。

excavation.m: ex(出)+cav(洞)+ation(名词)→挖出洞来→发掘
excavation.e: The excavation revealed a Roman village.
excavation.z: 这次发掘发现了一座罗马时期的村庄。

bunk.m: 联想：bunk谐音“棒客”→船上睡的窄铺位→铺位；双层床
bunk.e: The children sleep in bunk beds.

greedy.e: Greedy developers destroyed much of the old town.
greedy.z: 贪婪的开发商毁掉了老城的大部分。

salvage.e: Workers tried to salvage what they could from the fire.
salvage.z: 工人们尽力从火灾中抢救出一些东西。

shepherd.e: The shepherd led his flock down the mountain.

disadvantaged.m: dis(不)+advantage(优势)+d→没有优势的→弱势的；贫困的
disadvantaged.e: The scheme helps disadvantaged children go to university.
disadvantaged.z: 该计划帮助弱势儿童上大学。

punitive.e: Some argue that punitive taxes reduce smoking.
punitive.z: 有人认为惩罚性税收能减少吸烟。

token.m: 同源 teach(指示,显示)→显示意思的标志→象征；代币
token.e: He gave her flowers as a token of thanks.

anecdote.m: an(不)+ec(=ex,出)+dote(给)→未公开发表的事→轶事
anecdote.e: The speaker began with a funny anecdote.
anecdote.z: 演讲者以一个有趣的轶事开场。

frail.m: 同源 fragile(易碎的)→虚弱的；脆弱的
frail.e: My grandfather has become frail with age.
frail.z: 我爷爷随着年纪增长变得虚弱了。

dismissal.m: dis(离开)+miss(送)+al(名词)→送走→解雇；不予考虑
dismissal.e: He took legal action against his unfair dismissal.
dismissal.z: 他对自己被不公正解雇提起了诉讼。

contentious.m: content(=contend,争夺)+ious(…的)→争论的→有争议的
contentious.z: 移民问题依然颇具争议。

trumpet.m: trump(喇叭,古法语trompe)+et(小)→小号；鼓吹
trumpet.e: He plays the trumpet in the school band.

indispensable.m: in(不)+dis(分开)+pens(称量,分配)+able→不能分出去→不可或缺的
indispensable.e: A smartphone has become indispensable for most students.
indispensable.z: 智能手机对大多数学生来说已不可或缺。

revolt.m: re(反)+volt(转)→反转过来→反抗；叛乱
revolt.e: The peasants revolted against heavy taxes.
revolt.z: 农民起来反抗苛捐重税。

pamphlet.m: 源自12世纪拉丁小诗 Pamphilus 的名字+et(小)→小册子
pamphlet.e: Health pamphlets are available at the reception desk.
pamphlet.z: 前台有健康宣传小册子可取。

buckle.m: 源自拉丁 buccula(头盔面颊带,bucca脸颊)→皮带扣；扣上；变形

clearance.m: clear(清除)+ance(名词)→清除；许可；间隙
clearance.e: The shop is having a clearance sale this week.
clearance.z: 这家店本周在清仓大甩卖。

freak.m: 联想：fr+eak谐音“怪客”→怪人；反常的
freak.e: A freak storm destroyed the crops.
freak.z: 一场反常的风暴毁了庄稼。

salute.m: sal(健康,拉丁salus)+ute→祝人健康→行礼；致敬
salute.e: We salute the courage of the firefighters.
salute.z: 我们向消防员的勇气致敬。

oriental.m: ori(升起)+ent+al(…的)→太阳升起处的→东方的
oriental.e: The museum has a fine collection of oriental art.
oriental.z: 博物馆收藏了大量精美的东方艺术品。

swarm.m: 联想：s+warm(温暖)→蜜蜂挤成一团取暖→一大群；蜂拥
swarm.e: A swarm of bees settled on the tree.

blockbuster.m: 复合：block(街区)+buster(摧毁者)→能炸平街区的巨型炸弹→大片
blockbuster.e: The summer blockbuster broke box office records.
blockbuster.z: 这部暑期大片打破了票房纪录。

mitigate.m: mit(=mitis,温和)+ig(使)+ate→使温和→减轻；缓和
mitigate.e: Planting trees can help mitigate climate change.
mitigate.z: 植树有助于缓解气候变化。

unrest.e: Rising food prices led to social unrest.
unrest.z: 食品价格上涨引发了社会动荡。

clasp.m: 联想：c+lasp谐音“拉死”→紧紧抓住→紧握；搭扣
clasp.e: She clasped her hands together nervously.

tow.m: 联想：tow像two(二)→两辆车一辆拖一辆→拖；拖车
tow.e: My car was towed away for illegal parking.
tow.z: 我的车因违章停车被拖走了。

blush.m: 联想：b+lush(茂盛的)→脸上红晕泛开→脸红
blush.e: She blushed when the teacher praised her.
blush.z: 老师表扬她时她脸红了。

grit.m: 联想：grit像great→伟大的人有砂砾般的硬气→砂砾；毅力

fend.m: 由 defend(保卫)截短而来→抵挡；(fend for)照料自己
fend.e: Young birds must soon learn to fend for themselves.
fend.z: 幼鸟很快就得学会自己谋生。

shutter.m: shut(关闭)+t+er(物)→关闭的东西→百叶窗；快门
shutter.e: She closed the shutters to keep out the sun.
shutter.z: 她关上百叶窗挡住阳光。

doubtful.e: It is doubtful whether the plan will work.
doubtful.z: 这个计划能否奏效值得怀疑。

despise.e: She despises people who are cruel to animals.
despise.z: 她鄙视那些虐待动物的人。

dismay.m: dis(去掉)+may(力量,古日耳曼语)→失去力量→沮丧；惊愕
dismay.e: To our dismay, the flight was cancelled.
dismay.z: 令我们沮丧的是，航班被取消了。

outgoing.m: 复合：out(向外)+going(去)→向外走的→外向的；离任的
outgoing.e: She is outgoing and makes friends easily.
outgoing.z: 她性格外向，很容易交朋友。

clone.m: 源自希腊 klon(嫩枝)→插枝繁殖→克隆
clone.e: Scientists cloned a sheep named Dolly in 1996.
clone.z: 科学家于1996年克隆了一只名叫多莉的羊。

refrain.m: re(向后)+frain(=frenare,勒马缰)→往回勒→克制；副歌另源
refrain.e: Please refrain from smoking in the building.

lavish.m: 源自古法语 lavasse(倾盆大雨)→像大雨般倾泻→慷慨的；奢华的
lavish.e: They held a lavish wedding in a castle.
lavish.z: 他们在城堡里举行了一场奢华的婚礼。

ballroom.e: The hotel has a grand ballroom for weddings.
ballroom.z: 酒店有一个举办婚礼的豪华宴会厅。

pilgrim.m: 源自拉丁 peregrinus：per(穿过)+ager(田野)→远行者→朝圣者
pilgrim.e: Thousands of pilgrims visit the temple each year.
pilgrim.z: 每年有成千上万的朝圣者参拜这座寺庙。

curtail.m: 联想：cur+tail(尾巴)→剪掉尾巴→缩减；削减
curtail.e: The government plans to curtail public spending.
curtail.z: 政府计划削减公共开支。

federation.m: feder(联盟,拉丁foedus)+ation(名词)→联邦；联合会
federation.e: Switzerland is a federation of twenty-six cantons.
federation.z: 瑞士是由二十六个州组成的联邦。

hamper.m: 联想：ham(火腿)+per→装满火腿的食篮太重→阻碍；食物篮
hamper.e: Bad weather hampered the search for survivors.
hamper.z: 恶劣天气阻碍了搜寻幸存者的工作。

motto.m: 源自意大利语 motto(话语,拉丁muttum)→格言；座右铭
motto.e: The school's motto is 'Knowledge is power'.
motto.z: 这所学校的校训是“知识就是力量”。

vegetarian.m: veget(=vegetable,蔬菜)+arian(…的人)→吃蔬菜的人→素食者
vegetarian.e: More young people are becoming vegetarians.
vegetarian.z: 越来越多的年轻人成为素食者。

banquet.m: banc(=bench,长凳)+quet(小)→摆长凳的宴席→宴会
banquet.e: A banquet was held in honour of the visiting leaders.
banquet.z: 为来访领导人举行了一场宴会。

phenomenal.e: The film has enjoyed phenomenal success.
phenomenal.z: 这部电影取得了巨大成功。

equilibrium.m: equi(相等)+libr(天平)+ium(名词)→天平两边相等→平衡
equilibrium.e: The ecosystem is in a delicate equilibrium.
equilibrium.z: 这个生态系统处于微妙的平衡之中。

upheaval.m: 复合：up(向上)+heave(举起)+al(名词)→被向上掀起→剧变
upheaval.e: The country went through a period of political upheaval.
upheaval.z: 该国经历了一段政治剧变时期。

lava.m: 源自意大利语 lava(那不勒斯方言:山洪,拉丁lavare冲刷)→熔岩
lava.e: Lava flowed down the side of the volcano.
lava.z: 熔岩顺着火山侧面流下。

bouquet.m: 源自法语 bouquet(小树丛,bois树林)→花束
bouquet.e: He gave his mother a bouquet of roses.

trek.m: 源自荷兰语 trekken(拉,牛车长途迁徙)→长途跋涉
trek.e: We went on a three-day trek through the mountains.
trek.z: 我们在山里进行了为期三天的徒步跋涉。

furnace.m: 源自拉丁 fornax(炉),同forn(炉)→火炉；熔炉
furnace.e: The room felt like a furnace in summer.
furnace.z: 夏天这个房间热得像火炉。

pigment.e: Ancient artists made pigments from minerals.
pigment.z: 古代艺术家用矿物制作颜料。

nuance.m: 源自法语 nuer(给…着色深浅,nue云)→细微的色差→细微差别
nuance.e: Translators must capture every nuance of meaning.
nuance.z: 译者必须把握意义上的每个细微差别。

gadget.m: 联想：gad谐音“噶”+get(得到)→得到个小玩意→小装置
gadget.e: The kitchen is full of useful gadgets.
gadget.z: 厨房里满是实用的小工具。

eradicate.m: e(出)+radic(根)+ate(动词)→连根拔出→根除

augment.e: Many students work part-time to augment their income.
augment.z: 许多学生做兼职来增加收入。

caption.m: capt(拿,抓)+ion(名词)→抓住要点的文字→说明文字；字幕
caption.e: Read the caption under each photo.
caption.z: 读一读每张照片下面的说明文字。

safeguard.m: 复合：safe(安全)+guard(守卫)→保护；保障措施
safeguard.e: New laws safeguard the rights of workers.
safeguard.z: 新法律保障工人的权利。

barber.m: barb(胡须,拉丁barba)+er(人)→剃胡须的人→理发师
barber.e: I go to the barber once a month.

malaria.m: mal(坏)+aria(空气,意大利语)→坏空气(古人以为致病)→疟疾

scant.m: 源自古诺尔斯语 skamt(短的)→不足的；缺乏的
scant.e: He paid scant attention to the safety rules.
scant.z: 他几乎不重视安全规定。

allergic.m: all(=allos,其他)+erg(作用)+ic(…的)→对异物起反应的→过敏的
allergic.e: Many people are allergic to peanuts.

gamble.m: 同源 game(游戏)→拿钱玩游戏→赌博；冒险
gamble.e: Starting a business is always a bit of a gamble.

brisk.m: 联想：b+risk(风险)→冒风险要动作快→轻快的；清新凉爽的
brisk.e: We took a brisk walk along the beach.
brisk.z: 我们沿着海滩快步走了一圈。

bounty.m: bount(=bon,好)+y(名词)→好处→慷慨；赏金；丰富
bounty.e: The farmers celebrated the bounty of the harvest.

cramped.m: cramp(夹紧;抽筋)+ed(…的)→挤得紧紧的→狭窄的
cramped.e: Many students live in cramped rooms near campus.
cramped.z: 许多学生住在校园附近狭小的房间里。

authoritative.m: author(创造者)+ity+ative(…的)→有权威的；官方的
authoritative.e: This dictionary is the most authoritative guide to English.
authoritative.z: 这本词典是最权威的英语指南。

console.m: con(共同)+sol(安慰,拉丁solari)+e→一起安慰→安慰；控制台
console.e: Friends tried to console her after the loss.
console.z: 失去亲人后朋友们试着安慰她。

solemn.m: 源自拉丁 sollemnis(每年举行的宗教仪式)→庄严的；严肃的
solemn.e: The ceremony was a solemn occasion.
solemn.z: 那次仪式是一个庄严的场合。

rainfall.m: 复合：rain(雨)+fall(落下)→降雨；降雨量
rainfall.e: The region has very low annual rainfall.

heave.m: 联想：嘿(he)+ave→喊着「嘿哟」用力举起、抛出
heave.e: They heaved the heavy box onto the truck.
heave.z: 他们把沉重的箱子举上了卡车。

disregard.e: Many drivers disregard the speed limit near schools.
disregard.z: 许多司机无视学校附近的限速。

hound.m: 联想：与德语Hund(狗)同源→猎犬；动词「追逐」
hound.e: The hound followed the fox's scent across the field.
hound.z: 猎犬循着狐狸的气味穿过田野。

proxy.m: 由procuracy缩略：pro(代替)+cur(照管)→代人照管→代理
proxy.e: She voted by proxy because she was abroad.
proxy.z: 她因身在国外而委托他人代为投票。

dread.m: 联想：dr(大人)+read(读)→怕大人读到日记→恐惧
dread.e: Many students dread speaking in front of a large audience.
dread.z: 许多学生害怕在大群观众面前讲话。

livelihood.m: live(生活)+li+hood(状态)→赖以生活的方式→生计
livelihood.e: Fishing is the main livelihood of the coastal villagers.
livelihood.z: 捕鱼是沿海村民的主要生计。

chemist.m: chem(化学，源自alchemy)+ist(人)→化学家/药剂师
chemist.e: You can buy cough medicine at the local chemist.
chemist.z: 你可以在附近的药店买到止咳药。

outnumber.e: In this class, female students outnumber male students.
outnumber.z: 这个班里女生人数多于男生。

paddle.m: 联想：pad(垫子)+dle→像扁平垫子的桨→划桨
paddle.e: We paddled the canoe slowly down the river.
paddle.z: 我们划着独木舟沿河缓缓而下。

deprivation.m: de(去除)+priv(单个、剥夺)+ation(名词)→被夺走→剥夺；贫困
deprivation.e: Sleep deprivation can seriously affect students' performance.
deprivation.z: 睡眠不足会严重影响学生的表现。

inflammation.m: in(使)+flamm(火焰)+ation(名词)→体内起火→炎症
inflammation.e: Ice can help reduce inflammation after an injury.
inflammation.z: 冰敷有助于减轻受伤后的炎症。

clumsy.m: 联想：clum(谐音「笨」)+sy→手脚僵硬→笨拙的
clumsy.e: I'm so clumsy that I broke another cup today.
clumsy.z: 我太笨手笨脚了，今天又打碎了一个杯子。

singular.m: single(单一)+ar(形容词)→单个的→单数；非凡的
singular.z: everyone 后面要用单数动词。

coil.m: 源自拉丁colligere：col(共同)+lig(收集)→收拢绕起→盘绕
coil.e: The snake lay in a tight coil on the rock.
coil.z: 那条蛇紧紧地盘在石头上。

captive.m: capt(抓住)+ive(形容词/人)→被抓住的→俘虏
captive.e: The animals are held captive in small cages.
captive.z: 这些动物被关在小笼子里。

overt.m: 源自古法语ovrir(打开)，与covert(隐蔽的)相对→公开的
overt.e: There was no overt discrimination, but problems remained.
overt.z: 虽然没有明显的歧视，但问题依然存在。

curly.e: She has long curly hair like her mother.
curly.z: 她和妈妈一样有一头长长的卷发。

duplicate.m: du(二)+plic(折叠)+ate→折成两份→复制；副本
duplicate.e: Please keep a duplicate of your application form.
duplicate.z: 请保留一份申请表的副本。

germ.m: 源自拉丁germen(幼芽)→种子；萌芽→细菌
germ.e: Washing your hands helps stop germs from spreading.
germ.z: 洗手有助于阻止细菌传播。

hysterical.m: hyster(子宫，古人以为病因)+ical(形容词)→歇斯底里的
hysterical.e: The fans became hysterical when the singer appeared.
hysterical.z: 歌手一出现，粉丝们就变得歇斯底里。

redeem.e: You can redeem these points for free flights.
redeem.z: 你可以用这些积分兑换免费机票。

chic.m: 联想：谐音「洗刻」→打扮精致、时髦别致
chic.e: The café has a chic, modern interior.
chic.z: 这家咖啡馆的内部装修时尚而现代。

sprawl.m: 联想：spr(spread伸展)+awl→四肢摊开→蔓延；城市无序扩张
sprawl.e: Urban sprawl has destroyed much of the farmland.
sprawl.z: 城市无序扩张毁掉了大片农田。

fellowship.m: fellow(伙伴)+ship(关系)→伙伴关系；研究员职位
fellowship.e: She won a research fellowship at Oxford.
fellowship.z: 她获得了牛津大学的研究员职位。

overflow.e: Heavy rain caused the river to overflow its banks.
overflow.z: 大雨使河水漫过了河岸。

dreadful.m: dread(恐惧)+ful(充满…的)→可怕的；糟糕的
dreadful.e: The traffic in the city centre was dreadful today.
dreadful.z: 今天市中心的交通糟透了。

paramount.m: para(=per,在上)+mount(山)→在山之上→至高的、首要的
paramount.e: Safety is paramount in any laboratory experiment.
paramount.z: 在任何实验室实验中，安全都是最重要的。

sponge.m: 联想：谐音「死胖子」→吸水后鼓胀→海绵
sponge.e: Children's brains absorb languages like a sponge.
sponge.z: 孩子的大脑像海绵一样吸收语言。

carton.e: I bought a carton of milk on the way home.
carton.z: 我回家路上买了一盒牛奶。

opaque.m: 联想：o(圆)+pa(怕)+que→蒙住看不透→不透明的
opaque.e: The bathroom window is made of opaque glass.
opaque.z: 浴室窗户是用不透明玻璃做的。

nausea.e: Some patients experience nausea after the treatment.
nausea.z: 一些病人在治疗后会感到恶心。

menace.m: 源自拉丁minari(突出、威胁)，同eminent里的min→威胁
menace.e: Plastic waste is a growing menace to marine life.
menace.z: 塑料垃圾对海洋生物的威胁日益严重。

numb.m: 联想：num(谐音「麻」)+b→冻得发麻→麻木的
numb.e: My fingers went numb in the freezing wind.
numb.z: 我的手指在刺骨的寒风中冻麻了。

rewarding.m: reward(回报)+ing(形容词)→有回报的→有意义的
rewarding.e: Teaching young children is hard but rewarding.
rewarding.z: 教小孩子很辛苦，但很有意义。

falter.m: 联想：fal(fall跌)+ter→脚步一跌→蹒跚；说话支吾
falter.e: Her voice faltered as she told the sad story.
falter.z: 讲述那个悲伤的故事时，她的声音哽咽了。

fuss.m: 联想：谐音「发丝」→为一根头发丝大惊小怪
fuss.e: Don't make a fuss about such a small mistake.
fuss.z: 别为这么小的错误大惊小怪。

warden.m: ward(看守，同guard)+en(人)→看守人→典狱长
warden.e: The warden locked the hostel doors at midnight.
warden.z: 宿舍管理员午夜锁上了大门。

humiliate.e: He felt humiliated when his mistake was shown to everyone.
humiliate.z: 他的错误被展示给大家时，他感到很丢脸。

multilateral.z: 应对气候变化需要多边合作。

extinct.e: Many species became extinct because of habitat loss.
extinct.z: 许多物种因栖息地丧失而灭绝。

cupboard.m: cup(杯)+board(板)→放杯子的板架→碗柜
cupboard.e: The plates are in the cupboard above the sink.
cupboard.z: 盘子在水槽上方的橱柜里。

impetus.m: im(向内)+pet(追求、冲)+us→向前冲→动力
impetus.e: The new law gave fresh impetus to green energy.
impetus.z: 新法律为绿色能源注入了新的动力。

unilateral.e: The country made a unilateral decision to leave the treaty.
unilateral.z: 该国单方面决定退出条约。

assimilation.m: as(使)+simil(相似)+ation(名词)→使相似→同化；吸收
assimilation.e: Language learning helps the assimilation of immigrants.
assimilation.z: 学习语言有助于移民融入当地。

futile.m: 源自拉丁futilis(漏水的)→容器漏水装不住→徒劳的
futile.e: It is futile to argue with him once he decides.
futile.z: 他一旦决定，再跟他争也是徒劳。

cultivation.e: Rice cultivation needs a lot of water.
cultivation.z: 种植水稻需要大量的水。

bowel.m: 源自拉丁botellus(小香肠)→像香肠的肠子→肠
bowel.e: A high-fibre diet keeps your bowels healthy.
bowel.z: 高纤维饮食能保持肠道健康。

conspicuous.m: con(加强)+spic(看)+uous(形容词)→一眼就看到→显眼的
conspicuous.e: Put the notice in a conspicuous place.
conspicuous.z: 把通知贴在显眼的地方。

invasive.m: in(进入)+vas(走)+ive(形容词)→闯进来的→入侵的
invasive.e: Invasive plants can push out native species.
invasive.z: 入侵植物会挤掉本地物种。

ruthless.m: ruth(怜悯)+less(无)→毫无怜悯→无情的
ruthless.e: The company was ruthless in cutting costs.
ruthless.z: 这家公司在削减成本上毫不留情。

placebo.m: 拉丁语「我将使人满意」，plac(取悦，同please)→安慰剂
placebo.e: Some patients improved after taking only a placebo.
placebo.z: 一些病人只服用了安慰剂病情就好转了。

outlaw.m: out(在外)+law(法律)→法律之外的人→歹徒；宣布非法
outlaw.e: Many cities have outlawed smoking in public places.
outlaw.z: 许多城市已禁止在公共场所吸烟。

cripple.m: 与creep(爬行)同源→只能爬的人→跛子；使瘫痪
cripple.e: The strike crippled the city's transport system.
cripple.z: 罢工使城市交通系统陷入瘫痪。

waver.m: 与wave(摆动)同源，wav+er→来回摇摆→动摇
waver.e: She never wavered in her support for the plan.
waver.z: 她对这个计划的支持从未动摇。

screenplay.e: He wrote the screenplay for the award-winning film.
screenplay.z: 他为那部获奖电影写了剧本。

radius.m: 拉丁语「轮辐、光线」，同radiate→从中心射出的线→半径
radius.e: There are three schools within a two-mile radius.
radius.z: 方圆两英里内有三所学校。

banish.e: The king banished him from the country.

prophecy.e: The prophecy that the city would fall came true.
prophecy.z: 城市将陷落的预言成真了。

assimilate.m: as(使)+simil(相似)+ate(动词)→使相似→同化；吸收
assimilate.e: It takes time to assimilate into a new culture.
assimilate.z: 融入一种新文化需要时间。

bandage.m: band(带子)+age(名词)→包扎的带子→绷带
bandage.e: The nurse wrapped a bandage around his knee.
bandage.z: 护士在他膝盖上缠了绷带。

tangle.m: 联想：tang(谐音「缠」)+gle→缠成一团→纠结
tangle.e: My headphone cables are always in a tangle.
tangle.z: 我的耳机线总是缠成一团。

digest.m: di(分开)+gest(带、运)→分开搬运→消化；文摘
digest.e: It takes hours for the body to digest a big meal.
digest.z: 身体需要几个小时才能消化一顿大餐。

jagged.m: jag(尖突)+ged(形容词)→尖凸不平的→锯齿状的
jagged.e: Be careful of the jagged rocks along the shore.
jagged.z: 小心岸边参差不齐的岩石。

prolong.e: Regular exercise can prolong your life.
prolong.z: 规律运动可以延长寿命。

relinquish.m: re(回)+linqu(离开)+ish(动词)→撒手离开→放弃
relinquish.e: He refused to relinquish control of the company.
relinquish.z: 他拒绝放弃对公司的控制权。

commence.e: The ceremony will commence at ten o'clock.

apprehension.m: ap(向)+prehens(抓住)+ion(名词)→抓住→理解；担忧
apprehension.e: She felt some apprehension before her first exam.
apprehension.z: 第一次考试前她有些忧虑。

predicament.m: pre(前)+dic(说)+ament(名词)→事先断言的处境→困境
predicament.e: Many graduates face the predicament of high rents.
predicament.z: 许多毕业生面临房租高昂的困境。

override.m: over(在上)+ride(骑)→骑在上面→推翻；凌驾
override.e: Safety concerns override all other considerations.
override.z: 安全考虑高于其他一切考量。

notch.m: 联想：not(不)+ch→刻个「不」字→刻痕；等级
notch.e: Her performance went up a notch this term.
notch.z: 她这学期的表现提高了一个档次。

attentive.e: The students were attentive throughout the lecture.
attentive.z: 整堂讲座学生们都很专注。

perish.m: per(完全)+ish(=ire去)→完全离去→死亡；毁灭

vicinity.e: There are several cafés in the vicinity of the campus.
vicinity.z: 校园附近有几家咖啡馆。

anthem.m: 源自antiphon：anti(对)+phon(声音)→对唱的圣歌→赞歌；国歌
anthem.e: Everyone stood up for the national anthem.
anthem.z: 奏国歌时所有人都站了起来。

vanity.e: Buying luxury goods is often a matter of vanity.
vanity.z: 买奢侈品往往出于虚荣心。

limp.m: 联想：lim(谐音「瘸」)+p→一瘸一拐→跛行；软弱的
limp.e: He walked with a limp after the accident.
limp.z: 事故后他走路一瘸一拐的。

traveling.m: travel(旅行)+ing(形容词)→旅行的；流动的
traveling.e: A traveling exhibition will visit our city next month.
traveling.z: 一个巡回展览下个月将来我们城市。

dilute.e: Dilute the juice with water for young children.
dilute.z: 给小孩喝的果汁要用水稀释。

compress.e: You can compress large files before emailing them.
compress.z: 发邮件前你可以先压缩大文件。

mortal.m: mort(死)+al(形容词)→会死的→凡人；致命的

ascend.e: The plane ascended slowly into the clouds.

exempt.m: ex(出)+empt(拿取)→被拿出来→免除的
exempt.e: Students are exempt from paying the entry fee.

ultraviolet.m: ultra(超)+violet(紫色)→超出紫色→紫外线的
ultraviolet.e: Sunscreen protects your skin from ultraviolet rays.
ultraviolet.z: 防晒霜保护皮肤免受紫外线伤害。

twig.m: 联想：tw(two)+ig→分出两叉的小枝→细枝
twig.e: Birds use twigs to build their nests.

pageant.m: 联想：page(页)+ant→一页页展开的历史场景→盛会；选美
pageant.e: The town holds a historical pageant every summer.
pageant.z: 这个小镇每年夏天举办历史游行盛会。

unhealthy.m: un(不)+health(健康)+y(形容词)→不健康的
unhealthy.e: Fast food is often cheap but unhealthy.
unhealthy.z: 快餐通常便宜但不健康。

ensue.e: A heated debate ensued after his speech.
ensue.z: 他讲话后随之而来的是一场激烈辩论。

havoc.m: 联想：谐音「害我克」→大破坏，一片混乱
havoc.e: The storm caused havoc on the roads.
havoc.z: 暴风雨使道路一片混乱。

bilingual.e: Children raised in bilingual families learn both languages naturally.
bilingual.z: 在双语家庭长大的孩子自然学会两种语言。

evade.e: Some companies try to evade paying taxes.

inference.m: in(进)+fer(带)+ence(名词)→带出结论→推论
inference.e: What inference can you draw from the data?
inference.z: 你能从这些数据中得出什么推论？

robber.e: The robber was caught by the police an hour later.
robber.z: 一小时后强盗被警察抓获。

monarchy.m: mon(单一)+archy(统治)→一人统治→君主制
monarchy.z: 英国是君主立宪制国家。

metabolism.m: meta(变化)+bol(抛)+ism(名词)→抛掉旧的换新的→新陈代谢
metabolism.e: Exercise can speed up your metabolism.
metabolism.z: 运动可以加快新陈代谢。

magnify.e: The microscope magnifies objects a thousand times.
magnify.z: 显微镜能将物体放大一千倍。

ascertain.e: Police are trying to ascertain the cause of the fire.
ascertain.z: 警方正在设法查明火灾原因。

auditorium.e: The lecture will be held in the main auditorium.

deflect.m: de(偏离)+flect(弯曲)→弯向一边→使偏斜；转移
deflect.e: He tried to deflect attention from his mistakes.
deflect.z: 他试图转移人们对他错误的注意。

defiance.m: de(去掉)+fi(信任)+ance(名词)→不再信服→蔑视；反抗
defiance.e: They held the protest in defiance of the ban.
defiance.z: 他们不顾禁令举行了抗议。

luminous.e: The clock has luminous hands you can see at night.
luminous.z: 这个钟的指针夜里会发光。

shear.m: 与share、shore同源，意为「切割」→剪羊毛；修剪
shear.e: Farmers shear their sheep in early summer.

amplify.m: ampl(大，同ample)+ify(使)→使变大→放大；增强
amplify.e: Social media can amplify false information.
amplify.z: 社交媒体会放大虚假信息。

lofty.m: loft(阁楼、高处)+y(形容词)→高耸的；崇高的
lofty.e: The project has lofty goals but little funding.
lofty.z: 这个项目目标远大但资金不足。

foyer.m: 法语，源自拉丁focus(炉火)→有火炉的前厅→门厅
foyer.e: Let's meet in the theatre foyer before the show.
foyer.z: 演出前我们在剧院门厅碰面吧。

rot.m: 联想：rot倒过来是tor→东西放倒烂掉→腐烂
rot.e: Fallen leaves rot and enrich the soil.
rot.z: 落叶腐烂后使土壤更肥沃。

fume.m: 源自拉丁fumus(烟)，同perfume→烟；冒烟；发怒
fume.e: Car exhaust fumes pollute the city air.
fume.z: 汽车尾气污染了城市空气。

warranty.e: The laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
warranty.z: 这台笔记本电脑保修两年。

terrestrial.m: terr(土地)+estr+ial(形容词)→陆地的；地球的
terrestrial.e: Most terrestrial animals depend on fresh water.
terrestrial.z: 大多数陆生动物依赖淡水。

perk.m: perquisite缩略：per(完全)+quisit(获得)→额外所得→福利
perk.e: Free lunch is one of the perks of the job.
perk.z: 免费午餐是这份工作的福利之一。

permeate.m: per(穿过)+mea(通过)+te(动词)→穿过→渗透；弥漫
permeate.e: The smell of coffee permeated the whole building.

maritime.e: The city has a long maritime history.
maritime.z: 这座城市有悠久的航海历史。

taxation.e: Higher taxation on sugary drinks may reduce obesity.
taxation.z: 对含糖饮料征更高的税可能减少肥胖。

loophole.m: loop(环；缝)+hole(洞)→墙上的小孔→漏洞
loophole.e: The government closed the tax loophole last year.
loophole.z: 政府去年堵上了税收漏洞。

acquaint.e: New staff need time to acquaint themselves with the system.
acquaint.z: 新员工需要时间熟悉这套系统。

afflict.e: Drought has afflicted the region for years.
afflict.z: 干旱已困扰这个地区多年。

browse.m: 本义「吃嫩叶」，牛羊东啃一口西啃一口→浏览
browse.e: I like to browse in bookshops at the weekend.
browse.z: 我周末喜欢逛书店随便翻翻。

slum.m: 联想：s+lum(谐音「烂」)→破烂的街区→贫民窟
slum.e: Millions of people still live in urban slums.
slum.z: 数百万人仍住在城市贫民窟里。

traverse.e: The road traverses the mountains from east to west.
traverse.z: 这条路由东向西横贯群山。

thermometer.e: The thermometer showed a fever of 39 degrees.

disdain.m: dis(不)+dain(=dign值得)→认为不值得→蔑视
disdain.e: She looked at the cheap souvenirs with disdain.
disdain.z: 她不屑地看着那些廉价纪念品。

vibrate.e: My phone vibrated during the meeting.
vibrate.z: 开会时我的手机振动了。

impart.m: im(进入)+part(部分)→分一部分给→传授
impart.e: Good teachers impart knowledge with enthusiasm.
impart.z: 好老师满怀热情地传授知识。

parachute.m: para(防)+chute(降落，法语)→防坠落→降落伞

trafficking.m: traffic(交易；交通)+king(名词)→非法交易；贩卖
trafficking.e: The police are fighting drug trafficking at the border.
trafficking.z: 警方正在边境打击毒品走私。

amuse.m: a(使)+muse(沉思、发呆)→使发呆着迷→逗乐
amuse.e: The clown amused the children for an hour.
amuse.z: 小丑逗孩子们玩了一个小时。

mileage.e: The used car has very low mileage.

underline.m: under(在下)+line(线)→在下面划线→强调
underline.e: The report underlines the need for more teachers.
underline.z: 报告强调了增加教师的必要性。

quantify.e: It is hard to quantify the benefits of art education.
quantify.z: 艺术教育的益处很难量化。

oust.m: 源自拉丁obstare：ob(反)+st(站)→站着挡住→逐出
oust.e: The president was ousted in a military coup.
oust.z: 总统在军事政变中被赶下台。

partition.m: part(部分)+ition(名词)→分成部分→分割；隔板
partition.e: A glass partition divides the office into two areas.
partition.z: 一面玻璃隔板把办公室分成两个区域。

deterrent.m: de(去)+terr(吓)+ent(名词)→吓走的东西→威慑
deterrent.e: High fines act as a deterrent to littering.
deterrent.z: 高额罚款对乱扔垃圾有威慑作用。

timeless.m: time(时间)+less(无)→不受时间影响→永恒的
timeless.e: Her designs have a timeless elegance.
timeless.z: 她的设计有一种永恒的优雅。

demolish.m: de(向下)+mol(堆、建筑)+ish(动词)→把建筑推倒→拆毁
demolish.e: The old factory will be demolished next year.
demolish.z: 旧工厂将于明年被拆除。

berth.m: 联想：与bear同源，birth形近→船「安家」的泊位；卧铺
berth.e: I booked a lower berth on the night train.

marrow.m: 联想：mar(马)+row→马骨里的髓→骨髓；精华
marrow.e: He donated bone marrow to save a stranger.
marrow.z: 他捐献骨髓救了一个陌生人。

transnational.m: trans(跨越)+nation(国家)+al(形容词)→跨国的
transnational.e: Transnational companies dominate the global market.
transnational.z: 跨国公司主导着全球市场。

stitch.m: 与stick(刺)同源→一针一针刺→缝线；岔气刺痛
stitch.e: The doctor put six stitches in the cut.

voltage.m: volt(伏特，源自物理学家Volta)+age(名词)→电压
voltage.e: Check the voltage before using the charger abroad.
voltage.z: 在国外用充电器前先查一下电压。

grieve.e: The whole town grieved for the victims.

harness.m: 本义「马具」→套上马具驾驭→利用、控制
harness.e: We should harness solar and wind energy.
harness.z: 我们应该利用太阳能和风能。

dissipate.m: dis(分散)+sip(抛)+ate(动词)→四处抛散→驱散；消散
dissipate.z: 到上午十点左右雾就散了。

subordinate.m: sub(下)+ordin(顺序)+ate→排在下面的→从属的；下属
subordinate.e: A good manager listens to subordinates.
subordinate.z: 好的经理会倾听下属意见。

bulge.m: 源自拉丁bulga(皮袋)→袋子鼓起→膨胀；凸出
bulge.z: 他的口袋塞满硬币鼓了起来。

oxide.e: Iron oxide gives the soil its red colour.

quarry.m: 源自拉丁quadrare(使方)→切方石的地方→采石场；猎物
quarry.e: The stone for the cathedral came from a local quarry.
quarry.z: 大教堂的石料来自当地一个采石场。

obscene.m: 联想：ob(反)+scene(场景)→不宜见人的场景→淫秽的
obscene.e: Some think the bankers' bonuses are obscene.
obscene.z: 有些人认为银行家的奖金多得离谱。

combustion.z: 燃料燃烧会释放二氧化碳。

turbulent.m: turb(搅动，同disturb)+ulent(多…的)→翻腾的→动荡的
turbulent.e: The country went through a turbulent period.
turbulent.z: 这个国家经历了一段动荡时期。

holistic.e: Doctors now take a holistic approach to health.
holistic.z: 医生现在采用整体性方法看待健康。

manure.e: Organic farmers use animal manure instead of chemicals.
manure.z: 有机农户用动物粪肥代替化肥。

longitudinal.m: longitud(长度，同long)+inal(形容词)→纵向的；长期的
longitudinal.e: A longitudinal study followed the children for twenty years.
longitudinal.z: 一项纵向研究追踪这些孩子二十年。

aggravate.m: ag(加强)+grav(重)+ate(使)→使更重→使恶化
aggravate.z: 压力会使皮肤问题恶化。

mantle.m: 源自拉丁mantellum(斗篷)→斗篷；覆盖物；地幔
mantle.e: A mantle of snow covered the hills.

flux.e: The job market is in a state of flux.
flux.z: 就业市场处于不断变化中。

gloomy.m: gloom(阴暗)+y(形容词)→阴沉的；忧郁的
gloomy.e: The economic forecast for next year is gloomy.
gloomy.z: 明年的经济预测不容乐观。

disposable.m: dispose(处置)+able(可…的)→可随手处理掉的→一次性的
disposable.e: Cafés are moving away from disposable cups.
disposable.z: 咖啡馆正在弃用一次性杯子。

annoy.m: 源自拉丁in odio(在憎恨中)→使恼怒
annoy.e: Loud music from neighbours annoys me.
annoy.z: 邻居家的吵闹音乐让我很烦。

amidst.e: She stayed calm amidst all the chaos.
amidst.z: 在一片混乱中她保持冷静。

enclosure.m: en(使)+clos(关闭)+ure(名词)→围起来的地方→围场；附件
enclosure.e: The deer are kept in a large enclosure.
enclosure.z: 鹿被养在一大片围场里。

molest.m: mol(重负)+est→给人压负担→骚扰；猥亵
molest.e: The man was arrested for molesting passengers.
molest.z: 那名男子因骚扰乘客被捕。

imprisonment.e: He was sentenced to five years' imprisonment.

indicative.m: indic(指出)+ative(形容词)→指示的；表明的
indicative.e: Rising prices are indicative of a strong economy.
indicative.z: 物价上涨表明经济强劲。

blizzard.e: Flights were cancelled because of the blizzard.
blizzard.z: 由于暴风雪，航班被取消了。

videotape.e: The interview was videotaped for later analysis.
videotape.z: 访谈被录了像以便日后分析。

pertinent.m: per(完全)+tin(=ten握住)+ent→紧扣着→相关的；中肯的
pertinent.e: Please ask questions pertinent to the topic.
pertinent.z: 请提出与主题相关的问题。

presumption.m: pre(预先)+sumpt(拿)+ion(名词)→预先拿定→假定；放肆
presumption.e: There is a presumption of innocence until proven guilty.
presumption.z: 在被证明有罪之前推定无罪。

endow.e: She endowed the university with a large scholarship fund.
endow.z: 她向大学捐赠了一大笔奖学金基金。

anyhow.e: It was raining, but we went out anyhow.
anyhow.z: 下着雨，但我们还是出门了。

vice.m: 拉丁vitium(缺陷)→恶习；副(vice-前缀另源于「代替」)
vice.z: 抽烟是他唯一的坏习惯。

racket.m: 联想：rack(架子)+et→带网架的拍→球拍；吵闹声
racket.e: I need a new tennis racket.

vocation.m: voc(喊)+ation(名词)→被召唤去做的事→天职；职业
vocation.e: She believes nursing is her true vocation.
vocation.z: 她认为护理是她真正的天职。

logistics.m: 源自法语loger(安置、住宿)+istics(学)→后勤；物流
logistics.e: Online shopping depends on efficient logistics.

witty.m: wit(机智)+ty(形容词)→机智风趣的
witty.e: He gave a witty speech at the wedding.
witty.z: 他在婚礼上做了一番风趣的讲话。

stale.m: 联想：st(stay)+ale(啤酒)→啤酒放久了→不新鲜的

equitable.e: We need a more equitable distribution of wealth.
equitable.z: 我们需要更公平的财富分配。

fret.m: 本义「吃掉」(同德语fressen)→心被啃噬→烦躁；磨损
fret.e: Don't fret about the exam; you've prepared well.
fret.z: 别为考试发愁，你准备得很好。

errand.m: 联想：err(走错)+and→跑腿时别走错→差事
errand.e: I have to run a few errands this afternoon.
errand.z: 今天下午我得去办几件杂事。

lapse.e: A brief lapse in concentration caused the accident.

psychiatry.m: psych(心灵)+iatry(治疗)→治心病→精神病学
psychiatry.e: She plans to specialise in child psychiatry.
psychiatry.z: 她打算专攻儿童精神病学。

judiciary.e: An independent judiciary is essential to democracy.
judiciary.z: 独立的司法机构对民主至关重要。

chromosome.m: chromo(颜色)+some(体)→易被染色的物体→染色体

traitor.m: trait(=tradit交出)+or(人)→把国家交出去的人→叛徒
traitor.e: He was called a traitor for leaking the secrets.
traitor.z: 他因泄露机密被称为叛徒。

traction.e: The idea is gaining traction among young voters.
traction.z: 这一想法在年轻选民中越来越受欢迎。

lame.m: 联想：lam(谐音「烂」)+e→腿烂了→跛的；站不住脚的
lame.e: That's a lame excuse for being late.
lame.z: 那是个站不住脚的迟到借口。

paralysis.m: para(旁)+lysis(松开)→身体一侧松垮→瘫痪；停顿
paralysis.e: The strike caused total paralysis of public transport.
paralysis.z: 罢工导致公共交通完全瘫痪。

tempo.m: 意大利语，源自拉丁tempus(时间)→节奏；速度
tempo.e: The tempo of city life is much faster.
tempo.z: 城市生活的节奏快得多。

acquit.m: ac(向)+quit(释放，同quiet)→放走→宣判无罪
acquit.e: The jury acquitted him of all charges.
acquit.z: 陪审团宣判他所有指控均不成立。

wane.m: 联想：w+ane→月亮由圆变「弯」→减弱；衰落
wane.e: Interest in the show began to wane.
wane.z: 人们对这个节目的兴趣开始减退。

savage.m: 源自拉丁silvaticus：silv(森林)→森林里的→野蛮的
savage.z: 这部电影受到猛烈批评。

willow.m: 联想：will(愿意)+low(低)→枝条甘愿低垂→柳树
willow.e: Willows grow along the river bank.

stakeholder.m: stake(赌注；利益)+holder(持有者)→利益相关者
stakeholder.e: All stakeholders were invited to discuss the plan.
stakeholder.z: 所有利益相关方都被邀请讨论该计划。

aboriginal.m: ab(从)+origin(起源)+al(形容词)→从起源就在的→土著的
aboriginal.e: Aboriginal art has a history of thousands of years.
aboriginal.z: 土著艺术有数千年的历史。

watchdog.m: watch(看守)+dog(狗)→看门狗→监督机构
watchdog.e: A consumer watchdog investigated the bank.
watchdog.z: 一个消费者监督机构调查了这家银行。

stationary.m: sta(站)+tion+ary(形容词)→站着不动的→静止的
stationary.e: The car was stationary when the bus hit it.
stationary.z: 公交车撞上时那辆车是静止的。

rectangle.e: Draw a rectangle and divide it into four parts.
rectangle.z: 画一个长方形并把它分成四份。

periphery.m: peri(周围)+pher(带，运)+y→绕周围运→外围
periphery.e: New housing is built on the periphery of the city.

statesman.m: state(国家)+s+man(人)→治国之人→政治家
statesman.e: He was remembered as a great statesman.
statesman.z: 人们记得他是一位伟大的政治家。

zest.m: 本义「柠檬皮」，提味增香→热情；兴趣
zest.e: She has a real zest for life.

invaluable.m: in(不能)+valu(估价)+able(可)→无法估价→无价的
invaluable.e: Your advice has been invaluable to me.
invaluable.z: 你的建议对我来说非常宝贵。

translucent.m: trans(穿过)+luc(光)+ent(形容词)→光可穿过→半透明的
translucent.e: The lamp has a translucent paper shade.
translucent.z: 这盏灯有一个半透明的纸灯罩。

precarious.m: prec(祈求，同pray)+arious→全靠祈求→不稳定的
precarious.e: Many young people have precarious jobs.
precarious.z: 许多年轻人的工作很不稳定。

mosaic.m: 源自希腊Mousa(缪斯)→献给缪斯的艺术→马赛克
mosaic.e: The floor is decorated with Roman mosaics.
mosaic.z: 地板用罗马马赛克装饰。

avalanche.m: 法语，与lavanche(滑落)相关→雪崩；大量涌来
avalanche.e: We received an avalanche of emails after the ad.
avalanche.z: 广告发布后我们收到了大量邮件。

numerical.e: The files are arranged in numerical order.

coupon.m: 源自法语couper(切)→剪下的票券→优惠券
coupon.e: Use this coupon to get 20% off.
coupon.z: 用这张优惠券可以打八折。

ramification.m: ram(枝)+ification(化)→分出枝杈→衍生后果
ramification.e: The decision will have serious ramifications.
ramification.z: 这一决定将带来严重的后果。

sluggish.m: slug(鼻涕虫)+gish(像…的)→像鼻涕虫一样慢→迟缓的
sluggish.e: The economy remained sluggish last year.

grope.e: She groped for the light switch in the dark.
grope.z: 她在黑暗中摸索电灯开关。

microbe.m: micro(微小)+be(=bio生命)→微小生命→微生物
microbe.e: Soil is full of useful microbes.
microbe.z: 土壤里充满了有益的微生物。

serene.m: 源自拉丁serenus(晴朗无云)→晴朗→宁静安详的
serene.e: The lake looked serene in the morning light.
serene.z: 晨光中的湖面显得宁静安详。

notation.m: not(标记，同note)+ation(名词)→记号；符号系统
notation.e: Musicians must learn to read musical notation.
notation.z: 音乐家必须学会识读乐谱。

sanitation.z: 卫生条件差会传播疾病。

gust.m: 与古诺尔斯语gustr(风)同源→一阵狂风；（情感）迸发
gust.e: A gust of wind blew my umbrella away.
gust.z: 一阵风把我的伞吹走了。

stern.m: 联想：st(stone石头)+ern→石头般的脸→严厉的；船尾另义
stern.e: The teacher gave him a stern warning.
stern.z: 老师给了他严厉的警告。

vain.m: 源自拉丁vanus(空的)→空的→徒劳的；自负的
vain.e: They tried in vain to save the old tree.
vain.z: 他们想保住那棵老树，却徒劳无功。

excavate.m: ex(出)+cav(洞，同cave)+ate(动词)→挖出洞→发掘
excavate.e: Archaeologists excavated an ancient village here.
excavate.z: 考古学家在这里发掘了一个古村落。

metric.m: metr(测量，同meter)+ic(形容词)→米制的；公制的
metric.e: Most countries use the metric system.

crocodile.m: 希腊语kroke(卵石)+drilos(虫)→卵石上的爬虫→鳄鱼
crocodile.e: Crocodiles can stay underwater for an hour.
crocodile.z: 鳄鱼能在水下待一个小时。

symmetry.m: sym(相同)+metr(测量)+y(名词)→量起来相同→对称
symmetry.e: The building is admired for its perfect symmetry.
symmetry.z: 这座建筑因完美的对称而受到赞赏。

decipher.m: de(解除)+cipher(密码)→解开密码→破译
decipher.e: I couldn't decipher the doctor's handwriting.

deplete.m: de(去掉)+plet(满，同complete)+e→去掉满的→耗尽
deplete.z: 过度捕捞已使鱼类资源枯竭。

perverse.m: per(完全)+vers(转)+e→完全转向反面→故意作对的
perverse.e: He takes a perverse pleasure in arguing.
perverse.z: 他以抬杠为乐，真是乖张。

proficiency.m: pro(向前)+fic(做)+iency(名词)→做得超前→熟练
proficiency.e: An IELTS score shows your English proficiency.
proficiency.z: 雅思成绩证明你的英语熟练程度。

patriarchal.m: patri(父)+arch(统治)+al(形容词)→父亲统治的→父权制的
patriarchal.e: Traditional patriarchal values are slowly changing.
patriarchal.z: 传统的父权观念正在慢慢改变。

gleam.m: gl-开头多与「光」有关(glow,glitter)→微光；闪烁
gleam.e: A gleam of light came from under the door.
gleam.z: 一丝光从门底下透出来。

brittle.m: 与古英语breotan(打碎)同源→易碎的；脆弱的

adept.e: She is adept at solving problems quickly.

thrift.m: thrive(兴旺)的名词→靠省才兴旺→节俭
thrift.e: Thrift shops sell second-hand clothes cheaply.
thrift.z: 旧货店廉价出售二手衣服。

necessitate.e: The new rules will necessitate more staff training.
necessitate.z: 新规定将需要更多员工培训。

precipitate.m: pre(前)+cipit(头)+ate→头朝前栽→促成；沉淀物
precipitate.e: The crisis precipitated a fall in house prices.
precipitate.z: 这场危机促使房价下跌。

subsistence.m: sub(下)+sist(站)+ence(名词)→在底层站住→勉强维生
subsistence.e: Many farmers there live at subsistence level.
subsistence.z: 那里许多农民只能勉强维生。

subtract.e: Subtract the costs from the total income.

nourish.e: Good food nourishes both body and mind.

scold.m: 联想：s+cold(冷)→冷着脸训人→责骂
scold.e: Her mother scolded her for coming home late.

upbringing.m: up(向上)+bring(带)+ing(名词)→把孩子带大→养育
upbringing.e: A strict upbringing shaped his character.
upbringing.z: 严格的家教塑造了他的性格。

conglomerate.m: con(一起)+glomer(球、团)+ate→聚成一团→企业集团
conglomerate.e: The company was bought by a media conglomerate.
conglomerate.z: 这家公司被一家传媒集团收购。

rust.m: 与red(红)同源→红色的锈→生锈
rust.e: The old bike was covered in rust.
rust.z: 那辆旧自行车锈迹斑斑。

insulate.m: insul(岛，同isle)+ate(使)→使成孤岛→隔离；绝缘
insulate.e: Insulate your roof to save heating costs.
insulate.z: 给屋顶做隔热以节省取暖费。

bailout.m: bail(舀出水)+out(出)→把船里的水舀出→紧急救助
bailout.e: The government approved a bailout for the airline.
bailout.z: 政府批准了对这家航空公司的紧急救助。

hacker.e: Hackers stole the personal data of millions.
hacker.z: 黑客窃取了数百万人的个人数据。

anthology.m: anth(花)+ology(集)→采集诗文之花→选集
anthology.e: This anthology contains poems from ten countries.
anthology.z: 这本选集收录了十个国家的诗歌。

vacancy.e: The hotel has no vacancies this weekend.
vacancy.z: 这家酒店本周末没有空房。

audition.e: She has an audition for the school play tomorrow.
audition.z: 她明天要参加校剧试镜。

receptionist.e: Ask the receptionist for your room key.
receptionist.z: 向前台接待员要房间钥匙。

projector.m: pro(向前)+ject(投)+or(物)→向前投射的东西→投影仪
projector.e: The projector in Room 3 isn't working.

prehistoric.e: Prehistoric cave paintings were found here.
prehistoric.z: 这里发现了史前洞穴壁画。

eloquent.m: e(出)+loqu(说)+ent(形容词)→说出来很动听→雄辩的
eloquent.e: She gave an eloquent speech about education.
eloquent.z: 她就教育发表了一篇雄辩的演讲。

ascent.e: The ascent to the summit took six hours.

quaint.m: 源自拉丁cognitus(已知的)，古义「精巧」→古色古香的
quaint.e: We stayed in a quaint village by the sea.
quaint.z: 我们住在海边一个古色古香的小村庄。

oasis.m: 源自古埃及语→沙漠绿洲；舒适之地
oasis.e: The park is an oasis of calm in the busy city.
oasis.z: 这个公园是喧嚣城市中的一片宁静绿洲。

aquarium.m: aqua(水)+rium(场所)→放水生物的地方→水族馆
aquarium.e: The children loved the sharks at the aquarium.
aquarium.z: 孩子们很喜欢水族馆里的鲨鱼。

misfortune.e: He had the misfortune to lose his job twice.

monstrous.m: monster(怪物)+ous(形容词)→怪物般的→巨大的；骇人的
monstrous.e: A monstrous wave hit the small boat.

ore.m: 联想：o(圆石)+re→从石头里提炼金属→矿石
ore.e: Australia exports large amounts of iron ore.
ore.z: 澳大利亚出口大量铁矿石。

monologue.e: The play opens with a long monologue.
monologue.z: 该剧以一段长长的独白开场。

feud.m: 联想：谐音「废的」→两家闹翻关系废了→世仇；不和
feud.e: The two families have had a feud for decades.

audible.e: Her voice was barely audible over the music.
audible.z: 音乐声中她的声音几乎听不见。

fuse.m: fus(熔化、倾泻，同confuse)+e→熔合；保险丝
fuse.e: The lights went out because a fuse blew.
fuse.z: 保险丝烧断了，灯全灭了。

fabricate.m: fabric(织物、结构)+ate(动词)→制造；捏造
fabricate.e: The journalist was fired for fabricating stories.
fabricate.z: 那名记者因捏造报道被解雇。

sow.m: 联想：s+ow→播种后种子发芽「哦」；另义母猪

getaway.m: get(离开)+away(远离)→逃离；短期度假
getaway.e: The island is a perfect weekend getaway.
getaway.z: 这个岛是绝佳的周末度假地。

complexion.m: com(一起)+plex(编织)+ion→体液交织的状态→肤色；局面
complexion.e: Fresh air gave her a healthy complexion.
complexion.z: 新鲜空气让她气色很好。

wrench.e: He used a wrench to loosen the bolt.

collateral.m: col(共同)+later(边)+al→在旁边的→附带的；抵押品
collateral.e: He used his house as collateral for the loan.
collateral.z: 他用房子作为贷款抵押。

stoop.m: 联想：st(stand站)+oop(oops)→站不直弯腰→弯腰；屈尊
stoop.e: She stooped to pick up the coin.

ecstatic.m: ec(=ex出)+stat(站)+ic→站出自我之外→狂喜的
ecstatic.e: The fans were ecstatic after the victory.

paramedic.m: para(辅助)+medic(医生)→辅助医务人员→急救员
paramedic.e: Paramedics arrived within minutes of the crash.
paramedic.z: 事故发生几分钟内急救员就赶到了。

hardy.m: hard(坚硬)+y(形容词)→吃得了苦的→耐寒的；强壮的
hardy.e: These hardy plants survive the cold winter.
hardy.z: 这些耐寒植物能熬过寒冬。

notwithstanding.m: not(不)+with(对着)+standing(站)→不构成阻挡→尽管
notwithstanding.e: Notwithstanding the rain, the event was a success.
notwithstanding.z: 尽管下雨，活动还是很成功。

rover.m: rove(漫游)+er(物)→漫游者→行星探测车
rover.e: The Mars rover sent back new photos.

internship.e: She did a summer internship at a law firm.
internship.z: 她在一家律所做了暑期实习。

extravagant.m: extra(超出)+vag(漫游)+ant→游荡出界→奢侈的
extravagant.e: It was extravagant to spend so much on a dress.
extravagant.z: 在一条裙子上花这么多钱太奢侈了。

interrogate.m: inter(在…之间)+rog(问)+ate(动词)→反复盘问→审讯
interrogate.e: The police interrogated the suspect for hours.

detach.m: de(分开)+tach(钉住，同attach)→取下钉子→分离
detach.e: Detach the form and return it by post.
detach.z: 把表格撕下来邮寄回来。

brew.m: 与broth(肉汤)同源→熬煮→酿造；酝酿
brew.e: This café brews its own beer.

adrenaline.m: ad(附近)+ren(肾)+al+ine(素)→肾旁腺的激素→肾上腺素
adrenaline.e: Skydiving gives you a rush of adrenaline.
adrenaline.z: 跳伞让你肾上腺素飙升。

mediocre.m: medi(中间)+ocre(山)→爬到半山腰→平庸的
mediocre.e: The food was expensive but mediocre.

sparse.m: 源自拉丁sparsus(撒开)，同disperse→稀疏的
sparse.e: Vegetation is sparse in the desert.

rendition.m: rend(=render给予、表现)+ition(名词)→演绎；演奏
rendition.e: She gave a moving rendition of the song.

yen.m: 日元源自日语「円」；渴望义源自粤语「瘾」→渴望
yen.e: I have a yen to travel around Japan.
yen.z: 我渴望去日本各地旅行。

encyclopedia.m: en(在内)+cyclo(圆、全)+pedia(教育)→全面教育→百科全书
encyclopedia.e: Wikipedia is a free online encyclopedia.
encyclopedia.z: 维基百科是免费的在线百科全书。

remorse.e: He showed no remorse for his crime.
remorse.z: 他对自己的罪行毫无悔意。

progressively.m: progress(前进)+ive+ly(副词)→一步步向前→逐步地

scroll.m: 联想：s+croll(roll卷)→卷起来的纸→卷轴；滚动
scroll.e: Scroll down to see more photos.
scroll.z: 向下滚动查看更多照片。

cot.m: 源自印地语khat(床)→小床；行军床
cot.e: The hotel provided a cot for our baby.
cot.z: 酒店为我们的宝宝提供了一张婴儿床。

tedious.m: tedi(厌倦，同tedium)+ous(形容词)→冗长乏味的
tedious.e: Data entry is a tedious job.
tedious.z: 数据录入是一项乏味的工作。

nostalgic.m: nost(回家)+alg(痛)+ic(形容词)→想家的痛→怀旧的
nostalgic.e: Old songs make me feel nostalgic.

parody.m: par(=para旁)+ody(=ode歌)→在旁边唱的歌→戏仿
parody.e: The show is a parody of reality TV.
parody.z: 这档节目是对真人秀的戏仿。

fleeting.m: fleet(飞逝)+ing(形容词)→转瞬即逝的
fleeting.e: I caught a fleeting glimpse of the singer.
fleeting.z: 我匆匆瞥见了那位歌手一眼。

paranoia.m: para(偏离)+noia(=noos心智)→心智偏离→偏执；多疑
paranoia.e: Constant news alerts can create paranoia.
paranoia.z: 不断的新闻推送会让人疑神疑鬼。

reptile.m: rept(爬)+ile(物)→爬行的东西→爬行动物

majestic.m: majest(y)(威严，同major大)+ic(形容词)→雄伟的
majestic.z: 我们欣赏着雄伟的群山。

commend.m: com(加强)+mend(=mand委托)→郑重托付→称赞；推荐
commend.e: The firefighters were commended for their bravery.
commend.z: 消防员因英勇受到表彰。

dynasty.m: dyna(力量，同dynamic)+sty→掌权的家族→王朝
dynasty.e: The Tang dynasty was a golden age of poetry.
dynasty.z: 唐朝是诗歌的黄金时代。

burglary.e: Burglary rates fall when streets are well lit.
burglary.z: 街道照明良好时入室盗窃率会下降。

disco.m: discotheque缩写：disc(唱片)+theque(库)→舞厅；迪斯科
disco.e: They went to a disco on Saturday night.
disco.z: 他们周六晚上去了迪厅。

resilience.m: re(回)+sili(跳)+ence(名词)→弹回来→韧性；恢复力
resilience.z: 运动帮助孩子培养韧性。

bewildered.e: He looked bewildered by the new ticket machine.
bewildered.z: 他对新售票机一脸茫然。

captivity.z: 大熊猫在圈养条件下很少繁殖。

steward.m: 古英语sty(猪圈、厅)+ward(看守)→管家；乘务员
steward.e: We should be good stewards of the environment.
steward.z: 我们应当好好守护环境。

sparkle.m: spark(火花)+le(反复)→不断冒火花→闪耀

edible.e: Some wild mushrooms are not edible.

booklet.e: Read the information booklet before the course.
booklet.z: 课程开始前请阅读信息手册。

bumper.m: bump(撞)+er(物)→挡撞的东西→保险杠；丰盛的
bumper.e: Farmers expect a bumper harvest this year.
bumper.z: 农民们预计今年大丰收。

skyscraper.m: sky(天空)+scrape(刮)+er(物)→刮到天的楼→摩天大楼
skyscraper.e: Dubai is famous for its skyscrapers.

expend.m: ex(出)+pend(称量、付钱)→付出去→花费
expend.e: Don't expend too much energy on small details.
expend.z: 别在小细节上耗费太多精力。

outpatient.m: out(外)+patient(病人)→不住院的病人→门诊病人
outpatient.e: The surgery is done on an outpatient basis.
outpatient.z: 这项手术在门诊进行，无需住院。

resilient.m: re(回)+sili(跳)+ent(形容词)→能弹回的→有韧性的
resilient.e: Children are often more resilient than adults think.
resilient.z: 孩子往往比大人想的更坚强。

erratic.m: err(游荡、出错)+atic(形容词)→乱游的→不稳定的
erratic.e: His sleep pattern became erratic during exams.
erratic.z: 考试期间他的作息变得不规律。

reciprocal.m: 源自拉丁reciprocus：re(向后)+pro(向前)→来回的→相互的
reciprocal.e: The two universities have a reciprocal exchange program.
reciprocal.z: 两所大学有互惠交换项目。

hilarious.m: hilar(欢乐，希腊hilaros)+ious(形容词)→极其滑稽的

dispel.e: The report helped dispel fears about the vaccine.
dispel.z: 报告帮助消除了人们对疫苗的担忧。

yawn.m: 拟声：嘴张大发出「哟嗯」声→打哈欠
yawn.e: He yawned through the long meeting.
yawn.z: 冗长的会议上他哈欠连连。

emigrate.m: e(出)+migr(迁移)+ate(动词)→迁出→移居国外
emigrate.e: Her family emigrated to Canada in 2010.

bribe.m: 联想：bri(bring带来)+be→带东西来求人→贿赂
bribe.e: The official was jailed for accepting bribes.

climax.m: 希腊语klimax(梯子)→爬到梯顶→高潮
climax.e: The climax of the film is a car chase.
climax.z: 影片的高潮是一场飞车追逐。

ambivalent.m: ambi(两边)+val(价值、强)+ent→两边都有力→矛盾的
ambivalent.e: Many people feel ambivalent about social media.
ambivalent.z: 许多人对社交媒体抱有矛盾心态。

obstruct.m: ob(反)+struct(建造)→建东西挡住→阻碍
obstruct.e: Parked cars obstructed the fire engine.
obstruct.z: 停着的汽车阻碍了消防车通行。

generalize.m: general(一般的)+ize(使)→使一般化→概括
generalize.e: It's unfair to generalize about all teenagers.
generalize.z: 把所有青少年一概而论是不公平的。

bungalow.m: 源自印地语bangla(孟加拉式的房子)→平房
bungalow.e: They retired to a bungalow by the sea.
bungalow.z: 他们退休后住进了海边的平房。

dialect.m: dia(穿过、之间)+lect(说)→地方间说的话→方言
dialect.e: My grandparents speak a local dialect.

arid.e: Few crops grow in arid regions.
arid.z: 干旱地区种不了什么庄稼。

unreliable.e: The bus service here is very unreliable.
unreliable.z: 这里的公交服务很不靠谱。

dwindle.m: dwine(衰弱)+le(反复)→越来越弱→逐渐减少
dwindle.e: The number of bees is dwindling.
dwindle.z: 蜜蜂的数量在逐渐减少。

rejoice.e: The whole city rejoiced at the news.
rejoice.z: 全城都为这个消息欢欣鼓舞。

propulsion.m: pro(向前)+puls(推)+ion(名词)→向前推→推进力

informative.m: inform(告知)+ative(形容词)→提供信息的
informative.e: The museum tour was very informative.
informative.z: 博物馆导览内容很丰富。

nominal.m: nomin(名字)+al(形容词)→名义上的；象征性的
nominal.e: Students pay only a nominal fee.
nominal.z: 学生只需支付象征性的费用。

cohesion.m: co(共同)+hes(粘)+ion(名词)→粘在一起→凝聚力；衔接
cohesion.z: 好文章需要逻辑上的衔接。

funnel.m: 源自拉丁infundibulum：fund(倒)→倒液体用的→漏斗
funnel.e: Use a funnel to pour the oil into the bottle.

fanatic.m: fan(神庙)+atic→被神灵附体的→狂热者

repercussion.m: re(回)+per(穿)+cuss(敲击)+ion→敲击后反弹→反响；后果
repercussion.e: The scandal had repercussions for the whole party.
repercussion.z: 这起丑闻波及整个政党。

thirst.m: 与古英语thurst(干)同源→口渴；渴望
thirst.e: He has a thirst for knowledge.

dweller.e: City dwellers often lack green space.
dweller.z: 城市居民常常缺少绿地。

tame.m: 联想：ta(他)+me(我)→他被我驯服了→驯服的
tame.e: The deer in the park are quite tame.

hygiene.m: 源自希腊健康女神Hygieia→卫生
hygiene.z: 良好的卫生习惯可预防许多疾病。

detrimental.e: Too much screen time is detrimental to sleep.
detrimental.z: 屏幕使用时间过长不利于睡眠。

valuation.z: 该公司的估值翻了一倍。

jolt.m: 联想：j+olt(谐音「哦」)→车一颠「哦」一声→颠簸；震惊
jolt.e: The bus stopped with a jolt.
jolt.z: 公交车猛地一颠停下了。

ardent.m: ard(燃烧，同ardor)+ent(形容词)→燃烧的→热情的
ardent.e: She is an ardent supporter of animal rights.
ardent.z: 她是动物权利的热心支持者。

righteous.m: right(正确)+eous(形容词)→正直的；正义的
righteous.e: He was filled with righteous anger.

provisional.m: pro(提前)+vis(看)+ion+al→提前看好的→临时的
provisional.e: The dates are provisional and may change.
provisional.z: 日期是暂定的，可能会变。

refund.e: You can get a full refund within 30 days.

ascribe.m: a(=ad向)+scribe(写)→写到某人名下→归因于
ascribe.e: He ascribed his success to hard work.

rouse.m: 联想：r+ouse(谐音「哦！醒」)→唤醒；激起
rouse.e: The speech roused the crowd to action.
rouse.z: 这番演讲激起了群众行动。

smother.m: s+mother(妈妈)→妈妈抱得太紧→使窒息；过度溺爱
smother.e: Don't smother your children with too much attention.
smother.z: 别过度关注让孩子透不过气。

eject.e: Press the button to eject the disc.

tsunami.m: 日语「津波」：津(港口)+波(浪)→冲进港口的浪→海啸
tsunami.e: The tsunami destroyed many coastal towns.
tsunami.z: 海啸摧毁了许多沿海城镇。

quirky.m: quirk(怪癖)+y(形容词)→古怪有趣的
quirky.e: The café has a quirky, artistic style.
quirky.z: 这家咖啡馆风格古怪又文艺。

stipulate.m: 联想：sti(stick坚持)+pul(拉)+ate→死死拉住条款不放→规定
stipulate.e: The contract stipulates a one-month notice period.
stipulate.z: 合同规定须提前一个月通知。

intrusive.m: in(进)+trus(推、挤)+ive(形容词)→硬挤进来的→侵扰的
intrusive.e: Some online ads are very intrusive.
intrusive.z: 一些网络广告非常扰人。

overdue.m: over(超过)+due(到期的)→过期的；迟到的
overdue.e: My library books are two weeks overdue.
overdue.z: 我借的图书馆的书已经过期两周了。

prolific.m: proli(后代，同proletariat)+fic(做)→生很多→多产的

shabby.m: shab(=scab疥癣)+by→满是疤痕的→破旧的
shabby.e: He wore a shabby old coat.
shabby.z: 他穿着一件破旧的外套。

censor.e: The government censors news on social media.
censor.z: 政府审查社交媒体上的新闻。

overhaul.m: over(全面)+haul(拖拉)→全部拖出来检查→彻底检修
overhaul.e: The education system needs a complete overhaul.
overhaul.z: 教育体系需要彻底改革。

conducive.m: con(共同)+duc(引导)+ive(形容词)→引向好结果→有助于
conducive.e: A quiet room is conducive to studying.
conducive.z: 安静的房间有助于学习。

disable.m: dis(使失去)+able(能力)→使丧失能力；禁用
disable.e: You can disable notifications in settings.
disable.z: 你可以在设置里关闭通知。

ludicrous.m: lud(玩，同prelude)+icrous→像玩笑的→荒唐可笑的
ludicrous.e: It's ludicrous to charge so much for water.

throng.m: 与throng(挤压)同源→挤成一团的人→人群；蜂拥
throng.z: 游客挤满了狭窄的街道。

optimum.e: The optimum temperature for this plant is 20°C.
optimum.z: 这种植物的最适温度是20摄氏度。

sanity.m: san(健康的，同sane)+ity(名词)→神志健全
sanity.e: Taking breaks helps keep my sanity during exams.
sanity.z: 考试期间休息一下能让我保持清醒。

renaissance.e: The city is enjoying a cultural renaissance.
renaissance.z: 这座城市正在经历文化复兴。

shrewd.m: 联想：shrew(泼妇、鼩鼱)+d→精得像鼩鼱→精明的
shrewd.z: 她是一位精明的女商人。

magistrate.m: magistr(主人，同master)+ate→掌事者→地方法官
magistrate.e: He appeared before the magistrate on Monday.
magistrate.z: 他周一出庭接受地方法官审理。

burglar.m: 联想：burg(城镇)+lar→夜入城中民宅的贼→窃贼
burglar.e: A burglar broke in while we were away.
burglar.z: 我们不在家时有个窃贼闯了进来。

locality.m: local(当地的)+ity(名词)→地区；所在地

truce.m: 与true(忠实、信约)同源→守信的约定→休战
truce.e: The two sides agreed to a truce.

prerequisite.e: A degree is a prerequisite for this job.
prerequisite.z: 学位是这份工作的先决条件。

refute.e: Scientists refuted the claim with new data.
refute.z: 科学家用新数据驳斥了这一说法。

meticulous.m: metic(=metus害怕)+ulous→怕出错的→一丝不苟的
meticulous.e: She keeps meticulous notes in every class.
meticulous.z: 她每节课都做一丝不苟的笔记。

eminent.m: e(出)+min(突出)+ent(形容词)→突出的→杰出的
eminent.e: An eminent scientist gave the opening speech.
eminent.z: 一位杰出科学家做了开幕演讲。

pastime.m: pass(度过)+time(时间)→消磨时间的事→消遣
pastime.z: 阅读是我最喜欢的消遣。

submerge.e: The flood submerged the whole village.

saturate.m: satur(满，同satisfy)+ate(使)→使饱满→浸透；饱和
saturate.e: The market is saturated with smartphones.
saturate.z: 智能手机市场已经饱和。

thorn.m: 联想：th+orn(谐音「哦」)→被刺扎得「哦」一声→刺

discreet.m: dis(分开)+creet(=cern辨别)→能分辨轻重→谨慎的
discreet.e: Please be discreet about her illness.
discreet.z: 关于她的病请谨慎保密。

bookshelf.e: The bookshelf is full of travel guides.
bookshelf.z: 书架上摆满了旅游指南。

methane.e: Cows produce large amounts of methane.

dementia.m: de(离开)+ment(心智)+ia(病)→心智离开→痴呆症
dementia.e: Dementia affects millions of older people.
dementia.z: 痴呆症影响着数百万老人。

homogeneous.m: homo(相同)+gene(种类)+ous(形容词)→同类的→同质的
homogeneous.e: The village is a fairly homogeneous community.
homogeneous.z: 这个村子是个相当同质化的社区。

blackout.e: The storm caused a blackout across the city.

ferocious.m: fer(=ferus野的)+ocious(形容词)→野性的→凶猛的
ferocious.e: The tiger let out a ferocious roar.

rehabilitate.m: re(重新)+habilit(使能够)+ate→使重新有能力→使康复
rehabilitate.z: 这个中心帮助受伤运动员康复。

cashier.m: cash(现金)+ier(人)→管现金的人→收银员
cashier.e: Pay the cashier at the front desk.
cashier.z: 请到前台向收银员付款。

gloss.e: He tried to gloss over his mistakes.
gloss.z: 他试图掩饰自己的错误。

seismic.m: seism(震动)+ic(形容词)→地震的；巨大的
seismic.e: Seismic activity is common in Japan.

inland.e: The town is fifty miles inland.
inland.z: 那座小镇位于内陆五十英里处。

itinerary.e: Our itinerary includes three days in Rome.
itinerary.z: 我们的行程包括在罗马的三天。

nibble.m: nib(啄、尖)+ble(反复)→一小口一小口啃→小口咬

economical.m: economy(节约)+ical(形容词)→节约的；经济的
economical.e: Buses are more economical than taxis.
economical.z: 公交车比出租车更经济。

gush.m: 与gust同源，表「猛冲而出」→涌出；滔滔不绝
gush.e: Water gushed from the broken pipe.
gush.z: 水从破裂的管子里涌出。

expulsion.m: ex(出)+puls(推)+ion(名词)→推出去→开除；驱逐
expulsion.e: Cheating can lead to expulsion from university.
expulsion.z: 作弊可能导致被大学开除。

esteem.m: 与estimate同源：es(=ex)+teem(估价)→评价高→尊重
esteem.z: 表扬可以提升孩子的自尊心。

barricade.m: barric(桶，法语barrique)+ade→用木桶堆成→路障
barricade.e: Protesters built barricades in the street.
barricade.z: 抗议者在街上筑起了路障。

madden.z: 持续的噪音让他快疯了。

deduct.e: Tax is deducted from your monthly salary.

concerted.m: concert(协调、音乐会)+ed→齐心协力的
concerted.e: A concerted effort is needed to cut pollution.
concerted.z: 减少污染需要齐心协力。

landslide.m: land(土地)+slide(滑)→山体滑坡；压倒性胜利

fieldwork.e: Geography students do fieldwork every spring.
fieldwork.z: 地理系学生每年春天做实地考察。

trample.m: tramp(重步行走)+le(反复)→反复重踩→践踏

taboo.m: 源自汤加语tabu(神圣不可碰)→禁忌
taboo.e: Mental health is no longer a taboo subject.
taboo.z: 心理健康不再是禁忌话题。

symposium.m: sym(共同)+pos(=pot喝)+ium→一起喝酒畅谈→座谈会
symposium.e: She spoke at a symposium on climate policy.
symposium.z: 她在一个气候政策研讨会上发言。

vulgar.m: vulg(普通民众)+ar(形容词)→平民的→粗俗的
vulgar.e: He apologised for his vulgar language.
vulgar.z: 他为自己的粗俗言语道歉。

homelessness.z: 房租上涨加剧了无家可归问题。

doze.m: 联想：谐音「斗着」→脑袋一斗一斗→打瞌睡
doze.e: Grandpa dozed off in front of the TV.
doze.z: 爷爷在电视前打起了瞌睡。

flora.m: 源自罗马花神Flora，flor(花)→植物群
flora.e: The island has unique flora and fauna.
flora.z: 这座岛有独特的动植物。

janitor.m: 源自罗马门神Janus(看门)+itor(人)→看门人→清洁工
janitor.e: The janitor cleans the classrooms every evening.
janitor.z: 清洁工每天晚上打扫教室。

chancellor.m: chancel(栅栏)+lor→站在法庭栅栏边的书记官→大臣；总理
chancellor.e: The chancellor announced new tax cuts.
chancellor.z: 财政大臣宣布了新的减税措施。

kernel.m: corn(谷粒)+el(小)→小谷粒→果仁；核心
kernel.e: There is a kernel of truth in his story.
kernel.z: 他的故事里有几分真实。

corroborate.m: cor(加强)+robor(力量)+ate(使)→使更有力→证实
corroborate.z: 目击者证实了她的说法。

incite.e: He was arrested for inciting violence online.
incite.z: 他因在网上煽动暴力被捕。

primate.m: prim(第一)+ate→排第一等的动物→灵长类
primate.e: Chimpanzees are our closest primate relatives.
primate.z: 黑猩猩是我们最近的灵长类亲属。

coerce.m: co(一起)+erce(=arcere关住)→关起来逼→强迫
coerce.e: No one should be coerced into signing a contract.
coerce.z: 任何人都不应被迫签合同。

assertive.m: assert(断言、坚持)+ive(形容词)→果断自信的
assertive.e: You need to be more assertive in meetings.
assertive.z: 开会时你需要更有主见一些。

picturesque.e: We walked through a picturesque old town.
picturesque.z: 我们漫步穿过一座风景如画的古镇。

maternity.m: mater(母亲)+nity(名词)→母亲身份→产妇的
maternity.e: She is on maternity leave until June.

quarterly.e: The company publishes a quarterly report.
quarterly.z: 该公司每季度发布一份报告。

folklore.m: folk(民间)+lore(学问、传说)→民间传说
folklore.e: Dragons are common in Chinese folklore.
folklore.z: 龙在中国民间传说中很常见。

depress.m: de(向下)+press(压)→往下压→使沮丧；压低
depress.z: 下雨天总让我心情低落。

tributary.m: tribut(给予，同contribute)+ary→把水贡献给干流的→支流；纳贡的
tributary.e: The river has many small tributaries.

drone.m: 本义「雄蜂」，嗡嗡飞→无人机；嗡嗡声
drone.e: Drones are now used to deliver parcels.
drone.z: 现在无人机被用来送包裹。

geology.e: She studied geology to understand earthquakes.
geology.z: 她学地质学是为了了解地震。

yarn.m: 联想：谐音「压」→把棉压捻成线→纱线；奇谈
yarn.e: She knitted a scarf with soft wool yarn.
yarn.z: 她用柔软的毛线织了条围巾。

converse.m: con(共同)+vers(转)+e→一起转话题→交谈；相反
converse.e: It's easy to converse with locals here.
converse.z: 在这里和当地人交谈很容易。

coward.m: cow(=coue尾巴，古法语)+ard(人)→夹着尾巴逃的人→懦夫
coward.e: He called himself a coward for not speaking up.
coward.z: 他骂自己是懦夫，因为没敢说出来。

clockwise.e: Turn the lid clockwise to close it.
clockwise.z: 顺时针旋转盖子把它关上。

dormant.m: dorm(睡，同dormitory)+ant(形容词)→睡着的→休眠的
dormant.e: The volcano has been dormant for centuries.
dormant.z: 这座火山已休眠数百年。

treatise.m: treat(论述、处理)+ise→论述性的文章→专著
treatise.e: He wrote a treatise on political economy.
treatise.z: 他写了一部政治经济学专著。

purge.m: pur(纯洁，同pure)+ge→使纯洁→清除；清洗
purge.e: The new leader purged his opponents.
purge.z: 新领导人清洗了他的对手。

quiver.m: 联想：qui(=quick快)+ver→快速抖→颤抖；箭袋
quiver.e: Her lips quivered as she spoke.

ingenious.m: in(内)+geni(天生的才能)+ous(形容词)→天才的→巧妙的
ingenious.e: It's an ingenious solution to the problem.
ingenious.z: 这是个巧妙的解决办法。

vigilant.z: 上网时要对诈骗保持警惕。

counterproductive.m: counter(反)+productive(有成效的)→适得其反的
counterproductive.e: Punishing students too often is counterproductive.
counterproductive.z: 过于频繁地惩罚学生会适得其反。

enlighten.e: The documentary enlightened me about ocean pollution.
enlighten.z: 这部纪录片让我了解了海洋污染。

sporadic.m: 源自希腊sporas(散落的，同spore孢子)→零星的
sporadic.e: There were sporadic showers in the afternoon.

troupe.m: 法语，与troop(军队、群)同源→剧团；戏班
troupe.e: A dance troupe performed at the festival.
troupe.z: 一个舞蹈团在节日上演出。

veterinarian.m: 源自拉丁veterina(役畜)+arian(人)→给牲口看病的人→兽医
veterinarian.e: Take your dog to the veterinarian for a check-up.
veterinarian.z: 带你的狗去兽医那儿做个检查。

outcry.e: The plan caused a public outcry.
outcry.z: 该计划引起了公众强烈抗议。

pore.m: 源自希腊poros(通道)→毛孔；（over）钻研
pore.e: Sweat comes out through the pores.

procurement.m: pro(为了)+cur(照管)+ment(名词)→为…操办→采购
procurement.e: The hospital improved its drug procurement process.
procurement.z: 医院改进了药品采购流程。

unconditional.m: un(无)+condition(条件)+al(形容词)→无条件的
unconditional.e: Parents give their children unconditional love.
unconditional.z: 父母给孩子无条件的爱。

superstition.m: super(在上)+stit(站)+ion→站在上面敬畏→迷信
superstition.e: Many people still follow old superstitions.
superstition.z: 许多人仍遵从旧的迷信。

rave.m: 联想：与rage(狂怒)形近→胡言乱语；热烈赞扬
rave.e: Critics raved about the new musical.
rave.z: 评论家对这部新音乐剧赞不绝口。

sabotage.m: 法语sabot(木鞋)+age→工人用木鞋砸机器→蓄意破坏

solvent.m: solv(溶解、解决)+ent→溶剂；有偿付能力的
solvent.e: Water is the most common solvent.

conscientious.m: conscience(良心)+tious(形容词)→凭良心做事→尽责的
conscientious.e: She is a conscientious and hard-working student.
conscientious.z: 她是个认真勤奋的学生。

subtitle.m: sub(下)+title(标题)→下面的标题→字幕；副标题
subtitle.e: I watch foreign films with subtitles.
subtitle.z: 我看外国电影时开字幕。

retribution.m: re(回)+tribut(给予)+ion(名词)→还回去→报应
retribution.e: They feared retribution from the gang.
retribution.z: 他们害怕遭到黑帮报复。

depletion.m: de(去掉)+plet(满)+ion(名词)→去掉满的→耗尽
depletion.e: Ozone depletion increases skin cancer risk.
depletion.z: 臭氧耗竭增加了皮肤癌风险。

commotion.m: com(加强)+mot(动)+ion(名词)→大动起来→骚动
commotion.e: There was a commotion outside the station.

streamline.m: stream(流)+line(线)→流线型→精简、使高效
streamline.e: The app streamlines the booking process.
streamline.z: 这款应用简化了预订流程。

etiquette.m: 法语「标签」→贴在宫廷的规矩标签→礼仪

queer.m: 联想：que(谐音「怪」)+er→古怪的；同性恋者
queer.e: There was a queer smell in the kitchen.

fraught.m: 与freight(货物)同源→装满货物的→充满(风险等)的
fraught.e: The journey was fraught with danger.

negligence.m: neg(不)+lig(=leg选择、收集)+ence→不去留意→疏忽
negligence.e: The accident was caused by negligence.

torrent.m: torr(=torrere沸腾)+ent→沸腾奔涌→奔流；暴雨
torrent.e: Heavy rain turned the stream into a raging torrent.
torrent.z: 大雨把小溪变成了汹涌的激流。

locomotive.m: loco(地方)+mot(动)+ive→从一地移到另一地→机车
locomotive.e: The old steam locomotive is now displayed in a museum.
locomotive.z: 那台老蒸汽机车现在陈列在博物馆里。

utmost.m: ut(=out外)+most(最)→最外端→极限；最大的
utmost.e: The project requires the utmost care and attention.
utmost.z: 这个项目需要极其细心和专注。

elastic.m: 联想：e+last(持久)+ic→拉开后还能恢复→有弹性；松紧带
elastic.e: The waistband is made of soft elastic.
elastic.z: 腰带是用柔软的松紧带做的。

baffle.m: 联想：baff谐音"爸烦"→难题让爸爸烦恼→使困惑
baffle.e: The sudden drop in sales baffled the economists.
baffle.z: 销量的骤降让经济学家们困惑不解。

protrude.e: A rusty nail protruded from the wooden fence.
protrude.z: 一颗生锈的钉子从木栅栏上突了出来。

densely.e: Hong Kong is one of the most densely populated cities.
densely.z: 香港是人口最稠密的城市之一。

wretched.m: wretch(可怜人)+ed(形容词)→可怜的；不幸的
wretched.e: The refugees lived in wretched conditions.
wretched.z: 难民们生活在悲惨的环境中。

alloy.m: 联想：all(全部)+oy→几种金属全熔在一起→合金
alloy.e: Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin.

mischief.m: mis(坏)+chief(=chever达成)→结局坏→损害；淘气
