mischief.e: The children got into mischief while their parents were out.
mischief.z: 父母外出时孩子们调皮捣蛋。

crumple.m: 联想：crum(=crumb碎屑)+ple→揉成一团→弄皱
crumple.e: He crumpled the letter and threw it away.
crumple.z: 他把信揉成一团扔掉了。

workload.e: Many teachers complain about their heavy workload.
workload.z: 许多教师抱怨工作量太大。

prelude.m: pre(前)+lud(玩,演奏)+e→先演奏的部分→前奏；序幕
prelude.e: The protests were a prelude to major political change.
prelude.z: 抗议活动是重大政治变革的序幕。

glitter.m: 联想：gl开头常与光有关(glow,glare)+itter→闪烁
glitter.e: The city lights glittered across the harbour.
glitter.z: 城市灯光在港湾上闪烁。

dissect.e: Students dissected a frog in the biology lab.
dissect.z: 学生们在生物实验室解剖了一只青蛙。

propagate.m: pro(向前)+pag(固定,插枝)+ate→向前插枝→繁殖；传播
propagate.e: Social media can propagate false information quickly.
propagate.z: 社交媒体能迅速传播虚假信息。

piety.e: Filial piety is a core value in Confucian culture.
piety.z: 孝道是儒家文化的核心价值。

wither.m: 联想：形近weather(天气)→风吹日晒→花草凋谢
wither.e: The plants withered during the long drought.
wither.z: 植物在长期干旱中枯萎了。

reimburse.m: re(回)+im(进)+burse(钱包)→钱放回钱包→偿还
reimburse.e: The company will reimburse your travel expenses.
reimburse.z: 公司会报销你的差旅费。

tar.m: 联想：tar倒过来是rat→老鼠掉进柏油里→焦油；柏油
tar.e: Cigarette smoke contains tar that damages the lungs.
tar.z: 香烟烟雾中含有损害肺部的焦油。

extinguish.m: ex(完全)+stingu(熄灭)+ish(动词)→完全熄灭
extinguish.z: 消防员迅速扑灭了大火。

ransom.m: 源自拉丁redemptio(赎回)，与redemption同源→赎金
ransom.e: The kidnappers demanded a huge ransom.

inaugurate.m: in(进)+augur(占卜官)+ate→占卜后就职→举行就职典礼；开创
inaugurate.e: The new president will be inaugurated in January.
inaugurate.z: 新总统将于一月宣誓就职。

fluent.m: flu(流)+ent(形容词)→流动的→流利的
fluent.e: She is fluent in English and Spanish.
fluent.z: 她能流利地说英语和西班牙语。

tamper.m: temper(调和)的变体→乱调乱弄→干预；篡改
tamper.e: Someone had tampered with the election results.

scorn.m: 联想：s+corn(玉米)→只拿玉米打发人→轻蔑
scorn.e: Critics poured scorn on the government's new plan.
scorn.z: 批评者对政府的新计划嗤之以鼻。

recital.e: She gave a piano recital at the town hall.
recital.z: 她在市政厅举办了钢琴独奏会。

exodus.e: There was an exodus of young people from rural areas.
exodus.z: 大批年轻人离开了农村地区。

swerve.m: 联想：werve谐音"歪"→车子猛地一歪→急转弯
swerve.e: The driver swerved to avoid a cyclist.
swerve.z: 司机猛地转向以避开一名骑车人。

ravage.e: The region was ravaged by war for decades.
ravage.z: 该地区数十年饱受战争蹂躏。

latent.m: lat(=latere隐藏)+ent(形容词)→隐藏的；潜伏的
latent.e: The virus can remain latent in the body for years.
latent.z: 这种病毒能在体内潜伏多年。

desolate.m: de(完全)+sol(单独)+ate→完全孤独→荒凉的
desolate.e: The village became desolate after the factory closed.
desolate.z: 工厂关闭后村庄变得荒凉。

disarray.m: dis(否定)+array(排列整齐)→不成队列→混乱
disarray.e: The office was in disarray after the move.
disarray.z: 搬家后办公室一片混乱。

torment.e: He suffered years of mental torment after the accident.
torment.z: 事故后他承受了多年的精神折磨。

meteorite.m: meteor(流星)+ite(石)→流星落下的石头→陨石
meteorite.e: Scientists found a meteorite in the Antarctic ice.
meteorite.z: 科学家在南极冰层中发现了一块陨石。

misuse.e: The misuse of antibiotics leads to drug resistance.
misuse.z: 滥用抗生素会导致耐药性。

pervade.m: per(穿过)+vad(走)+e→走遍各处→弥漫；遍及
pervade.e: A sense of optimism pervaded the conference.
pervade.z: 乐观情绪弥漫着整个会议。

negligible.e: The cost of the change is negligible.
negligible.z: 这项改动的成本微不足道。

suspense.m: sus(下)+pens(悬挂)+e→悬在下面→悬念；焦虑
suspense.e: The film keeps viewers in suspense until the end.
suspense.z: 这部电影让观众一直悬着心直到结尾。

handout.m: hand(手)+out(出)→用手递出去→施舍；讲义
handout.e: The lecturer gave each student a handout.
handout.z: 讲师给每个学生发了一份讲义。

strait.m: 与strict同源(紧,窄)→窄窄的水道→海峡；困境
strait.e: Ships pass through the narrow strait every day.
strait.z: 每天都有船只经过这条狭窄的海峡。

feeble.m: 源自拉丁flebilis(可悲的)→可怜无力→微弱的
feeble.e: The old man's voice was feeble but clear.
feeble.z: 老人的声音微弱但清晰。

tonic.m: ton(声调,张力)+ic→恢复张力的→补药；主音
tonic.e: A walk in the countryside is a great tonic.
tonic.z: 在乡间散步是极好的提神良方。

nobility.e: The castle was once home to French nobility.
nobility.z: 这座城堡曾是法国贵族的居所。

metropolis.e: Shanghai has grown into a vast metropolis.
metropolis.z: 上海已发展成为一座庞大的都市。

detached.m: de(分离)+tach(粘,钉)+ed→不相连的→独立式的
detached.e: They bought a detached house with a large garden.
detached.z: 他们买了一栋带大花园的独立式住宅。

burrow.m: 联想：bur谐音"钻"+row(一排)→钻出一排洞→洞穴；挖洞
burrow.e: Rabbits dig burrows under the ground.

delinquency.m: de(离开)+linqu(留下,离弃)+ency→离弃职责→违法；过失
delinquency.e: Poverty is often linked to juvenile delinquency.
delinquency.z: 贫困常与青少年犯罪相关。

camouflage.m: 源自法语camoufler(伪装)；联想：camou谐音"看不"→看不见→伪装
camouflage.e: The chameleon uses colour as camouflage.

replenish.m: re(再)+plen(满)+ish(动词)→再次装满→补充
replenish.e: Drink water to replenish fluids after exercise.

trolley.m: 联想：troll(滚动)+ey→滚着走的车→手推车；电车
trolley.e: She pushed a shopping trolley around the supermarket.
trolley.z: 她推着购物车在超市里转。

incarceration.e: Rates of incarceration vary widely between countries.
incarceration.z: 各国的监禁率差异很大。

hectic.m: 源自希腊hektikos(持续发热)→像发烧般→忙乱的
hectic.e: She has a hectic schedule this week.
hectic.z: 她这周的日程排得很满。

stagnant.m: stagn(=stagnum池塘)+ant→像池塘死水→停滞的
stagnant.e: Wages have remained stagnant for years.

interdependence.m: inter(相互)+depend(依赖)+ence(名词)→相互依存
interdependence.z: 全球化加深了经济上的相互依存。

migratory.e: Many migratory birds stop at this lake.
migratory.z: 许多候鸟在这片湖泊停留。

overrule.m: over(在上)+rule(裁决)→从上面裁决→否决；驳回
overrule.e: The judge overruled the lawyer's objection.
overrule.z: 法官驳回了律师的反对。

pertain.m: per(完全)+tain(拿住)→完全属于→从属；关于
pertain.e: These rules pertain only to new employees.
pertain.z: 这些规定只适用于新员工。

burnout.e: Long working hours can lead to burnout.
burnout.z: 长时间工作会导致职业倦怠。

doubtless.e: Technology will doubtless change how we learn.
doubtless.z: 技术无疑会改变我们的学习方式。

cumbersome.m: cumber(阻碍)+some(形容词)→碍手碍脚→笨重的；麻烦的
cumbersome.e: The application process is slow and cumbersome.

concurrent.m: con(共同)+curr(跑)+ent→一起跑→同时发生的
concurrent.e: He is serving two concurrent prison sentences.

intermittent.m: inter(之间)+mitt(放,送)+ent→间断地放出→间歇的
intermittent.e: We had intermittent rain throughout the day.
intermittent.z: 一整天断断续续地下雨。

illiterate.e: Millions of adults worldwide are still illiterate.
illiterate.z: 全球仍有数百万成年人不识字。

prerogative.m: pre(先)+rog(问)+ative→先被问意见的权利→特权
prerogative.e: Choosing a career is your own prerogative.
prerogative.z: 选择职业是你自己的权利。

engrave.e: Their names were engraved on the trophy.
engrave.z: 他们的名字被刻在奖杯上。

malignant.e: Doctors found a malignant tumour in her lung.
malignant.z: 医生在她肺部发现一个恶性肿瘤。

guild.m: 源自古诺斯语gildi(付款)→交会费的组织→行会；协会
guild.e: Medieval craftsmen joined guilds to protect their trade.
guild.z: 中世纪工匠加入行会以保护自己的行业。

impartial.m: im(不)+partial(偏向一方)→不偏不倚→公正的

evict.m: e(出)+vict(征服)→击败并赶出→驱逐
evict.e: The landlord evicted the tenants for not paying rent.
evict.z: 房东因租户不交房租将其赶走。

antarctic.m: ant(=anti相对)+arctic(北极)→北极的对面→南极的
antarctic.e: Penguins live in the Antarctic region.

arson.e: Police believe the fire was caused by arson.
arson.z: 警方认为火灾是人为纵火。

iconic.m: icon(图标,偶像)+ic(形容词)→标志性的
iconic.e: The Eiffel Tower is an iconic landmark.
iconic.z: 埃菲尔铁塔是标志性地标。

hijack.m: 联想："Hi, Jack!"一声招呼后动手→劫持
hijack.e: The plane was hijacked shortly after take-off.
hijack.z: 飞机起飞后不久遭劫持。

diffuse.m: dif(分散)+fus(倒,流)+e→向四处倒出→散播；扩散
diffuse.e: The internet helps diffuse knowledge globally.
diffuse.z: 互联网帮助知识在全球传播。

exuberant.m: ex(出)+uber(丰饶)+ant→丰饶得溢出→繁茂的；热情洋溢
exuberant.e: The exuberant crowd cheered the winning team.
exuberant.z: 热情洋溢的人群为获胜队欢呼。

segregate.m: se(分开)+greg(群)+ate→使离群→隔离；分离
segregate.e: Waste should be segregated before recycling.

meditate.e: She meditates for ten minutes every morning.
meditate.z: 她每天早上冥想十分钟。

underdog.m: under(在下)+dog(狗)→被压在下面的狗→不被看好的一方
underdog.e: Everyone loves to see the underdog win.

virtuous.m: virtue(美德)+ous(形容词)→品德高尚的
virtuous.e: He was regarded as a virtuous leader.
virtuous.z: 他被视为一位品德高尚的领袖。

abort.m: ab(离开)+or(=oriri出生)+t→未能出生→流产；中止
abort.e: The mission was aborted due to bad weather.
abort.z: 由于天气恶劣任务被中止。

concoct.m: con(一起)+coct(煮)→煮在一起→调制；捏造
concoct.e: He concocted a story to explain his absence.
concoct.z: 他编了个故事来解释缺席。

mania.m: 源自希腊mania(疯狂)；作后缀"-mania"即"…狂"→狂热
mania.e: There was a mania for collecting stamps in the 1950s.

dazzle.m: daze(使眩晕)+le(反复)→晃得眼花→使目眩
dazzle.e: The bright sunlight dazzled the drivers.
dazzle.z: 强烈的阳光晃得司机睁不开眼。

acclaim.m: ac(向)+claim(喊)→向人高喊→喝彩；赞誉
acclaim.e: The novel won wide acclaim from critics.
acclaim.z: 这部小说广受评论家赞誉。

jargon.m: 联想：jar(罐子)+gon→罐里嘟囔，外人听不懂→行话
jargon.e: Try to avoid technical jargon in your essay.
jargon.z: 写作文时尽量避免技术行话。

tentacle.m: tent(=tentare触,试探)+acle(小物)→试探之物→触须

arduous.m: ard(=arduus陡峭)+uous→陡峭难攀→艰巨的；费力的
arduous.e: Climbing the mountain was an arduous journey.
arduous.z: 攀登这座山是一段艰辛的旅程。

temperate.m: temper(调和)+ate→调和适中的→温和的；温带的
temperate.e: The UK has a temperate climate.

aptitude.m: apt(适合)+itude(名词)→天生适合→天资；才能
aptitude.e: She shows a natural aptitude for languages.
aptitude.z: 她在语言方面天资过人。

pounce.m: 联想：p+ounce(盎司)→猫为一盎司肉猛扑→猛扑
pounce.e: The cat pounced on the mouse.

glimmer.e: There is a glimmer of hope for the economy.

calamity.m: 联想：谐音"可来灭体"→灾祸降临→灾难
calamity.e: The flood was the worst calamity in the town's history.
calamity.z: 这场洪水是该镇历史上最严重的灾难。

wildfire.e: Wildfires have become more frequent due to climate change.
wildfire.z: 由于气候变化，山火变得更加频繁。

bookcase.e: The bookcase is full of old novels.

placid.m: plac(=placere使平静,取悦)+id→平静的；温和的
placid.e: The lake was placid in the early morning.

pinnacle.e: Winning the Nobel Prize was the pinnacle of her career.
pinnacle.z: 获得诺贝尔奖是她事业的巅峰。

subdue.m: sub(下)+du(=ducere引导)+e→引到下面→征服；压制
subdue.e: Police used tear gas to subdue the crowd.
subdue.z: 警察用催泪瓦斯压制人群。

pendulum.e: The pendulum of the old clock swung slowly.

accuser.e: The accuser refused to give evidence in court.

erroneous.e: The report was based on erroneous data.
erroneous.z: 这份报告基于错误的数据。

detergent.m: de(去掉)+terg(擦)+ent→擦去污物之物→清洁剂
detergent.e: Use a mild detergent to wash wool.
detergent.z: 洗羊毛制品要用温和的洗涤剂。

undue.m: un(不)+due(应有的)→不应有的→不适当的；过度的
undue.e: Exams put undue pressure on young students.
undue.z: 考试给年幼学生带来了过度的压力。

fauna.m: 源自罗马动物女神Fauna→动物群(对比flora植物群)
fauna.e: The island's fauna includes rare birds.
fauna.z: 该岛的动物群中有珍稀鸟类。

gridlock.m: grid(路网)+lock(锁住)→路网锁死→交通堵塞；僵局
gridlock.e: Rush hour brings gridlock to the city centre.
gridlock.z: 高峰期市中心交通瘫痪。

underwrite.m: under(在下)+write(写)→在下面签名→承保；担保
underwrite.e: The bank agreed to underwrite the loan.
underwrite.z: 银行同意为这笔贷款担保。

forfeit.m: for(=foris越界)+feit(=facere做)→犯规→被没收；丧失
forfeit.e: He forfeited his deposit by cancelling late.
forfeit.z: 他因取消太晚而丧失了押金。

momentous.e: Leaving home was a momentous decision.
momentous.z: 离开家是一个重大决定。

strenuous.m: 联想：stren形近strength(力量)+uous→要用大力→费力的
strenuous.e: Avoid strenuous exercise after a big meal.

substantiate.e: There is no evidence to substantiate his claims.
substantiate.z: 没有证据能证实他的说法。

cosmopolitan.m: cosmo(世界)+polit(城市,公民)+an→世界公民的→国际化的
cosmopolitan.e: London is a truly cosmopolitan city.
cosmopolitan.z: 伦敦是一座真正的国际化都市。

hasty.m: haste(匆忙)+y(形容词)→匆匆的；轻率的
hasty.e: Don't make a hasty decision about your future.
hasty.z: 不要对未来草率做决定。

glitch.m: 联想：谐音"格里吃"→系统卡一下→小故障
glitch.e: A technical glitch delayed the flight.
glitch.z: 一个技术小故障导致航班延误。

pessimism.m: pessim(=pessimus最坏)+ism(主义)→总想最坏→悲观
pessimism.e: There is growing pessimism about the economy.
pessimism.z: 人们对经济越来越悲观。

checkup.e: You should have a medical checkup every year.
checkup.z: 你应该每年做一次体检。

apprenticeship.m: apprentice(学徒)+ship(身份,状态)→学徒期；学徒制
apprenticeship.e: He did a four-year apprenticeship as a carpenter.

idiom.m: idio(个人的,特有的)+m→语言特有说法→习语
idiom.e: "Break a leg" is an English idiom.

incline.e: I'm inclined to agree with you.
incline.z: 我倾向于同意你的看法。

insomnia.e: Stress is a common cause of insomnia.
insomnia.z: 压力是失眠的常见原因。

colossal.e: The project was a colossal waste of money.
colossal.z: 这个项目是巨大的金钱浪费。

egalitarian.m: egal(=法语égal平等)+itarian(主义者的)→平等主义的
egalitarian.e: Scandinavia is known for its egalitarian society.
egalitarian.z: 斯堪的纳维亚以平等的社会著称。

crease.m: 联想：形近increase→衣服越压褶子越多→折痕
crease.e: Iron the shirt to remove the creases.
crease.z: 把衬衫熨一下去掉褶子。

compulsory.m: com(加强)+puls(驱,推)+ory→强行驱使→强制的；义务的
compulsory.e: Education is compulsory until the age of sixteen.
compulsory.z: 十六岁前接受教育是义务性的。

fortify.e: Cereals are often fortified with vitamins.
fortify.z: 谷物常常添加维生素以强化营养。

equator.m: equ(相等)+ator→把地球平分的线→赤道
equator.e: Singapore lies just north of the equator.
equator.z: 新加坡位于赤道以北不远处。

twinkle.m: 联想：twin(双胞胎)+kle→一对星星眨眼→闪烁
twinkle.e: Stars twinkled in the clear night sky.
twinkle.z: 星星在晴朗的夜空中闪烁。

permissible.m: per(通过)+miss(放,送)+ible(可…的)→可放行的→允许的
permissible.e: Is it permissible to use a dictionary in the exam?

materialism.e: Critics blame advertising for rising materialism.
materialism.z: 批评者把物质主义的上升归咎于广告。

epoch.m: ep(=epi在)+och(=ekhein停住)→停在某一点→纪元；时代
epoch.e: The internet marked the start of a new epoch.
epoch.z: 互联网标志着一个新时代的开始。

cork.m: 联想：谐音"靠它"塞住瓶口→软木塞
cork.e: He pulled the cork out of the bottle.
cork.z: 他把软木塞从瓶子里拔了出来。

astound.m: 与astonish同源(古法语estoner,如遭雷击)→使震惊
astound.e: The speed of change astounded everyone.
astound.z: 变化之快令所有人震惊。

cunning.m: cunn(=can古义"知道")+ing→知道得多→狡猾的；巧妙的
cunning.e: The fox is a cunning animal in many stories.
cunning.z: 在许多故事里狐狸是狡猾的动物。

stamina.m: 源自拉丁stamen(纺线)复数→命运之线→耐力；体力
stamina.z: 马拉松运动员需要极强的耐力。

dreary.m: 联想：drear谐音"抓耳"+y→无聊得抓耳挠腮→沉闷的
dreary.e: It was a dreary, rainy afternoon.
dreary.z: 那是一个沉闷的雨天下午。

gale.m: 联想：g+ale(麦酒)→像醉汉东倒西歪的风→大风
gale.e: The gale knocked down several trees.

paraphrase.m: para(旁,另)+phrase(措辞)→换种说法→改写；释义
paraphrase.e: Paraphrase the question in your introduction.

annuity.m: annu(年)+ity(名词)→每年付的钱→年金
annuity.e: She receives a small annuity from her pension.
annuity.z: 她从养老金中领取一小笔年金。

stranded.m: strand(海滩;搁浅)+ed→搁浅的→被困的；滞留的
stranded.e: Thousands of passengers were stranded at the airport.
stranded.z: 数千名乘客滞留在机场。

onlooker.e: A crowd of onlookers gathered at the scene.
onlooker.z: 一群旁观者聚集在现场。

wholesome.m: whole(完整,健康)+some(形容词)→有益健康的
wholesome.e: Fresh fruit is a wholesome snack.
wholesome.z: 新鲜水果是健康的零食。

persecute.m: per(始终)+secut(跟随)+e→一直追着→迫害
persecute.e: The minority group was persecuted for centuries.
persecute.z: 这一少数群体遭受了数百年的迫害。

agitation.m: agit(=agere驱动)+ation→心被搅动→激动；焦虑
agitation.e: She paced the room in agitation.
agitation.z: 她焦虑地在房间里踱步。

drench.e: We were drenched by a sudden shower.
drench.z: 一场骤雨把我们浇透了。

bandwidth.e: Video calls require a lot of bandwidth.
bandwidth.z: 视频通话需要大量带宽。

innumerable.e: Innumerable stars filled the desert sky.
innumerable.z: 沙漠的夜空布满了无数星星。

inertia.m: in(无)+ert(=ars技能,活力)+ia→无活力→惯性；惰性
inertia.e: Political inertia has delayed climate action.
inertia.z: 政治上的惰性延误了气候行动。

redundant.m: red(=re再)+und(波浪)+ant→波浪重叠溢出→多余的；被裁员的
redundant.e: Hundreds of workers were made redundant.

rendezvous.m: 法语rendez-vous(去那儿报到)→约会；约会地点
rendezvous.e: The café became a popular rendezvous for students.
rendezvous.z: 这家咖啡馆成了学生们常去的聚会点。

periodical.m: period(周期)+ical(形容词)→定期出版的→期刊
periodical.e: The library subscribes to many scientific periodicals.
periodical.z: 图书馆订阅了许多科学期刊。

lax.m: lax(=laxus松)，即relax中的lax→松懈的；不严格的
lax.e: Security at the event was rather lax.

toil.m: 联想：to+il谐音"土"→在土里劳作→苦工；辛苦
toil.e: Farmers toil in the fields from dawn to dusk.
toil.z: 农民从早到晚在田里辛苦劳作。

oppress.m: op(对着)+press(压)→压在人身上→压迫
oppress.e: The regime oppressed its own people.
oppress.z: 那个政权压迫本国人民。

handbook.e: Every new student receives a handbook.
handbook.z: 每个新生都会收到一本手册。

inundate.m: in(进)+und(波浪)+ate→波浪涌进→淹没；使应接不暇
inundate.z: 我们收到的申请多得应接不暇。

pungent.e: The pungent smell of garlic filled the kitchen.
pungent.z: 厨房里弥漫着刺鼻的大蒜味。

postulate.m: postul(=postulare要求)+ate→要求别人承认→假定
postulate.e: Scientists postulate that life began in the ocean.
postulate.z: 科学家假定生命起源于海洋。

transistor.e: The transistor made modern computers possible.
transistor.z: 晶体管使现代计算机成为可能。

panorama.e: The tower offers a panorama of the city.
panorama.z: 塔上可以看到城市全景。

untold.m: un(未)+told(说过)→未说过的；数不清的
untold.z: 这场风暴造成了难以估量的损失。

miscarriage.m: mis(错)+carriage(运送)→运错了→失败；流产
miscarriage.e: The case was a miscarriage of justice.
miscarriage.z: 这起案件是一次司法误判。

scapegoat.m: scape(=escape逃)+goat(山羊)→替人逃罪的羊→替罪羊
scapegoat.e: Immigrants are often made scapegoats for social problems.
scapegoat.z: 移民常被当作社会问题的替罪羊。

mire.m: 联想：mi谐音"泥"+re→泥沼；陷入困境
mire.e: The car got stuck in the mire.

trustworthy.m: trust(信任)+worthy(值得的)→值得信赖的
trustworthy.e: It's important to find a trustworthy source.
trustworthy.z: 找到可靠的信息来源很重要。

courier.e: The documents were sent by courier.

ovation.m: 源自拉丁ovatio(古罗马小凯旋式)→热烈欢迎；鼓掌
ovation.e: The audience gave her a standing ovation.

archaic.e: Some of these laws are now archaic.
archaic.z: 其中一些法律如今已经过时。

vindicate.m: vindic(=vindex辩护人)+ate(动词)→辩护；证明无辜
vindicate.e: New evidence vindicated the scientist's theory.
vindicate.z: 新证据证明了这位科学家理论的正确。

din.m: 联想：谐音"叮"→叮叮当当吵成一片→喧嚣
din.e: I couldn't hear her above the din of traffic.
din.z: 车流的喧嚣中我听不见她说话。

semblance.m: sembl(相似)+ance(名词)→看起来相似→外表；表象
semblance.e: Life slowly returned to some semblance of normality.
semblance.z: 生活慢慢恢复了些许常态。

junction.m: junct(连接)+ion(名词)→连接处；交叉路口
junction.e: Turn left at the next junction.

blunder.e: Leaving the key at home was a big blunder.
blunder.z: 把钥匙落在家里是个大失误。

allot.e: Each speaker is allotted ten minutes.
allot.z: 每位发言人分配十分钟。

memento.m: mem(记忆)+ento，拉丁语"记住!"→纪念品
memento.e: She kept the ticket as a memento of the trip.
memento.z: 她把车票留作那次旅行的纪念。

increment.m: in(加)+cre(生长)+ment(名词)→增长量；增加
increment.e: Your salary will rise in annual increments.

dole.m: 与deal(一份)同源→分给的一份→救济金
dole.e: He has been on the dole for six months.
dole.z: 他靠失业救济金过了六个月。

expatriate.m: ex(出)+patri(祖国)+ate(人)→离开祖国的人→外籍人士
expatriate.z: 许多外籍人士在迪拜工作。

electrician.e: We called an electrician to fix the lights.

observance.m: observe(遵守;观察)+ance(名词)→遵守；纪念仪式
observance.e: Strict observance of the rules is required.

preface.m: pre(前)+face(=fari说)→在前面说的话→序言
preface.e: The author thanks her family in the preface.
preface.z: 作者在序言中感谢了家人。

impromptu.m: im(=in在)+promptu(准备好)→当场就有→即兴的
impromptu.e: He gave an impromptu speech at the wedding.
impromptu.z: 他在婚礼上即兴发表了讲话。

bribery.e: The official was charged with bribery.

postage.e: How much is the postage to Australia?
postage.z: 寄到澳大利亚的邮费是多少？

pamper.m: 联想：pam谐音"胖"+per→把人宠得胖胖的→纵容；娇惯
pamper.e: Treat yourself and pamper your skin at the spa.
pamper.z: 犒劳自己，在水疗馆好好护理一下皮肤。

levy.m: lev(举起)+y→向上收取→征税；税款
levy.e: The government plans to levy a tax on sugary drinks.
levy.z: 政府计划对含糖饮料征税。

piston.m: 源自意大利语pestare(捣)→捣杵般往复运动→活塞
piston.e: The piston moves up and down inside the engine.
piston.z: 活塞在发动机内上下运动。

procure.m: pro(为)+cur(关心)+e→为之操心→设法获得
procure.e: The charity procured food for the refugees.
procure.z: 慈善机构为难民筹到了食物。

lull.m: 联想：模仿哄睡声"lu-lu"→哄睡；暂时平静
lull.e: There was a brief lull in the fighting.

steamer.e: They crossed the lake on an old steamer.
steamer.z: 他们乘一艘旧汽船渡湖。

vehemently.e: Residents vehemently opposed the new airport.
vehemently.z: 居民们强烈反对新建机场。

flaunt.m: 联想：形近flag(旗帜)→像挥旗一样招摇→炫耀
flaunt.e: Some celebrities flaunt their wealth online.

haste.m: 联想：谐音"嗨死它"→急急忙忙→匆忙
haste.e: In her haste, she forgot her passport.

broadband.e: Rural areas still lack fast broadband.
broadband.z: 农村地区仍缺乏高速宽带。

smuggling.e: Drug smuggling is a serious crime.
smuggling.z: 毒品走私是严重的罪行。

overture.m: 源自法语ouvrir(打开)→开场→序曲；主动示好
overture.e: The company made overtures to its rival about a merger.
overture.z: 该公司就合并一事向竞争对手示好。

leisurely.e: We took a leisurely walk along the river.

chronological.m: chrono(时间)+logical(按逻辑的)→按时间顺序的
chronological.e: List your work experience in chronological order.
chronological.z: 按时间顺序列出你的工作经历。

chasm.m: 源自希腊khasma(裂口)→深渊；巨大分歧
chasm.e: There is a widening chasm between rich and poor.
chasm.z: 贫富之间的鸿沟日益扩大。

pretext.m: pre(预先)+text(编织)→预先编好的说辞→借口
pretext.e: He used illness as a pretext to skip the meeting.
pretext.z: 他以生病为借口缺席会议。

bustle.m: 联想：bus(公交)+tle→公交站人来人往→喧闹；忙乱
bustle.e: I love the hustle and bustle of city life.
bustle.z: 我喜欢城市生活的熙熙攘攘。

sarcasm.m: sarc(肉)+asm(名词)→撕咬人肉般的话→讽刺
sarcasm.e: "Great job," she said with obvious sarcasm.
sarcasm.z: "干得真好，"她明显带着讽刺说。

ruffle.m: 联想：形近rough(粗糙)→弄得乱糟糟→弄皱；使烦恼

starch.m: 与stark(硬)同源→使衣物变硬的浆→淀粉；浆糊

philanthropy.e: His philanthropy funded many new schools.
philanthropy.z: 他的慈善捐助资助了许多新学校。

condolence.m: con(共同)+dol(痛)+ence→共同悲痛→哀悼；吊唁

populous.e: India is now the most populous country.
populous.z: 印度现在是人口最多的国家。

automation.e: Automation may replace many factory jobs.
automation.z: 自动化可能取代许多工厂岗位。

melancholy.m: melan(黑)+choly(胆汁)→古人认为黑胆汁致郁→忧郁
melancholy.e: A feeling of melancholy came over him.
melancholy.z: 一阵忧郁涌上他的心头。

leaflet.e: Volunteers handed out leaflets in the street.

piracy.m: pira(te海盗)+cy(行为)→海盗行为；盗版
piracy.e: Online piracy costs the film industry billions.
piracy.z: 网络盗版让电影业损失数十亿。

crevice.m: 源自拉丁crepare(破裂)，与crevasse同源→裂缝
crevice.e: Small plants grew in the crevices of the wall.

tarnish.m: 联想：tar(柏油)+nish→蒙上一层柏油→失去光泽；玷污
tarnish.z: 这起丑闻玷污了他的名声。

tacit.m: tac(=tacere沉默)+it→不说出口的→心照不宣的；沉默的
tacit.e: There was a tacit agreement not to discuss politics.
tacit.z: 大家心照不宣地不谈政治。

agreeable.m: agree(同意)+able(可…的)→令人愉快的；可同意的
agreeable.e: We had an agreeable evening with friends.
agreeable.z: 我们和朋友度过了愉快的夜晚。

propriety.m: propri(适当的,自己的)+ety(名词)→得体→礼节；规矩
propriety.e: She always behaves with great propriety.
propriety.z: 她的举止总是十分得体。

condense.e: Steam condenses into water on the cold window.
condense.z: 蒸汽在冰冷的窗户上凝结成水。

slang.m: 联想：s+lang(=language语言)→街头的语言→俚语
slang.z: 青少年常在网上使用俚语。

aristocracy.m: aristo(最好的)+cracy(统治)→最优者统治→贵族
aristocracy.e: The aristocracy lost much of its power in the 20th century.
aristocracy.z: 贵族阶层在20世纪失去了大部分权力。

sanitary.z: 恶劣的卫生条件会传播疾病。

persevere.m: per(始终)+severe(严格)→始终严格要求→坚持不懈
persevere.e: If you persevere, your English will improve.
persevere.z: 只要坚持，你的英语就会进步。

safari.m: 源自斯瓦希里语safari(旅行)→游猎；野外旅行
safari.e: We went on a safari in Kenya.
safari.z: 我们去肯尼亚进行了野生动物观光。

hereditary.m: hered(继承人)+itary(形容词)→遗传的；世袭的

idyllic.m: idyll(田园诗)+ic(形容词)→田园诗般的
idyllic.e: They spent an idyllic summer in the countryside.
idyllic.z: 他们在乡村度过了一个田园诗般的夏天。

maize.e: Maize is a staple crop in Mexico.
maize.z: 玉米是墨西哥的主要农作物。

physique.e: Swimmers usually have a strong physique.
physique.z: 游泳运动员通常体格健壮。

obnoxious.m: ob(加强)+nox(伤害)+ious→很伤人的→令人讨厌的
obnoxious.z: 他讨厌的行为惹恼了所有人。

malnutrition.z: 营养不良影响着数百万儿童。

herbicide.e: Farmers spray herbicide to control weeds.
herbicide.z: 农民喷洒除草剂来控制杂草。

affix.m: af(向)+fix(固定)→固定上去→贴上；附上
affix.e: Please affix a stamp to the envelope.
affix.z: 请在信封上贴一张邮票。

perpendicular.m: per(完全)+pend(悬挂)+icular→铅锤垂挂→垂直的
perpendicular.e: The two lines are perpendicular to each other.

regeneration.e: The city invested in urban regeneration.
regeneration.z: 这座城市投资于城市复兴。

inert.m: in(无)+ert(=ars技能,活力)→无活力→惰性的；迟钝的

jumble.m: 联想：jump(跳)+ble→东西乱跳→混杂；杂乱一堆
jumble.e: The drawer was a jumble of old cables.
jumble.z: 抽屉里乱糟糟地堆着旧电线。

obligatory.m: oblig(=oblige强制)+atory(形容词)→义务的；必须的
obligatory.e: Wearing a helmet is obligatory for cyclists.

percussion.m: per(穿透)+cuss(=quatere敲击)+ion→敲击；打击乐器

rupture.e: The pipe ruptured during the cold snap.

inept.m: in(不)+ept(=apt适合)→不合适的；无能的

paternity.e: Many fathers now take paternity leave.
paternity.z: 如今许多父亲会休陪产假。

indefinite.m: in(不)+definite(确定的)→不确定的；无限期的
indefinite.e: The strike will continue for an indefinite period.
indefinite.z: 罢工将无限期持续下去。

deplore.m: de(加强)+plor(哭喊)+e→痛哭→哀叹；强烈谴责
deplore.e: We deplore all forms of violence.
deplore.z: 我们谴责一切形式的暴力。

antagonism.m: ant(反)+agon(竞争)+ism(名词)→对着干→对立；敌对
antagonism.e: There is deep antagonism between the two groups.
antagonism.z: 两个群体之间存在深深的敌意。

auxiliary.m: auxili(帮助)+ary(形容词)→辅助的；辅助者
auxiliary.e: The hospital has auxiliary power generators.

ultimatum.m: ultim(最后)+atum(名词)→最后的话→最后通牒
ultimatum.e: The union issued an ultimatum to management.
ultimatum.z: 工会向管理层发出了最后通牒。

dearth.m: dear(稀贵)+th(名词)→物以稀为贵→缺乏
dearth.e: There is a dearth of affordable housing.

rife.m: 联想：形近rice(米)→米粒满地都是→盛行的；充斥
rife.e: Corruption was rife in the local government.

resonant.m: re(回)+son(声音)+ant→声音回荡→共鸣的；洪亮的
resonant.e: He has a deep, resonant voice.
resonant.z: 他有一副低沉洪亮的嗓音。

flask.m: 联想：形近flash(闪光)→实验室里闪闪发亮的玻璃瓶→烧瓶
flask.e: She poured hot tea from a flask.
flask.z: 她从保温瓶里倒出热茶。

grudge.m: 联想：形近judge(裁判)→对判罚耿耿于怀→怨恨
grudge.e: He still holds a grudge against his old boss.
grudge.z: 他仍对前老板怀恨在心。

bibliography.m: biblio(书)+graphy(写,记录)→书目→参考文献
bibliography.e: Include a bibliography at the end of your essay.
bibliography.z: 在论文末尾附上参考文献。

blot.m: 联想：b+lot(很多)→纸上一大片墨→污点
blot.e: The factory is a blot on the landscape.

outcast.m: out(出)+cast(扔)→被扔出去的人→被遗弃者
outcast.e: He felt like an outcast at his new school.
outcast.z: 在新学校里他觉得自己是个被排斥的人。

meek.m: 联想：谐音"咪咪"→小猫般温顺→逆来顺受的
meek.e: She was too meek to complain.

mishap.m: mis(坏)+hap(运气)→坏运气→小事故；不幸
mishap.z: 旅途一路顺利，没出意外。

scorch.m: 联想：谐音"烤焦"→烧焦；烤焦
scorch.e: The hot sun scorched the grass.

omen.m: 直接源自拉丁omen(预兆)；联想：O, men!一声惊呼→预兆
omen.e: Many people see a black cat as a bad omen.
omen.z: 很多人认为黑猫是凶兆。

septic.m: sept(=希腊sepein腐烂)+ic(形容词)→腐败的；脓毒性的

ephemeral.m: ep(=epi在)+hemer(日)+al→只存在一天的→短暂的
ephemeral.z: 时尚潮流往往转瞬即逝。

fervent.m: ferv(沸腾)+ent(形容词)→沸腾的→热烈的；炽热的
fervent.e: She is a fervent supporter of animal rights.
fervent.z: 她是动物权利的热烈支持者。

rainwater.e: They collect rainwater to water the garden.

commonwealth.m: common(共同)+wealth(福祉)→共同福祉的群体→联邦
commonwealth.e: Australia is a member of the Commonwealth.
commonwealth.z: 澳大利亚是英联邦成员国。

ghastly.m: ghast(=ghost鬼,恐惧)+ly(形容词)→像鬼一样→可怕的；惨白的

sustenance.m: sus(下)+ten(握,支撑)+ance→从下面撑住生命→食物；生计
sustenance.e: Rice provides sustenance for billions of people.
sustenance.z: 大米为数十亿人提供食物。

instantaneous.m: instant(瞬间)+aneous(形容词)→瞬间的；即时的
instantaneous.z: 网上银行可以即时转账。

prodigious.m: prodigy(奇迹)+ous→像奇迹的→巨大的；惊人的

supersede.e: Smartphones have superseded traditional cameras for many people.
supersede.z: 对许多人来说，智能手机已取代了传统相机。

vandalism.m: Vandal(洗劫罗马的汪达尔人)+ism→故意破坏公物
vandalism.e: The bus shelter was damaged by vandalism.
vandalism.z: 公交候车亭遭人恶意破坏。

pandemic.m: pan(全)+dem(人民)+ic→全民染上的→大流行病
pandemic.e: The pandemic changed the way we work.
pandemic.z: 这场大流行改变了我们的工作方式。

entangle.e: Dolphins can get entangled in fishing nets.
entangle.z: 海豚可能会被渔网缠住。

resentful.e: He felt resentful about being ignored.

avail.e: Students should avail themselves of the library.
avail.z: 学生应充分利用图书馆。

irritable.e: Lack of sleep makes me irritable.
irritable.z: 睡眠不足让我烦躁易怒。

duly.m: due(应当的)+ly(副词)→恰当地；按时地
duly.e: The form was duly signed and returned.
duly.z: 表格已按规定签字并交回。

gape.m: 联想：gap(缺口)+e→张开大口→张嘴发呆；裂口
gape.e: Tourists gaped at the huge waterfall.
gape.z: 游客们张大嘴看着巨大的瀑布。

detriment.e: Working too much can be to the detriment of your health.

exposition.m: ex(出)+pos(放)+ition→摆出来说明→阐述；博览会
exposition.e: The book offers a clear exposition of the theory.
exposition.z: 这本书清晰地阐述了这一理论。

quarantine.m: quarant(四十)+ine→古时隔离四十天→隔离
quarantine.e: Travellers had to stay in quarantine for two weeks.

maiden.m: maid(少女)+en→少女；首次的(maiden voyage处女航)
maiden.e: The Titanic sank on its maiden voyage.
maiden.z: 泰坦尼克号在处女航中沉没。

rectify.e: The company promised to rectify the mistake.
rectify.z: 公司承诺纠正这个错误。

payload.m: pay(付费)+load(载荷)→付费运载的部分→有效载荷
payload.e: The rocket carried a payload of three satellites.

predisposition.m: pre(预先)+disposition(性情,倾向)→天生的倾向；素质
predisposition.e: Some people have a genetic predisposition to diabetes.
predisposition.z: 有些人天生易患糖尿病。

rivet.m: 联想：river(河)换一字母→跨河大桥靠铆钉固定→铆钉；吸引住
rivet.e: The audience was riveted by her performance.
rivet.z: 观众被她的表演深深吸引。

saline.e: The nurse gave him a saline drip.
saline.z: 护士给他输了生理盐水。

shimmer.m: 联想：与glimmer同韵，-mmer表闪动→微光闪烁
shimmer.e: The sea shimmered in the moonlight.
shimmer.z: 大海在月光下闪着微光。

refreshment.m: refresh(使恢复精神)+ment(名词)→提神之物→茶点
refreshment.e: Refreshments will be served after the talk.
refreshment.z: 讲座结束后将提供茶点。

cordial.m: cord(心)+ial(形容词)→发自内心的→热诚的；甜果汁饮料
cordial.z: 他们受到了热情的欢迎。

microcosm.e: The city is a microcosm of modern society.
microcosm.z: 这座城市是现代社会的缩影。

painstaking.m: pains(辛苦)+taking(付出)→付出辛苦的→煞费苦心的
painstaking.z: 修复工作需要极其细致的努力。

neurotic.m: neur(神经)+otic(病态的)→神经症的；神经质的

obedient.e: Dogs can be trained to be obedient.
obedient.z: 狗可以被训练得很听话。

oar.m: 联想：形近our(我们的)→我们一起划桨→桨
oar.e: He pulled hard on the oars.

sportsman.e: He is a keen sportsman who plays tennis weekly.
sportsman.z: 他热爱运动，每周都打网球。

brood.m: 与breed(繁殖)同源→一窝幼雏；沉思
brood.e: The hen sat on her brood of chicks.

readership.e: The newspaper has a large online readership.
readership.z: 这份报纸拥有大量网络读者。

groundbreaking.m: ground(地面)+breaking(打破)→破土动工的→开创性的
groundbreaking.e: The study made a groundbreaking discovery.
groundbreaking.z: 这项研究取得了开创性的发现。

palatable.m: palat(=palate上腭)+able(可…的)→合口味的；可接受的
palatable.e: The medicine was made more palatable for children.
palatable.z: 这种药被改得更适合孩子的口味。

optic.m: opt(眼,视)+ic(形容词)→眼睛的；视觉的
optic.e: Data travels through optic fibre cables.
optic.z: 数据通过光纤电缆传输。

inextricably.m: in(不)+ex(出)+tric(纠缠)+ably→无法从纠缠中脱出→密不可分地
inextricably.e: Health is inextricably linked to diet.

interviewee.e: Each interviewee answered the same questions.
interviewee.z: 每位受访者回答了同样的问题。

custodian.e: The museum is the custodian of national treasures.
custodian.z: 博物馆是国家珍宝的保管者。

uplifting.m: up(向上)+lift(举)+ing→把心情举高→振奋人心的
uplifting.e: It was an uplifting story of survival.
uplifting.z: 这是一个振奋人心的生存故事。

eyesight.e: Too much screen time can harm your eyesight.
eyesight.z: 看屏幕太久会损害视力。

tinge.m: ting(=tingere染)+e→淡淡的染色→色调；一丝
tinge.e: There was a tinge of sadness in her voice.
tinge.z: 她的声音里带着一丝悲伤。

jobless.e: The jobless rate rose to six percent.

tenacious.m: ten(握住)+acious(多…的)→紧握不放→顽强的
tenacious.z: 她是一位坚韧的谈判者。

stationery.m: stationer(文具商,原指固定摊位)+y→文具
stationery.e: The shop sells books and stationery.
stationery.z: 这家店出售书籍和文具。

austerity.m: austere(严厉的;朴素的)+ity(名词)→节俭；紧缩
austerity.e: Austerity measures led to cuts in public services.
austerity.z: 紧缩措施导致公共服务被削减。

vogue.m: 源自法语vogue(划行;潮流)→时尚；流行
vogue.e: Vintage clothing is back in vogue.
vogue.z: 复古服装又流行起来了。

smelly.e: The bins become smelly in hot weather.

apologetic.m: apology(道歉)+etic(形容词)→道歉的；愧疚的
apologetic.e: He was very apologetic about being late.

bleach.m: 与bleak(苍白)同源→使变白→漂白；漂白剂
bleach.z: 漂白剂会损坏有色衣物。

escalator.e: Take the escalator to the second floor.

nourishment.e: Plants get nourishment from the soil.
nourishment.z: 植物从土壤中获取养分。

stagnation.m: stagn(=stagnum死水池)+ation→像死水一样→停滞
stagnation.z: 这个国家面临经济停滞。

discord.m: dis(分开)+cord(心)→心不在一起→不和
discord.e: The issue caused discord within the family.
discord.z: 这个问题在家里引发了不和。

puncture.e: I had a puncture on the way to work.
puncture.z: 我上班路上车胎被扎破了。

additive.e: This bread contains no artificial additives.
additive.z: 这种面包不含人工添加剂。

indignant.m: in(不)+dign(值得)+ant→觉得不该如此→愤慨的
indignant.e: Residents were indignant about the rent rise.
indignant.z: 居民们对涨租感到愤慨。

misinformation.e: Misinformation spreads fast on social media.
misinformation.z: 错误信息在社交媒体上传播很快。

deft.m: 联想：形近left(左手)→连左手都灵巧→敏捷熟练的
deft.e: With a few deft movements, she fixed the machine.
deft.z: 她几下灵巧的动作就修好了机器。

mercenary.m: merc(交易,报酬)+enary→为报酬卖命的→雇佣兵；唯利是图的
mercenary.z: 军队雇用了外国雇佣兵。

infringe.m: in(进)+fring(=frangere打破)+e→打破进入→侵犯；违反
infringe.e: The new law may infringe on privacy rights.
infringe.z: 新法律可能侵犯隐私权。

sterilize.m: steril(e无菌的,不育的)+ize(使)→消毒；绝育
sterilize.e: All surgical tools must be sterilized.
sterilize.z: 所有手术器械都必须消毒。

tram.m: 联想：形近train(火车)→街上的小火车→有轨电车
tram.e: We took a tram to the city centre.
tram.z: 我们乘有轨电车去市中心。

housekeeping.e: She spends her weekends on housekeeping.

eavesdrop.m: eaves(屋檐)+drop(滴水)→站在檐下滴水处偷听→偷听
eavesdrop.e: It's rude to eavesdrop on other people's conversations.
eavesdrop.z: 偷听别人谈话很不礼貌。

fallacy.m: fall(=fallere欺骗)+acy(名词)→骗人的观点→谬论
fallacy.e: It is a fallacy that money brings happiness.
fallacy.z: 金钱带来幸福是一种谬见。

invincible.m: in(不)+vinc(征服)+ible(可…的)→不可征服的→无敌的
invincible.e: The team seemed invincible this season.
invincible.z: 这支球队本赛季似乎所向无敌。

oblique.m: 直接源自拉丁obliquus(斜的)→倾斜的；间接的
oblique.e: He made an oblique reference to the scandal.
oblique.z: 他隐晦地提到了那起丑闻。

dingy.m: 联想：ding谐音"灯"+y→灯光昏暗→昏暗肮脏的
dingy.e: They lived in a dingy flat above a shop.
dingy.z: 他们住在一家商店楼上昏暗的公寓里。

null.m: 源自拉丁nullus(没有一个)→无效的
null.e: The contract was declared null and void.

gaudy.m: 联想：谐音"高调"→打扮太高调→俗丽的
gaudy.e: She wore a gaudy dress to the party.
gaudy.z: 她穿了一件花哨俗气的裙子去派对。

tranquility.e: The garden offers peace and tranquility.

gripping.m: grip(紧抓)+ping→紧紧抓住人心→扣人心弦的
gripping.e: The novel is a gripping thriller.
gripping.z: 这部小说是一部扣人心弦的惊悚作品。

refurbish.m: re(再)+furbish(擦亮)→重新擦亮→翻新；整修
refurbish.e: The hotel was refurbished last year.

weld.m: 源自well(古义沸腾,熔化)变体→熔合→焊接
weld.e: The metal parts were welded together.
weld.z: 金属部件被焊接在一起。

elated.m: e(出)+lat(被举起)+ed→心情被举起→欣喜若狂的
elated.e: She was elated to get the scholarship.
elated.z: 获得奖学金让她欣喜若狂。

scalpel.e: The surgeon picked up a scalpel.
scalpel.z: 外科医生拿起了手术刀。

paraphernalia.m: para(旁)+pherne(嫁妆)+alia→新娘的随身物→随身用具
paraphernalia.e: The room was full of camping paraphernalia.
paraphernalia.z: 房间里堆满了露营用具。

obsess.m: ob(对着)+sess(坐)→围坐盯住→使着迷；困扰
obsess.e: He is obsessed with computer games.

outlying.m: out(外)+lying(位于)→位于外围的→边远的
outlying.e: Buses rarely reach the outlying villages.
outlying.z: 公交车很少到达边远村庄。

holocaust.m: holo(全部)+caust(烧)→全部烧掉→大屠杀；浩劫
holocaust.e: The museum tells the history of the Holocaust.
holocaust.z: 这座博物馆讲述了纳粹大屠杀的历史。

potion.e: The witch brewed a magic potion.
potion.z: 女巫熬了一锅魔法药水。

lucid.m: luc(光)+id(形容词)→明亮的→清晰易懂的
lucid.e: She gave a lucid explanation of the problem.
lucid.z: 她对这个问题作了清楚的解释。

consumerism.e: Consumerism has a heavy environmental cost.
consumerism.z: 消费主义带来沉重的环境代价。

exhort.m: ex(加强)+hort(鼓励)→极力鼓励→劝诫
exhort.e: The coach exhorted the players to try harder.
exhort.z: 教练激励队员们更加努力。

scum.m: 联想：谐音"死砍"→水面漂着砍不掉的脏东西→浮渣
scum.e: A layer of scum floated on the pond.

buoyant.m: buoy(浮标)+ant(形容词)→像浮标→有浮力的；轻快的

perceptive.m: per(完全)+cept(拿)+ive→完全领会→敏锐的
perceptive.e: She made a perceptive comment about the novel.
perceptive.z: 她对这部小说作了一番敏锐的评论。

filth.e: The streets were covered in filth.

contrive.m: 联想：con+trive形近try(尝试)→反复尝试→设计；设法
contrive.e: She contrived a way to escape.
contrive.z: 她想出了一个逃脱的办法。

perplex.m: per(完全)+plex(缠绕)→完全缠住→使困惑
perplex.e: The question perplexed even the experts.
perplex.z: 这个问题连专家都感到困惑。

pivot.m: 联想：pi谐音"劈"+vot→劈叉似的绕一点转→枢轴；关键
pivot.e: Tourism is the pivot of the local economy.
pivot.z: 旅游业是当地经济的支柱。

noxious.m: nox(伤害)+ious(形容词)→有害的；有毒的

annihilate.e: The army was annihilated in the battle.
annihilate.z: 军队在战斗中全军覆没。

indelible.m: in(不)+del(=delere删除)+ible→不可删除的→难以磨灭的
indelible.e: The trip left an indelible impression on me.
indelible.z: 那次旅行给我留下了难以磨灭的印象。

gaunt.m: 联想：形近giant(巨人)→巨人饿瘦了→瘦削憔悴的
gaunt.e: He looked gaunt after his illness.
gaunt.z: 病后他看起来憔悴消瘦。

urchin.m: 古义"刺猬"(sea urchin海胆)→刺头小孩→顽童
urchin.e: A street urchin begged for coins.
urchin.z: 一个街头顽童讨要硬币。

synchronize.e: Synchronize your phone with your laptop.
synchronize.z: 把手机和笔记本电脑同步。

placard.m: plac(=法语plaque板)+ard→贴出的板子→标语牌；布告
placard.z: 抗议者在议会外举着标语牌。

phobia.e: She has a phobia of spiders.

barter.m: 联想：bar(酒吧)+ter→在酒吧以物换酒→物物交换

consign.m: con(加强)+sign(签字)→签字交付→托运；交付
consign.e: The old furniture was consigned to the attic.
consign.z: 旧家具被扔到了阁楼上。

steadfast.m: stead(位置)+fast(牢固)→站位牢固→坚定的
steadfast.e: She remained steadfast in her beliefs.
steadfast.z: 她始终坚守自己的信念。

cardinal.m: cardin(=cardo门枢)+al→枢纽般的→首要的；红衣主教
cardinal.e: Honesty is a cardinal rule in journalism.
cardinal.z: 诚实是新闻业的首要准则。

canteen.m: 源自意大利语cantina(酒窖)→食堂；水壶
canteen.e: We had lunch in the staff canteen.
canteen.z: 我们在员工食堂吃了午饭。

departmental.e: The departmental meeting is on Monday.

extraterrestrial.m: extra(外)+terr(土地,地球)+estrial→地球外的；外星人
extraterrestrial.e: Scientists search for signs of extraterrestrial life.
extraterrestrial.z: 科学家寻找外星生命的迹象。

morbid.e: He has a morbid interest in crime stories.
morbid.z: 他对犯罪故事有一种病态的兴趣。

encryption.m: en(使)+crypt(隐藏)+ion(名词)→使隐藏→加密
encryption.z: 加密技术保障在线支付的安全。

surname.m: sur(在上,额外)+name(名)→附加的名字→姓
surname.e: Please write your surname in capital letters.
surname.z: 请用大写字母填写你的姓。

narrow-minded.m: narrow(狭窄)+minded(心思的)→心胸狭窄的
narrow-minded.e: Travel can stop us being narrow-minded.
narrow-minded.z: 旅行能让我们不再心胸狭隘。

linguistics.e: She is studying linguistics at university.

fracking.e: Fracking has been banned in several countries.
fracking.z: 一些国家已禁止水力压裂开采。

decompose.z: 塑料需要几百年才能分解。

invoice.m: 源自古法语envois(寄出的货物清单)→发票；开发票
invoice.e: Please send us an invoice for the work.
invoice.z: 请把这项工作的发票寄给我们。

fickle.m: 联想：形近tickle(挠痒)→一挠就变→变化无常的
fickle.z: 英国的天气出了名的变幻无常。

tolerable.m: toler(忍受)+able(可…的)→可容忍的；尚可的

altruistic.z: 做志愿者是一种利他行为。

cutting-edge.m: cutting(切削)+edge(刃)→刀刃最前端→尖端的
cutting-edge.z: 这个实验室使用尖端技术。

circumference.m: circum(环绕)+fer(带)+ence→绕一圈的长度→圆周
circumference.e: The circumference of the Earth is about 40,000 km.

awe-inspiring.e: The Great Wall is an awe-inspiring sight.
awe-inspiring.z: 长城是一道令人叹为观止的景观。

thought-provoking.z: 这是一部发人深省的纪录片。

chatbot.m: chat(聊天)+bot(=robot机器人)→聊天机器人
chatbot.e: Many banks use a chatbot to answer questions.
chatbot.z: 许多银行用聊天机器人答疑。

atlas.m: 源自希腊神Atlas(扛天巨人,常印于地图集封面)→地图集
atlas.e: Look up the country in the atlas.
atlas.z: 在地图集里查一下这个国家。

recline.e: You can recline your seat during the flight.
recline.z: 飞行途中你可以把座椅放倒。

syndicate.m: syn(共同)+dic(=dike判,正义)+ate→共同代理人→企业联合；辛迪加
syndicate.e: A syndicate of investors bought the club.
syndicate.z: 一个投资财团收购了这家俱乐部。

user-friendly.m: user(用户)+friendly(友好)→对用户友好的→易用的
user-friendly.e: The new app is very user-friendly.

deepfake.z: 深度伪造视频可能误导选民。

cybercrime.e: Cybercrime costs businesses billions each year.
cybercrime.z: 网络犯罪每年让企业损失数十亿。

liquidity.m: liquid(液体;流动的)+ity(名词)→流动性
liquidity.z: 银行必须保持足够的流动性。

cyberbullying.e: Schools are taking action against cyberbullying.
cyberbullying.z: 学校正在采取措施应对网络霸凌。

outdo.e: The brothers always try to outdo each other.

relapse.m: re(回)+laps(滑)+e→滑回原状→复发；故态复萌
relapse.e: He suffered a relapse after leaving hospital.

peer-reviewed.m: peer(同行)+reviewed(评审过的)→经同行评审的
peer-reviewed.e: Cite only peer-reviewed journals in your essay.
peer-reviewed.z: 论文中只引用经同行评审的期刊。

mirage.m: mir(=mirare惊奇地看)+age(名词)→看到的奇景→海市蜃楼
mirage.e: The lake turned out to be a mirage.
mirage.z: 那片湖原来是海市蜃楼。

constrict.z: 寒冷天气会使血管收缩。

concise.m: con(加强)+cis(切)+e→切掉多余→简洁的
concise.e: Keep your answers clear and concise.

zealous.m: zeal(热情)+ous(形容词)→狂热的；热心的
zealous.e: He is a zealous campaigner for clean energy.
zealous.z: 他是清洁能源的热心倡导者。

plunder.m: 源自德语plündern(抢走家什)→掠夺；掠夺品
plunder.z: 侵略者洗劫了这座古城。

tutorial.m: tutor(导师)+ial→导师辅导的→辅导课；教程
tutorial.e: I watched a video tutorial on coding.
tutorial.z: 我看了一个编程视频教程。

influencer.m: influence(影响)+er(人)→有影响力者；网红
influencer.e: Brands pay influencers to promote products.
influencer.z: 品牌付钱让网红推广产品。

invert.e: Invert the cake onto a plate.

clickbait.m: click(点击)+bait(诱饵)→诱人点击的诱饵→标题党
clickbait.e: Many news sites rely on clickbait headlines.
clickbait.z: 许多新闻网站依赖标题党式标题。

protectionism.m: protection(保护)+ism(主义)→贸易保护主义
protectionism.z: 保护主义可能引发贸易战。

trespass.m: tres(=trans越过)+pass(通过)→越界通过→擅自进入

start-up.m: start(开始)+up→刚起步的公司→初创公司
start-up.e: She works for a tech start-up in London.
start-up.z: 她在伦敦一家科技初创公司工作。

incongruous.e: The modern building looks incongruous in the old town.
incongruous.z: 这栋现代建筑在古镇里显得格格不入。

downpour.e: We got caught in a heavy downpour.
downpour.z: 我们遇上了一场倾盆大雨。

degenerate.m: de(向下)+gener(种,出生)+ate→品种变坏→退化；堕落的
degenerate.e: The debate degenerated into a shouting match.
degenerate.z: 辩论演变成了一场对骂。

surcharge.m: sur(超过)+charge(收费;装载)→额外收费；超载
surcharge.e: There is a surcharge for paying by credit card.
surcharge.z: 用信用卡付款要加收附加费。

recuperate.e: She went to the coast to recuperate.

conqueror.e: William the Conqueror invaded England in 1066.
conqueror.z: 征服者威廉于1066年入侵英格兰。

pretentious.m: pretent(=pretend假装)+ious→装腔作势的→自命不凡的
pretentious.e: The restaurant's menu was rather pretentious.
pretentious.z: 这家餐厅的菜单相当装腔作势。

cryptocurrency.m: crypto(隐藏,加密)+currency(货币)→加密货币
cryptocurrency.z: 比特币是最知名的加密货币。

crowdfunding.e: The film was made through crowdfunding.
crowdfunding.z: 这部电影是通过众筹拍成的。

package holiday.m: package(打包)+holiday(假期)→打包好的假期→跟团度假
package holiday.e: Package holidays are popular with families.
package holiday.z: 跟团度假很受家庭欢迎。

microfinance.e: Microfinance helps women start small businesses.
microfinance.z: 小额信贷帮助女性创办小企业。

hitherto.e: The study revealed hitherto unknown facts.
hitherto.z: 这项研究揭示了迄今未知的事实。

lenient.e: The judge was criticised for being too lenient.
lenient.z: 法官因判得太轻而受到批评。

layman.m: lay(世俗的,非专业的)+man(人)→外行；俗人
layman.e: Explain it in layman's terms, please.
layman.z: 请用通俗易懂的话解释一下。

engross.m: en(使)+gross(大)→写成大字；使全神贯注
engross.e: She was engrossed in her book.

sweatshop.e: Many cheap clothes are made in sweatshops.
sweatshop.z: 许多廉价衣服产自血汗工厂。

yoke.m: 与拉丁jugum(轭)同源(conjugal"结为连理")→轭；束缚
yoke.e: The country threw off the yoke of colonial rule.
yoke.z: 这个国家摆脱了殖民统治的枷锁。

tramp.m: 联想：tram(电车)+p→坐不起电车只能步行→流浪者；跋涉
tramp.e: We tramped through the snow for hours.
tramp.z: 我们在雪地里跋涉了几个小时。

blue-collar.m: blue(蓝)+collar(领子)→穿蓝色工装的→蓝领的
blue-collar.e: Blue-collar jobs are disappearing in some regions.
blue-collar.z: 一些地区的蓝领岗位正在消失。

white-collar.m: white(白)+collar(领子)→穿白衬衫的→白领的
white-collar.e: White-collar workers often sit at desks all day.
white-collar.z: 白领通常整天坐在办公桌前。

self-employed.m: self(自己)+employed(受雇的)→自己雇自己→自雇的
self-employed.z: 越来越多的人选择自雇。

hydroelectric.e: The dam supplies hydroelectric power to the region.
hydroelectric.z: 这座大坝为该地区提供水电。

offshoring.m: off(离开)+shore(海岸)+ing→移到海外→离岸外包
offshoring.e: Offshoring has moved many jobs to Asia.
offshoring.z: 离岸外包把许多工作转移到了亚洲。

haphazard.m: hap(运气)+hazard(冒险)→碰运气的→随意的；杂乱的
haphazard.e: The city grew in a haphazard way.
haphazard.z: 这座城市的发展杂乱无章。

touchy.m: touch(触碰)+y→一碰就恼→易怒的；敏感的
touchy.e: Money is a touchy subject for many families.
touchy.z: 钱对许多家庭来说是个敏感话题。

geothermal.e: Iceland relies heavily on geothermal energy.

face-to-face.z: 没有什么能取代面对面交流。

eviction.e: Many tenants face eviction after rent increases.
eviction.z: 房租上涨后许多租户面临被赶走。

diaspora.m: dia(分散)+spor(播种)+a→像种子撒开→散居侨民
diaspora.e: The Chinese diaspora is found worldwide.
diaspora.z: 海外华人遍布世界各地。

superfluous.m: super(超过)+flu(流)+ous→流溢出来的→多余的
superfluous.e: Delete any superfluous words in your essay.

lingua franca.m: 意大利语"法兰克人的语言"→中世纪地中海通用语→通用语
lingua franca.e: English is the lingua franca of business.

westernisation.z: 西化改变了当地人的饮食。

hands-on.m: hands(手)+on(在上)→亲手上阵的→动手实践的
hands-on.z: 这门课程提供动手实践的机会。

outstrip.m: out(超过)+strip→跑到前面→超过；胜过
outstrip.e: Demand for water is outstripping supply.

magnate.e: He became a wealthy shipping magnate.
magnate.z: 他成了一位富有的航运大亨。

misrepresent.m: mis(错误)+represent(描述;代表)→歪曲；误传

supplementary.z: 补充材料可在网上获取。

deluge.m: 源自拉丁diluvium(洪水)，与dilute(冲淡)同源→大洪水；泛滥
deluge.e: The office received a deluge of complaints.
deluge.z: 办公室收到了大量投诉。

wager.m: 与wage同源(古法语wage抵押)→押上的钱→赌注；打赌
wager.e: I'd wager that it will rain tomorrow.

detest.m: de(下)+test(作证)→请神作证诅咒→憎恶
detest.e: I detest waiting in long queues.

moustache.e: He grew a moustache over the summer.
moustache.z: 他整个夏天留起了小胡子。

barometer.m: baro(重,气压)+meter(计量器)→气压计；晴雨表
barometer.e: Retail sales are a barometer of consumer confidence.
barometer.z: 零售额是消费者信心的晴雨表。

rewilding.e: Rewilding projects have brought wolves back to some areas.
rewilding.z: 再野化项目让狼重返一些地区。

antecedent.m: ante(前)+ced(走)+ent→走在前面的→前情；先例
antecedent.e: The novel explores the antecedents of the war.
antecedent.z: 这部小说探究了战争的前因。

homeownership.m: 复合词：home(家)+owner(拥有者)+ship(名词：状态)→拥有住房的状态
homeownership.e: Homeownership rates have fallen among young people in big cities.
homeownership.z: 大城市年轻人的住房自有率已经下降。

trifle.m: 联想：tri(三)+fle→三块钱的小东西→琐事、少量
trifle.e: Don't waste your energy arguing over such a trifle.
trifle.z: 别在这种琐事上浪费精力争吵。

amphibian.m: amphi(两边)+bi(生命)+an(名词)→两种环境都能生活→两栖动物
amphibian.e: Frogs are amphibians that live both in water and on land.
amphibian.z: 青蛙是既能在水中又能在陆地生活的两栖动物。

utilities.m: util(使用)+ity(名词)+s(复数)→供大家使用的服务→公用事业
utilities.e: Rent includes utilities such as water and electricity.
utilities.z: 房租包括水电等公用事业费用。

high-rise.m: 复合词：high(高)+rise(升起)→高高升起的→高层建筑
high-rise.e: Many families in Hong Kong live in high-rise flats.
high-rise.z: 香港许多家庭住在高层公寓里。

kindle.m: 联想：kind(善良)+le→善意点燃心中的火→点燃；激发
kindle.e: A good teacher can kindle a lifelong interest in science.
kindle.z: 好老师能点燃学生对科学的终身兴趣。

posterity.m: post(在后)+er+ity(名词)→后来的人→子孙后代
posterity.e: We must protect these forests for posterity.
posterity.z: 我们必须为子孙后代保护这些森林。

envisage.m: en(使)+visage(面容，源自vis看)→使出现在眼前→设想
envisage.e: Few people envisaged how quickly the internet would spread.
envisage.z: 很少有人设想到互联网会传播得如此之快。

monsoon.m: 源自阿拉伯语mawsim(季节)→按季节来的风→季风；雨季
monsoon.e: The monsoon brings heavy rain to India every summer.
monsoon.z: 季风每年夏天给印度带来大量降雨。

exorbitant.m: ex(出)+orbit(轨道)+ant(形容词)→偏出轨道→过度的、过高的
exorbitant.e: Rents in central London are exorbitant for most students.
exorbitant.z: 伦敦市中心的房租对大多数学生来说过高。

frugal.m: 源自拉丁frux(果实、节俭)+al(形容词)→珍惜果实→节俭的
frugal.e: Living a frugal life helped her save for university.
frugal.z: 节俭的生活帮她攒下了上大学的钱。

destitute.m: de(离开)+stitut(站立、放置)+e→被弃置不顾的→贫困潦倒的
destitute.e: The charity provides shelter for destitute families.
destitute.z: 这家慈善机构为贫困潦倒的家庭提供住所。

remittance.m: re(回)+mitt(送)+ance(名词)→送回家的钱→汇款
remittance.e: Remittances from overseas workers support many rural families.
remittance.z: 海外务工人员的汇款养活了许多农村家庭。

fruition.m: 源自拉丁frui(享受成果)+tion(名词)→结出果实→实现、成就
fruition.e: After years of research, the project finally came to fruition.
fruition.z: 经过多年研究，这个项目终于取得了成果。

means-tested.m: 复合词：means(财力)+tested(被审查的)→经财力审查的
means-tested.e: Housing benefit is a means-tested form of support.
means-tested.z: 住房补贴是一种需经济状况审查的援助。

decrepit.m: de(加强)+crep(发出咯吱声)+it→老得咯吱作响→衰老的、破旧的
decrepit.e: The decrepit old building was finally demolished.
decrepit.z: 那栋破旧的老楼终于被拆除了。

tax evasion.m: 复合词：tax(税)+evasion(逃避，e出+vas走)→逃税
tax evasion.e: Tax evasion costs governments billions every year.
tax evasion.z: 逃税每年让政府损失数十亿。

repent.m: re(再)+pent(悔、痛苦)→一再痛苦→后悔、懊悔
repent.e: He soon repented his decision to drop out of college.
repent.z: 他很快就后悔自己辍学的决定了。

surmount.m: sur(在上)+mount(登、山)→登到上面→战胜、克服
surmount.e: She surmounted many obstacles to become a doctor.
surmount.z: 她克服了重重困难成为一名医生。

conservative.m: con(加强)+serv(保持)+ative(形容词)→一直保持原样→保守的
conservative.e: Older voters tend to be more conservative.

meddle.m: 源自拉丁miscere(混合)→混进别人的事→干涉
meddle.e: Parents shouldn't meddle too much in their children's choices.
meddle.z: 父母不应过多干涉孩子的选择。

congruent.m: con(共同)+gru(相合)+ent(形容词)→合在一起→一致的、适合的
congruent.e: His actions are not congruent with his words.
congruent.z: 他的行为和他的言语不一致。

elapse.e: Two years elapsed before the results were published.
elapse.z: 两年过去了，结果才公布。

headmaster.m: 复合词：head(首领)+master(主人)→学校之首→校长
headmaster.e: The headmaster gave a speech at the graduation ceremony.
headmaster.z: 校长在毕业典礼上发表了讲话。

goad.m: 联想：go+ad→用棒子赶它go→赶牛棒；激励
goad.e: Rising prices goaded the government into action.
goad.z: 物价上涨促使政府采取行动。

redundancy.m: re(再)+und(波浪、涌出)+ancy(名词)→一再涌出→冗余；裁员
redundancy.e: The factory closure led to hundreds of redundancies.
redundancy.z: 工厂关闭导致数百人被裁员。

glossary.m: gloss(注释，源自希腊语舌头)+ary(集合)→注释的集合→术语表
glossary.e: Check the glossary at the back for technical terms.
glossary.z: 专业术语请查阅书后的术语表。

ramble.m: 联想：ram(公羊)+ble→像羊一样到处溜达→漫步；漫谈
ramble.e: We rambled through the countryside all afternoon.
ramble.z: 我们整个下午都在乡间漫步。

maim.m: 联想：形似main，失去主要(main)肢体→使残废
maim.e: Landmines still kill and maim civilians every year.
maim.z: 地雷每年仍造成平民伤亡和致残。

monotonous.m: mono(单一)+ton(音调)+ous(形容词)→只有一个音调→单调的
monotonous.e: Factory work can be monotonous and tiring.
monotonous.z: 工厂工作可能既单调又累人。

geriatric.m: ger(老年)+iatr(医治)+ic(形容词)→医治老人的→老年病学的
geriatric.e: The hospital is expanding its geriatric ward.
geriatric.z: 医院正在扩建老年病房。

secretion.m: se(分开)+cret(分离、筛)+ion(名词)→分离出来的东西→分泌物
secretion.e: Saliva secretion increases when we smell food.
secretion.z: 闻到食物时唾液分泌会增加。

longitude.m: long(长)+itude(名词)→地图上长的方向→经度
longitude.e: The city lies at a longitude of 120 degrees east.

dismayed.m: dis(去掉)+may(力量)+ed→失去力量→灰心的、惊愕的
dismayed.e: She was dismayed by her low exam score.
dismayed.z: 她对自己低分的考试成绩感到沮丧。

robotics.e: Robotics is transforming the manufacturing industry.
robotics.z: 机器人学正在改变制造业。

thrilled.m: thrill(激动、颤动)+ed(形容词)→激动得发抖→非常高兴的
thrilled.e: I was thrilled to receive the scholarship.
thrilled.z: 获得奖学金我非常高兴。

symbiotic.m: sym(共同)+bio(生命)+tic(形容词)→共同生活的→共生的
symbiotic.e: Bees and flowers have a symbiotic relationship.
symbiotic.z: 蜜蜂和花朵之间是共生关系。

synonym.m: syn(相同)+onym(名字)→相同的名字→同义词
synonym.e: Using synonyms can improve your IELTS writing score.
synonym.z: 使用同义词可以提高雅思写作分数。

loath.m: 联想：loathe(厌恶)去掉e→厌恶去做→不情愿的
loath.e: Many people are loath to change their daily habits.
loath.z: 许多人不愿改变日常习惯。

materialistic.m: material(物质)+ist(人)+ic(形容词)→看重物质的→物质主义的
materialistic.e: Some argue that modern society is too materialistic.
materialistic.z: 有人认为现代社会过于物质主义。

chisel.m: 源自拉丁caedere(切)→切削工具→凿子
chisel.e: The sculptor shaped the stone with a chisel.
chisel.z: 雕塑家用凿子雕琢石头。

everlasting.m: 复合词：ever(永远)+lasting(持续的)→永恒的
everlasting.e: The trip left an everlasting impression on me.
everlasting.z: 那次旅行给我留下了永恒的印象。

pompous.m: pomp(盛况、排场)+ous(形容词)→讲排场的→浮夸的
pompous.e: His pompous speech bored the audience.
pompous.z: 他浮夸的演讲让听众感到乏味。

exasperate.m: ex(加强)+asper(粗糙)+ate(使)→使变得粗暴→激怒
exasperate.e: The constant delays exasperated the passengers.
exasperate.z: 不断的延误激怒了乘客。

distil.m: di(分开)+stil(滴)→一滴滴分离出来→蒸馏；提炼
distil.e: The report distils years of research into ten pages.
distil.z: 这份报告把多年研究提炼成十页。

considerate.m: consider(考虑)+ate(形容词)→替人考虑的→体贴的
considerate.e: It was considerate of you to call ahead.
considerate.z: 你提前打电话真是体贴。

penicillin.m: penicill(拉丁：小毛刷，指青霉形状)+in(化学物)→青霉素
penicillin.e: Penicillin was discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928.
penicillin.z: 青霉素由亚历山大·弗莱明于1928年发现。

inquisitive.m: in(加强)+quisit(寻求、问)+ive(形容词)→不停问的→好奇的

harrowing.m: harrow(耙地)+ing→像耙子耙过心→令人痛苦的
harrowing.e: Refugees described their harrowing journey across the sea.
harrowing.z: 难民们讲述了他们横渡大海的痛苦经历。

reticent.m: re(加强)+tic(沉默，拉丁tacere)+ent(形容词)→沉默寡言的
reticent.e: He is reticent about his private life.
reticent.z: 他对自己的私生活讳莫如深。

gregarious.m: greg(群)+arious(形容词)→喜欢合群的→爱交际的
gregarious.e: Gregarious people often enjoy working in teams.
gregarious.z: 爱交际的人往往喜欢团队合作。

defraud.e: He was jailed for defrauding investors.
defraud.z: 他因诈骗投资者而入狱。

counterfeit.m: counter(相反、对应)+feit(做)→对着真品做→伪造的
counterfeit.e: Counterfeit goods are sold openly in some markets.
counterfeit.z: 一些市场公开出售假冒商品。

empathetic.m: em(进入)+path(感情)+etic(形容词)→进入他人感情→有同理心的
empathetic.e: Good nurses are patient and empathetic.
empathetic.z: 好护士既耐心又富有同理心。

incipient.m: in(进入)+cip(拿、取)+ient(形容词)→刚开始着手的→初期的
incipient.e: Doctors can treat the disease at its incipient stage.
incipient.z: 医生可以在疾病初期加以治疗。

pester.m: 联想：pest(害虫)+er→像害虫一样烦人→纠缠
pester.e: Children often pester their parents for new toys.
pester.z: 孩子们经常缠着父母要新玩具。

genial.m: gen(出生、天性)+ial(形容词)→天性温和的→和蔼的
genial.e: Our genial host made everyone feel welcome.
genial.z: 和蔼的主人让每个人都感到宾至如归。

intelligible.m: intel(在…之间)+lig(选择、理解)+ible(能…的)→能理解的
intelligible.e: His accent made the lecture barely intelligible.
intelligible.z: 他的口音让讲座几乎听不懂。

bygone.m: 复合词：by(经过)+gone(过去)→过去的
bygone.e: The old photos remind us of a bygone era.
bygone.z: 这些老照片让我们想起过去的年代。

fluff.m: 联想：fl(飘)+uff→轻飘飘的毛→软毛；绒毛
fluff.e: The kitten was just a ball of white fluff.
fluff.z: 小猫就像一团白色绒毛。

supersonic.m: super(超过)+son(声音)+ic(形容词)→超过声音的→超音速的
supersonic.e: Concorde was a famous supersonic passenger jet.
supersonic.z: 协和号是著名的超音速客机。

henceforth.m: 复合词：hence(从此)+forth(向前)→从今以后
henceforth.e: Henceforth, all students must wear ID cards.
henceforth.z: 今后所有学生必须佩戴学生证。

loll.m: 联想：两个l像垂下的手臂→懒散倚靠；耷拉
loll.e: The dog lolled in the sun with its tongue out.
loll.z: 狗伸着舌头懒洋洋地躺在阳光下。

delude.m: de(加强)+lud(玩弄)+e→玩弄人→欺骗、迷惑
delude.e: Don't delude yourself that the exam will be easy.
delude.z: 别自欺欺人地以为考试会很容易。

respiration.e: Plants release oxygen during respiration and photosynthesis.
respiration.z: 植物在呼吸和光合作用中释放氧气。

invalid.m: in(不)+valid(有效的、强壮的)→不强壮的人→病人；无效的
invalid.e: Your ticket is invalid without a stamp.
invalid.z: 没有盖章，你的票是无效的。

microchip.e: Many pet dogs are fitted with a microchip.
microchip.z: 许多宠物狗都植入了微芯片。

sectional.m: sect(切)+ion(名词)+al(形容词)→切分的→部分的
sectional.e: Sectional interests should not override public welfare.
sectional.z: 局部利益不应凌驾于公共福利之上。

misdeed.m: mis(错误)+deed(行为)→错误的行为→罪行
misdeed.e: He apologised publicly for his past misdeeds.
misdeed.z: 他为过去的错误行为公开道歉。

landlady.m: 复合词：land(土地)+lady(女士)→女房东
landlady.e: My landlady lives on the ground floor.

adjoin.e: The library adjoins the main lecture hall.

sieve.e: Pour the flour through a sieve to remove lumps.
sieve.z: 把面粉过筛以去除结块。

deplorable.m: de(加强)+plor(哭)+able(可…的)→令人哭泣的→糟糕可悲的
deplorable.z: 工人们生活在可悲的条件下。

infest.m: 源自拉丁infestus(有敌意的)→敌人般侵扰→大批出没
infest.e: The old house was infested with rats.
infest.z: 那座老房子里老鼠成灾。

exterminate.m: ex(出)+termin(界限)+ate(动词)→赶出边界→消灭
exterminate.e: Farmers used poison to exterminate the pests.

profane.m: pro(在前)+fane(神庙)→在神庙外的→世俗的、亵渎的
profane.e: Some lyrics were considered profane by critics.
profane.z: 一些歌词被评论家认为亵渎不敬。

planetarium.m: planet(行星)+arium(场所)→展示行星的地方→天文馆
planetarium.e: We watched a star show at the planetarium.
planetarium.z: 我们在天文馆看了星空表演。

vex.m: 源自拉丁vexare(摇动、骚扰)→使烦恼
vex.e: The problem of traffic has long vexed city planners.
vex.z: 交通问题长期困扰着城市规划者。

sicken.m: sick(病、恶心)+en(使)→使生病；使厌恶
sicken.e: The cruelty of the film sickened many viewers.
sicken.z: 电影中的残忍让许多观众感到恶心。

cola.m: 源自希腊kolon(肢体、分句)，colon复数→结肠；冒号
cola.e: In anatomy, cola is a rare plural of colon.
cola.z: 在解剖学中，cola是colon的罕见复数形式。

gist.m: 联想：谐音"技术特"→抓住技术要点→要旨
gist.e: I didn't catch every word, but I got the gist.
gist.z: 我没听清每个字，但明白了大意。

shoplifting.m: 复合词：shop(商店)+lift(偷拿)+ing→商店行窃
shoplifting.e: Shoplifting has increased since prices rose.
shoplifting.z: 物价上涨后商店行窃有所增加。

counterbalance.m: counter(相反)+balance(平衡)→反向平衡→抵消
counterbalance.e: Exercise can counterbalance the effects of sitting all day.
counterbalance.z: 运动可以抵消整天久坐的影响。

forerunner.m: fore(前)+run(跑)+ner(人)→跑在前面的人→先驱
forerunner.e: The abacus was a forerunner of the calculator.

mildew.m: 联想：mild(温和)+dew(露水)→温和潮湿处长出→霉
mildew.e: Damp walls quickly become covered in mildew.
mildew.z: 潮湿的墙壁很快会长满霉斑。

tumult.m: 源自拉丁tumere(膨胀)→情绪膨胀→骚动
tumult.z: 会议在一片骚乱中结束。

pathos.m: path(感情、痛苦)+os→引起感伤的力量→感染力
pathos.e: The novel is full of humour and pathos.
pathos.z: 这部小说充满幽默与哀婉。

mannerism.m: manner(方式、举止)+ism(名词)→习惯性举止→怪癖；矫饰
mannerism.e: Actors often study the mannerisms of real people.
mannerism.z: 演员经常研究真人的习惯动作。

custodial.m: custod(看护)+ial(形容词)→看管的→监护的；监禁的
custodial.e: He received a custodial sentence of two years.

deadlock.m: 复合词：dead(死)+lock(锁)→锁死了→僵局
deadlock.e: Talks between the two sides reached a deadlock.

terse.m: 源自拉丁tersus(擦净的)→擦去多余部分→简洁的
terse.e: She gave a terse reply and left.
terse.z: 她简短地回答了一句就离开了。

cyclone.m: cycl(圆、环)+one→旋转成圆的风→气旋
cyclone.e: The cyclone destroyed thousands of homes.
cyclone.z: 这场气旋摧毁了数千所房屋。

photovoltaic.m: photo(光)+volta(伏特)+ic(形容词)→光变成电压的→光伏的
photovoltaic.e: Photovoltaic panels convert sunlight into electricity.
photovoltaic.z: 光伏板将阳光转化为电能。

shanty.m: 联想：谐音"山堤"→山堤边搭的小屋→棚屋
shanty.e: Many migrants live in shanty towns on the city's edge.
shanty.z: 许多移民住在城市边缘的棚户区。

captivating.m: captiv(俘虏，源自capt抓)+ating→抓住人心的→迷人的
captivating.z: 这部纪录片真的很引人入胜。

supposition.m: sup(在下)+pos(放)+ition(名词)→放在下面作基础→假设、推测
supposition.e: The theory is based on pure supposition.
supposition.z: 这个理论完全基于推测。

pimple.m: 联想：谐音"冒泡"→脸上冒出的小泡→丘疹、粉刺
pimple.e: Stress can cause pimples on your face.
pimple.z: 压力可能导致脸上长痘。

aftershock.e: Several aftershocks followed the main earthquake.
aftershock.z: 主震之后发生了几次余震。

euphoric.m: eu(好)+phor(带来)+ic(形容词)→带来好感觉→极度兴奋的
euphoric.e: Fans were euphoric after the team's victory.
euphoric.z: 球队获胜后球迷们欣喜若狂。

derelict.m: de(加强)+relict(遗弃，re后+lict留下)→被彻底遗弃的→废弃的
derelict.e: The derelict factory was turned into an art centre.
derelict.z: 废弃的工厂被改造成了艺术中心。

vertebrate.m: vertebr(脊椎骨)+ate(名词/形容词)→脊椎动物
vertebrate.e: Fish were the first vertebrates on Earth.
vertebrate.z: 鱼类是地球上最早的脊椎动物。

upkeep.m: 复合词：up(向上)+keep(保持)→保持好状态→维修(费)
upkeep.e: The upkeep of a large garden is expensive.
upkeep.z: 维护大花园的费用很高。

connectivity.e: Rural areas still suffer from poor internet connectivity.
connectivity.z: 农村地区网络连通性仍然很差。

jubilant.m: 源自拉丁jubilare(欢呼)+ant(形容词)→欢呼的→欢欣鼓舞的
jubilant.z: 欢欣鼓舞的人群挤满街道。

abrasion.m: ab(离开)+ras(刮、擦)+ion(名词)→擦掉→磨损；擦伤
abrasion.e: She suffered minor abrasions in the fall.
abrasion.z: 她摔倒时受了轻微擦伤。

payable.m: pay(支付)+able(可…的)→应付的；到期的
payable.e: The fee is payable before the course starts.
payable.z: 费用须在课程开始前支付。

reproach.m: re(反)+proach(接近)→迎面靠近指责→责备

tertiary.m: terti(第三)+ary(形容词)→第三的→高等(教育)的
tertiary.e: Tertiary education is free in some European countries.
tertiary.z: 一些欧洲国家的高等教育是免费的。

dilate.e: Your pupils dilate in the dark.
dilate.z: 在黑暗中你的瞳孔会放大。

causation.e: Correlation does not always imply causation.
causation.z: 相关并不总意味着因果。

plagiarism.m: 源自拉丁plagiarius(绑架者)+ism→绑架别人的文字→剽窃
plagiarism.z: 大学非常重视抄袭问题。

delectable.m: de(加强)+lect(引诱)+able→很诱人的→美味的、令人愉快的
delectable.z: 这家面包店出售美味的点心。

photocopy.e: Please photocopy this article for the class.
photocopy.z: 请把这篇文章复印给全班。

negation.e: War is the negation of civilised values.
negation.z: 战争是对文明价值的否定。

temperamental.m: tempera(调和、性情)+ment+al(形容词)→随性情变→喜怒无常的
temperamental.e: The old printer is rather temperamental.
temperamental.z: 那台旧打印机时好时坏。

malleable.m: 源自拉丁malleus(锤子)+able(能…的)→能被锤打的→有延展性的
malleable.e: Gold is a highly malleable metal.
malleable.z: 金是一种延展性很强的金属。

stratification.e: Social stratification affects access to education.
stratification.z: 社会分层影响受教育机会。

caustic.m: 源自希腊kaustos(燃烧)+ic→灼烧的→腐蚀性的；刻薄的
caustic.e: Caustic soda must be handled with gloves.
caustic.z: 苛性钠必须戴手套处理。

habitable.e: Scientists are searching for habitable planets.
habitable.z: 科学家正在寻找宜居行星。

abysmal.m: abysm(深渊)+al(形容词)→深渊般的→极差的
abysmal.e: The team's performance this season has been abysmal.
abysmal.z: 球队本赛季的表现糟透了。

rejuvenate.m: re(再)+juven(年轻)+ate(使)→使再年轻→恢复活力
rejuvenate.e: The new park has rejuvenated the old district.
rejuvenate.z: 新公园让老城区焕发了活力。

laborious.e: Translating old documents is a laborious task.
laborious.z: 翻译古老文献是件费力的工作。

conservatory.m: con(加强)+serv(保持)+atory(场所)→保存植物的地方→温室；音乐学院
conservatory.e: We had tea in the glass conservatory.
conservatory.z: 我们在玻璃温室里喝茶。

vegan.m: veg(etable蔬菜)+an(人)→只吃植物的人→纯素食者
vegan.e: More young people are becoming vegan for environmental reasons.
vegan.z: 越来越多年轻人出于环保原因成为纯素食者。

backpacker.e: The hostel is popular with backpackers.
backpacker.z: 这家青旅很受背包客欢迎。

sportsmanship.m: sports(运动)+man(人)+ship(品质)→运动员精神
sportsmanship.e: Shaking hands after a match shows good sportsmanship.
sportsmanship.z: 赛后握手体现了良好的体育精神。

languid.m: langu(松弛、无力)+id(形容词)→无力的→倦怠的
languid.e: We spent a languid afternoon by the pool.
languid.z: 我们在泳池边度过了一个慵懒的下午。

hitchhike.m: 复合词：hitch(钩住)+hike(徒步)→钩住过路车→搭便车
hitchhike.z: 他们搭便车游遍了新西兰。

whilst.m: while(当…时)+st(古英语附加音)→当…时；而
whilst.e: Some students work whilst studying at university.
whilst.z: 有些学生在上大学的同时打工。

overrated.e: Some critics say the film is overrated.
overrated.z: 有评论认为这部电影被高估了。

registrar.m: regist(登记)+rar(人)→登记者；教务主任
registrar.e: Contact the registrar to change your course.
registrar.z: 如需换课请联系教务处。

nicety.m: nice(精细、精确)+ty(名词)→细微之处；精确
nicety.e: She had no time for social niceties.
nicety.z: 她没时间讲究社交礼节。

precipice.m: pre(在前)+cip(头)+ice→头朝前栽下去的地方→悬崖
precipice.e: The economy is on the edge of a precipice.

pacify.e: The mother tried to pacify her crying baby.
pacify.z: 母亲努力安抚哭闹的婴儿。

perceptible.m: per(全部)+cept(拿取)+ible(能…的)→能感知到的
perceptible.e: There was a perceptible change in the weather.

muddle.m: mud(泥)+dle(反复动作)→搅成一团泥→混乱
muddle.e: I got into a muddle with the dates.

isle.e: The Isle of Skye attracts many tourists.
isle.z: 斯凯岛吸引了许多游客。

plaintive.e: We heard the plaintive cry of a lost kitten.
plaintive.z: 我们听到一只走失小猫哀伤的叫声。

prospectus.m: pro(向前)+spect(看)+us→让人往前看的→招生简章；说明书
prospectus.e: The university prospectus lists all courses.
prospectus.z: 大学招生简章列出了所有课程。

breadwinner.m: 复合词：bread(面包)+winner(赢得者)→挣面包的人→养家人
breadwinner.e: In many families both parents are breadwinners.
breadwinner.z: 在许多家庭中父母双方都挣钱养家。

prologue.m: pro(前)+logue(说话)→前面说的话→序言
prologue.e: The novel opens with a short prologue.
prologue.z: 这部小说以简短的序言开篇。

quench.m: 联想：谐音"灌去"→灌下水熄火、解渴
quench.e: Nothing quenches thirst like cold water.
quench.z: 没有什么比冷水更解渴。

plumb.m: 源自拉丁plumbum(铅)→铅锤；垂直；探究
plumb.e: Builders use a plumb line to check walls are straight.
plumb.z: 建筑工人用铅垂线检查墙是否垂直。

posthumous.m: post(在后)+hum(泥土，掩埋)+ous(形容词)→埋葬之后的→死后的
posthumous.e: The writer won a posthumous award.
posthumous.z: 这位作家获得了一项追授奖。

calligraphy.m: calli(美)+graph(写)+y(名词)→美丽的书写→书法
calligraphy.e: Chinese calligraphy is a traditional art form.
calligraphy.z: 中国书法是一种传统艺术。

oscillate.m: 源自拉丁oscillum(小秋千)+ate(动词)→像秋千来回摆→振动；摇摆
oscillate.e: Prices oscillated between high and low.

laudable.e: Reducing plastic waste is a laudable goal.
laudable.z: 减少塑料垃圾是一个值得称赞的目标。

overpopulation.e: Overpopulation puts pressure on housing and water supply.
overpopulation.z: 人口过剩给住房和供水带来压力。

succinct.m: suc(在下)+cinct(束紧)→束紧的→简洁的
succinct.e: Write a succinct summary of the article.
succinct.z: 写一份这篇文章的简洁摘要。

absenteeism.e: Poor working conditions can increase absenteeism.
absenteeism.z: 恶劣的工作条件会增加缺勤率。

alphabetical.m: alpha+beta(希腊字母前两个)+ical(形容词)→字母顺序的
alphabetical.e: Names are listed in alphabetical order.

plankton.m: 源自希腊planktos(漂流的)→随水漂流的生物→浮游生物
plankton.z: 鲸以微小的浮游生物为食。

storehouse.m: 复合词：store(储存)+house(房子)→仓库；宝库
storehouse.e: The library is a storehouse of knowledge.

ponderous.m: ponder(重量，拉丁pondus)+ous(形容词)→沉重的；笨重的
ponderous.e: The report was written in a ponderous style.
ponderous.z: 这份报告文风沉闷冗长。

biofuel.e: Biofuels are made from crops such as corn.
biofuel.z: 生物燃料由玉米等作物制成。

extort.e: The gang extorted money from local shops.
extort.z: 该团伙向当地商店勒索钱财。

tyrannical.m: tyrann(暴君)+ical(形容词)→暴君的→暴虐的
tyrannical.e: The people rose up against the tyrannical regime.
tyrannical.z: 人民起来反抗暴虐的政权。

bookkeeper.m: 复合词：book(账簿)+keep(保管)+er(人)→记账员
bookkeeper.e: She works as a bookkeeper for a small firm.
bookkeeper.z: 她在一家小公司当记账员。

pervert.m: per(彻底)+vert(转)→完全转向坏处→使堕落；歪曲
pervert.e: Don't pervert the meaning of my words.

tectonic.m: 源自希腊tekton(建造者)+ic→建造的→(地壳)构造的
tectonic.e: Earthquakes are caused by tectonic plate movement.
tectonic.z: 地震由构造板块运动引起。

scrupulous.m: scrupul(小石子，心里的不安)+ous→有顾虑的→一丝不苟的
scrupulous.e: She is scrupulous about checking her facts.

subliminal.m: sub(在下)+limin(门槛)+al(形容词)→在意识门槛以下→潜意识的
subliminal.z: 广告商可能使用潜意识信息。

naught.e: All their efforts came to naught.
naught.z: 他们所有的努力都化为乌有。

deflation.m: de(向下)+flat(吹气)+ion(名词)→放气→通货紧缩
deflation.z: 通货紧缩会抑制消费支出。

chaste.m: 源自拉丁castus(纯洁)→贞洁的；朴素的
chaste.e: The temple has a chaste, simple design.
chaste.z: 这座寺庙设计朴素简洁。

piecemeal.m: 复合词：piece(片)+meal(一份一份，古英语)→零碎地
piecemeal.e: Reforms were introduced piecemeal over ten years.
piecemeal.z: 改革在十年间逐步推行。

expedient.m: ex(出)+ped(脚)+ient→把脚解脱出来→权宜之计；便利的
expedient.e: Closing the road was a temporary expedient.
expedient.z: 封路只是临时的权宜之计。

delirium.m: de(偏离)+lir(犁沟)+ium→犁偏了沟→神志失常

mercantile.m: merc(商品、交易)+antile(形容词)→商业的
mercantile.e: Venice was a great mercantile city.
mercantile.z: 威尼斯曾是一座伟大的商业城市。

workaholic.e: My boss is a workaholic who never takes holidays.
workaholic.z: 我的老板是个从不休假的工作狂。

apathetic.m: a(无)+path(感情)+etic(形容词)→无感情的→冷漠的
apathetic.e: Young voters are often described as apathetic.
apathetic.z: 年轻选民常被描述为对政治冷漠。

malnourished.z: 数百万儿童仍然营养不良。

lubricate.e: Oil is used to lubricate engine parts.
lubricate.z: 机油用于润滑发动机部件。

bereavement.m: be(使)+reave(夺走)+ment(名词)→亲人被夺走→丧亲
bereavement.e: Counselling helps people cope with bereavement.
bereavement.z: 心理辅导帮助人们应对丧亲之痛。

jeer.m: 联想：谐音"嗤儿"→嗤笑→嘲笑
jeer.e: The crowd jeered at the referee.

abbreviation.m: ab(加强)+brevi(短)+ation(名词)→使变短→缩写
abbreviation.e: "UK" is an abbreviation for United Kingdom.

inexhaustible.m: in(不)+exhaust(耗尽)+ible(能…的)→取之不尽的
inexhaustible.e: Solar energy is an almost inexhaustible resource.
inexhaustible.z: 太阳能是一种几乎取之不尽的资源。

drudgery.e: Machines have removed much of the drudgery of housework.
drudgery.z: 机器消除了家务中的许多苦差事。

badminton.m: 源自英国Badminton庄园(此运动在此流行)→羽毛球
badminton.e: Badminton is very popular in China.
badminton.z: 羽毛球在中国非常流行。

platitude.m: plat(平)+itude(名词)→平淡的话→陈词滥调
platitude.e: His speech was full of empty platitudes.
platitude.z: 他的演讲满是空洞的陈词滥调。

sociable.m: soci(社会、同伴)+able(能…的)→能和同伴相处的→好交际的
sociable.e: She is sociable and makes friends easily.
sociable.z: 她善于交际，很容易交到朋友。

fastidious.m: 源自拉丁fastidium(厌恶)+ious→容易厌恶的→挑剔的

granular.e: The soil has a granular texture.

neurosis.e: Chronic stress may lead to neurosis.
neurosis.z: 长期压力可能导致神经症。

insolvent.m: in(不)+solv(解决、偿付)+ent(形容词)→无力偿付的→破产的

appreciable.m: ap(向)+preci(价值)+able(可…的)→可估价的→可观的
appreciable.e: There has been an appreciable rise in crime.

ungainly.m: un(不)+gain(古义：合适)+ly→不合适的→笨拙难看的
ungainly.e: The young giraffe walked in an ungainly way.
ungainly.z: 小长颈鹿走路笨手笨脚的。

underprivileged.m: under(不足)+privileged(享有特权的)→缺少权利的→弱势的
underprivileged.e: The charity helps underprivileged children go to school.
underprivileged.z: 这家慈善机构帮助贫困儿童上学。

terraced.m: terrace(梯田、排房)+d→成排的→排屋的
terraced.e: They live in a terraced house in Manchester.
terraced.z: 他们住在曼彻斯特的一栋排屋里。

equivocal.m: equi(相等)+voc(声音)+al→两种声音一样响→模棱两可的
equivocal.e: The minister gave an equivocal answer.
equivocal.z: 部长给出了模棱两可的回答。

vehement.m: 源自拉丁vehemens(猛烈的)→激烈的
vehement.e: She was vehement in her opposition to the plan.

botany.m: 源自希腊botane(植物)+y(学科)→植物学
botany.z: 他在大学学的是植物学。

hubbub.m: 联想：拟声词"哈布哈布"→嘈杂声
hubbub.e: The hubbub of the market faded as night fell.
hubbub.z: 夜幕降临，市场的喧嚣渐渐消失。

repatriate.m: re(回)+patri(祖国)+ate(动词)→送回祖国→遣返
repatriate.z: 没有签证的移民被遣返。

slander.m: 源自古法语esclandre(丑闻)，与scandal同源→诽谤
slander.e: He sued the newspaper for slander.
slander.z: 他以诽谤罪起诉了那家报纸。

sportswear.m: 复合词：sports(运动)+wear(服装)→运动装
sportswear.z: 运动装已成为日常时尚。

perishable.m: perish(毁灭、腐烂)+able(易…的)→易腐烂的
perishable.e: Perishable food should be kept in the fridge.
perishable.z: 易腐食品应放在冰箱里。

microbiology.m: micro(微小)+bio(生命)+logy(学科)→微生物学
microbiology.e: She is doing a PhD in microbiology.
microbiology.z: 她在攻读微生物学博士。

recidivism.e: Education programmes can reduce recidivism among prisoners.
recidivism.z: 教育项目能降低囚犯的再犯率。

excrement.m: ex(出)+cre(筛分)+ment(名词)→排出的东西→粪便

transgress.e: Those who transgress the rules will be punished.
transgress.z: 违反规定者将受到惩罚。

pliable.m: pli(折叠、弯)+able(能…的)→易弯的→柔顺的
pliable.e: Warm plastic becomes soft and pliable.
pliable.z: 加热的塑料变得柔软易弯。

york.m: 专有名词：英格兰北部城市约克，源自古名Eboracum
york.e: York is famous for its medieval city walls.
york.z: 约克以其中世纪城墙闻名。

flabby.m: flab(松弛的肉)+by(形容词)→松弛的→软弱无力的
flabby.z: 定期锻炼可防止肌肉松弛。

ruinous.e: The war had ruinous effects on the economy.
ruinous.z: 战争对经济造成了毁灭性的影响。

embezzlement.m: em(使)+bezzle(古法语：毁掉、偷)+ment(名词)→贪污
embezzlement.e: The manager was arrested for embezzlement.

bookshop.e: Independent bookshops are struggling to survive.

teem.m: 联想：team(团队)→成群成队→充满
teem.e: The coral reef teems with marine life.
teem.z: 珊瑚礁中到处是海洋生物。

torrential.m: torrent(激流，源自拉丁torrere沸腾)+ial(形容词)→倾盆的
torrential.e: Torrential rain caused flooding in the city.

ostensible.m: os(=ob,面前)+tens(伸展)+ible→伸到面前展示的→表面上的
ostensible.e: The ostensible reason for the trip was business.
ostensible.z: 这次旅行表面上的理由是出差。

venerate.e: Confucius is venerated as a great teacher.
venerate.z: 孔子被尊为伟大的老师。

kelp.m: 联想：谐音"可乐泡"→泡在海里的大海带→海带、巨藻
kelp.e: Kelp forests provide shelter for many fish.
kelp.z: 海带林为许多鱼类提供了栖身之所。

frost.e: Frost covered the fields this morning.
frost.z: 今早田野上覆盖着一层霜。

superstructure.m: super(在上)+structure(结构)→上层结构；上层建筑
superstructure.e: The bridge's superstructure is made of steel.
superstructure.z: 这座桥的上部结构由钢材建成。

manifold.e: The benefits of exercise are manifold.

gratuity.m: grat(感谢、恩惠)+uity(名词)→表感谢的钱→小费
gratuity.e: A gratuity of 10% is added to the bill.

defence.m: de(离开)+fen(打击)+ce(名词)→把打击挡开→防卫
defence.e: The country increased its defence budget.

xenophobia.m: xeno(外国人)+phob(恐惧)+ia(名词)→恐惧外国人→仇外心理
xenophobia.z: 经济危机可能助长仇外情绪。

dictation.m: dict(说)+ation(名词)→说出来让人写→听写
dictation.e: The teacher gave us a dictation test.
dictation.z: 老师给我们进行了听写测验。

zoology.e: She chose zoology because she loves animals.
zoology.z: 她因为热爱动物而选了动物学。

reverent.m: re(加强)+ver(敬畏)+ent(形容词)→虔诚恭敬的
reverent.e: Visitors stood in reverent silence at the memorial.
reverent.z: 参观者在纪念碑前肃立静默。

criterion.m: 源自希腊krites(判断者)+ion→判断依据→标准
criterion.e: Price is not the only criterion for choosing a university.
criterion.z: 价格不是选择大学的唯一标准。

roundabout.m: 复合词：round(环绕)+about(周围)→绕圈的地方→环岛
roundabout.e: Turn left at the next roundabout.

typhoon.m: 源自粤语"大风"及希腊Typhon(风神)→台风
typhoon.e: The typhoon forced flights to be cancelled.

oblong.e: The table is oblong rather than square.
oblong.z: 这张桌子是长方形而不是正方形。

obstinate.m: ob(反对)+stin(站立)+ate(形容词)→站着对着干→顽固的
obstinate.e: The obstinate child refused to eat vegetables.
obstinate.z: 那个固执的孩子拒绝吃蔬菜。

arable.e: Only a small share of the land is arable.
arable.z: 只有一小部分土地适合耕种。

perturb.m: per(完全)+turb(扰乱)→完全扰乱→使不安；扰乱
perturb.e: The rising sea levels deeply perturb scientists.
perturb.z: 海平面上升令科学家深感不安。

hibernate.e: Bears hibernate during the winter months.

infirmary.m: in(不)+firm(结实)+ary(场所)→不结实者去的地方→医院
infirmary.e: He was taken to the local infirmary.

combustible.e: Keep combustible materials away from heat.

leprosy.m: 源自希腊lepros(有鳞的)+y→皮肤起鳞的病→麻风病
leprosy.e: Leprosy can now be cured with antibiotics.
leprosy.z: 麻风病现在可以用抗生素治愈。

offence.m: of(=ob,对着)+fen(打击)+ce(名词)→打击对方→冒犯；犯罪
offence.z: 酒驾是严重的违法行为。

meteoric.m: meteor(流星)+ic(形容词)→流星般的→迅速的
meteoric.e: She enjoyed a meteoric rise to fame.

petrol.e: Petrol prices have risen sharply this year.
petrol.z: 今年汽油价格大幅上涨。

horticulture.e: He took a course in horticulture.

trinity.m: trin(三)+ity(名词)→三位一体；三个一组
trinity.e: Food, water and shelter form the trinity of basic needs.
trinity.z: 食物、水和住所构成基本需求的三要素。

fester.m: 源自拉丁fistula(管、溃疡)→溃烂；(怨恨)郁积
fester.e: Unresolved conflicts can fester for years.
fester.z: 未解决的冲突可能积压多年。

defile.m: de(加强)+file(弄脏，古英语fylan)→弄脏；玷污
defile.z: 垃圾玷污了美丽的海滩。

thesaurus.m: 源自希腊thesauros(宝库)→词语宝库→同义词词典
thesaurus.e: Use a thesaurus to find better words.
thesaurus.z: 用同义词词典找更好的词。

filial.e: Filial piety is central to Confucian ethics.
filial.z: 孝道是儒家伦理的核心。

microfilm.e: Old newspapers are stored on microfilm.
microfilm.z: 旧报纸以缩微胶卷保存。

timidity.e: His timidity made public speaking difficult.
timidity.z: 他的胆怯让公开演讲变得困难。

podcast.e: I listen to an English podcast on my commute.

perspire.m: per(穿过)+spir(呼吸)+e→通过皮肤呼吸→出汗
perspire.e: People perspire more in humid weather.
perspire.z: 在潮湿天气里人们出汗更多。

fortnight.m: 复合词：fourteen nights缩合→两星期
fortnight.e: I'll be on holiday for a fortnight.

sulphur.e: Volcanoes release sulphur into the air.

headstrong.m: 复合词：head(头)+strong(强硬)→头很硬的→任性的
headstrong.e: As a teenager, he was headstrong and rebellious.
headstrong.z: 他十几岁时任性又叛逆。

gaily.m: gay(欢乐的)+ly(副词)→欢乐地；华丽地
gaily.e: The streets were gaily decorated for the festival.
gaily.z: 街道为节日装饰得五彩缤纷。

husbandry.m: husband(古义：管家、农夫)+ry(名词)→耕作；畜牧
husbandry.e: Animal husbandry is a key part of the rural economy.
husbandry.z: 畜牧业是农村经济的重要组成部分。

eke.m: 联想：谐音"一渴"→一点点挤着补→勉强维持(eke out)
eke.e: Many farmers eke out a living on small plots.
eke.z: 许多农民靠小块土地勉强维持生计。

curable.m: cur(治疗、关心)+able(可…的)→可治愈的
curable.e: Most skin cancers are curable if found early.
curable.z: 大多数皮肤癌发现得早可以治愈。

biometric.m: bio(生命)+metr(测量)+ic(形容词)→测量人体特征的→生物识别的
biometric.z: 机场越来越多地使用生物识别扫描仪。

wearable.e: Wearable devices can track your sleep.
wearable.z: 可穿戴设备能监测你的睡眠。

practicable.e: The plan is not practicable in rural areas.
practicable.z: 这个计划在农村地区行不通。

cohabitation.m: co(共同)+habit(居住)+ation(名词)→共同居住→同居
cohabitation.e: Cohabitation before marriage is now common.

meteorology.e: Meteorology helps us predict extreme weather.
meteorology.z: 气象学帮助我们预测极端天气。

devolution.m: de(向下)+volu(滚、转)+tion(名词)→向下传递→权力下放
devolution.e: Devolution gave Scotland its own parliament.
devolution.z: 权力下放使苏格兰有了自己的议会。

matrimony.m: matri(母亲)+mony(状态)→成为母亲的状态→婚姻
matrimony.e: They were joined in holy matrimony.
matrimony.z: 他们缔结了神圣的婚姻。

unconvincing.m: un(不)+convinc(说服)+ing→不能令人信服的
unconvincing.z: 他的借口听起来不可信。

criticise.e: Critics criticise the policy for ignoring the poor.
criticise.z: 批评者指责该政策忽视穷人。

bay.m: 源自古法语baie(海湾)→海湾；(狗)吠
bay.e: We watched the sunset over the bay.
bay.z: 我们看着海湾上的日落。

handicraft.m: 复合词：hand(手)+i+craft(技艺)→手工艺(品)
handicraft.e: Tourists buy local handicrafts as souvenirs.
handicraft.z: 游客购买当地手工艺品作纪念。

rumour.m: 源自拉丁rumor(噪音、传言)→谣言
rumour.e: Rumours spread quickly on social media.
rumour.z: 谣言在社交媒体上传播迅速。

malware.e: Never open attachments that may contain malware.
malware.z: 千万别打开可能含恶意软件的附件。

navigable.e: The river is navigable for large ships.

magnanimous.m: magn(大)+anim(心、精神)+ous(形容词)→心胸大的→宽宏大量的

centenary.m: cent(百)+enary(形容词/名词)→一百周年
centenary.e: The university celebrates its centenary next year.
centenary.z: 这所大学明年庆祝建校一百周年。

pollinate.e: Bees pollinate a third of our food crops.
pollinate.z: 蜜蜂为三分之一的粮食作物授粉。

ventilate.e: Open the windows to ventilate the room.

westerner.e: Many westerners find chopsticks hard at first.
westerner.z: 许多西方人一开始觉得筷子难用。

speciality.m: special(特别的)+ity(名词)→特长；特色菜
speciality.e: Seafood is the speciality of this restaurant.
speciality.z: 海鲜是这家餐厅的特色菜。

flavour.m: 联想：fla(=fl飘)+vour→飘出的香气→味道
flavour.e: Herbs add flavour to the soup.

gentrification.m: gentry(上流阶层)+ific(使)+ation(名词)→使变成上流→中产阶级化
gentrification.e: Gentrification has pushed rents up in east London.
gentrification.z: 中产阶级化推高了伦敦东区的房租。

perplexity.m: per(完全)+plex(编织、缠绕)+ity(名词)→完全缠住→困惑
perplexity.e: She stared at the map in perplexity.

enquiry.e: Thank you for your enquiry about our courses.
enquiry.z: 感谢您咨询我们的课程。

slag.m: 联想：谐音"死垃圾"→炼铁后剩的渣→矿渣

punctual.m: punct(点)+ual(形容词)→准点的→准时的

notary.m: not(标记、记录)+ary(人)→做记录的人→公证人

eagle.z: 一只鹰在群山之上翱翔。

kilowatt.e: The heater uses two kilowatts of power.
kilowatt.z: 这台取暖器功率为两千瓦。

marginalised.e: Marginalised groups often lack access to healthcare.
marginalised.z: 边缘群体往往难以获得医疗服务。

fahrenheit.m: 源自德国物理学家Fahrenheit的姓氏→华氏温度

mucous.e: The nose is lined with a mucous membrane.

unsocial.m: un(不)+social(社交的)→不合群的；(工时)非正常的
unsocial.z: 护士常常在非正常时间工作。

epicentre.m: epi(在上)+centre(中心)→震源正上方→震中
epicentre.e: The epicentre was 20 kilometres from the city.

booklist.e: The professor gave us a long booklist.
booklist.z: 教授给了我们一份长长的书单。

flexitime.m: flexi(ble灵活的)+time(时间)→弹性工作制
flexitime.e: Flexitime helps parents balance work and family.
flexitime.z: 弹性工作制帮助父母平衡工作与家庭。

homogenisation.m: homo(相同)+gen(产生)+is(化)+ation→变得相同→同质化
homogenisation.e: Globalisation may lead to cultural homogenisation.
homogenisation.z: 全球化可能导致文化同质化。

close-up.m: 复合词：close(近)+up→近距离的→特写
close-up.e: The photo is a close-up of a bee.
close-up.z: 这张照片是一只蜜蜂的特写。

co-operation.m: co(共同)+oper(工作)+ation(名词)→共同工作→合作
co-operation.z: 应对气候变化需要国际合作。

co-operative.m: co(共同)+oper(工作)+ative(形容词)→合作的；合作社
co-operative.e: The farmers formed a co-operative to sell their crops.
co-operative.z: 农民们组成合作社出售作物。

drop-off.m: 复合词：drop(下降)+off→下降；(接送)放下
drop-off.e: There was a sharp drop-off in visitor numbers.

exhilarate.m: ex(加强)+hilar(欢乐，hilarious)+ate(使)→使非常高兴
exhilarate.e: The view from the summit exhilarated us.
exhilarate.z: 山顶的景色令我们兴奋不已。

flourishment.e: The flourishment of trade made the city rich.
flourishment.z: 贸易的繁荣使这座城市富裕起来。

full-time.m: 复合词：full(全部)+time(时间)→全职的
full-time.e: She has a full-time job at a bank.
full-time.z: 她在银行有一份全职工作。

invigilate.m: in(加强)+vigil(警醒、看守)+ate(动词)→警惕看守→监考
invigilate.z: 每场考试由两位老师监考。

low-risk.m: 复合词：low(低)+risk(风险)→低风险的
low-risk.e: Bonds are seen as a low-risk investment.
low-risk.z: 债券被视为低风险投资。

midmorning.m: mid(中间)+morning(上午)→上午中段→上午十点左右
midmorning.e: We usually have a coffee break at midmorning.
midmorning.z: 我们通常在上午十点左右喝咖啡休息。

non-drinker.e: As a non-drinker, he ordered orange juice.
non-drinker.z: 他不喝酒，所以点了橙汁。

ohp.m: 缩写：O(verhead)头顶+H+P(rojector)投影仪→投影仪
ohp.e: The lecturer showed slides on the OHP.
ohp.z: 讲师用投影仪展示幻灯片。

open-book.m: 复合词：open(打开)+book(书)→可以翻书的→开卷的

part-time.m: 复合词：part(部分)+time(时间)→兼职的

phone-in.m: 复合词：phone(打电话)+in(进来)→听众来电节目
phone-in.e: Listeners called a radio phone-in about housing.
phone-in.z: 听众致电一档关于住房的电台热线节目。

second-hand.e: Buying second-hand clothes is good for the environment.
second-hand.z: 买二手衣服对环境有益。

self-sufficient.m: self(自己)+sufficient(足够的)→自给自足的
self-sufficient.e: The farm is almost self-sufficient in food.
self-sufficient.z: 这个农场的食物几乎自给自足。

up-to-date.m: 复合词：up to(直到)+date(日期)→直到今天的→最新的
up-to-date.z: 保持你的简历是最新的。

water-clock.e: The ancient Chinese used water-clocks to measure time.
water-clock.z: 古代中国人用滴漏计时。

water-skiing.e: We went water-skiing on the lake.

wollongong.m: 专有名词：伍伦贡，源自当地原住民语，澳洲东南港市
wollongong.e: The University of Wollongong attracts many international students.
wollongong.z: 伍伦贡大学吸引了许多国际学生。
